title: PCM: A Proof-Carrying Message Protocol for Verifiable Multi-Agent Communication
summary: The paper presents Proof-Carrying Messages (PCM), a protocol in which every claim between AI agents carries evidence rather than relying on the sender's word: records from an append-only Merkle log the agent cannot write, inclusion proofs, and signatures from an attesting signer the agent cannot control. Receivers verify messages offline and assign each claim a three-valued verdict of proven, unproven or failed, with self-reported claims never rated proven. Authority is transmitted through grant chains rooted in a recorded human approval and may only be narrowed. The work specifies four claim types, a typed caveat algebra, replay rules that survive restarts, and strict readings that yield agreement among independent verifiers, and proves the resulting security properties. On a pre-specified benchmark of 926 real-run messages containing 712 lies in 16 classes, PCM accepted 10 lies, all cases of stale evidence (1.4%, 95% CI 0.8-2.6%); plain A2A accepted all 712, and models of six deployed protocols (A2A with signed Agent Cards, uAgents, RFC 9421, SCITT, AP2, Verifiable Intent) accepted 504-712. Two independent verifiers agreed on all 926 verdicts, and verification takes about 1 ms.
significance: Multi-agent systems currently authenticate the communication channel but cannot police a compromised or prompt-injected sender, allowing fabricated facts and forged authority to propagate unchecked. PCM shifts trust from the sender's assertion to externally anchored evidence, with a formal specification, proven security properties, and strong measured resistance to deception across diverse lie classes, while remaining fast and deterministic enough for deployment.

zh.summary: 论文提出携带证明消息协议（Proof-Carrying Messages，PCM），要求智能体之间的每条断言都附带证据，而非依赖发送方的一面之词：证据包括该智能体无法写入的追加式 Merkle 日志中的记录、包含性证明，以及该智能体无法控制的证明签署者的签名。接收方离线验证消息，并对每条断言给出三值判定：已证实、未证实或失败，仅凭智能体自身报告的断言永远不会被判定为已证实。授权通过以已记录的人类批准为根的授权链（grant chain）传递，且链上权限只能收窄。研究明确了四种断言类型、带类型的备注代数（caveat algebra）、可跨重启存活的重放规则，以及使独立验证器达成一致的严格语义，并证明了由此得到的安全性质。在预先指定的基准测试中，926 条真实运行消息包含 16 类共 712 条谎言，PCM 接受了 10 条谎言，全部属于过期证据（stale evidence），占 1.4%（95% 置信区间 0.8-2.6%）；纯 A2A 接受全部 712 条，六种已部署协议（带签名 Agent Card 的 A2A、uAgents、RFC 9421、SCITT、AP2、Verifiable Intent）的模型接受 504 至 712 条。两个独立验证器在全部 926 条判定上完全一致，验证耗时

title: Formalizing the Intrinsic Dimension of Objective Landscapes by a Generalized Notion of Co-dimension
summary: This work formalizes the intrinsic dimension of objective landscapes introduced by Li et al. (2018) as the minimal dimension of a random subspace in parameter space that intersects the set of interest with probability one, and shows that it is a generalized notion of co-dimension governed by the global geometry of the set. The authors study its mathematical properties and develop estimation techniques, deriving upper and lower bounds for sets of optimal parameters in student-teacher settings with shallow and deep ReLU networks, in both finite and infinite sample regimes, with and without regularization. The theory yields new forms of generalization bounds and connects symmetry classification of ReLU networks with stochastic geometry.
significance: The work supplies a rigorous geometric measure of learning complexity together with practical bounding techniques, and it builds bridges between generalization theory, the classification of ReLU network symmetries, and stochastic geometry.

zh.title: 通过广义余维数概念形式化目标景观的内在维数
zh.summary: 这项工作将 Li et al. (2018) 提出的目标景观内在维数（intrinsic dimension）严格形式化为：参数空间中与所考察集合以概率一相交的随机子空间的最小维数，并证明它是受集合全局几何控制的广义余维数（co-dimension）概念。研究者考察其数学性质并发展估计方法，在师生模型设置中针对浅层与深层 ReLU 网络的最优参数集合推导出上界和下界，涵盖有限样本与无限样本情形以及带正则化和不带正则化的情形。该理论导出新形式的泛化界（generalization bounds），并将 ReLU 网络的对称性分类与随机几何（stochastic geometry）联系起来。
zh.significance: 这项工作提供了严格的学习复杂度几何度量及实用的界估计方法，并在泛化理论、ReLU 网络对称性分类与随机几何之间建立了联系。

title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
summary: EasyProver is a Lean proving system built from recursive agents with isolated contexts, asynchronous search, parallel tactic probing, and an elastic elaboration service. Using an off-the-shelf frontier model with no additional training, it solves 669/672 PutnamBench problems, all six IMO 2026 formalizations, 597/600 NTP4VC verification conditions, and all 189 VERINA tasks by proof or refutation. The authors also introduce Aegis, a pipeline that converts competitive programming problems into harder verification tasks over real Rust implementations: it writes safe Rust solutions, translates them into Lean with Aeneas, generates specifications, and labels each frozen statement with a kernel-checked proof or refutation, yielding 2,045 differentially validated Rust-Lean program pairs and 11,533 candidate specifications. On a stratified sample of 2,000 statements, EasyProver proves 1,054 (52.7%) within 30 minutes per statement.
significance: Popular benchmarks are close to saturation, making further progress hard to assess. Aegis supplies much harder tasks carrying implementation-level obligations such as fixed-width arithmetic, explicit failure, generated loops, casts, and functionalized mutation, with frozen labels verified by the kernel. These tasks can benchmark other provers and serve as reinforcement learning rewards.

title: GTFormer: A Syntax-Free Graph Network Alternative to Transformers for 8192$\times$ Length Extrapolation in Linear Time
summary: GTFormer is presented as a syntax-free hierarchical GNN that replaces flat softmax self-attention with a bounded-degree graph over raw token streams: a balanced binary reduction tree of depth ⌈log₂ N⌉, horizontal boundary-bridging shift edges, random expander shortcuts, multi-channel convex highway gating, and a top-down broadcast pass, drawing inspiration from algebraic graph learning work (WPNet). Trained only on sequences of length N ≤ 512, the model reportedly extrapolates zero-shot to N = 4,194,304 tokens (8192× the training horizon) on a single commodity GPU in O(N) compute and memory, achieving near-perfect accuracy across eight long-context code, log, and multi-hop retrieval benchmarks where standard and RoPE Transformers degrade via out-of-distribution attention collapse or run out of memory.
significance: If substantiated, the claimed linear-time, linear-memory scaling with strong zero-shot length extrapolation would address a core bottleneck for long-context models, including proof assistants and formal reasoning tools that must process large corpora of definitions, lemmas, and tactic states within tight memory budgets. However, the abstract reports results on code, log, and retrieval benchmarks — no theorem-proving or automated reasoning benchmark appears in the evaluation, so the relevance to the stated classification rests on architectural generality rather than demonstrated prover results. Verification of the 8192× extrapolation and near-perfect accuracy claims would require checking the full paper's experimental setup and baselines.

zh.title: GTFormer：一种无语法的图网络方案，作为 Transformers 的替代，以线性时间实现 8192 倍长度外推

zh.significance: 若这些主张得到证实，所宣称的线性时间、线性内存扩展能力以及强零样本长度外推将解决长上下文模型的一个核心瓶颈，包括必须在严格内存预算内处理大规模定义、引理与策略状态语料的证明助手和自动推理工具。然而，摘要报告的是代码、日志与检索基准的结果——评估中未见定理证明或自动推理基准，因此该工作与所述类别的相关性依赖于架构的通用性，而非已展示的证明器成果。要验证 8192 倍外推与近乎完美准确率的主张，需要核查完整论文的实验设置与基线。

title: Boundary Geometry Determines Optimal Shallow ReLU Approximation under Weighted Coefficient Constraints
summary: The paper analyzes how the geometry of the boundary of a convex body $K\subset\mathbb R^d$ influences $L^q$ approximation rates of shallow ReLU networks, with targets taken from unit balls of weighted variation spaces whose output-coefficient constraints incorporate domain geometry. It gives upper and lower bounds for arbitrary convex bodies, and determines optimal polynomial approximation exponents exactly for all planar convex bodies and their products with polytopes (including cubes and circular cylinders). For $C^2$ convex bodies the optimal exponent is determined in a dimension-dependent range of $q$ extending past $2$, and for bodies with strictly positive principal curvatures this extends to all finite $q\ge 2$; in these cases a single geometric growth exponent governing small boundary caps captures the domain dependence. The work also locates sharp weight thresholds for preserving the classical approximation exponent, improves earlier weights on Euclidean balls while retaining the classical $L^2$ rate, and shows that when the target is a finite ReLU network the upper bounds can be attained by a compression reusing only the original neurons without enlarging the weighted coefficient sum.
significance: The central finding is that boundary geometry alone can alter the optimal approximation exponent even with dimension, error norm, and weighting rule held fixed, so domain shape is a genuine parameter in ReLU approximation theory rather than a constant factor. The cap-growth exponent offers a compact, computable descriptor of this effect, and the sharp weight thresholds tell practitioners exactly when weighting can be strengthened without sacrificing rate. The compression result is relevant to network pruning and minimality questions, showing rate-optimal approximants need not introduce new neurons or inflate the coefficient budget.

zh.title: 边界几何决定加权系数约束下最优浅层 ReLU 逼近
zh.summary: 本文分析了凸体（convex body）K ⊂ R^d 的边界几何如何影响浅层 ReLU 网络的 L^q 逼近速率，其中目标函数取自加权变差空间（weighted variation spaces）的单位球，其输出系数约束中纳入了定义域的几何信息。文章对任意凸体给出上下界，并对所有平面凸体及其与多面体（包括立方体和圆柱体）的乘积精确确定了最优多项式逼近指数。对 C^2 凸体，在依赖于维数的 q 范围内确定了最优指数，该范围延伸至超过 2；对主曲率（principal curvatures）严格为正的形体，这一结论扩展到所有有限的 q ≥ 2；在这些情形中，只需一个控制小边界帽（boundary caps）增长的几何指数即可刻画定义域依赖性。该工作还确定了保持经典逼近指数的尖锐权重阈值，在改进欧氏球上已有权重的同时保持经典的 L^2 速率，并证明当目标
zh.significance: 核心发现是：即使维数、误差范数和权重规则均保持不变，仅边界几何就能改变最优逼近指数，因此定义域形状是 ReLU 逼近理论（approximation theory）中的真实参数而非常数因子。帽增长指数为这一效应提供了一个紧凑、可计算的描述量，而尖锐的权重阈值精确告知实践者何时可以加强权重而不牺牲速率。压缩结果与网络剪枝及最小性问题相关，表明达到速率最优的逼近元无需引入新神经元，也无需膨胀系数预算。

title: Dependency Graphs of Mathematical Arguments: Representation, Structural Measurement, and Proof Review
summary: The paper proposes a source-grounded framework for representing mathematical arguments as finite directed acyclic dependency graphs, covering numbered and unnumbered statements, equations, assumptions, and constructions, while distinguishing source occurrences, contextual states, and inference records. Dependencies carry source evidence and review status, and a "measurement contract" fixes manuscript versions, boundaries, granularity, proof choices, and macro anchors so that measurements are reproducible. On this specified graph, depth is the longest prerequisite-path length and bulk counts distinct ancestor edges; a union recurrence handles shared subarguments, and reachability conditions are identified that preserve depth and the macro skeleton, whereas unrestricted refinement need not preserve these measures. A versioned prompt protocol separates annotation discovery, deterministic recomputation, and review assistance, and cross-paper links are proposed as a basis for studying theorem co-use, rare premise combinations, and dependency-community structure. The authors offer an evaluation design rather than empirical evidence, and explicitly caution that the measures describe a chosen representation rather than intrinsic difficulty, originality, or importance, and that suggested premises require mathematical validation.
significance: The work addresses reproducibility and measurement reliability in LLM-assisted proof analysis by decoupling the annotation pipeline (LLM-driven discovery) from deterministic recomputation and human review, with versioning contracts that make structural claims auditable across paper revisions. If validated, the framework could support probabilistic premise suggestion, detection of omissions or unchecked application conditions in both human and AI-generated proofs, source-linked reading tools, and cross-paper analyses of theorem reuse and community structure. However, the contribution is currently methodological and prospective: no empirical results are presented, and the proposed metrics capture only properties of the encoded argument graph, not mathematical significance — so downstream applications remain untested hypotheses.

zh.title: 数学论证的依赖图：表示、结构测量与证明审查
zh.summary: 本文提出一个以来源为依据的框架，将数学论证表示为有限的有向无环依赖图（directed acyclic dependency graph），涵盖带编号与不带编号的陈述、等式、假设和构造，同时区分来源出现、上下文状态和推理记录。依赖关系附带来源证据与审查状态；“测量契约（measurement contract）”固定文稿版本、边界、粒度、证明选择和宏锚点，从而保证测量结果可复现。在这一指定图上，深度（depth）是最长前提路径的长度，体量（bulk）统计不同祖先边的数量；递推并集处理共享子论证，并确定了可保持深度与宏骨架的可达性条件，而无限制的细化未必保持这些测度。一个带版本的提示词协议将标注发现、确定性重算和审查辅助分开，并提出跨论文链接，作为研究定理共用、罕见前提组合及依赖社区结构的基础。作者提供的是评估设计而非经验证据，并明确提醒：这些测度描述的是所选表示，而非内在难度、原创性或重要性；所建议的前提仍需经过数学验证。
zh.significance: 该工作通过将标注流程（由 LLM 驱动的发现）与确定性重算及人工审查解耦，并采用使结构主张在文稿修订间可审计的版本化契约，回应了 LLM 辅助证明分析中的可复现性和测量可靠性问题。若得到验证，该框架可支持概率性前提建议、在人类和 AI 生成的证明中检测遗漏或未检查的适用条件、建立来源关联的阅读工具，以及对定理复用和社区结构进行跨论文分析。不过，目前的贡献仍属方法性与前瞻性：文中没有呈现实证结果，所提指标只捕捉编码后论证图的性质，并不表示数学意义，因此下游应用仍是未经检验的假设。

title: Can LLMs Reliably Grade Olympiad Proofs? A Study of Mathematical Verification with LLMs
summary: — The paper addresses the underexplored problem of verifying natural-language Olympiad proofs with LLMs. The authors curate a dataset of USAMO 2025 candidate solutions with expert grading, and evaluate 20 models spanning seven metrics, two prompt styles, three inference methods, and three prompt templates, finding that frontier verifiers still leave considerable room for improvement. They also introduce TROJAN, an iterative self-critique pipeline for generating high-fidelity adversarial proofs at scale, and MABGrader, a Multi-Armed Bandit framework that reframes grading as arm selection over the discrete score space. MABGrader outperforms the state-of-the-art ProofGrader by 26.4% in Quadratic Weighted Kappa and reduces grading error by 14%; code and dataset are released.
significance: — Reliable automated proof verification is a key bottleneck for scaling Olympiad-level math reasoning, since expert grading is costly and limits benchmark size, training signal, and evaluation throughput. The adversarial proof generation pipeline provides a way to stress-test verifier robustness beyond naturally occurring errors, while MABGrader's bandit-based formulation delivers a concrete, reproducible improvement over the current SOTA and demonstrates that grading can be effectively treated as selection over discrete score levels. The public dataset and code lower the barrier for follow-up work on math proof verification.

title: Automatic Certified Differentiation in Lean
summary: This work presents an approach to automatic differentiation inside the Lean proof assistant that produces, alongside the derivative function, a machine-checked correctness certificate and a domain of validity. Rather than defining bespoke differentiation rules, the method reuses existing derivative theorems from Mathlib, applying them step-wise so that the proof of correctness is assembled as the derivative is constructed. Lean metaprogramming is used to inspect the symbolic structure of the input function and to synthesize the derivative expression. To make theorem search efficient, derivative theorems are indexed by the function they differentiate. Evaluated on 500 randomly generated functions, the tool differentiated all of them with a median runtime of 0.18 s per function — 8.6 times faster than the unindexed variant.
significance: Correctness of computed derivatives is a persistent concern in scientific computing and machine learning, where silently wrong derivatives can invalidate results; coupling differentiation with a formal certificate moves this from trust in the tool to a machine-verifiable guarantee. The approach also demonstrates a general pattern for symbolic-calculation tooling in proof assistants: lean on the library's existing theorem corpus instead of maintaining a parallel rule set, and index that corpus for tractable search. The reported speedup indicates that such certified automation can approach interactive-use latency, which is key to adoption for mechanized mathematics, verified numerics, and formally certified learning pipelines.

zh.title: Lean 中的自动认证微分
zh.summary: 这项工作提出了一种在 Lean 证明助理中实现自动微分（automatic differentiation）的方法，该方法除生成导函数外，还产出一份机器检查的正确性证书以及定义域。该方法不定义专门的微分规则，而是复用 Mathlib 中现有的求导定理，并以逐步方式应用它们，使得正确性证明随导数的构造一同组装完成。Lean 元编程用于检查输入函数的符号结构，并综合生成导数表达式。为提高定理搜索效率，求导定理按其所微分的函数进行索引。在 500 个随机生成的函数上评估时，该工具成功对全部函数完成求导，每个函数的中位运行时间为 0.18 秒——比未索引版本快 8.6 倍。
zh.significance: 在科学计算（scientific computing）和机器学习（machine learning）中，计算导数的正确性始终是一个令人关切的问题，因为静默错误的导数会使结果失效；将微分与形式化证书相结合，可将信任基础从“相信工具”转变为“机器可验证的保证”。该方法还展示了证明助理中符号计算工具的一种通用模式：利用库中现有的定理语料，而不是维护一套平行的规则集，并对该语料进行索引以实现可行的搜索。所报告的加速比表明，这类认证自动化已能接近交互式使用的延迟水平，这对于形式化数学（mechanized mathematics）、经验证的数值计算（verified numerics）以及形式认证的学习管道（formally certified learning pipelines）的推广至关重要。

title: Reasoning about the Genetic Code in Lean
summary: The work presents a machine-verified formalization of the central dogma of molecular biology in Lean 4. Nucleic acid bases and amino acids are encoded as inductive types, with transcription (DNA→RNA) and translation (RNA→polypeptide) defined as functions. Within this framework the authors prove properties including the redundancy of the genetic code, injectivity of transcription, and non-injectivity of translation — the latter capturing the fact that multiple nucleotide sequences can encode the same amino acid sequence. Auxiliary processes such as DNA replication and mutation are also formalized, with verified properties including length conservation under transcription and point mutations. The paper further reports that Lean 4's type checking helped prevent semantic errors during development.
significance: The genetic code's non-injectivity is a standard biological fact, but this work shows it can be stated and proven rigorously in a mainstream interactive theorem prover, connecting formal methods with life-science modeling. Verified length-conservation and injectivity results illustrate how mechanized reasoning can catch semantic mistakes in scientific code that testing alone may miss. As a Theorem Proving contribution, it broadens the demonstrated application domain of Lean 4 beyond mathematics into computational biology, and provides a small, tractable case study for provers as tools for reliable scientific computing.

zh.title: 在 Lean 中推理遗传密码
zh.summary: 这项工作给出了分子生物学中心法则在 Lean 4 中的一个机器验证形式化。核酸碱基和氨基酸被编码为归纳类型（inductive types），转录（DNA→RNA）和翻译（RNA→多肽）被定义为函数。在此框架内，作者证明了包括遗传密码的冗余性、转录的单射性以及翻译的非单射性等性质——后者刻画了多条核苷酸序列可以编码相同氨基酸序列这一事实。DNA 复制和突变等辅助过程也被形式化，并验证了转录和点突变下的长度守恒等性质。论文还报告称，Lean 4 的类型检查（type checking）有助于在开发过程中避免语义错误。
zh.significance: 遗传密码的非单射性是一个标准的生物学事实，但这项工作表明它可以在主流交互式定理证明器中被严格陈述和证明，从而将形式化方法与生命科学建模联系起来。经过验证的长度守恒和单射性结果说明，机械化推理如何能够捕捉仅靠测试可能遗漏的科学代码中的语义错误。作为定理证明（Theorem Proving）方向的贡献，它将 Lean 4 的已展示应用领域从数学拓展到计算生物学，并提供了一个小而易于处理的案例研究，说明证明器可作为可靠科学计算的工具。

title: How Stable Are LLM-Generated Proofs Under Program Refactoring? A Stress Test for Verifiable Code Generation
summary: RefactorProof tests whether Lean proofs survive behavior-preserving program refactoring: it produces 458 Lean-certified variants from the 185 VERINA tasks that compile in a pinned environment, keeping the specification and evaluated proof byte-for-byte fixed. Because VERINA supplies reference proofs for only 46 tasks (all in the basic split), the main model-versus-reference comparison is confined to 21–25 matched short, non-recursive tasks. Structural refactorings prove highly brittle: task-normalized structural proof survival rate is 4.3% for the supplied references versus 13.3–26.8% for the specialized provers. On the matched tasks, prover proofs have higher unchanged-proof survival than the references by +15.6 points (DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B), +18.8 (Goedel-Prover-V2-32B), and +20.3 (Goedel-Prover-V2-8B), with all 95% CIs excluding zero; this ordering holds after excluding universally survived T1 variants, under family-balanced aggregation, and under alternative deployable valid-proof selection rules. Failure is not equivalent to expensive maintenance: predefined one-identifier edits repair 51/54 eligible reference structural failures and 58/85 eligible prover failures, so the benchmark measures unchanged-proof stability rather than repair cost.

title: Proofs of strong forms of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture and a complex analogue
summary: The paper establishes two universality results for single-neuron neural networks. Over finite fields, it proves a strong form of the Bovdi–Geche universality conjecture, where a single neuron with an activation function given by a modified discrete logarithm can realize arbitrary functions; the argument relies on the Weil bound for multiplicative character sums over finite fields, which controls the relevant exponential-type sums. In the complex setting, the authors extend Aizenberg's universality theorem for complex binary neurons, showing in addition that the weight vector can be chosen independently of the target function; this is obtained from an equidistribution theorem describing the distribution of dilates of certain maps into tori.
significance: These results give definitive answers to questions left open in the literature on the expressive power of single neurons, a minimal architecture whose universality is far from automatic over finite or complex domains. The finite-field theorem resolves (in a strong form) the Bovdi–Geche conjecture and demonstrates that arithmetic tools — notably Weil's character-sum bounds — yield sharp representation results in discrete settings. The complex result shows that a *fixed* weight vector suffices for universal approximation of complex binary neurons, a genuinely stronger uniformity statement than standard universality claims, and the torus equidistribution machinery behind it may transfer to other approximation problems.

zh.title: 波夫迪–格切普遍性猜想（Bovdi–Geche universality conjecture）强形式及其复数域类比的证明
zh.summary: 本文建立了单神经元神经网络的两项普遍性结果。在有限域（finite fields）上，论文证明了波夫迪–格切普遍性猜想的强形式：激活函数取为修正离散对数的单个神经元可以实现任意函数；证明依赖于有限域上乘法特征和（multiplicative character sums）的韦伊界（Weil bound），用以控制相关的指数型和。在复数域情形中，作者推广了艾岑贝格（Aizenberg）关于复二值神经元的普遍性定理，并进一步证明权向量可以独立于目标函数而选取；这一结果源于一条等分布定理（equidistribution theorem），该定理描述了某些映射在环面（tori）中的伸缩像的分布。
zh.significance: 这些结果对文献中关于单神经元表达能力的悬而未决问题给出了明确回答——单神经元是极简架构，其在有限域或复数域上的普遍性远非自动成立。有限域定理以强形式解决了波夫迪–格切猜想，并表明算术工具——尤其是韦伊的特征和界——可在离散情形中导出尖锐的表示结果。复数域结果表明，一个固定的权向量即足以使复二值神经元实现普遍逼近，这比通常的普遍性陈述具有真正更强的一致性，而其背后的环面等分布方法也可能迁移到其他逼近问题中。

title: KAPPA: Checking the Proofs in Statistics Papers with Lean 4 and Language Model Agents
summary: KAPPA ("Kit of Agents for Proof-checking Papers with a proof Assistant") is open-source software that orchestrates language model agents (run by Claude Code) to translate the proofs of a LaTeX statistics paper into Lean 4 with Mathlib and check them result by result. Each numbered result receives one of four verdicts: verified unconditionally; verified conditionally, with all cited or unproved inputs recorded as named hypotheses; issue recorded, with location and the side at fault; or unfinished, with a reason. The system follows the paper's existing proof rather than inventing new ones, uses separate writer and reviewer agents, compares each statement with the paper before proving it and fingerprints it afterward, and bases every verdict on evidence rerunnable without a language model. It runs unattended for hours, tolerates usage limits, re-checks only revision-affected material, and reports cost by role, model, and result. The paper presents the design and a full walkthrough, then applies the kit to four example papers with answer keys and to three published statistical papers checked blind on versions predating public corrections: in all three, the kit located the published error at the exact step named in the correction and surfaced further problems confirmed by hand. zh.title: KAPPA：使用 Lean 4 与语言模型智能体检查统计学论文中的证明
zh.summary: KAPPA（“Kit of Agents for Proof-checking Papers with a proof Assistant”）是一款开源软件，它编排由 Claude Code 运行的语言模型智能体，把一篇 LaTeX 统计学论文的证明翻译成 Lean 4 与 Mathlib 中的形式，并逐条检查每个结果。每个编号结果会得到四种判定之一：无条件验证通过；有条件验证通过，并把所有被引用或未证明的输入记录为具名假设；记录问题，注明位置及责任方；未完成，并说明原因。该系统沿用论文现有的证明而非另创证明，使用彼此独立的撰写智能体与评审智能体，在证明前将每个陈述与论文原文比对、在证明后为其生成指纹，并使每项判定都建立在无需语言模型即可重新运行的证据之上。它可无人值守地运行数小时，能容忍使用额度限制，仅重新检查受修订影响的部分，并按角色、模型与结果报告成本。论文介绍了系统设计与完整流程演示，随后将该工具包应用于四篇附有答案的示例论文，以及三篇按公开勘误之前版本盲检的已发表统计学论文：在这三篇中，该工具包都在勘误所指的那一步精确定位了已发表的错误，并发现了经人工核实的其他问题。在直接对比中，同一个语言模型在不使用该工具包而仅用 Lean 时，在最长的那篇论文上正确判定的结果更少，并把某些比论文原文更窄的陈述报告为已证明，而
zh.significance: 它把大语言模型生成的数学证明从“看起来正确”推进到可由 Lean 4 与 Mathlib 机械复核、证据可独立重放的层面；在盲检中精确定位已发表论文被勘误确认的错误，表明这类工具可用于统计学文献的系统性质量审查；而与无工具包使用 Lean 的直接对比显示，智能体编排、陈述比对与指纹校验等工程设计本身是可靠性的关键来源。

title: Agentic Algorithm Design: LLMs that Propose, Formalise, and Prove Runtime Bounds for Evolutionary Algorithms in Lean
summary: The paper presents a staged agentic pipeline, modelled on the design-and-analysis methodology of evolutionary algorithm research, in which an LLM proposes black-box optimisation algorithms, Lean-based guards reject flawed designs, and the agent then supplies a potential function and proves drift bounds yielding expected-runtime guarantees — with no empirical comparison at any stage. Reported outcomes: an algorithm with expected runtime O(n²) on a CycleUncover problem where the classical (1+1) EA requires e^{Ω(n)}, an algorithm for integer-valued submodular minimisation with expected runtime O(n^{2+2c)}, and a match of the classical O(n²) runtime on LeadingOnes. Across 8 problem classes, 12 of 15 runs with frontier models produced a machine-checked expected-runtime bound. An ablation shows that without staging — asking for a zero-shot design with runtime guarantee — the agent returns a copy of the seeded random-search baseline or leaves proofs incomplete. The authors claim this is the first automated pipeline that designs efficient black-box optimisation algorithms with machine-checked runtime bounds in Lean.
significance: This is evidence that LLM agents can jointly design algorithms and certify their efficiency in a proof assistant, closing a gap between empirical LLM-guided heuristic discovery (e.g., AlphaEvolve) and LLM-assisted theorem proving on pre-stated claims. The ablation indicates that decomposition mirroring the human research workflow, not raw model capability alone, is what makes the pipeline succeed, and the results support the provocative thesis that machine-checked specifications can substitute for empirical benchmarking in algorithm discovery. Caveats: the guarantees are expected-runtime bounds on selected problem classes (12/15 runs succeeded, so failures remain), "first of its kind" is asserted only to the authors' knowledge, and the absence of empirical evaluation means no claims are made about practical performance versus tuned heuristics.

zh.title: 智能体式算法设计：在 Lean 中提出、形式化并证明演化算法（evolutionary algorithms）运行时间界的 LLM
zh.summary: 该论文提出一个分阶段的智能体流程，其建模方式沿用演化算法研究中的设计—分析方法论：由 LLM 提出黑箱优化（black-box optimisation）算法，基于 Lean 的守卫机制拒绝有缺陷的设计，随后智能体给出势函数（potential function）并证明漂移界（drift bounds），从而获得期望运行时间（expected runtime）保证——整个过程任何阶段均不进行实证比较。报告的结果包括：在 CycleUncover 问题上得到期望运行时间 O(n²) 的算法，而经典 (1+1) EA 需要 e^{Ω(n)}；一个用于整数值子模函数最小化（submodular minimisation）的算法，期望运行时间为 O(n^{2+2c})；以及在 LeadingOnes 上达到经典的 O(n²) 运行时间。在 8 个问题类别中，使用前沿模型的 15 次运行里有 12 次产生了机器检验（machine-checked）的期望运行时间界。消融实验表明，若去掉分阶段设计，改为一次性要求提出带运行时间保证的算法，智能体只会返回种子随机搜索基线的副本，或无法完成证明。作者声称这是首个在 Lean 中设计出具有机器检验运行时间界的高效黑箱优化算法的自动化流程。
zh.significance: 这一结果证明 LLM 智能体能够同时设计算法并在证明助理（proof assistant）中认证其效率，从而弥合了实证式 LLM 引导启发式发现（如 AlphaEvolve）与针对预先陈述命题的 LLM 辅助定理证明（theorem proving）之间的差距。消融实验表明，使流程成功的因素是模仿人类研究工作流的任务分解，而非仅靠模型的原始能力；这些结果也支持一个颇具争议性的论点：机器检验的规范可以替代算法发现中的实证基准测试。需要注意的是，这些保证仅针对所选问题类别的期望运行时间界（15 次运行中有 12 次成功，仍存在失败情形），“首创”仅是作者在自身知识范围内的断言，而且由于缺少实证评估，无法就其相对于经过调优的启发式方法的实际性能作出任何声明。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文的智能体 LLM 流水线提出黑盒优化算法，并给出势函数，借助 Lean 证明漂移界，得到机器检查的期望运行时间保证，包括在 CycleUncover 上 O(n²) 运行时间（经典 (1+1) EA 为 e^{Ω(n)}），并匹配 LeadingOnes 的 O(n²) 界；在 8 个问题类别中，15 次运行有 12 次得到经验证的界。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了分阶段的智能体流水线，构建了用于拒绝有缺陷算法设计的 Lean 守卫，并提供了用于比较及零样本消融实验的随机搜索基线。

title: Proof-of-Agentness: Towards Verifying Agents on the Web
summary: The paper introduces "Proof-of-Agentness" (PoA), a mechanism for a Web service to obtain evidence that a client is an LLM-powered agent rather than a simple bot or script, motivated by a parallel between human attention and an agent's inference (token) resources. Two approaches are outlined: active verification via challenge-response, and passive analysis of service-visible signals. In the active evaluation, eight language models achieved 96.5% overall accuracy on the challenges with an average overhead of 1,647 tokens. In the passive evaluation, an IRB-approved user study comparing Web interactions of twelve human participants against representative Bot and Agent implementations yielded 95.8% average classification accuracy across four classifiers.
significance: As Web services begin accepting agents as legitimate users, the ability to distinguish them from abusive automation becomes a practical resource-allocation and anti-abuse problem; these results suggest both active and passive PoA signals are usable in principle, though the studies are small-scale (twelve human participants) and the numbers are empirical evaluation results rather than formal guarantees. Note that the paper's classification as "LLM for Mathematics (Math-specialized models)" appears misassigned: the work concerns Web agent verification and involves no mathematics-specific modeling or mathematical benchmarks, so its relevance to a math-specialized-models track is indirect at best.

zh.title: 智能体身份证明（Proof-of-Agentness）：迈向对网络智能体的验证
zh.summary: 本文提出"智能体身份证明"（Proof-of-Agentness，PoA），一种让 Web 服务获得证据以确认客户端是由大语言模型驱动的智能体而非简单机器人或脚本的机制，其动机源自人类注意力与智能体推理（token）资源之间的类比。文中概述了两种方法：通过挑战-响应进行主动验证，以及对服务可见信号进行被动分析。在主动评估中，八个语言模型在挑战任务上取得了 96.5% 的总体准确率，平均开销为 1,647 个 token。在被动评估中，一项经 IRB 批准的用户研究将十二名人类参与者的 Web 交互与具有代表性的 Bot 和 Agent 实现进行比较，四个分类器的平均分类准确率达到 95.8%。
zh.significance: 随着 Web 服务开始将智能体接纳为合法用户，将其与恶意自动化区分开来便成为一个实际的资源分配与反滥用问题；这些结果表明，主动和被动的 PoA 信号原则上均可使用，不过研究规模较小（十二名人类参与者），且相关数字是经验性评估结果而非形式化保证。值得注意的是，论文被归入"数学大语言模型（LLM for Mathematics，专用数学模型）"类似乎是误分类：该工作涉及网络智能体验证，并未涉及任何数学专用建模或数学基准测试，因此其与专用数学模型方向的关联充其量只是间接的。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文报告了 AI 系统的评测得分：八个语言模型在 Proof-of-Agentness 主动挑战上取得 96.5% 的总体准确率，四个分类器在区分人类、Bot 与 Agent 的 Web 交互时取得 95.8% 的平均准确率。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了 PoA 机制及其主动挑战-响应与被动信号分析两种方法，构建了评测挑战，并开展了经 IRB 批准、由十二名人类参与者组成的用户研究以提供对比数据。

title: MechAlign: Evaluating Semantic Alignment at the Project Level in Mathematical Formalization
summary: MechAlign addresses the gap between what Lean verifies (that a formal proof establishes its stated proposition under its assumptions) and whether that proposition faithfully expresses the manuscript's mathematical claim—a question requiring interpretation of the main theorem through project dependencies scattered across a large development. The framework combines LeanTrace, a dependency extraction tool that builds a statement dependency graph from elaborated declarations while retaining definition bodies and structure constraints, excluding proof bodies, and stopping at an explicit library boundary, with an LLM-based reviewer that investigates alignment and reports discrepancies with localized evidence. A preliminary review covers 201 main results from 173 OpenAI Math projects using supplied informal descriptions and available paper context; a hyperbolic-group case study shows how dependency inspection localizes a missing dimensional constraint relative to the manuscript, consistent with the upstream declaration of formalization scope. The paper also introduces LeanReviewBench, a benchmark of 501 fixed claim-statement-context triples drawn from OpenAI Math, Fermat's Last Theorem, and Kakeya, with description provenance recorded.
significance: Project-level semantic alignment is a distinct failure mode from proof correctness: a proof can be fully machine-checked yet formalize a claim weaker or otherwise different than the intended theorem, and existing prover tooling offers no guarantee against this. By extracting only statement-relevant dependency context (excluding proof bodies and bounding scope at a library boundary), LeanTrace gives LLM reviewers interpretable, localized evidence for judging correspondence, which supports auditable discrepancy reports rather than ungrounded judgments. LeanReviewBench's fixed triples and provenance tracking enable controlled, reproducible comparisons across alignment evaluation methods—important since informal descriptions and paper context vary in availability and quality. As a preliminary contribution scoped to OpenAI Math projects with a single illustrative case, its evaluation is limited in size and breadth, but it establishes tooling and benchmarks that could make semantic fidelity a checkable step in formalization pipelines.

zh.title: MechAlign：评估数学形式化中的项目级语义对齐
zh.summary: MechAlign 旨在填补 Lean 所验证的内容（即形式化证明确实在其假设下证明了所述命题）与该命题是否忠实表达论文中的数学主张之间的鸿沟——回答后一个问题需要在大型开发项目中通过散布于各处的项目依赖来解读主定理（main theorem）。该框架结合了 LeanTrace 与一个基于 LLM 的审阅器：LeanTrace 是一个依赖提取工具，它从已推导完成的声明中构建命题依赖图（statement dependency graph），保留定义体和结构约束，排除证明体，并在显式的库边界处停止；LLM 审阅器则调查对齐情况，并附带定位证据报告差异。初步评审覆盖了 173 个 OpenAI Math 项目中的 201 个主要结果，使用所提供的非形式化描述及可用的论文背景；一个双曲群（hyperbolic group）案例研究表明，依赖检查如何定位相对于论文缺失的维数约束，这与形式化范围的上游声明一致。论文还提出了 LeanReviewBench，一个包含 501 个固定的“主张—陈述—上下文”三元组的基准，数据来自 OpenAI Math、费马大定理（Fermat's Last Theorem）和 Kakeya，并记录了描述的来源信息。
zh.significance: 项目级语义对齐是区别于证明正确性（proof correctness）的一种失败模式：一个证明可以完全通过机器检查，却形式化了一个弱于或以其他方式不同于预期定理的主张，而现有的证明器工具无法对此提供任何保证。通过仅提取与命题相关的依赖上下文（排除证明体并在库边界处限定范围），LeanTrace 为 LLM 审阅器提供可解释的、定位明确的证据来判断对应关系，从而支持可审计的差异报告，而非无根据的判断。LeanReviewBench 的固定三元组与来源追踪使对齐评估方法之间的受控、可复现比较成为可能——这一点很重要，因为非形式化描述和论文背景的可用性与质量参差不齐。作为一项以 OpenAI Math 项目为范围、仅含一个示例性案例的初步贡献，其评估在规模和广度上均有限，但它建立了工具和基准，有望使语义保真度成为形式化流水线中的一个可检查步骤。
zh.aiRoleDescription: MechAlign 中基于 LLM 的评审器考察 Lean 形式化语句是否忠实于论文原意，并报告带有定位证据的差异，包括对 201 个主要结果的初步评审，以及一个识别出缺失维度约束的案例研究。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了该框架，构建了 LeanTrace 依赖提取工具，提供了非形式化描述与论文上下文，并整理了带有描述来源记录的 LeanReviewBench。

title: Connecting Quantum Proof Systems and Hoare Logic
summary: The paper argues that quantum program verification need not be harder than verifying classical array programs of the kind used in parallel programming. It defines a translation of the Qafny quantum proof system into Hoare logic with array theory, claiming completeness (every Qafny proof maps to a valid Hoare triple) and soundness (a valid translated triple certifies only true quantum specifications); the completeness direction is mechanized in Rocq. The embedding determinizes quantum proof obligations and thereby opens quantum code to off-the-shelf classical verification tooling such as Dafny and SMT-based separation logic, and it supplies a correctness guarantee that the prior Qafny-to-Dafny compilation did not provide.
significance: Formal verification is presented as the only practical route to quantum software correctness since runtime testing is ineffective for quantum programs, yet bespoke proof systems in Rocq, Lean, Isabelle, or Why3 impose heavy human effort even on modest algorithms. By reducing quantum verification to classical array reasoning and reusing mature automated verifiers, the approach targets the stated bottleneck of scalable quantum software assurance. As the mechanization covers only the completeness direction, the work represents a proof-of-concept reduction rather than a fully verified end-to-end toolchain.

zh.title: 连接量子证明系统与霍尔逻辑（Hoare logic）
zh.summary: 该论文主张，量子程序验证的难度不必高于并行编程中所用的那类经典数组程序的验证。论文定义了从 Qafny 量子证明系统到带数组理论（array theory）的霍尔逻辑的翻译，并声称其具有完备性（completeness，即每个 Qafny 证明都映射为一个有效的霍尔三元组）与可靠性（soundness，即有效的翻译后三元组仅能保证真实的量子规格）。完备性方向已在 Rocq 中机械化。该嵌入将量子证明义务确定化，从而把量子代码向 Dafny 和基于 SMT 的分离逻辑（separation logic）等现成经典验证工具开放，并提供了先前 Qafny 到 Dafny 编译所不具备的正确性保证。
zh.significance: 由于运行时测试对量子程序效果不佳，形式化验证被呈现为确保量子软件正确性的唯一现实途径，而在 Rocq、Lean、Isabelle 或 Why3 中使用专用证明系统，即使针对规模不大的算法也需要大量人力投入。通过将量子验证归约为经典数组推理并复用成熟的自动验证器，该方法瞄准了量子软件保障可扩展性这一公认瓶颈。由于机械化仅覆盖完备性方向，这项工作属于概念验证性的归约，而非完全验证的端到端工具链。

title: Propositional formula minimization is $Σ_2^p$-complete under many-one reductions
summary: The note addresses Minimum Equivalent Expression (MEE): given a propositional formula φ and integer k, decide whether φ is equivalent to some formula using at most k variable occurrences. Membership in Σ₂ᵖ is straightforward; Buchfuhrer and Umans (2008) proved Σ₂ᵖ-completeness under polynomial-time Turing reductions, while many-one completeness had been open since at least 1979. The note claims a new proof of Σ₂ᵖ-completeness under polynomial-time many-one reductions, attributed to the system GPT-Sol-6.1. Note that this report reflects the authors' claim; I have not verified the proof or the reduction construction.
significance: A many-one reduction would close a longstanding gap and is a strictly stronger hardness statement than Turing reducibility, ruling out oracle-aided shortcuts in the reduction itself. It would place formula minimization firmly as a canonical Σ₂ᵖ-complete problem and sharpen fine-grained and approximation analyses of propositional simplification. If the proof checks out, it would also be a notable instance of an AI system resolving a four-decade-old open complexity-class gap, meriting careful human review of the reduction.

zh.title: 命题公式最小化在多一归约下是 Σ₂ᵖ 完全的
zh.summary: 该笔记讨论极小等价表达式（Minimum Equivalent Expression, MEE）问题：给定一个命题公式 φ 和整数 k，判定是否存在一个至多使用 k 次变元出现的公式与 φ 等价。属于 Σ₂ᵖ（Σ₂ᵖ）是直接的；Buchfuhrer 与 Umans（2008）证明了在多项式时间图灵归约（Turing reductions）下的 Σ₂ᵖ 完全性，而在多一归约（many-one reductions）下的完全性自至少 1979 年以来一直悬而未决。该笔记声称给出了一种在多项式时间多一归约下 Σ₂ᵖ 完全性的新证明，并将其归功于系统 GPT-Sol-6.1。请注意，本报告仅反映作者的主张；我尚未验证该证明或归约构造。
zh.significance: 多一归约将弥合这一长期存在的缺口，是一种严格强于图灵可归约性的困难性结论，从而排除归约本身中借助预言机的捷径。它将把公式最小化问题确立为一个典型的 Σ₂ᵖ 完全问题，并推进对命题简化的细粒度分析与近似分析。若该证明经检验成立，这也将是人工智能系统解决一个长达四十年的复杂性类开放缺口的显著实例，值得人类对该归约进行仔细审查。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 该札记声称给出了 Minimum Equivalent Expression 在多项式时间 many-one 归约下 Σ₂ᵖ-完全的新证明，解决了自至少 1979 年以来的悬而未决问题；该证明被归于系统 GPT-Sol-6.1。

title: Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers
summary: The paper proposes a joint proof framework for Lean 4 that unifies candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation in a single reasoning call, avoiding the cost of searching proofs for each candidate separately. A trained prover either selects a supplied candidate or proposes a new answer and generates a proof for at least one answer, and generated proofs can be reused to detect faithfulness errors: when two distinct answers both yield verifiable proofs for the same formal statement of a problem with a unique answer, the statement fails to faithfully encode the original problem. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, the framework matches the formal proof success rate of per-candidate proof generation at roughly one sixth the token cost and flags at least 6.1% of formalized statements as unfaithful without extra judges. Model and code are released at https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover.
significance: Per-candidate proof search is a major source of redundant compute in pipelines where upstream solvers emit multiple answers; demonstrating equal proof success at ~1/6 the token cost makes automated formalization noticeably cheaper and more practical. The faithfulness check is also notable: it uses the prover's own verified proofs as a self-contained diagnostic for mistranslation from informal problem to formal statement, providing a cheap alternative to learned judges and improving the trustworthiness of formal benchmarks built from automatically formalized problems.

title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
summary: h1 is a deliberately minimal agentic harness that gives a frontier language model a fast interface to Lean 4 and lets it iterate on verifier feedback and self-reflection, with no imposed planning, decomposition, or search structure. Reported results include state-of-the-art performance on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, the settling of eight open problems in FormalConjectures, and matched-model results that match or exceed specialized workflows such as Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus; notably, pass@1 alone is often sufficient to solve open problems. Ablations and matched comparisons with Claude Code and AxProverBase indicate that the design of the Lean execution interface — not simplicity per se — is the dominant factor in both cost and solve rate.
significance: The work frames a "bitter lesson" challenge to the trend of human-engineered proving pipelines: if a simple test-time-compute loop with good tooling matches complex workflows at matched models and compute, added orchestration may not be necessary. Since reported gains of new workflows are frequently confounded by stronger models or extra compute, matched-model evaluation with efficient verifier feedback is presented as a necessary baseline before new workflows are proposed — relevant as formal verification must scale to keep pace with frontier-model-generated research mathematics. (Claims here are those of the paper's abstract and have not been independently verified.)

title: The Information Geometry of Representation Formation
summary: This work reframes representation learning as a geometric trajectory rather than studying trained endpoints alone, using Bures geometry to quantify movement through representation space and quantum Fisher information to characterize local sensitivity to input factors. Empirically, learning concentrates local sensitivity on task-relevant factors, and changing the prediction target reorganizes this geometry around the corresponding visual factor. Trajectory directness systematically decreases as the computation requires higher-order interactions among input factors, an effect that persists under matched-performance and training-duration controls and transfers from synthetic vector inputs to residual CNNs on rendered and natural images. Beyond description, path tortuosity — controlling for interaction order — predicts subsequent representation drift and sensitivity to parameter perturbations, whereas endpoint displacement does not, and a representation-aware optimization scheme can actively shape these trajectories.
significance: If these findings hold broadly, formation geometry becomes a diagnostic that carries information unavailable from the trained endpoint, offering early predictive signals about representational stability and a concrete lever for intervention during training. The transfer from synthetic vectors to CNNs on natural images suggests the framework is not confined to toy settings, and the connection to Bures and quantum Fisher geometry gives it a principled information-geometric foundation. Two caveats are worth flagging: the reported results are empirical and predictive rather than theoretical guarantees, and the supplied classification ("Geometry (Geometry problem solving)") is a mismatch — this is an information-geometry/machine-learning study of neural representations, not a work in classical or contest-style geometry problem solving.

zh.title: 表征形成的信息几何
zh.summary: 这项工作不再仅研究训练后的终点，而是将表示学习（representation learning）重新刻画为一条几何轨迹：借助布雷斯几何（Bures geometry）度量在表示空间中的移动，并用量子费希尔信息（quantum Fisher information）刻画对输入因子的局部敏感性。实证结果表明，学习会将局部敏感性集中到与任务相关的因子上，而改变预测目标会围绕相应的视觉因子重新组织这一几何结构。随着计算需要输入因子之间更高阶的交互作用，轨迹的直接性系统性下降；这一效应在匹配性能与训练时长的对照下依然存在，并从合成向量输入迁移到在渲染图像和自然图像上的残差CNN。除描述性作用外，在控制交互阶数后，路径曲折度（tortuosity）能够预测后续的表示漂移以及对参数扰动的敏感性，而终点位移则不能；此外，一种感知表示的优化方案还能主动塑造这些轨迹。
zh.significance: 若这些发现具有普遍性，形成几何就成为一种诊断工具，蕴含了训练终点所不具备的信息，可提供关于表示稳定性的早期预测信号，并为训练过程中的干预提供具体抓手。从合成向量到自然图像上CNN的迁移表明，该框架并不局限于玩具场景，而与布雷斯几何和量子费希尔几何的联系则赋予其坚实的信息几何（information geometry）基础。有两点需要指出：所报告的结果是经验性与预测性的，而非理论保证；所提供的分类“几何（Geometry problem solving）”并不匹配——这是一项关于神经表示的信息几何/机器学习（machine learning）研究，而非经典或竞赛式几何解题的工作。

title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
summary: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for autoformalizing mathematics in Lean 4, motivated by two problems: Lean code can compile without matching its intended informal meaning, and agents now produce Lean faster than humans can read. Fuse therefore places a human supervisor alongside an AI orchestrator, with views over the project blueprint, dependency graph, and Lean code, while a backend maintains derived project state and runs agents for hours unattended. The project reportedly evolved through 2026 from a prescribed agent pipeline paced by human review to an orchestrator that autonomously dispatches specialist agents, provers, and parallel children, enabled by keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration. The paper reports use in formalizing the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models, and offers lessons for future autoformalization systems. An open-source local version, Fuse Desktop, is available.
significance: The core contribution is architectural rather than a new prover: decoupling state, tooling, and UI from orchestration lets the level of agent autonomy grow as models improve without redesigning the system. The abstract also flags a genuine correctness gap for the field — compilation does not certify faithful formalization of informal intent — positioning human supervision plus multi-view inspection as the practical safeguard as generation throughput outpaces manual review. As reported, the Kakeya formalization and prover-model study serve as case studies, but the abstract gives no quantitative results, so claims about effectiveness should be checked against the full paper.

zh.title: Numina Fuse：Lean 4 中的交互式自动形式化
zh.summary: Numina Fuse 是一款面向智能体（agent-native）的应用，用于在 Lean 4 中进行自动形式化（autoformalization），其出发点是两个问题：Lean 代码可以在不匹配其预期非形式含义的情况下编译通过，而且如今智能体生成 Lean 代码的速度已超过人类的阅读速度。因此，Fuse 将人类监督者与 AI 编排器并置，提供项目蓝图、依赖图和 Lean 代码的多重视图，而后端负责维护派生的项目状态，并让智能体无人值守地运行数小时。据称，该项目在 2026 年间由一套规定好的、由人类审查把控节奏的智能体流水线，演进为一个能够自主调度专家智能体、证明器和并行子智能体的编排器；这一演进得益于将项目状态、工具和界面设计与编排层相分离。论文报告了其在三维挂谷猜想（Kakeya conjecture）形式化和证明器模型研究中的使用，并总结了面向未来自动形式化系统的经验。此外还提供了一个开源本地版本 Fuse Desktop。
zh.significance: 核心贡献在于架构而非新的证明器：将状态、工具和 UI 与编排解耦，使得随着模型能力提升，智能体自主程度可以提高而无需重新设计系统。摘要还指出了该领域一个真实存在的正确性缺口——编译通过并不能保证对非形式意图的形式化忠实无误——从而将人类监督加多视图检查定位为当生成吞吐量超过人工审查能力时的实用保障。据报告，挂谷猜想形式化和证明器模型研究作为案例研究，但摘要未给出定量结果，因此关于有效性的论断应对照完整论文加以核实。

title: The Geometry of Limits in ReLU Function Spaces
summary: The paper analyzes the closure and geometry of function spaces realized by ReLU networks of fixed architecture. It proves that the minimal number of convex regions on which a CPWL function is affine is lower semicontinuous under pointwise convergence—via a hypergraph-coloring connection and a compactness argument—yielding quantitative bounds on the polyhedral complexity of limits. The authors extend a scalar-valued shallow-network characterization to vector-valued outputs, use limiting hyperplane arrangements to show fixed-width shallow scalar realization spaces are closed in the weighted supremum norm, and exhibit an explicit sequence with architecture $(2,3,2\mid 1)$ whose limit is not realizable by that architecture. The non-closedness holds both in weighted supremum norm and under uniform convergence on compact sets with nonempty interior, refuting a conjecture of Petersen, Raslan, and Voigtlaender. They further prove that non-closedness for a fixed scalar-output architecture must occur through a "blow-up residue," where diverging output coefficients amplify an emerging linear dependence among hidden features.
significance: The results sharply delineate when fixed-architecture ReLU realization spaces are closed versus not, resolving a stated conjecture and identifying the exact degeneration mechanism (blow-up residue) underlying non-closedness. This is directly relevant to approximation theory and expressivity limits of fixed-width networks, and to questions about whether limit points of trained or approximating networks remain representable. The lower semicontinuity theorem and associated complexity bounds give geometric and functional-analytic tools—hypergraph coloring, compactness, hyperplane arrangement geometry—for controlling the piecewise-linear complexity of limits of networks, extending the toolkit for studying boundaries of neural network function spaces.

zh.title: ReLU 函数空间中极限的几何结构
zh.summary: 本文研究由固定架构的 ReLU 网络所实现的函数空间的闭包与几何结构。文章证明：分片线性函数（CPWL function）在其上仿射的凸区域的最小数目，在逐点收敛（pointwise convergence）下是下半连续（lower semicontinuous）的——其证明借助超图着色（hypergraph coloring）的联系与紧性（compactness）论证——从而给出极限的多面体复杂度（polyhedral complexity）的定量界。作者将标量值浅层网络的刻画推广到向量值输出，利用极限超平面构型（hyperplane arrangement）证明固定宽度的浅层标量实现空间在加权上确界范数（weighted supremum norm）下是闭的，并构造一个架构为 $(2,3,2\mid 1)$ 的显式序列，其极限无法由该架构实现。这种非闭性（non-closedness）在加权上确界范数以及具有非空内部的紧集上的一致收敛（uniform convergence on compact sets with nonempty interior）两种意义下均成立，从而否证了 Petersen、Raslan 与 Voigtlaender 的一个猜想（conjecture）。他们进一步证明：对于固定标量输出架构，非闭性必然通过"爆炸残项"（blow-up residue）出现——即发散的输出系数放大了隐层特征之间新出现的线性依赖关系。
zh.significance: 这些结果清晰界定了固定架构 ReLU 实现空间何时为闭、何时不为闭，解决了一个已有猜想，并指出了非闭性背后确切的退化机制（爆炸残项）。这与逼近理论（approximation theory）以及固定宽度网络的表达能力极限直接相关，也关系到训练所得或用于逼近的网络的极限点是否仍可表示的问题。下半连续性定理（lower semicontinuity theorem）及相关复杂度界提供了几何与泛函分析工具——超图着色、紧性、超平面构型几何——用于控制网络极限的分片线性复杂度，扩展了研究神经网络函数空间边界的工具箱。

title: PACE: Research Proving Agent for Adaptive Conjecture Exploration
summary: PACE is a research-proof agent for conjecture research in applied mathematics. Its structured research loop selects mathematical objectives and develops or challenges candidate mechanisms; a whole prover builds proofs from these mechanisms and an independent verifier checks them against the original target, while evidence-tracking memory records assumptions and dependencies and flags evidence for revalidation when a candidate or condition changes. The paper introduces ResearchProofBench, an optimization-focused benchmark of 51 known-proof tasks with 331 hidden checkpoints under historical abstract access plus six open-problem cases. PACE attains an aggregate Proof Score of 75.16 and completes 20 proofs on the known-proof tasks, and on open problems produces conditional results whose submissions score higher in review than the compared baselines.
significance: Conjecture research in applied mathematics requires revising candidate questions and conclusions as investigation proceeds, coupling problem formulation with proof development rather than solving fixed statements. PACE addresses this by keeping checked premises, exploratory material, and unresolved obligations distinct and revalidating evidence when assumptions change, while ResearchProofBench separates reconstruction of published results from genuine open-problem investigation, offering a way to measure both proof construction and mathematical discovery.

title: Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation
summary: This paper reports an independent audit of a cheap frozen "System One" model returning typed, calibrated decisions (~USD 0.000025/call, ~100 ms) on 142,658 human-labeled comments, benchmarked against 14 frontier reasoning models (GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, Grok families) on a shared probe set. The cheap model reaches zero-shot classification AUROC 0.83, which a paired bootstrap (n=56) shows is not statistically separable from 13 of the 14 frontier systems—explicitly framed as a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence—while costing 1–3 orders of magnitude less and matching the calibration of several frontier models. The core conceptual claim is that "confidence" conflates human disagreement (annotator splits on satire, coded language) with decision risk (cost of costly-wrong automatic actions), which under asymmetric moderation loss imply opposite escalation signals. Because the cheap model prices extra queries near zero, decomposing judgments into parallel sub-questions and reading their spread recovers a human-disagreement signal native confidence misses, though only for the weakest, disagreement-blind models and only when the decomposition matches the disagreement sources; a specialist toxicity model and the strongest LLMs show no such need, and the effect is distribution-sensitive.
significance: The work offers a cost-aware evaluation design—paired bootstrap comparisons, calibration assessment, and uncertainty decomposition—for deciding when cheap structured models can substitute for frontier LLMs in high-volume binary decisions, with a cautionary note that a single scalar confidence cannot simultaneously flag contested judgments and asymmetric risk. However, the paper's assigned classification ("LLM for Mathematics / Math-specialized models") does not match the content: this is a content-moderation audit with no mathematics-specialized modeling or math reasoning results. Its relevance to the mathematics track is limited to transferable evaluation methodology (statistical parity testing, calibration, uncertainty decomposition), so the classification should be revisited before inclusion in math-focused tracking.

zh.title: 两种不确定性并非一种：廉价结构化内容审核中的分歧与决策风险
zh.summary: 本文报告了对一个廉价冻结的 "System One" 模型的独立审计：该模型以约 0.000025 美元/次、约 100 毫秒的成本返回类型化、经过校准的决策，并在 142,658 条有人工标注的评论上，与共享探针集上的 14 个前沿推理模型（GPT-5.x、Claude、Gemini 3、Grok 系列）进行基准比较。该廉价模型在零样本分类上的 AUROC 为 0.83，成对自助法（paired bootstrap，n=56）显示其与 14 个前沿系统中的 13 个在统计上无法区分——这被明确表述为未能拒绝持平，而非证明等价——同时其成本低 1 至 3 个数量级，并与若干前沿模型的校准程度相当。其核心概念主张是，“置信度”混同了人类分歧（标注者对讽刺、隐语等的判断分裂）与决策风险（代价高昂的错误自动操作所造成的损失）；在不对称的审核损失下，二者会指向相反的升级信号。由于廉价模型追加查询的边际成本近乎为零，将判断拆解为并行子问题并读取其离散程度，可以恢复原生置信度遗漏的人类分歧信号；但该方法仅对最弱的、对分歧不敏感的模型有效，且只有在拆解方式与分歧来源相匹配时才有效；专用毒性模型以及最强的 LLM 均无需如此，且该效应对数据分布敏感。
zh.significance: 该研究提供了一套考虑成本的评估设计——成对自助法比较、校准评估和不确定性分解（uncertainty decomposition）——用于判断何时廉价结构化模型可以替代前沿 LLM，承担高吞吐量的二元决策；同时发出警示：单一标量置信度无法同时标示有争议的判断与不对称风险。然而，本文被分配的分类（“LLM for Mathematics / Math-specialized models”）与内容不符：这是一项内容审核审计，不包含数学专用建模或数学推理结果。其与数学方向的相关性仅限于可迁移的评估方法（统计持平检验、校准、不确定性分解），因此在纳入数学方向跟踪前应重新考虑其分类。

title: SemantEq: Faithful Bidirectional Equivalence of Formal Statements
summary: SemantEq defines a principled equivalence relation for judging whether an autoformalized Lean 4 statement faithfully matches a trusted reference formalization. It replaces plain logical equivalence, which stronger provers can satisfy trivially by routing both statements through True, with a requirement that each statement transform into the other via allowed steps such as logical rearrangement and rewriting with library equations. The method judges the Lean-checked proof term rather than the tactic script. The model-free search SemantEq-Eval reaches 100% precision and 65.6% recall on the ProofNetVerif test split under adjudicated labels, versus 95.8% and 61.8% for BEq+, and an 8.9-fold increase in CPU time gains at most three pairs. SemantEq-ProofAudit audits model-written proofs under a policy derived from the relation, accepts none of 104 non-equivalent pairs, and raises recall on 407 equivalent pairs from 65.4% to 81.1% under the best prompt. Code and data are released.
significance: As provers improve, correctness risk shifts from proofs to the faithful translation of statements. SemantEq separates equivalence-proof generation from proof acceptance, so a stronger prover can raise recall without changing what acceptance means, giving a more reliable correctness check for large-scale autoformalization (自动形式化).

zh.title: SemantEq：形式化语句的忠实双向等价
zh.summary: SemantEq定义了一种有原则的等价关系（equivalence relation），用于判断自动形式化后的Lean 4语句是否忠实匹配可信的参考形式化。该方法取代了朴素的逻辑等价（logical equivalence）——更强的证明器可借助True平凡地满足该检验——要求每条语句仅通过允许的步骤变换为另一条，例如逻辑重排以及用库中的等式进行重写。该方法以Lean校验的证明项（proof term）而非策略脚本（tactic script）作为评判依据。无模型搜索SemantEq-Eval在ProofNetVerif测试划分上，依据人工裁定标签达到100%精确率和65.6%召回率，BEq+则为95.8%和61.8%；CPU时间增加8.9倍至多新增三对。SemantEq-ProofAudit依据由该关系导出的策略审计模型撰写的证明，在104对不等价语句中无一通过，并在最佳提示下将407对等价语句的召回率从65.4%提升至81.1%。代码与数据已发布。
zh.significance: 随着证明器能力增强，正确性风险从证明转移到语句的忠实翻译上。SemantEq将等价证明的生成与证明的接受相分离，使更强的提升器（prover）能够提高召回率而不改变"接受"的语义，从而为大规模自动形式化（autoformalization）提供更可靠的正确性检验。

title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
summary: PaperFormalizer is an author-in-the-loop, Lean-based agentic pipeline that converts LaTeX research papers into Lean-verified versions against Mathlib, optional domain libraries, and the author's growing personal toolkit. It transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity, and correctness, then formalizes and proves statements in Lean. Crucially, it halts and consults the author whenever a statement admits multiple readings, presenting every proposed repair in natural language and TeX as an accept/decline/redirect decision, so that any change affecting what the paper claims remains with the author. Outputs include an annotated and revised paper, a change report, and Lean code with declarations linked to their source statements. The system runs inside a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) and is open source, with a site (paperformalizer.org) where users share papers with Lean code for downstream reuse.
significance: The work reframes autoformalization as a tool for auditing and strengthening proofs in existing papers rather than merely translating them, targeting small gaps in proofs and unstated assumptions that survive careful proofreading. The author-in-the-loop design is the key differentiator: by deferring all claims-altering decisions to the author, it addresses a core obstacle in autoformalization — the need for intent that only the author possesses — while still automating transcription, audit, and formal proof against Lean/Mathlib. If effective in practice, per-paper toolkits and shared, reusable verified papers could compound: later papers build on Lean-verified predecessors, making proof-based research more robust and verifiable.

title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
summary: Lean Finder V2 is a semantic search framework for Mathlib designed for short, underspecified queries—properties, notation, aliases, hypotheses—rather than the context-rich queries assumed by prior search engines. It treats ambiguity as a data problem: adversarial training generates labeled short/ambiguous queries at scale, and disambiguation is applied at two levels, via model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark it sets a new state of the art with at least 11% relative improvement over prior Mathlib semantic search engines; optimized query rewriting on top of the retriever improves MathlibQR retrieval further. On unlabeled queries from human and coding-agent interactions it is rated the strongest system, and when integrated with Claude Code it improves downstream proof success. The system is available at https://leanfinder.github.io/.
significance: Retrieval is a practical bottleneck in interactive theorem proving: mathematicians and coding agents issue terse, notation-heavy queries that existing tools handle poorly, and the lack of real paired short-query/ground-truth data makes supervised fixes hard. By synthesizing ambiguous query–statement pairs via adversarial training and handling ambiguity both during training and at query time, the work addresses a realistic deployment gap rather than an assumed benchmark setting. Reported gains on the curated MathlibQR benchmark, on unlabeled real interaction queries, and on downstream proof success with Claude Code suggest the approach generalizes beyond a single evaluation setting and could meaningfully improve how both humans and agents locate relevant Mathlib lemmas.

title: Global Convergence of Detailed Balanced Mass Action Systems
summary: The paper claims a self-contained proof that any finite detailed-balanced mass-action system with positive rate constants has exactly one positive equilibrium per positive stoichiometric compatibility class, with every positive trajectory converging to it, and reports a Lean 4 formalization of the full argument from persistence to convergence. Boundedness and persistence are said to follow from a barrier construction (attributed in the abstract to "OpenAI (2026)" for weakly reversible systems) using an arbitrary-tolerance affine approximation to build a finite-minimum barrier whose superlevel sets confine trajectories and give a single logarithmic bound per initial state. Uniqueness is obtained via the Horn–Jackson dissipation identity, characterizing positive equilibria as an exponential family parameterized by the orthogonal complement of the stoichiometric subspace, while convergence is established by a bounded-speed descent argument that replaces LaSalle's invariance principle, requires neither solution uniqueness nor continuous dependence, and confines cluster points to that family. The abstract states the main theorem was checked by the Lean kernel against explicit definitions, and that the work was produced in an agent harness (ClawsGO Science) with model-per-role attribution.
significance: If the claims hold, the result closes a clean convergence theorem for detailed-balanced mass-action systems with a mechanized, kernel-checked proof chain from persistence to convergence, and the descent route's avoidance of uniqueness/continuous dependence suggests a broadly reusable pattern for formalizing asymptotic arguments in ODE-based chemical reaction network theory. The exponential-family characterization of equilibria also gives a structural handle for uniqueness that could generalize to other thermodynamically consistent networks. However, the derivation's reliance on a barrier argument attributed to an unspecified 2026 source, and the paper's provenance from a multi-agent harness rather than human-led work, warrant independent scrutiny of both the mathematical attribution and the formalization's coverage before treating the contribution as verified.

zh.title: 详细平衡质量作用系统的全局收敛性
zh.summary: 该论文声称给出了一个自包含的证明：任何具有正速率常数的有限详细平衡质量作用系统（detailed-balanced mass-action system），在每个正的化学计量兼容类（stoichiometric compatibility class）中恰有一个正平衡点，并且所有正轨迹都收敛到该平衡点；同时报告了从持续性（persistence）到收敛性（convergence）的完整论证的 Lean 4 形式化。据称有界性（boundedness）与持续性可由障碍函数构造（barrier construction）得出（摘要将其归于 "OpenAI (2026)"，针对弱可逆系统），该构造使用任意容差的仿射逼近来建立一个具有有限最小值的障碍函数，其超水平集（superlevel sets）可限制轨迹，并为每个初始状态给出单个对数界。唯一性通过 Horn–Jackson 耗散恒等式（Horn–Jackson dissipation identity）得到，其将正平衡点刻画为以化学计量子空间（stoichiometric subspace）的正交补（orthogonal complement）为参数的指数族（exponential family）；而收敛性由有界速度的下降论证确立，该论证取代了 LaSalle 不变性原理（LaSalle's invariance principle），既不需要解的唯一
zh.significance: 若这些主张成立，该结果将为详细平衡质量作用系统给出一个简洁的收敛定理，并提供从持久性到收敛的机械化、内核检查证明链。下降论证不依赖唯一性或连续依赖性，这提示了一种可广泛复用的模式，适用于形式化常微分方程（ODE）化学反应网络理论中的渐近论证。平衡态的指数族刻画还为唯一性提供了结构性工具，可能推广到其他热力学一致网络。然而，证明所依赖的障碍函数论证来自一个未具体说明的 2026 年来源，而且论文出自多智能体框架而非由人类主导，在将该贡献视为已验证之前，应独立审查其数学归属和形式化覆盖面。

title: RAIN: Agentic Proof Generation for Rocq-based Software Verification
summary: RAIN is a lightweight, proof-specialized agent for generating Rocq (Coq) proofs, built by augmenting an LLM with proof-engineering capabilities: autonomous repository exploration and lemma retrieval, iterative refinement, and checker feedback. Key design choices include revising complete proof scripts rather than isolated tactics and iterating on proof strategy using enriched proof-state information. Evaluated on a subset of the CoqStoq benchmark, RAIN reportedly achieves over 90% prove success rate with at least 24.7% improvements over existing baselines.
significance: Automating proof construction addresses a major bottleneck in using interactive theorem provers for software verification, where correctness guarantees come at high labor cost. The reported results suggest that agentic scaffolding specialized for proof engineering (as opposed to generic coding agents) can deliver strong success rates while maintaining comparable performance to general-purpose agents at significantly lower cost, pointing toward more practical, scalable formal verification workflows in Rocq-based projects.

title: Beyond Correctness: Attribution of Natural-Language Documentation for Formal Libraries
summary: The paper introduces attribution, meaning whether a documentation statement depends on a function's specific behavior, and gives a method to check it. It presents DocAuth, a documentation-generation method that decides what to publish using attribution and attaches to each published sentence the formal property recovered from it along with checkable evidence. Evaluated on 150 functions from the Community Books library of the ACL2 theorem prover, three large language models produced proved but non-attributable properties for about a third of the functions. DocAuth matched or exceeded the attribution rate of a mutation-based filter while delivering 37% more attributable sentences, and versus a truth-only pipeline it raised the share of published sentences confirmed as attributable by a second model from 82.9% to 94.7%.
significance: Provable truth alone does not ensure that documentation reflects what a function actually does. Treating attribution as a complement to truth gives developers a concrete way to generate and evaluate documentation for formal libraries, with each published statement linked to a recovered formal property and checkable evidence.

title: On the gradient conjecture at infinity: Finite spherical length for gradient trajectories of definable potentials
summary: The paper proves that for every open U in R^n and every definable C^1 potential F on U, the spherical projection of each gradient trajectory has finite length and therefore converges in direction, so the trajectory has finite total angular motion. Definability is meant with respect to an arbitrary o-minimal structure expanding the real field, and the result covers arbitrary solutions of the gradient flow differential equation with no uniqueness, boundedness, or convergence assumptions. It gives affirmative answers to the gradient conjecture at infinity and the Thom gradient conjecture for definable potentials, and is applied to deep neural network training: with definable and continuously differentiable activation and loss functions, the spherical projection of the training flow must always converge directionally.
significance: The theorem settles two long-standing conjectures for definable C^1 potentials in full generality, including gradient trajectories that are unbounded or diverge to infinity and whose solutions may fail to be unique. It further provides a rigorous direction-stability guarantee for gradient-based learning, showing that definability of the components alone forces the training flow of deep neural networks to settle in direction.

title: LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification
summary: This work introduces DynaCertBench, a benchmark of 105 instances covering stability, region-of-attraction, forward-invariance, and safety tasks, with 80 non-redundant literature systems extended by high-dimensional, control-constrained, and new nonlinearly coupled variants. It also presents LLM2Cert, an LLM-driven framework that synthesizes candidate Lyapunov functions and barrier certificates and discharges each proof obligation with an SMT solver or the Lean Proof-Repair agent. LLM2Cert verifies 81 of 105 instances (77.1%), a 17.1 percentage point gain over one-shot proposal without feedback, and verifies 22 certificates on which All-SMT remains unresolved. Code and data are released on GitHub.
significance: Existing certificate pipelines rely on sum-of-squares programs, interval methods, or SMT solvers that are conservative or scale poorly, and standard benchmarks mirror these limits by favoring low-dimensional polynomial systems. DynaCertBench instead stresses high-dimensional and nonlinearly coupled dynamics closer to engineering practice, while LLM2Cert shows that LLM synthesis paired with SMT and Lean-based proof repair can close verification gaps left by strong SMT baselines. The released benchmark and framework support reproducible progress on certifying stability and safety of nonlinear control systems.

title: TrustedCode: Evaluating Large Language Models for Developing Trusted Code through Automated Program Verification
summary: TrustedCode is an automated framework for verifying AI-generated Python code. It uses large language models to type-check Python code, translate it into WhyML through the Why3 framework, and verify it against formal specifications with Why3 back-end automated theorem provers. Chain-of-thought prompting via LangGraph is employed to identify and address LLM limitations in specification generation and proving specified programs. Experiments on ten Python programs of varying complexity show that 50% of observed errors arise from domain knowledge gaps, 30% from syntactic inaccuracies, and 20% from semantic and type-related issues. TrustedCode is released as open source, with a video demonstration available.
significance: With roughly 30% of Python contributions to GitHub reportedly AI-generated, establishing trust in such code is a pressing practical problem, and formal verification is a natural route to correctness guarantees. Existing verification tooling mainly targets Java and C, leaving Python poorly supported. TrustedCode demonstrates a full LLM-driven pipeline from type checking to proof, and its error breakdown points to concrete improvement targets for LLM-guided formal verification workflows, including better domain knowledge and specification generation.

title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
summary: PerMIT is a persistent memory architecture for LLM agents with provable integrity under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. Environment-derived values are released and used only through a finite memory interface, over which two integrity theorems are proved and machine-checked in Lean 4: such values reach a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate, and influence agent behavior only through what the gate displays. This collapses every attack in the threat model to one auditable decision, made by a human, an LLM verifier, or both. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because confirmations are logged verdicts on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users until items become community-confirmed without further verification. Under explicit assumptions the authors prove, and corroborate in simulation, a co-scaling property: as the community grows, promotion of poison and wrongful eviction of benign knowledge decrease while per-user verification effort stays flat. On τ²-bench, communities of up to 90 autonomous agents build shared knowledge bases with no direct memory injection promoted, and the shared knowledge significantly improves new agents on held-out tasks.
significance: Memory poisoning and injection are major unsolved risks for persistent, shared agent memory, and they also block safe knowledge reuse across agents. PerMIT shows that integrity can be reduced to a single auditable gate decision backed by machine-checked proofs, and that verification effort need not grow with community size. The reported results on Trojan Hippo and τ²-bench point toward shared, agent-built knowledge bases that remain safe at scale and support test-time self-improvement.

title: A Reverse-Gold Theorem: Positive-Data Identification by Substrate-Bounded Contrastive Learners
summary: The paper proves a positive counterpart to Gold's theorem for language learning from positive data. Given a fixed recursive contrast operator that maps each string to a finite set of structurally bounded perturbations, and a bounded-capacity discriminative scorer trained with InfoNCE-style contrastive estimation on self-generated perturbations, a faithfulness condition linking operator, scorer, and target suffices for PAC conditional identification from positive data alone. With high probability the learned scorer ranks all but an epsilon-fraction of in-language strings above every out-of-language perturbation in their own orbit, with sample complexity polynomial in the capacity, orbit size, score bound, and 1/epsilon. The negatives are constructed by the learner rather than supplied by an oracle, and no global normalizing constant over strings is computed. The misranking bound comes from the geometry of the contrastive loss, combining per-example loss floors with a definite loss increment under misranking to give an epsilon-to-the-minus-2 rate, together with an explicit approximation gap measuring the cost of in-language colliding perturbations, which vanishes for orbit-pure operators. Under a margin condition the ranking guarantee lifts to a global membership classifier, and the operator composed with the learned scorer yields a normalization-free Metropolis-Hastings generator. The hypotheses are instantiated for substitutable context-free languages and the subregular classes, and an open conjecture is stated locating the construction in the mildly context-sensitive hierarchy.
significance: The result shows that Gold's impossibility for positive-data identification can be circumvented when the learner supplies its own bounded negatives through an innate contrast operator, reframing learnability in terms of operator-scoring interaction rather than presentation alone. It delivers explicit polynomial sample complexity and an epsilon-to-the-minus-2 misranking rate without oracle negatives or global normalization, connects contrastive-loss geometry directly to identification guarantees, and links the framework to concrete grammatical classes while posing a conjecture about its reach within the mildly context-sensitive hierarchy.

title: Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems
summary: Researchers introduce DAR-MGSM, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic. It contains multi-step math word problems covering five major Arabic dialects plus Modern Standard Arabic, with parallel translated-only and translated-and-culturally-localized versions. Eleven Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs are evaluated: accuracy generally declines on the localized version, with sensitivity varying by model, and mechanistic interpretability reveals distinct internal reasoning trajectories for translated and localized variants despite similar aggregate accuracy.
significance: This work provides a dedicated benchmark for mathematical reasoning in a low-resource language variety and quantifies how linguistic variety and cultural context affect LLM problem-solving. The localization results and interpretability analysis offer concrete directions for building, evaluating, and explaining multilingual mathematical reasoning models.

title: Agentic Verified Optimization of Real-World Software
summary: The paper introduces agentic verified optimization, in which a coding agent produces a faster implementation together with a machine-checked proof of equivalence to the existing one, taking the existing implementation as the specification and using Lean 4 for both execution and reasoning. The authors develop Aqueduct, a framework that migrates C, C++, Go, and Rust programs into native Lean and validates each port by differential testing against the original. On the 189 reference implementations in Verina, agents produce faster proved rewrites for 156, including algorithmic changes such as replacing exponential recursion with dynamic programming. On 17 migrated applications, 92 proved rewrites speed up 47 of 51 application scenarios, with application-level gains smaller than function-level ones, which makes function selection a key problem.
significance: Unlike test-based equivalence checks that agents can exploit without preserving intended behavior, machine-checked equivalence proofs give trustworthy performance gains on real code. By reusing the existing implementation as the specification, the approach sidesteps the specification-writing bottleneck of verified code generation. The results show that current agents already handle verified optimization for standalone functions and for applications migrated from real programs, while identifying function selection and production-scale deployment as open challenges.

aiRole.description: Agents produce faster implementations with machine-checked proofs of equivalence: proved rewrites for 156 of 189 Verina reference implementations, including replacing exponential recursion with dynamic programming, and 92 proved rewrites on 17 migrated applications that speed up 47 of 51 scenarios.

humanContribution: Humans formulated the task of agentic verified optimization in Lean 4, built the Aquentic framework Aqueduct, and migrated C, C++, Go and Rust programs into native Lean, validating each port by differential testing against its original.

zh.title: 真实世界软件的智能体验证式优化
zh.summary: 本文提出智能体验证式优化（agentic verified optimization），即由编程智能体生成更快的实现，并附上其与现有实现等价的机器检查证明（machine-checked proof of equivalence），以现有实现作为规范，用 Lean 4 同时完成执行与推理。作者开发了 Aqueduct 框架，把 C、C++、Go 与 Rust 程序迁移为原生 Lean，并通过与原程序的差分测试（differential testing）验证每个移植版本。在 Verina 的 189 个参考实现上，智能体为其中 156 个给出了更快且经证明的重写，其中包括用动态规划替换指数级递归等算法层面的改动。在 17 个迁移后的应用上，92 个经证明的重写在 51 个应用场景中的 47 个带来加速；应用级收益小于函数级收益，因此选择哪些函数进行优化成为关键问题。
zh.significance: 相比可被智能体钻空子、无法保证行为意图的基于测试的等价性检查，机器检查的等价性证明让真实代码上的性能提升可信可靠。该方法直接以现有实现作为规范，绕开了验证式代码生成中编写规范的瓶颈。结果表明，现有智能体已能对独立函数以及从真实程序迁移而来的应用完成验证式优化，同时把函数选择和生产环境部署留作待解决的挑战。

title: Proof-Carrying Contracts: Commitments AI Agents Cannot Break
summary: This work introduces Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2), a framework in which an AI agent must submit a machine-checkable proof that a requested operation preserves the agreed constraints in every case allowed by its model before that operation can run. An execution system called Airlock verifies the proof and gates access to the operation. The parties specify the conditions to be preserved while the agent supplies the reasoning that justifies its decisions, which removes the need to design a separate permission policy and prove every permitted decision safe. The authors prove the constraints hold at every instant of execution, even against an adversarial agent, and identify when this implies safety in the real world. Reusable capability modules provide tools and guarantees from which contracts are built.
significance: It makes agreements between parties enforceable without inspecting or trusting each other's agents, shifting compliance from text and permission policies to machine-checked proofs. Per-operation proof obligations leave agents free to adapt their strategy while guaranteeing the agreed constraints throughout execution, providing a foundation for a dependable agent economy in which both delegating and executing parties are protected.
