title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
summary: GALA is a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object arrangement in 3D scenes. It predicts the 6D pose of one target object at a time, conditioned on scene context and a placement instruction, using a two-stage strategy that first aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks and then fine-tunes for placement. The work also curates a multi-source scene dataset spanning diverse room types and fine-grained furniture arrangements, intended for open release, and reports that GALA significantly outperforms baselines lacking explicit geometric reasoning on a new benchmark. A multi-stage plan-place-verify agent pipeline applying the model to text-driven scene generation is also presented.
significance: Fine-grained placement constraints such as support and containment are poorly handled by representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which discard detailed geometry. Explicit point cloud perception in an autoregressive placement model, paired with an open-sourced scene dataset and a plan-place-verify pipeline, could make text-driven 3D scene creation more geometrically faithful and controllable.

title: TriGeoBench: A Multimodal Mathematical Geometry Benchmark with Figures and TikZ
summary: TriGeoBench is a geometry-centric multimodal benchmark built from Chinese middle- and high-school mathematics examinations, containing 7,000 question-answer pairs and 12,235 geometric figures with accompanying TikZ code. Each item forms a {question-answer pair, image, TikZ} triplet, with question-answer pairs stored in LaTeX and TikZ preserving geometric topology, symbolic annotations, and relational structure. Coverage spans plane geometry, solid geometry, analytic geometry, function, and vector geometry in diverse response formats. Evaluations of representative open- and closed-source multimodal large language models via image-to-TikZ and multimodal reasoning probes reveal persistent fine-grained structure and image-text alignment difficulties. Oracle experiments using human-curated reference TikZ indicate that accurate executable representations supply complementary geometric cues, though they do not evaluate an end-to-end conversion pipeline.
significance: Because existing mathematical benchmarks rely on rasterized figures with narrow geometric coverage and formats, they cannot reliably show whether models reason over geometric structures or exploit superficial visual cues. By pairing each figure with topology-preserving TikZ and LaTeX question-answer data, TriGeoBench supports structure-aware probing of geometry reasoning and highlights fine-grained structural and alignment weaknesses that current multimodal large language models still exhibit.

title: Theorem prover Arend
summary: This expository paper presents Arend, a theorem prover developed at JetBrains Research for formalizing mathematics in the framework of univalent foundations, with a focus on constructive mathematics. Arend is based on a variant of homotopy type theory with cubical syntax that sits closer to Martin-Löf Type Theory (MLTT) than fully computational cubical type theories, while retaining some of their practically useful computational properties. Its class and record system supports subsumptive subtyping, partial implementations and anonymous extensions, offering flexibility in building hierarchies of definitions. The IntelliJ Arend plugin provides a full IDE experience, and arend-lib covers constructive algebra, topology and synthetic homotopy theory.
significance: The paper documents a language and tooling design that supports practical, structured formalization of mathematics, combining computational behavior inspired by cubical type theory with flexible mechanisms for organizing large libraries of definitions. The IDE integration and the breadth of arend-lib make Arend a substantive option for research and education in formal mathematics.

zh.significance: 该论文记录了一套面向数学形式化的语言与工具设计，将受立方类型论启发的计算行为与组织大型定义库的灵活机制结合起来。集成开发环境的支持以及 arend-lib 的覆盖范围，使 Arend 成为形式化数学研究与教学中一个有实质价值的选择。

title: Formalization of Rényi Differential Privacy in Isabelle/HOL (Draft version)
summary: This paper presents an Isabelle/HOL library that formalizes Rényi differential privacy (RDP) in a general setting. The authors begin with RDP for continuous distributions, building on formalized properties of convex functions and f-divergences for nonnegative convex functions. The library covers basic RDP properties, conversion laws from RDP to DP, moment accountants in DP, and the Gaussian mechanism together with its RDP. The work concludes by discussing the stochastic gradient descent mechanism with Gaussian noise and formalizing a rough RDP and DP evaluation of it.
significance: Privacy accounting for DP and especially RDP has grown increasingly intricate, so errors in evaluations can undermine real guarantees. A proof-assistant formalization of RDP, its links to DP, and core mechanisms such as the Gaussian mechanism provides machine-checked foundations for reasoning about privacy losses, including those arising in noisy stochastic gradient descent.

zh.title: Isabelle/HOL 中 Rényi 微分隐私（Rényi differential privacy）的形式化（草案版本）

zh.significance: 微分隐私（DP）尤其是 Rényi 微分隐私（Rényi differential privacy）的隐私核算日趋复杂，评估中的错误会削弱真实场景下的隐私保证。对 RDP、其与 DP 的联系以及高斯机制（Gaussian mechanism）等核心机制进行证明辅助器形式化，为推理隐私损失提供了机器检查的基础，其中也包括带噪随机梯度下降（stochastic gradient descent）中产生的隐私损失。

title: ReuF2F: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
summary: ReuF2F is a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU) materials, spanning entry-level open research questions across many mathematical subfields. The authors argue that these less prominent problems are better suited to held-out evaluation of end-to-end open problem solving in Lean than widely known results, since they attract less attention and tend to remain unsolved longer. Each problem and its logical negation are placed into a Lean project inside a Docker container, matching a standard coding-agent evaluation setting, and the team builds Leanimum-agent on top of mini-SWE-agent as a unified harness for fair cross-model comparison. Even the best-performing model resolves only about 40% of the problems.
significance: Benchmarks of open problems degrade quickly as solutions are discovered and publicized, so less visible, harder-to-contaminate problems give a more durable test of research capability. The containerized coding-agent protocol aligns formal proof evaluation with how modern software agents actually work, and the unified harness makes model comparisons meaningful. A best score near 40% shows that formalizing and proving open research problems in Lean remains far from solved.

title: GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories
summary: GLOBE is a training-free online algorithm that stops chain-of-thought generation early by embedding each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reading the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. A trial phase generates short trial answers in a separate branch and stops the main stream when an accepted trial passes a confidence threshold; if generation continues, a trajectory phase stops it when the path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. Across five benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, and two models, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0%, with a five-task average of 80.58% comparable to Full CoT.
significance: The method tackles wasted computation and answer degradation caused by overly long chains of thought, offering a training-free early exit rule usable during serving. Its reported token and latency reductions at accuracy comparable to Full CoT indicate practical efficiency gains for reasoning models.

title: Studying proof data with proof theory: the case of AI-generated mathematics
summary: The paper presents a method, grounded in proof theory, for analyzing large collections of formally verified mathematical proofs, such as OpenAI's. Quantities already computed to improve automated provers, including proof term size and the number of redundant steps, are repurposed as measurements of proofs: compared against a reference library and each proof's own cut-free form, checked against theorems they must obey, and controlled for compilation. Applying these instruments, the study finds that AI-written formal proofs realize far less of the available logical compression than human mathematicians do, at 31% versus 73% in mathlib and 55% versus 86% among proofs calling no automation, broadly matching reports that AI-written proofs are often longer than necessary.
significance: The work turns prover-optimization metrics into principled instruments for studying proofs themselves, enabling quantitative comparison of machine-generated and human formal mathematics. Its finding that AI proofs leave substantial logical compression unrealized offers concrete targets for proof improvement tools and for understanding how machine mathematics differs from human mathematics.

title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
summary: This work adds a bounded online step-level repair module to Lean 4 proof search. At each step the search samples K candidate tactics and, when a tactic is rejected, feeds the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix that step in place, attempting at most R repairs. The method beats a sampling-only baseline for every tested budget K in {1,3,5,8}, with up to a 32% relative gain and 82 additional theorems solved on a 1,990-theorem LeanDojo subset. The gains are front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing 84–96% of the total improvement, and arise almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatches. The approach transfers to the Lean Workbook benchmark, nearly doubling the solve rate with zero regressions, at the cost of extra runtime.
significance: The results show that compiler error messages are a usable signal that pure sampling discards, and that exploiting them yields consistent gains across candidate budgets at a predictable runtime cost. The finding that repair helps mainly on shallow execution failures rather than structural errors gives practical guidance on when to invoke repair, and replication on a second benchmark suggests the benefit is not confined to a single dataset.

title: Formally Verified Autoresearch for Analyzing the Expressivity of Multi-Head Attention
summary: The paper studies the expressivity of a one-layer attention-only transformer with additive positional embeddings, defining the head complexity H*(f) of a Boolean function f as the minimum number of attention heads needed to represent it. The authors derive an exact linear-fractional normal form for head complexity, prove a general threshold-degree lower bound, and exhibit an explicit ten-bit function for which this bound is strict. For symmetric Boolean functions they show that head complexity equals the number of value changes between consecutive Hamming-weight levels, even with positional embeddings allowed, matching the concurrent characterization of Hsu and Xu (arXiv:2608.04243) which assumes no positional embeddings. The symmetric lower bound combines the general threshold-degree bound with the classical result of Aspnes et al. (1994). These results were discovered and formalized by a frontier model through conjecture generation, theorem proving, and machine verification, with human researchers posing the high-level questions and reviewing the generated theorems. The Lean formalization and research traces are released publicly to support agent-assisted theorem proving and formal verification in mechanistic interpretability.
significance: This work gives concrete theoretical insight into how the number of attention heads governs transformer expressivity, including a tight characterization for symmetric Boolean functions and a strict separation example at ten bits. It also demonstrates that frontier models, with humans steering and reviewing, can discover and machine-verify new mathematics, and the released Lean artifacts provide a reusable benchmark for agent-assisted theorem proving in mechanistic interpretability.

aiRole.description: A frontier AI model discovered and formalized the paper's results on head complexity for a one-layer attention-only transformer, including an exact normal form, a threshold-degree lower bound, and a characterization for symmetric Boolean functions, all machine-verified in Lean.

humanContribution: Human researchers asked the high-level research questions and reviewed the theorems generated by the model.

title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
summary: MAMath-Bench is a process-aware benchmark for evaluating the multimodal mathematical reasoning of multi-agent systems, containing 1,003 problems across 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and text, image, and audio modalities. Fine-grained milestone annotations let systems be assessed on problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning-chain perturbations. The evaluation finds that multi-agent collaboration does not consistently beat strong single LLMs on final-answer accuracy, that it can widen intermediate reasoning coverage at the cost of greater redundancy, and that current systems remain vulnerable to adversarial reasoning errors, especially subtle structural perturbations. The dataset is released on GitHub at mira-ai-lab/AgentMath.
significance: Most prior evaluations score only final answers in text-only settings, leaving multimodal reasoning, intermediate-step reliability, and error robustness unmeasured. By separating correctness, process reliability, and adversarial robustness, MAMath-Bench gives a more faithful picture of where multi-agent collaboration helps and where it introduces redundancy or fragility, informing the design of more dependable LLM-based mathematical problem solving.

zh.summary: MAMath-Bench 是一个过程感知的基准（benchmark），用于评测多智能体系统（multi-agent systems，MASs）的多模态数学推理（multimodal mathematical reasoning）能力，包含 1,003 道题目，覆盖 11 个数学类别、多个难度级别以及文本、图像、音频等多种模态。细粒度的里程碑标注使系统可从解题正确性、推理过程可靠性以及对对抗性推理链扰动的鲁棒性三个维度进行评测。评测得出三点发现：多智能体协作在最终答案准确率上并不稳定优于强大的单一大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）；协作可以显著提升中间推理的覆盖度，但可能以推理冗余增加为代价；现有系统仍易受对抗性推理错误影响，尤其是细微的结构性扰动。数据集已在 GitHub 的 mira-ai-lab/AgentMath 发布。
zh.significance: 现有评测大多只在纯文本设定下衡量最终答案，无法检验多模态推理、中间步骤的可靠性与对错误的鲁棒性。MAMath-Bench 将正确性、过程可靠性与对抗鲁棒性分开考察，更真实地揭示了多智能体协作在哪些方面带来收益、又在哪些方面引入冗余或脆弱性，从而有助于设计更可靠的大语言模型数学解题系统。

title: How worried should we be about extinction risk from AI?
summary: On Timothy Gowers' blog, the discussion begins from Jacob Tsimerman's announcement, made shortly after receiving the Fields Medal, that he would give up mathematical research and pivot to AI safety. significance: The career turn of a newly decorated mathematician toward AI safety signals growing concern about existential risk within the mathematics community, and the resulting debate helps clarify how mathematicians assess the probability and severity of catastrophic AI outcomes.

title: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
summary: The paper measures how fast an autoregressive transformer forgets its prompt by comparing hidden states induced by two different prompts followed by the same continuation text. The resulting distance decays roughly as a power law t^{-α}, with α=1 corresponding to the shrinking share of uniform attention; trained models show α≈0.55–0.7 and untrained models α≈0.2–0.5. The authors prove a conditional no-hair theorem for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under the condition that pre-norm activations stay away from zero: the prompt's influence on the next token is bounded by O(P(log t)^{L-1}/t) for prompt length P and depth L. Continuation tokens relaying information from the prompt can only add logarithmic factors, and an exactly solvable linear relay model shows the bound is tight while reproducing the drift of the local exponent toward 1 in untrained networks. A logit-bias intervention that cancels the dilution halts the decay early in training and reverses it later, indicating that dilution is necessary for the measured forgetting, while the untrained networks and the solvable model show it is also sufficient.
significance: The work gives a quantitative and provable account of prompt forgetting in autoregressive transformers, separating the geometric dilution of prompt information from the relay of that information through generated tokens. Its bound shows that, given the text produced so far, prompt properties such as language can only survive insofar as they are carried by the generated text itself, with implications for context retention, prompt injection, and the design of long-context models. The tightness of the bound and the logit-bias experiments make the mechanism empirically testable rather than merely descriptive.

zh.title: Transformer的条件无毛定理（conditional no-hair theorem）：语言模型如何遗忘其提示
zh.summary: 该文通过比较两个不同提示在接续相同续写文本时产生的隐藏状态，衡量自回归Transformer遗忘提示的速度。两者的距离大致按幂律t^{-α}衰减，其中α=1对应均匀注意力下提示份额的收缩速率；训练过的模型α约为0.55至0.7，未训练的模型α约为0.2至0.5。作者对有限深度、具有有界注意力logit的pre-LN softmax Transformer证明了条件无毛定理（conditional no-hair theorem），其前提是pre-norm激活值不接近零：对长度为P、深度为L的模型，提示对下一词元的影响被O(P(log t)^{L-1}/t)界定。续写词元通过中继（relay）传递早先从提示读取的信息，只能增添对数因子；一个可精确求解的线性中继模型表明该界是紧的，并能重现未训练网络中局部指数向1靠近的趋势。实验中用logit偏置抵消稀释效应后，衰减在训练早期停止并在后期反转，说明稀释是实测遗忘的必要条件；未训练网络与可解模型则表明稀释也是充分条件。
zh.significance: 该工作给出了关于自回归Transformer提示遗忘的定量且可证明的解释，将提示信息的几何稀释与经由生成词元的中继区分开来。其界表明，在给定已生成文本的条件下，诸如语言这类提示性质只有被生成文本本身承载时才可能存续，这对上下文保持、提示注入以及长上下文模型的设计具有启示意义。该界的紧性与logit偏置实验使这一机制可以接受实证检验，而不止于描述。

title: MGE-PO: Entropy-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: MGE-PO is a policy optimization method for mathematical reasoning that addresses GRPO's treatment of equally rewarded responses within a question by incorporating rollout generation uncertainty. Its core component, four-quadrant (4Q) advantage shaping, combines verified correctness with generation entropy: correctness sets the sign of an added correction while entropy sets its magnitude, so lower-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher-entropy failures receive larger penalties. An online entropy-based question curriculum supports the credit rule using cached rollout measurements. On Qwen3-8B-Base after eight training epochs, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3.23-3.69% in six-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4.24-11.06% in macro pass@32. On Qwen2.5-7B-Base, the complete configuration raises four-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41.5% to 45.4%.
significance: Fine-grained credit assignment remains a limiting factor in reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning, since group-relative baselines cannot distinguish responses that share a reward despite differing generation difficulty. Entropy-aware shaping offers a cheap, verification-grounded way to differentiate them, and the gains hold across several policy optimization settings and two Qwen base models, suggesting the correction is broadly usable rather than tied to one trainer. The entropy-based question curriculum also reuses cached rollout statistics, so the added credit signal comes at low extra measurement cost.

title: Repair, Retry, and the Cost of Hindsight: Verifier Feedback in Formal Theorem Proving
summary: This work reconciles two conflicting findings on verifier-guided self-repair in Lean theorem proving using controlled one-step experiments on difficult MiniF2F problems with frozen Qwen3.6-27B and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B. Showing a model its own failed proof lowers success and sharply increases copying of that proof, while on Qwen adding the matching compiler error restores performance to the level of the diagnostic alone; substituting another theorem's failed proof largely removes the degradation, and substituting another problem's error on Qwen substantially reduces the recovery. Without the failed proof, correct diagnostics beat wrong-diagnostic controls on neither model, the failed-proof penalty persists regardless of the retry instruction, and Qwen's diagnostic recovery weakens without it. In sequential experiments over 11 problems and up to 64 attempts, Qwen retains a correct-diagnostic benefit within failed-proof histories but DeepSeek-Prover does not. Crucially, no one-step feedback condition outperforms instruction-only resampling, and 64-attempt sequential repair with failed proofs and correct diagnostics does not either at equal token budgets, so verifier feedback improves repair yet fails to overcome the loss from conditioning on a failed attempt.
significance: The results resolve the apparent tension between prior claims that verifier feedback aids repair and claims that self-repair adds little over independent resampling, by isolating two opposing effects: the cost of conditioning on a failed predecessor and the benefit of its matching diagnostic. This gives concrete guidance for prover tooling, suggesting that failed-proof histories and diagnostics should be handled separately and that resampling remains a strong baseline under fixed token budgets.

zh.title: 修复、重试与事后信息的代价：形式化定理证明中的验证器反馈
zh.summary: 本文通过在 Lean 定理证明中开展受控的单步实验，调和了关于验证器引导自我修复的两项相互矛盾的发现，实验在 MiniF2F 难题上使用冻结的 Qwen3.6-27B 与 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B，固定前一次失败并分别改变是否展示失败证明、编译错误是否对应这次失败以及重试指令。向模型展示其自身的失败证明会降低成功率并显著增加对该证明的复制；而在 Qwen 上补充该次尝试的编译错误可挽回这一损失，达到仅提供诊断信息时的水平。用另一条定理的失败证明替换前次证明可在两个模型上基本消除性能下降；在 Qwen 上用其他问题的错误替换诊断则大幅削弱这种挽回作用。若不展示失败证明，正确诊断在两个模型上都未显示出相对错误诊断对照的已分辨优势。无论有无重试指令，失败证明惩罚都会持续存在，而 Qwen 在缺少重试指令时诊断带来的恢复更弱。在覆盖 11 个问题、最多 64 次尝试的序列实验中，Qwen 在包含失败证明的历史中仍保留正确诊断的收益，而 DeepSeek-Prover 未表现出已分辨的恢复。关键在于，没有任何受测单步反馈条件优于仅指令的重采样，在相同 token 预算下，包含失败证明与正确诊断的 64 次尝试序列修复同样不占优。因此，验证器反馈能够改善修复，却无法克服因条件化于失败尝试而带来的性能损失。
zh.significance: 这些结果调和了此前的分歧：既有工作发现验证器反馈有助于修复，也有工作认为自我修复相对独立重采样几乎没有优势。研究将两种相反效应区分开来，即条件化于失败前次证明的代价，以及与之匹配的诊断信息带来的收益。这对证明器工具设计具有直接指导意义，提示应把失败证明历史与诊断信息分开处理，也表明在固定 token 预算下重采样仍是强有力的基线。

title: At the Limits of Computability: Steps Towards Autonomous AI Discovery on the Busy Beaver Frontier
summary: The paper presents a Gemini-based agentic pipeline that combines pattern recognition, automated conjecturing, informal reasoning, and formal theorem proving in Lean to discover compact acceleration rules for Turing machines on the Busy Beaver frontier. Applied to BB(6), the system autonomously discovered and formally verified novel Collatz-like accelerations for eleven machines, which are provisionally classified as Cryptids: machines with exact compact descriptions of blank-tape executions but unresolved halting behavior, pending community acceptance.
significance: The work extends AI for mathematics beyond predefined human-set problems toward autonomous question formation and structural discovery in an uncomputable domain. Its verified accelerations advance analysis of BB(6) holdouts and offer a concrete model for sustained, open-ended AI-driven discovery in fundamental computer science.

title: Lean Graph Search for Formal Theorem Proving
summary: The paper proposes LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that builds a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses multi-hop dependency chains to surface supporting lemmas that may not be lexically similar to a target theorem. The method links each declaration to the premises it depends on, propagates relevance from semantically matched declarations to their dependencies via a graph-based ranking algorithm, and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query. On retrieval benchmarks it raises recall by up to 12% over LeanSearch v2 on MathlibQR and covers up to 3.7% more complete annotated proof route groups on MathlibMPR. Integrated into an iterative proving loop guided by Lean feedback, it improves pass rate at {8, 16, 32} reflection turns by up to 40% over a vanilla prover and by up to 10% over LeanSearch v2 across three theorem proving benchmarks, with higher accuracy-cost efficiency.
significance: Lemma retrieval is a bottleneck for machine-checkable proof construction, yet existing retrieval systems largely rely on lexical or semantic matching and underuse the dependency structure already present in proof libraries. Showing that multi-hop dependency chains expose recurring supporting lemmas, and that the resulting gains persist in end-to-end theorem proving rather than only in retrieval metrics, argues for structure-aware search as a practical lever for proof discovery and for further work on graph-based retrieval in formal mathematics.

zh.summary: 本文提出 LeanGraphSearch，一种面向 Lean 4 的图检索方法，从 Mathlib 的前向依赖中构建图，并沿多跳依赖链遍历，以找出与目标定理未必词面相似的支撑引理（lemma）。该方法把每个声明链接到它所依赖的前提（premise），通过基于图的排序算法把语义匹配声明的相关性传播到其依赖项，并针对原始查询对扩展候选重新排序。在检索基准上，该方法在 MathlibQR 上的召回率较 LeanSearch v2 最多提升 12%，在 MathlibMPR 上使完整标注证明路径组的覆盖最多增加 3.7%。在接入由 Lean 反馈引导的迭代证明循环后，在三个定理证明（theorem proving）基准上，{8, 16, 32} 反思轮次下的通过率较朴素证明器最高提升 40%，较 LeanSearch v2 最高提升 10%，并呈现更高的准确率-成本效率。
zh.significance: 引理检索是构建机器可验证证明的瓶颈之一，而现有检索系统主要依赖词面或语义匹配，较少利用证明库中已有的依赖结构。研究表明，多跳依赖链能够揭示反复出现的支撑引理，而且这种收益不仅体现在检索指标上，也能延续到端到端定理证明中，这说明结构感知的搜索是改进证明发现的一条实用路径，也推动了形式化数学（formal mathematics）中图检索方法的进一步研究。
zh.aiRoleDescription: LeanGraphSearch 是一种面向 Lean 4 的图检索方法，在 MathlibQR 上将召回率较 LeanSearch v2 提升至多 12%，并接入以 Lean 反馈为引导的迭代证明循环后，在三个定理证明基准上将通过率较普通 prover 提升至多 40%。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计并构建了该图检索方法，从 Mathlib 构造依赖图，并在检索与定理证明基准上进行了评估。

title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
summary: Lean4AgenticRL is presented as the first framework grounding multi-level process rewards in a unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. It constructs problem-specific workflows balancing agent capability and controllability, formalizes these workflows with multi-level reward annotation so behavior can be verified in a general harness, and trains with a workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm to yield the LAR-9B/27B model family. LAR-27B reaches 77.3% on TerminalBench-2.1; on average the models exceed the base model by 9.89% and the best known comparable-size model by 5.07%.
significance: Agentic RL for software engineering and terminal tasks has mostly relied on coarse outcome-only rewards, weakening training signal at the tool-call and workflow levels. This work shows that formal methods in the form of Lean4-based verification can supply verifiable multi-level process rewards for open-ended agentic RL, producing measurable gains over strong models of similar size and suggesting a path for formal-methods integration beyond traditional mathematics benchmarks.

title: Learning Lean Feedback for Efficient Proof-Candidate Evaluation on GPUs
summary: This work trains neural evaluators to predict Lean 4 verdicts and compiler feedback from 4.84 million labelled programs. A two-stage evaluator, which screens candidates with a validity classifier and scores positive predictions with a feedback model that predicts goal states and error messages, reaches 87.8% accuracy on a 68,932-program benchmark drawn from public provers and processes 3.5 candidates per second on one H100, 4.2x the throughput of a 64-worker Lean baseline with environment reuse. Combining the evaluator with Lean verdicts yields a hybrid reward system that shortens GRPO training steps by about 31%, while after one GRPO epoch the prover scores 62.2% pass@1 and 72.4% pass@32 on miniF2F versus 62.4% and 71.3% with Lean-only rewards.
significance: Verifier latency is a bottleneck in training language models for formal theorem proving, since slow checks and timeouts idle GPUs and deny rewards to valid proofs. A fast learned surrogate for Lean verdicts and feedback could remove much of this bottleneck, and the reported hybrid reward scheme preserves proving performance while cutting training step time substantially, making reinforcement-learning pipelines for prover tooling far more GPU-efficient.

title: ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing
summary: ClaimScope is a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed mathematical claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair, covering optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact 2x2 linear algebra. Qwen3-8B is evaluated with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions sharing the same draft, under a witness checker that inspects only the submitted state. Verifier feedback produced 23/39 accepted counterexamples on invalid claims and 25/72 safe completions, versus 15/39 and 20/72 for checker-free generic feedback; verdict accuracy moves from 47/72 to 46/72. The claim-grouped safe-completion difference is .094 with a bootstrap 95% interval of [.000,.198]. All seven task-level gains follow horizon/input-length diagnostics, and a post-hoc schema-only correction of the direct outputs reaches the same 25 safe tasks without another model call, locating the gains in witness-structure correction rather than broader reasoning improvement.
significance: The benchmark separates claim classification from executable evidence, and the label-blind witness checker shows that feedback gains come from repairing witness structure rather than improving general reasoning, giving a more honest account of what verification signals actually contribute.

title: Multimodal AI Detection for Math-Heavy Scientific Text
summary: This work studies automatic detection of AI-generated content in math-heavy scientific writing. The authors extract human-written proof and prose passages from pre-2022 arXiv LaTeX sources and regenerate them with 15 modern LLMs in the same paper context, yielding paired human and AI outputs in three representations: LaTeX source, rendered PDF image, and text extracted from the PDF. The state-of-the-art Pangram 4 detector loses accuracy as a passage's mathematical content increases, especially on extracted text rather than LaTeX. Finetuning Qwen-3.5-27B-based detectors on this domain closes the gap, with LaTeX inputs outperforming extracted text because they retain more formatting information. Since LaTeX sources are rarely available in practice, the team also trains SnapJudge, an image-based detector operating on screenshots of prose and proofs; at a 0.1% false positive rate it detects 92% of proofs and 93% of prose generated by frontier models, substantially outperforming both Pangram 4 and their text-based detector. Data, models, and code are released.
significance: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing, transparent disclosure depends on reliable AI-generated content detection (AI detection). This study shows that purely text-based detectors degrade on mathematical material, but that the limitation is not intrinsic: domain finetuning and, crucially, image-based analysis of rendered pages recover strong detection performance. SnapJudge's results suggest that visual formatting cues in math-heavy papers are a practical detection signal, offering a workable path when LaTeX sources are unavailable.

zh.title: 面向数学密集型科学文本的多模态AI检测
zh.summary: 本研究关注数学密集型科学写作中AI生成内容的自动检测。研究者从2022年之前的arXiv LaTeX源文件中抽取人工撰写的证明与论述段落，并在同一篇论文的上下文中用15个现代LLM重新生成，从而得到同一批文本的三种配对表示：LaTeX源码、PDF渲染图像和从PDF中提取的纯文本。最先进的Pangram 4检测器的准确率随段落数学内容增多而明显下降，尤其在提取文本上评估时比在LaTeX上更差。在该领域上微调基于Qwen-3.5-27B的检测器可以弥补这一差距，其中LaTeX输入显著优于提取文本，因为它保留了更多排版格式信息。由于实践中很少能获得LaTeX源码，团队还训练了SnapJudge，这是一个基于截图的图像检测器，可处理论文中的论述与证明截图；在0.1%的误报率下，SnapJudge对前沿模型生成的证明检出率达92%，对论述达93%，大幅超过Pangram 4与作者们的文本检测器。数据、模型与代码已公开发布。

title: Beyond LLM Judge: Mechanical Verification for Agentic Autoformalization
summary: The paper introduces a verification method for Lean formalizations that combines LLM-based semantic review with mechanical numerical and vacuity checks, producing checkable feedback and catching errors missed by LLM judges. The authors pair this method with their Extract-Verify-Proof autoformalization pipeline to build the Formalized Library of Mathematical Functions (FLMF), a partial formalization of the NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions (DLMF). On three labeled datasets the method achieves the lowest accepted-error rate among the evaluated approaches, and expert review uncovers translation and source defects in existing datasets.
significance: Faithfulness of autoformalized mathematics is hard to verify when the sole arbiter is a model; mechanical checks make feedback checkable and reduce the rate of incorrect statements that pass verification. The released FLMF library and code give researchers and developers a reusable benchmark and resource for building more reliable mathematical agent pipelines.

title: IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation
summary: IneqAgent is an agentic framework for inequality proving in Lean4 that combines LLM reasoning with symbolic backends, using lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search to coordinate lemma construction, goal reformulation, and backend selection. Sum-of-squares, Bernstein, and successive difference-substitution backends generate exact certificates used for local Lean proof generation, which are combined with LLM-generated steps and validated with Lean feedback. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash it solves 175 of 186 problems across four benchmarks (94.09%), the highest overall success rate among the evaluated methods, and outperforms Direct Agent with the same backbones at low inference cost thresholds while incurring lower mean inference costs over successful runs.
significance: The work demonstrates that coordinating exact symbolic certificates with LLM reasoning yields complete Lean-checked proofs at high success rates and low inference cost. It also delivers Lean-verified strengthenings of Dittert's conjecture in dimensions four and five, and certifies the Holens–Djokovic (4,4) inequality, which implies Merris's conjecture in dimension four.

zh.summary: IneqAgent 是一个用于 Lean4 中不等式证明的智能体框架，将大语言模型推理与符号计算后端相结合，通过引理级蒙特卡洛树搜索（Monte Carlo Tree Search）协调引理构造、目标重构与后端选择。平方和、Bernstein 以及逐次差分代换后端生成精确证书，用于局部 Lean 证明生成，再与大语言模型生成的步骤整合，并借助 Lean 反馈构建针对原始定理陈述的完整证明。在四个基准测试中，配备 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的 IneqAgent 解决了 186 道题目中的 175 道（94.09%），在所评估方法中总体成功率最高；使用相同主干模型时，它在低推理成本阈值下的成功率高于 Direct Agent，且各方法成功运行的平均推理成本更低。
zh.significance: 该工作表明，将精确符号证书与大语言模型推理相协调，可以较低的推理成本获得高成功率的完整 Lean 校验证明。研究还给出了 Dittert 猜想（Dittert's conjecture）在四维和五维中的 Lean 验证加强版本，并证明了 Holens–Djokovic (4,4) 不等式，从而推出 Merris 猜想（Merris's conjecture）在四维情形下成立。
zh.aiRoleDescription: IneqAgent 是一个结合大语言模型推理与符号计算的智能体框架，它在四个基准上解决了 186 道题中的 175 道（94.09%），并给出了 Dittert 猜想在四维和五维中的 Lean 验证加强形式，以及 Holens--Djokovic $(4,4)$ 不等式的证书，从而蕴含 Merris 猜想在四维成立。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建并引导了 IneqAgent 框架，实现了平方和、Bernstein 与差分代换后端，并用 Lean 检查来验证生成的证明。

title: Euler: Towards Human-Centered Multi-Agent Mathematical Discovery
summary: Euler is a human-centered multi-agent mathematical research system built around a shared, structured representation of the research process. It organizes mathematical statements, assumptions, proof dependencies, alternative approaches, failed attempts, and verification evidence into connected research graphs, letting researchers trace how results were developed while giving agents persistent, task-relevant knowledge for planning, collaboration, and verification across sessions. Researchers can revisit earlier agent reasoning from saved team states and pursue alternative directions interactively. The paper presents the implemented system, its software validation, and three mathematical research case studies.
significance: Much AI-for-mathematics work focuses on final answers, leaving the reasoning behind a result hard to inspect, while long investigations suffer from fragmented context and the propagation of unsupported claims. Euler's research-graph representation makes multi-agent mathematical exploration traceable, reproducible, and extendable, helping researchers work with agents on sustained investigations rather than isolated problem solving.

title: What Has Actually Been Proved? Auditable Paper-to-Lean Alignment with LeanTrail
summary: LeanTrail is a post-hoc, tool-agnostic audit that measures formalization progress against the source paper rather than against compiler acceptance. Deterministic retrieval proposes candidate counterparts for each paper item in the Lean repository and, when available, the Blueprint; a language model judges statement-level correspondence only among those candidates, while a deterministic transitive dependency audit, never exposed to the model, establishes proof completeness. A fusion step assigns each item one of five coverage states, from Formalized to Missing, each backed by inspectable evidence. On consensus annotations of 98 items from three Lean projects, with three runs of each of two judge models, LeanTrail assigns the correct coverage state to 91.8% of items with Gemini 3.8 Flash and 92.5% with GPT-6 Sol; 96-97 of the 98 states are identical across runs, and GPT-6 Sol never reports a Partial item as Formalized.
significance: Compiler feedback certifies only that Lean accepts a declaration, not that the declaration captures the intended result, so a repository can compile while a central theorem is weakened, merely auxiliary, or transitively dependent on sorry. LeanTrail provides paper-anchored coverage states backed by inspectable evidence, turning uncovered items into a task queue for formalization agents.

aiRole.description: LeanTrail, an audit tool combining deterministic retrieval and dependency analysis with language-model judging, assigns the correct paper-item coverage state to 91.8% (Gemini 3.8 Flash) and 92.5% (GPT-6 Sol) of 98 items across three Lean projects, with high run-to-run consistency.

humanContribution: Humans designed LeanTrail and its deterministic retrieval and transitive dependency audit, and curated consensus annotations of the 98 items used to evaluate the judge models.

zh.title: 究竟证明了什么？基于 LeanTrail 的可审计论文到 Lean 对齐
zh.summary: LeanTrail 是一种事后执行、与工具无关的审计方法，它不以编译器接受为准，而以源论文为基准衡量形式化进展。确定性检索为 Lean 仓库中的每个论文条目（以及可用时的 Blueprint）提出候选对应项；语言模型只在这些候选中判定语句级对应关系，而确定性传递依赖审计（该审计从不暴露给模型）负责判定证明完备性。融合步骤为每个条目分配五种覆盖状态之一，从已形式化（Formalized）到缺失（Missing），每种状态都附有可检视的证据。在三个 Lean 项目的 98 个条目的共识标注上，使用两个评判模型各运行三次，LeanTrail 在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 下给出正确覆盖状态的比例为 91.8%，在 GPT-6 Sol 下为 92.5%；98 个状态中有 96 到 97 个在多次运行中保持一致，且 GPT-6 Sol 从未把部分形式化（Partial）的条目报告为已形式化。
zh.significance: 编译器反馈只证明 Lean 接受某个声明，并不证明该声明表达了预期结果：一个仓库可能顺利编译，而核心定理被削弱、仅成为辅助结果，或传递依赖于 sorry。LeanTrail 以论文为锚点、以可检视证据为支撑给出覆盖状态，从而把未覆盖条目转化为形式化智能体的任务队列。
zh.aiRoleDescription: LeanTrail 将确定性检索与依赖分析同语言模型判定相结合，为三个 Lean 项目的 98 个论文条目判定覆盖率状态，其中 Gemini 3.8 Flash 正确率为 91.8%，GPT-6 Sol 为 92.5%，且多次运行之间高度一致。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了 LeanTrail 及其确定性检索与传递依赖审计流程，并整理了 98 个条目的共识标注，用于评测判定模型。

title: Exhaustive Canonical Skeletons Generation: A Formal Dataset for Decomposable Symbolic Regression
summary: This work introduces an exhaustive dataset of univariate canonical skeletons generated by a deterministic constrained context-free grammar, replacing stochastic sampling of expressions that produces structural redundancy and incomplete functional coverage. A canonical skeleton subsumes more specific functional forms, so redundant expressions and repeated computation are eliminated. Although the skeletons are univariate, the dataset supports the decomposable symbolic regression paradigm for multivariate problems without assuming linear separability. The dataset is paired with a sampling strategy that yields clean numerical data without numerical instabilities or artificial protected operators. Canonicalizing two existing neural SR datasets shows the new dataset is substantially more compact, free of structural repetitions, and has a uniform operator distribution without simplicity bias. A benchmark of 150 SR problems across three tiers is also established, on which state-of-the-art SR methods struggle significantly.
significance: Training data quality is a central bottleneck for neural symbolic regression, and stochastic expression sampling wastes capacity on redundant or biased structures. An exhaustive, canonicalized skeleton dataset offers compact and complete structural coverage, while the clean sampling strategy removes a common source of numerical artifacts. The multi-tier benchmark of 150 problems gives the community a concrete measure of remaining weaknesses in state-of-the-art SR methods.

zh.title: 穷举规范骨架生成：一个面向可分解符号回归的形式化数据集
zh.summary: 本研究构建了一个由确定性受约束上下文无关文法（context-free grammar）生成的一元规范骨架穷举数据集，以取代会带来结构冗余与函数覆盖不完整的随机表达式采样方法。规范骨架（canonical skeleton）能够涵盖更具体的函数形式，从而消除冗余表达式与重复计算。尽管这些骨架是一元的，该数据集仍支持可分解符号回归（decomposable symbolic regression）范式，在不假设线性可分的前提下求解多元符号回归问题。研究者还将该数据集与一种采样策略配对，生成不含数值不稳定问题、也无需人工保护算子的干净数值数据。对两个现有神经符号回归数据集进行规范化后可见，本数据集规模显著更紧凑，消除了结构重复，并且算子分布均匀、不存在简单性偏差。研究还建立了一个包含 150 个符号回归问题、分为三个难度层级的基准，当前最先进的符号回归方法在该基准上表现出明显困难。
zh.significance: 训练数据质量是神经符号回归（neural symbolic regression）的核心瓶颈之一，而随机表达式采样会在冗余或有偏的结构上浪费模型容量。穷举且规范化的骨架数据集提供了紧凑而完整的结构覆盖，干净的采样策略则消除了数值伪影的常见来源。包含 150 个问题、分为三个层级的基准为研究界提供了衡量当前最先进符号回归方法剩余短板的具体手段。

title: Verifying deployed bytecode against executable EVM semantics, with exact gas and no added axioms
summary: Blanc, a Lean 4 verification stack, verifies fixed deployed EVM bytecode as it runs, using kernel-checked certificates and no axioms beyond Lean's own, with every theorem stated against Jaune, an executable semantics of the EVM and block processing that passes all 34,205 relevant blockchain-test cases of Ethereum's fixture release v20.0.2. The study covers eight artifacts deployed from 2017 to 2026, built by seven compiler versions and an assembler. For the EIP-7002 contract, it proves the end-of-block call always succeeds regardless of storage and that each block's withdrawal requests are exactly the oldest pending submissions. For a Uniswap V2 pair it proves storage-level correspondence with its Solidity model over committed calls, a balanced liquidity ledger, and geometric-mean reserves per share falling only through the protocol fee. Exact gas yields a closed-form withdrawal transaction for a tracked WETH9 holder without code, matching all 3,748 comparable mainnet receipts in 30,000 blocks. For Curve pool bytes containing the lock bug exploited in 2023, Jaune executes the reentrancy, while bytes from a fixed compiler are proved to exclude it. AI agents wrote the proofs in fifteen days under one author's direction, atop an existing stack.
significance: The work shows that immutable deployed bytecode, including old unverified compiler output and protocol logic, can be verified without trusting its producer, without simplifying the machine, and with exact gas, so safety and liveness results carry over to real mainnet execution. The demonstrated cases span protocol invariants, token-pair accounting, and historical exploit behavior, and the fifteen-day AI-driven proof effort indicates a practical route to machine-checked guarantees for deployed smart contracts.

aiRole.description: AI agents wrote proofs, in fifteen days, verifying deployed EVM bytecode against the executable Jaune semantics with exact gas and no added axioms, including theorems for EIP-7002, a Uniswap V2 pair, WETH9 withdrawals and Curve lock bytes.

humanContribution: One author directed the AI agents, and humans built the existing Blanc/Jaune verification stack the work relied on.

zh.title: 对照可执行 EVM 语义验证部署字节码，精确 gas 且不新增公理
zh.summary: Blanc，一个 Lean 4 验证栈，直接对固定部署的 EVM 字节码（bytecode）进行验证，使用经内核检查的证书，且除 Lean 自身外不引入任何公理（axiom），每个定理（theorem）都对照 Jaune 这一 EVM 与区块处理的可执行语义（semantics）陈述；Jaune 通过了 Ethereum 测试夹具版本 v20.0.2 中全部 34,205 个相关区块链测试用例。研究覆盖 2017 至 2026 年部署的八个产物，由七个编译器版本与一个汇编器构建。对 EIP-7002 合约，工作证明区块末尾对该合约的调用无论存储内容如何都会成功，且每个区块的提款请求（withdrawal requests）恰好是最早的待处理提交。对一个 Uniswap V2 交易对，工作证明其存储与 Solidity 模型在已提交调用上的回放相对应、均衡的流动性账本保持均衡，且在关于代币应答的前提之下，每份额的几何平均储备仅因协议手续费而下降。精确 gas 使得活性（liveness）可证：一个被追踪且无代码的 WETH9 持有者可以通过一笔 gas 有闭式表达的交易完成提款，该表达式与 30,000 个区块内全部 3,748 笔同形主网回执相符。对含有 2023 年被利用的锁漏洞的 Curve 资金池字节码，Jaune 会执行该重入；而对来自修复后编译器的字节码，工作证明该锁排除此类重入。AI 智能体在一位作者的指导下用十五天写出了这些证明，基于已有的技术栈。
zh.significance: 该工作表明，不可变的部署字节码，包括未经验证的旧编译器输出与协议逻辑，可以在不信任其产生者、不简化运行机器、且精确给出 gas 的前提下完成验证，因此安全性与活性结论可直接对应真实主网执行。所展示的案例涵盖协议不变量、代币对记账与历史漏洞行为
zh.aiRoleDescription: AI agents 在十五天内完成了证明，将已部署的 EVM 字节码对照可执行的 Jaune 语义进行验证，实现精确 gas 且不添加公理，涵盖 EIP-7002、Uniswap V2 交易对、WETH9 提取以及 Curve lock 字节码等定理。

title: LeanPRM: Lean-Grounded Process Supervision for Natural Language Proof Verification
summary: LeanPRM uses the Lean proof assistant to generate step-level correctness labels for natural-language proofs without human annotation. A model first writes a natural-language proof together with a paired formal proof without feedback from Lean, Lean then labels each step, and a second model filters failures caused only by formal syntax so that negative labels reflect genuine mathematical errors. The resulting dataset contains 10,634 proofs with 152K labeled steps. A Qwen3-4B verifier trained on it reaches 74.7 exact step-label accuracy on LeanPRM-Bench, up from 48.2, versus 60.3 for the same base model trained on PRM800K, with gains observed at every model size from 0.6B to 8B on LeanPRM-Bench, Hard2Verify and IMO-GradingBench.
significance: Obtaining step-level correctness labels is the main bottleneck for learned verification of long AI-generated proofs, and LeanPRM produces such labels automatically, letting the dataset grow with the supply of formal statements. The trained verifiers select better proofs in best-of-N selection on IMO-level problems and outperform the PRM800K-trained verifier on three of four external verification benchmarks, offering a scalable source of step-level feedback for proofs that are hard for humans to check.

title: Definition Grounding in Theory-Level Auto-formalization
summary: The paper proposes definition grounding, the continuous judging and revision of formalized definitions, as a way to make auto-formalization genuinely reusable. Agents formalizing definitions from textbook text often produce definitions that later statements cannot use: only 25%-50% of their definition sets are compatible with all later statements. Clarifying the informal definitions raises this rate to as much as 77.5% averaged over all models. Additionally, stating a small set of basic properties without proving them improves model judges' ability to detect definitions with compatibility issues, at roughly 11% of the definition formalization cost. The results are verified on ReuseBench, a benchmark curated for formalizing new mathematical fields and theories.
significance: Progress in auto-formalization is measured not by code generation speed but by whether downstream mathematics can build on the output. This work shows that definition-level quality is a practical bottleneck, and offers two cheap interventions, informal clarification and unproved property statements, that substantially improve the usability of formalized definitions and the reliability of automated quality checks.

zh.title: 理论层面自动形式化中的定义锚定
zh.summary: 本文提出定义锚定（definition grounding），即对形式化后的定义持续进行评判与修订，以提升自动形式化（auto-formalization）成果的可复用性。智能体从教科书文本形式化定义时，常产出后续陈述无法使用的定义：其定义集合中仅有 25%-50% 与所有后续陈述兼容。将非形式化定义加以澄清后，该比例在所有模型上平均可提升至 77.5%。此外，陈述少量基本性质而不加证明，可以提高模型评判器检测定义兼容性问题的能力，而成本仅约为定义形式化成本的 11%。以上结果通过 ReuseBench 得到验证，该基准由研究团队构建，用于形式化新的数学领域与理论。
zh.significance: 自动形式化（auto-formalization）的进展不应以代码生成速度衡量，而应看后续数学研究能否基于其产出继续构建。本研究表明，定义层面的质量是实际瓶颈，并给出两种低成本干预手段，即澄清非形式化定义与陈述未经证明的基本性质，它们能显著提升形式化定义的可用性以及自动质量检查的可靠性。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者的 LLM 智能体将教材文本中的定义形式化为 Lean 代码，其中仅 25%-50% 的定义集与所有后续语句兼容；在澄清非形式化定义后，各模型平均兼容率提升至 77.5%。陈述少量不加证明的基本性质还能以约 11% 的形式化成本提升模型评判器检测定义兼容性问题的能力。
zh.humanContribution: 作者提出了 definition grounding 方法，整理了用于形式化新数学领域与理论的 ReuseBench 基准，并在其上核验了所报告的结果。

title: Falsification-proof non-market allocation mechanisms
summary: The paper examines allocating resources through manipulable characteristics, showing that naively optimal rules invite falsification and allocative inefficiency, while rules optimized while anticipating falsification still induce it at substantial cost to agents, whose falsification also generates negative externalities. The authors characterize optimal falsification-proof rules across a broad range of falsification technologies and give an honesty condition under which such rules solve the planner's unconstrained problem of maximizing a weighted sum of allocative surplus and agents' welfare.
significance: The work offers a rigorous foundation for designing allocation rules in settings such as benefit targeting and school choice, where reported characteristics can be manipulated. It quantifies the welfare losses and negative externalities caused by misreporting and identifies when an honest, first-best allocation can be achieved despite manipulable information.

zh.title: 抗伪造的非市场资源配置机制
zh.summary: 该论文研究资源配置（resource allocation）中基于可操纵特征进行分配的问题，指出朴素最优规则会引发虚假申报（falsification）与配置低效（allocative inefficiency），而在优化规则时考虑虚假申报仍会诱发虚假申报，并给参与者带来沉重成本，且虚假申报产生负外部性。作者刻画了在广泛虚假申报技术（falsification technologies）下的最优防伪造规则（falsification-proof rules），并给出一个诚实条件（honesty condition），使这些规则能求解规划者最大化配置剩余与参与者福利加权和的无约束问题。
zh.significance: 该研究为补贴定向分配、学校选择等信息可操纵的非市场（non-market）场景提供了抗操纵的规则设计（mechanism design）框架，揭示了虚假申报造成的福利损失与负外部性，并指出了在信息可操纵时实现诚实、第一最优（first-best）配置的条件。

title: Beyond Equation Search: Conjecture-Guided Discovery with SCOPE and ClosureBench
summary: The paper argues that symbolic regression benchmarks measure equation fit but not whether the underlying scientific conjecture should be retained, revised, or rejected, since a conjecture may have multiple mathematical realizations and similarly accurate equations may carry different explanations. It introduces SCOPE, a framework where multiple scientist agents independently pursue conjectures through equation modeling, question formulation, and active experimentation, exchange evidence to revise conjectures and research directions, and consolidate findings into a report linking models, conclusions, and evidence. It also introduces ClosureBench, an interactive benchmark of 60 closure-discovery tasks across five scientific domains, where each task embeds an unknown algebraic relation in a known PDE system and agents control experimental conditions in OpenFOAM to acquire data. Beyond equation accuracy, ClosureBench evaluates evidence faithfulness, mechanism insight, and experimental effectiveness. The authors report that SCOPE achieves higher equation accuracy than diverse baselines on ClosureBench and a real-world scientific discovery case, while producing more accurate, reliable, and effective scientific discoveries.
significance: The work reframes AI-driven scientific discovery around testing and revising conjectures rather than optimizing single expressions, and it offers a benchmark that evaluates the evidence and experimental process behind discoveries, not just recovered equations. This could make automated discovery results more interpretable and trustworthy.

aiRole.description: SCOPE's scientist agents independently pursued conjecture-driven trajectories through equation modeling, question formulation, and active experimentation, achieving higher equation accuracy on ClosureBench and a real-world scientific discovery case along with more accurate, reliable, and effective discoveries.

humanContribution: Humans built the SCOPE framework and its scientist agents, curated ClosureBench's 60 closure-discovery tasks across five scientific domains, and defined its three evaluation metrics plus the baseline comparisons.

zh.title: 超越方程搜索：以 SCOPE 和 ClosureBench 进行猜想引导的发现
zh.summary: 论文指出，符号回归（symbolic regression）基准衡量方程拟合程度，却无法判断其背后的科学猜想（conjecture）应当保留、修订还是拒绝，因为一个猜想可能有多种数学实现，而拟合程度相近的方程可能隐含不同的解释。论文提出 SCOPE 框架，由多个科学家智能体独立通过方程建模、问题提出和主动实验来推进各自猜想，交换证据以修订猜想和研究方向，并将结果整合为关联模型、结论与证据的科学报告。论文同时提出交互式基准 ClosureBench，包含五个科学领域的 60 个闭包发现任务（closure-discovery），每个任务把一个未知代数关系嵌入已知的偏微分方程（PDE）系统，智能体在 OpenFOAM 中控制实验条件以获取新数据用于方程发现。除方程精度外，ClosureBench 还提出三项评估发现过程的指标：证据忠实度、机制洞见和实验有效性。作者报告称，与多种基线方法相比，SCOPE 在 ClosureBench 和一个真实科学发现案例上取得更高的方程精度，同时产出更准确、更可靠、更有效的科学发现。
zh.significance: 这项工作将人工智能驱动的科学发现重新定位于检验与修订猜想，而非优化单一表达式，并提供了一个评估发现背后的证据与实验过程、而不只是找回方程的基准。这有望使自动发现的结果更可解释、更值得信赖。
zh.aiRoleDescription: SCOPE 的 scientist agents 独立推进由猜想驱动的研究轨迹，开展方程建模、问题提出与主动实验，在 ClosureBench 及一个真实科学发现案例上取得更高的方程准确率，并产出更准确、可靠且有效的科学发现。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建了 SCOPE 框架及其 scientist agents，整理了 ClosureBench 覆盖五个科学领域的 60 个 closure-discovery 任务，并定义了三项评估指标与基线对比方案。

title: Reset Early, Reset Often, Eliminate Models
summary: SATResetCoP is a connection-tableau prover that keeps grounded tableau clauses in an incremental SAT solver and does not backtrack on unproductive tableaux, instead starting fresh tableaux to generate further ground clauses until the accumulated clauses become propositionally unsatisfiable. On TPTP it improves over a leanCoP-style baseline by 54% and a SATCoP-style baseline by 18%; on the bushy MPTP2078 benchmark it solves 616 problems, a 49% and 12% improvement over the two baselines respectively.
significance: The results indicate that guiding tableau construction toward faster accumulation of useful ground clauses can substantially improve prover performance, offering a simple way to exploit persistent SAT state in place of classical backtracking search.

aiRole.description: The paper introduces SATResetCoP, a connection-tableau prover that keeps grounded tableau clauses in an incremental SAT solver and starts new tableaux instead of backtracking, improving over the leanCoP-style baseline by 54% and the SATCoP-style baseline by 18% on TPTP, and solving 616 bushy MPTP2078 problems.

humanContribution: Humans designed and built SATResetCoP and its SAT-based tableau guidance, selected the leanCoP-style and SATCoP-style baselines and benchmarks, and evaluated and interpreted the results.

zh.title: 尽早重置，频繁重置，消除模型
zh.summary: SATResetCoP 是一种连接表列式证明器（connection tableau），它把接地后的表列子句保存在一个增量式 SAT 求解器中，并且不在无成效的表列上回溯，而是开启新的表列以生成更多接地子句，直到累积的子句达到命题不可满足（propositionally unsatisfiable）。在 TPTP 上，该方法比 leanCoP 风格基线提升 54%，比 SATCoP 风格基线提升 18%；在 bushy 版 MPTP2078 基准上解决 616 个问题，分别比两个基线提升 49% 和 12%。
zh.significance: 这些结果表明，把表列引导方式改为更快地累积有用的接地子句，可以显著提升证明器的性能，也为以持久 SAT 状态取代经典回溯搜索提供了一条简洁的改进路径。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文提出 SATResetCoP，一种将接地 tableau 子句保存在增量 SAT 求解器中、且不回溯而改为开启新 tableau 的连接 tableau 证明器，在 TPTP 上比 leanCoP 风格基线提升 54%、比 SATCoP 风格基线提升 18%，并在 bushy MPTP2078 基准上解决 616 个问题。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计并构建了 SATResetCoP 及其基于 SAT 的 tableau 引导策略，选取了 leanCoP 风格与 SATCoP 风格基线和基准，并对结果进行了评测与解读。

title: Lean 4 programming language and theorem prover
summary: Lean 4 is a programming language and theorem prover maintained in the public repository leanprover/lean4. Its latest release is v4.35.0, dated 2026-10-12, and the project is recorded as an inspectable artifact for AI4Math work.
significance: As a programming language and theorem prover, Lean 4 provides the interactive environment in which formal proofs are written, checked, and extended. The repository gives AI-for-Mathematics researchers a versioned, inspectable source of proof tooling and interaction machinery that can be studied, built upon, and used to evaluate automated reasoning systems.

title: Do Theorem Provers Need Theorem-Proving Agents? mini-Lean-agent: A Coding-Agent Baseline for Lean
summary: The paper introduces mini-Lean-agent, a deliberately minimal agent for Lean tasks whose only model-visible tool is bash; the model inspects and edits repositories, searches local libraries, invokes Lean, and manages intermediate work through bash, while a separate trusted evaluator verifies the final artifact. Comparisons against AxProverBase and Numina-Lean-Agent on the Putnam 2025 benchmark show that with Gemini 3.8 Flash as base model, mini-Lean-agent solves 7/12 problems under a $2 per problem limit versus AxProverBase's 4/12, and with Astra as base model it solves 12/12 at an average cost of $1.28 per problem. The authors argue that a generic coding agent with a minimal harness can already reach strong Lean benchmark performance and propose mini-Lean-agent as a standard baseline for evaluating theorem-proving infrastructure.
significance: Specialized, ad-hoc tooling in formal theorem-proving agents makes it hard to attribute benchmark gains to the base model, the harness, or individual tools. By isolating these factors with a bash-only minimal harness, the study provides a controlled baseline that can clarify which components genuinely drive progress, and the reported results suggest much of the performance attributed to specialized infrastructure may be attainable by generic coding agents.

zh.significance: 形式化定理证明（Formal Theorem Proving）智能体中专用的临时工具使人们难以判断基准性能提升究竟来自基础模型、专用框架还是某个具体工具。本文以仅用 bash 的极简框架分离这些因素，为厘清哪些组件真正推动进展提供了受控基线；所报告的结果表明，通用编码智能体或许无需专用基础设施也能达到接近的性能。

title: Constant-Depth Rational-Weight GNNs and their Connection to Schanuel's Conjecture
summary: This work shows that a constant-depth graph neural network (GNN) with only rational, in fact integer, weights can match the expressiveness of the 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test, provided Schanuel's conjecture holds. The construction is uniform across graph sizes and works with logistic sigmoid, hyperbolic tangent, and related activations. A partial converse is proved: in a setting where graphs may contain certain auxiliary vertices, matching 1-WL with exponentiation, hyperbolic sine, or hyperbolic cosine activations implies Schanuel's conjecture restricted to the numbers appearing in GNN computations. Experiments support the claimed equivalence with 1-WL.
significance: The work links the practical expressive limits of GNNs to a central open problem in transcendental number theory, conditionalizing a sharp expressiveness result on Schanuel's conjecture and deriving a converse direction. The integer-weight, size-uniform construction shows that rational precision suffices in principle for matching 1-WL, with relevance for theoretical understanding and efficient implementations of GNNs.

zh.title: 常数深度有理权重图神经网络及其与Schanuel猜想的联系
zh.summary: 本文证明，只要Schanuel猜想（Schanuel's conjecture）成立，常数深度、仅使用有理数（事实上是整数）权重的图神经网络（GNN）即可达到1-维Weisfeiler-Leman（1-WL）测试的表达能力。该构造在所有图规模上保持一致，并可采用logistic sigmoid、双曲正切（tanh）及相关激活函数。研究还证明了一个部分逆命题：在图可包含某些辅助顶点的更强设定下，若以指数函数、双曲正弦（sinh）或双曲余弦（cosh）为激活函数的GNN能匹配1-WL测试的表达能力，则可推出Schanuel猜想对GNN计算中出现的那些数成立。实验支持该构造与1-WL等价的结论。
zh.significance: 本研究把GNN的实际表达能力上限与超越数论（transcendental number theory）中的核心未解问题联系起来，在Schanuel猜想条件下给出精确的表达能力结果，并建立了逆向关系。整数权重、与图规模无关的构造表明，有理精度在原理上足以匹配1-WL，这对GNN的理论理解与高效实现均有意义。

title: Attention-Graph Curvature for the Verification of Mathematical Reasoning
summary: The paper tests whether the directed Forman curvature of a language model's attention graph, a local quantity computed at each edge from surrounding attention weights, indicates the correctness of individual reasoning steps. Four per-step verifiers were evaluated on ProcessBench with curvature values appended to their inputs; mean performance improved for all four, with the largest gain for ReProbe, which consumes every token of a step. Adding the curvature increased forward-pass time by 18% on average, and the code is publicly available.
significance: A single erroneous reasoning step can invalidate all subsequent work, and natural-language model solutions remain hard to verify with proof assistants, so early error detection is valuable. The results show that a geometric feature already present in the forward pass can strengthen step-level verification of mathematical reasoning at a modest computational cost, aiding the screening of model-generated proofs before formal verification.

aiRole.description: The paper reports that appending directed Forman curvature of the language model's attention graph to per-step verifier inputs improves mean ProcessBench performance for all four verifiers, with ReProbe showing the largest gain and an 18% average forward-pass time increase.

humanContribution: The authors proposed studying curvature as a correctness signal, implemented the computation, and built and evaluated the four per-step verifiers on ProcessBench.

zh.title: 数学推理验证的注意力图曲率
zh.summary: 本文研究语言模型注意力图（attention graph）的有向Forman曲率（directed Forman curvature）是否能反映单个推理步骤的正确性，该曲率是由边周围注意力权重计算出的局部量。研究者在 ProcessBench 上评测四个逐步验证器（per-step verifier），并在其输入中附加曲率数值；四个验证器的平均性能均获得提升，其中接收步骤全部 token 的 ReProbe 提升最大。加入曲率后，前向传播时间平均增加 18%，代码已公开。
zh.significance: 一个错误的推理步骤会使后续所有步骤失效，而模型以自然语言给出的解答目前难以由证明助手（proof assistant）验证，因此尽早发现错误具有重要价值。结果表明，前向传播中已有的几何特征能以适度的计算开销增强数学推理的逐步验证，有助于在形式化验证之前筛查模型生成的证明。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文报告：将语言模型注意力图的有向 Forman 曲率附加到逐步验证器输入后，四个验证器在 ProcessBench 上的平均性能均有所提升，其中 ReProbe 提升最大，前向传播平均耗时增加 18%。
zh.humanContribution: 作者提出了将曲率作为正确性信号进行研究的思路，实现了相关计算，并构建和评测了四个逐步验证器在 ProcessBench 上的表现。

title: AI Discovery in Combinatorics: From Problems to Solutions and Back to Bigger Problems
summary: The paper introduces qtBench, a benchmark of 29 open problems in algebraic combinatorics in which the goal is to find a simple combinatorial algorithm explaining given polynomial coefficients or identities. The authors provide a scaffold for manipulating combinatorial objects, resisting cheating, and testing candidate solutions, and they collaborated with OpenAI, whose researchers proposed solutions to several benchmark problems. The authors then turn to meta-questions raised by such results, including the ethics of AI discovery at scale, how findings should be released, and how proof digestion should be organized, offering their own views on each.
significance: qtBench gives the field a standardized, anti-cheating testbed for measuring how well frontier AI systems can generate genuine combinatorial explanations rather than pattern-matched answers. The proposed solutions obtained through the OpenAI collaboration show both the promise of AI-driven discovery and the governance problems it creates, making the paper relevant to benchmark design, research practice, and the responsible communication of AI-assisted proofs.

zh.summary: 本文提出 qtBench，一个包含29个代数组合学（algebraic combinatorics）未解问题的基准测试，其目标是找到能解释给定多项式系数或恒等式的简单组合算法。作者提供了用于操作组合对象、防范作弊行为并检验候选解的脚手架，并与 OpenAI 合作，由其研究者为其中若干问题提出了候选解。作者进而讨论这些成果引发的元问题，包括大规模人工智能发现是否合乎伦理、成果应如何发布，以及证明消化应如何组织，并给出了各自的观点。
zh.significance: qtBench 为该领域提供了一个标准化且具备防作弊机制的测试环境，用以衡量前沿人工智能系统能否生成真正的组合学解释，而非依赖模式匹配的答案。通过与 OpenAI 合作所获得的候选解既展示了人工智能驱动发现的潜力，也暴露了随之而来的治理难题，因此本文对基准测试设计、研究实践以及人工智能辅助证明的负责任传播都具有重要意义。

title: A Lean formalisation of the disproof of Ramaekers's conjecture
summary: The paper presents Redhill, a Lean formalisation of the main results of Hölzl, Kleine and Stephan's "Improved Lower Bounds for Strong $n$-Conjectures" (arXiv:2409.13439), covering the disproof of Ramaekers's conjecture. It justifies type and data structure choices that enable canonical statements of the paper's claims and the most direct proofs of them. The formalisation process uncovered errors, omissions and optimisation opportunities in the informal proof, all resolved in the final library. A few lemmas were upstreamed to mathlib, and the authors discuss the trade-offs between upstreaming and keeping lemmas in a standalone library. Completed without any large language model (LLM) assistance, Redhill is compared with LLM-assisted projects, notably an extension of arXiv:2409.13439 to $n=4$, to derive design and style guidelines for good Lean formalisations.
significance: It provides machine-checked verification of a disproof of Ramaekers's conjecture and demonstrates how formalisation exposes flaws and improvement opportunities in informal proofs. The discussion of upstreaming versus standalone libraries, together with a comparison of LLM-free and LLM-assisted workflows, offers actionable design and style guidance for the growing ecosystem of Lean formalisation projects.

zh.title: Ramaekers猜想（Ramaekers's conjecture）反证的Lean形式化
zh.summary: 本文介绍Redhill，这是对Hölzl、Kleine与Stephan所著《Improved Lower Bounds for Strong $n$-Conjectures》（arXiv:2409.13439）主要结果的Lean形式化，涵盖对Ramaekers猜想（Ramaekers's conjecture）的反证。论文论证了类型与数据结构的设计选择如何使论文主张得以规范表述，并由此得到这些主张最直接的证明。形式化过程发现了非形式证明中的许多错误、疏漏与优化机会，最终库中均予以解决。少量引理被上游合并至mathlib，作者讨论了上游合并与将引理保留在独立库之间的取舍。Redhill的完成完全未借助大语言模型（LLM），论文将其与使用LLM辅助的项目作比较，尤其是将arXiv:2409.13439推广到$n=4$的扩展工作，旨在提炼出界定优质Lean形式化的设计与风格准则。
zh.significance: 该工作为Ramaekers猜想的反证提供了机器校验的验证，并展示了形式化如何暴露非形式证明中的缺陷与改进空间。关于上游合并与独立库的讨论，以及无LLM辅助与LLM辅助工作流的对比，为日益壮大的Lean形式化生态提供了可操作的设计与风格指导。

title: VeriPIE: Checkable Query Plans and Evidence-Guided Selection for Text-to-SQL
summary: VeriPIE is a neurosymbolic Text-to-SQL framework that ensembles direct SQL generation with QuerySketch, a structured plan language whose checks are implemented in Lean. Plan diagnostics drive repair before SQL is emitted, while execution agreement and bounded searches for distinguishing databases guide candidate selection; the approach exposes malformed plans and hidden disagreements but does not prove agreement with user intent. On the full Spider development set in single-run experiments, VeriPIE reaches 72.05% test-suite accuracy (745/1,034) versus DeepEye's 65.67% (679/1,034), and its two-query shortlist covers 78.43% (811 questions) against 74.66% for DIN-SQL (772) and 69.05% for DeepEye (714). On BIRD it attains 68.90% execution accuracy and 73.73% two-query coverage.
significance: Financial AI governance and model risk management demand independent validation, transparency, and effective challenge of AI-generated computations. VeriPIE supplies reviewable evidence about what a generated query computes — explicit plan checks, repair diagnostics, and concrete counterexample disagreements — while improving accuracy and shortlist coverage over strong baselines on Spider and BIRD, making automated query generation more auditable for financial analysis.

zh.title: VeriPIE：可检查的查询计划与证据引导的选择机制
zh.summary: VeriPIE 是一个神经符号 Text-to-SQL 框架，将直接生成 SQL 与 QuerySketch 相结合；QuerySketch 是一种结构化查询计划语言，其检查后端用 Lean 实现。系统在生成 SQL 之前利用计划诊断信息指导修复，并通过执行一致性与有界搜索寻找区分性数据库来辅助候选选择；这些检查能够暴露格式错误的计划与隐蔽的分歧，但并不能证明生成结果符合用户意图。在 Spider 开发集完整数据上的单次运行实验中，VeriPIE 达到 72.05% 的测试套件准确率（745/1,034），高于 DeepEye 的 65.67%（679/1,034）；其两条查询候选覆盖 78.43% 的问题（811 条），而 DIN-SQL 为 74.66%（772 条）、DeepEye 为 69.05%（714 条）。在 BIRD 上，VeriPIE 达到 68.90% 的执行准确率与 73.73% 的两查询覆盖率。
zh.significance: 金融人工智能治理与模型风险管理（MRM）要求对 AI 生成的计算进行独立验证、保持透明并实施有效质疑。VeriPIE 为生成查询究竟计算了什么提供可审查的证据，包括显式的计划检查（plan check）、修复诊断以及具体的反例分歧，同时在 Spider 与 BIRD 上相较强基线提升了准确率与候选覆盖能力，使自动化查询生成在金融分析场景中更易于审计。

title: Masked Attention Pooling Is Invariant to Padding and Permutation: A Formal Proof in Lean
summary: The paper defines masked attention pooling using a guarded normalizer and proves in Lean 4 with mathlib that the pooled output is invariant under any bijective reindexing of rows and under appending any finite number of masked rows with arbitrary real features and logits. It further shows that masked-position values are irrelevant and that an all-masked bag maps to zero, for arbitrary finite index types and feature dimensions. Using the jax-lean certificate pipeline, the authors connect these theorems to the Jaxpr traced from the JAX kernel itself: Lean checks translation certificates for two concrete shapes, identifies the generated functions with the generic specification, and transfers both invariances to the imported Jaxpr's real-arithmetic semantics. All audited theorems rely only on Lean's three standard axioms. Floating-point execution, XLA, and the JAX tracer and importer are outside the proof.
significance: Attention-based multiple instance learning pipelines commonly assume that padding and storage order do not affect the pooled result, but standard implementation idioms such as zeroing padded features or masking logits with -infinity or a large negative constant fail without side conditions. This work supplies machine-checked guarantees for the exact conditions under which padding and permutation invariance hold, and it carries those guarantees down to JAX-generated code via verified translation certificates. The results provide a sound reference specification for implementations while making clear that floating-point and compiler behavior remain unverified.

zh.title: 掩码注意力池化对填充与排列不变：Lean 中的形式化证明
zh.summary: 本文定义了使用受保护归一化项的掩码注意力池化，并在 Lean 4 结合 mathlib 证明其输出对行的任意双射重索引（permutation invariance）以及对追加任意有限多个带任意实数特征和对数的掩码行（padding invariance）均不变。定理（theorem）还表明掩码位置上的取值无关紧要，且全掩码的包映射为零，结论适用于任意有限索引类型与特征维度。借助 jax-lean 证书流水线，作者将这些定理与从 JAX 核心本身追踪得到的 Jaxpr 相连接：Lean 检查两个具体形状的翻译证书，将生成函数与通用规范对应起来，并把两种不变性转移到所导入 Jaxpr 的实数算术语义上。所有经审计的定理仅依赖 Lean 的三个标准公理。浮点执行、XLA 以及 JAX 追踪器和导入器均在证明范围之外。
zh.significance: 基于注意力的多重实例学习（multiple instance learning, MIL）流水线通常假定填充和存储顺序不影响池化结果，但将填充特征置零、用 -infinity 或大负数掩码对数等常见实现手法只有在附加条件下才成立。这项工作为填充不变性与排列不变性成立的精确条件提供了机器检查的保证，并通过经验证的翻译证书把这些保证下达到 JAX 生成的代码。结果可作为实现的可靠参考规范，同时明确指出浮点与编译器行为仍未被验证。

title: What the Machine Invented: Mining New Mathematical Instruments from OpenAI's October 2026 Release of AI-Generated Mathematics
summary: This paper treats OpenAI's October 2026 release of 722 AI-written manuscripts, grouped into 372 problem families in github.com/openai/math, as a mine of mathematical ideas, and extracts the new lemmas, constructions, inequalities and proof mechanisms used in the source arguments. The authors coin the term mathematical instruments for these objects and survey 38 families across number theory, geometry, analysis, combinatorics, complexity, algebra, operator algebras, topology and mathematical physics, recording each claim, its extracted instruments, antecedents and caveats. Eleven cross-cutting patterns link the entries, and a scoreboard tracks formalization status and dependencies. Novelty judgments are explicitly provisional, source comparisons fix statements, hypotheses and counts without certifying proofs or priority, and no Lean development was compiled or kernel-checked. A short closing section describes applying the signed restriction lemma from family 112 to circuit lower bounds at every fixed depth.
significance: The survey separates extraction of candidate ideas from validation, giving researchers a systematic inventory of instruments that can be checked, formalized and reused independently of whether the AI-generated source proofs hold. Its provisionality safeguards and dependency scoreboard model how large AI-generated corpora can be triaged productively, and the reported application of the signed restriction lemma suggests that instruments mined from the release may feed back into areas such as complexity theory.

zh.title: 机器发明了什么：从OpenAI 2026年10月发布的AI生成数学中挖掘新的数学工具
zh.summary: 本文将OpenAI于2026年10月发布的722篇AI撰写的数学手稿视为一座数学思想的富矿，这些手稿在github.com/openai/math中按372个问题族组织，作者从中提取源论证所引入的新引理、构造、不等式与证明机制，并将这些对象统称为数学工具（mathematical instruments）。研究者考察了数论、几何、分析、组合学、复杂性、代数、算子代数、拓扑与数学物理中的38个问题族，分为17和21两组，每一条目记录相应断言、提取出的工具、先例与注意事项。十一条贯穿性模式把这些条目联系起来，计分板则记录形式化状态与依赖关系。新颖性判断明确是暂定的，源文献比较只修正陈述、假设与计数，不确立优先权或证明其底层证明成立，且本综述未编译或经内核检查任何Lean形式化开发。文末简述将问题族112中的带符号限制引理（signed restriction lemma）应用于任意固定深度的线路下界（circuit lower bounds）的后续工作。
zh.significance: 该综述把候选思想的提取与验证明确分开，使研究者能够获得一份可独立核查、形式化与复用的工具清单，无论AI生成的源证明是否成立。其关于新颖性的保留态度与依赖关系计分板，为如何高效梳理大规模AI生成文献提供了范式；带符号限制引理的上述应用表明，从这批成果中挖掘出的工具可能反哺复杂性理论等领域。

title: Learning Graded Sparse Mechanisms: A Representation Theorem and Certified Generalization
summary: This paper studies supervised learning of graded sparse mechanisms, where each element's influence is capped by a provided weight and the relevant elements vary with system state. The authors axiomatize the function class and prove a representation theorem: it coincides exactly with the Lipschitz ball of a transport metric on weighted multisets, and this metric is uniquely forced by the axioms. The resulting geometry yields generalization bounds driven by the data's sparsity profile, with an exponent from the profile and no dependence on the number of elements, together with matching lower bounds in several natural cases. An empirical bound is also obtained by applying classical discrepancy results directly, giving a transport distance between the two halves of the sample computed exactly via matching, plus a concentration term. Simulations of a Vicsek flock under four interaction rules and two noise levels show the certificate is non-vacuous, a small fraction of the trivial value in every case.
significance: The work puts a widely used modeling pattern, from flocks and crowds to learned particle simulators and graph networks, on rigorous foundations as a class of functions with an explicit grading. The representation theorem pins down the correct geometry of the class, and the generalization bounds scale with a data-dependent sparsity profile rather than the number of elements, making the guarantees relevant for large multi-agent systems. The computable empirical certificate, verified as non-vacuous on simulation data, offers a practical tool for certifying learned interaction mechanisms.

zh.title: 学习分级稀疏机制：表示定理与可认证泛化
zh.summary: 本文研究分级稀疏机制的监督学习问题，其中每个元素的影响受所给权重限制，而起作用的元素随系统状态变化。作者用公理刻画该函数类并证明表示定理（representation theorem）：该类恰好等于加权多重集（weighted multiset）上某种输运度量（transport metric）的 Lipschitz 球，且该度量由公理唯一确定。由此几何结构导出的泛化界（generalization bound）依赖于数据的稀疏度剖面，指数由该剖面给出且不依赖元素个数；在若干自然情形下作者还给出匹配的下界。借助经典差异性界还可直接得到经验泛化界，其形式为用匹配精确计算的、样本两半在该度量下的输运距离，外加一个集中项。作者在两种噪声水平、四种交互规则下模拟 Vicsek 鸟群模型（Vicsek flock），结果表明该认证非平凡，在所有设置下仅为平凡值的一小部分。
zh.significance: 这项工作为从鸟群、人群到学习型粒子模拟器与图网络等广泛使用的建模模式提供了严格基础，将其作为带显式分级的函数类加以研究。表示定理（representation theorem）确定了该类的正确几何结构，而泛化界随数据依赖的稀疏度剖面变化而非元素个数增长，因此对大型多智能体系统具有实际意义。在仿真数据上验证为非平凡的可计算认证，为验证所学交互机制提供了实用工具。

title: Representation Theorems for Actual Powers over Two-Agent General Concurrent Game Frames
summary: This paper revisits Pauly's representation theorem, which links the induced powers of individuals and coalitions in concurrent game frames to neighborhood frames via alpha effectivity, a monotonic notion that cannot distinguish whether two enforceable sets come from the same joint action. Using actual power, also called basic power by van Benthem, Bezhanishvili, and Enqvist (2019), which records the set of states corresponding to one joint action of the coalition against all joint actions of the others, the authors study the eight classes of general concurrent game frames obtained by relaxing seriality, independence of agents, and determinism, as argued by Li and Ju (2025, 2026). Assuming two agents, the paper proves that these eight classes are represented, in terms of actual powers, by eight corresponding classes of neighborhood frames, generalizing the result of van Benthem, Bezhanishvili, and Enqvist (2019).
significance: The result preserves action-level information that alpha effectivity erases, showing that neighborhood semantics can faithfully capture actual powers even when standard game assumptions are weakened. It extends Pauly's representation theorem to a broader family of game frames and provides a uniform correspondence across all eight variants, strengthening the logical analysis of strategic power.

zh.title: 两智能体一般并发博弈框架中实际权力的表示定理
zh.summary: 本文重新考察 Pauly 表示定理（Pauly's representation theorem），该定理通过 α-有效（alpha effectivity）把并发博弈框架（concurrent game frame）中个体与联盟的诱导权力对应到邻域框架（neighborhood frame）。α-有效本质上是单调的，无法区分两个可强制实现的集合是否出自同一个联合行动。本文采用实际权力（actual power），即 van Benthem、Bezhanishvili 与 Enqvist (2019) 所称的基本权力（basic power），它记录联盟的单一联合行动在其他智能体所有联合行动下所对应的状态集合。研究者考察了 Li 与 Ju (2025, 2026) 提出的八类一般并发博弈框架，这些框架由放松串行性（seriality）、智能体独立性（independence of agents）与确定性（determinism）得到。在假设两智能体的情形下，本文证明这八类一般并发博弈框架在实际权力意义上分别由八类相应的邻域框架所表示，从而推广了 van Benthem、Bezhanishvili 与 Enqvist (2019) 的结果。
zh.significance: 该结果保留了 α-有效所抹去的与具体联合行动相关的信息，表明即便在放宽标准博弈假设时，邻域语义仍能忠实刻画实际权力。它把 Pauly 表示定理推广到更广的博弈框架族，并在全部八种变体上给出统一的对应关系，从而加强了对策略权力的逻辑分析。

title: Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning
summary: Sequent-Prover is a family of verifier-using language-model agents that reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad, writing complete SMT-LIB programs, querying Z3 across turns, repairing formalizations from solver feedback, and ending with an explicit answer. Its verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation recipe samples multi-turn trajectories from a noisy teacher proposal policy, keeps the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applies supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Since solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, the work evaluates task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability from 64.1% to 91.7%, while reducing average SMT calls from 4.10 to 2.52 and tokens per attempt from 18.97k to 12.72k.
significance: The work couples language-model reasoning with solver-verified formal artifacts, so answers can be checked mechanically rather than trusted on plausibility. It shows that verifier-informed filtering of a noisy teacher's trajectories can substantially improve accuracy and multi-attempt reliability while cutting solver calls and token cost, and it offers evaluation criteria that distinguish executable solver success from genuine semantic faithfulness in formal reasoning.

zh.summary: Sequent-Prover 是一族使用验证器的语言模型智能体，它们在可执行的 SMT-LIB 草稿空间中进行推理：编写完整的 SMT-LIB 程序，跨轮次调用 Z3，根据求解器反馈修复形式化，最终给出明确答案。其名为验证器条件轨迹蒸馏（verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation）的流程从一个嘈杂的教师提议策略中采样多轮轨迹，保留正确、非平凡、有依据且可执行的成功尾部，再进行监督微调（SFT）与轨迹级偏好优化。由于仅凭求解器成功并不能保证语义忠实，本文评估任务准确率、k 样本可靠性与 SMT 程序质量。在 37 个基准、每个模型系列 7,254 道问题上，后训练将 4B 模型的单次尝试准确率从 85.6% 提升至 97.0%，四样本全对可靠性从 64.1% 提升至 91.7%，并将平均 SMT 调用次数从 4.10 降至 2.52、每次尝试的 token 数从 18.97k 降至 12.72k。
zh.significance: 该工作把语言模型推理与求解器验证的形式化产物结合起来，使答案可以被机械检验，而不必依赖表面合理性。研究表明，用验证器信息筛选嘈杂教师的轨迹可显著提升准确率与多次尝试的可靠性，同时减少求解器调用与 token 开销；评估标准还能区分求解器层面的可执行成功与形式推理中真正的语义忠实。

title: TLA-Verus: Generating and Solving Temporal Proof Obligations with LLM Agents
summary: The work addresses TLA+'s limited support for proving arbitrary temporal logic properties and its inability to detect drift between implementations and mathematical specifications. The authors translate TLA+ specifications into Verus, a verifier for Rust, using both a deterministic transpiler and an agentic LLM translator. The pipeline generates proof obligations at scale and produces fully machine-checkable proofs of safety and liveness properties, and the resulting evaluation dataset is used to assess current LLM capabilities in Verus theorem proving.
significance: Verifying temporal properties of distributed systems such as databases and coordination protocols remains difficult for existing TLA+ tooling. By bridging TLA+ and Verus, this work makes safety and liveness proofs machine-checkable and offers an early route toward implementation-specification consistency checking, while also establishing a benchmark for LLM-based formal reasoning in Verus.
