title: Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees
summary: The paper derives sufficient conditions under which local reflection in language agents yields sublinear counterfactual regret for the complete agent under resource constraints, while keeping the native controller unchanged. It establishes a resource-sensitive transfer bounding full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserving the own-history laws of both learner and comparator, together with a cumulative generation opportunity bound linking local generation reliability to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. The conditional proof chains for all thirteen numbered theoretical results are formalized in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.
significance: Existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves yield long-term guarantees for a full reflective agent; these results close that gap in a resource-aware setting. Machine-checked Lean formalizations strengthen confidence in the proof chain and support rigorous deployment analysis of memory-based, budget-constrained agents.

zh.title: 面向反思型智能体的反事实遗憾及Lean验证保证
zh.summary: 本文推导出一组充分条件，使得语言智能体在资源受限条件下，无需更改原生控制器，即可让局部反思为完整智能体带来次线性反事实遗憾（counterfactual regret）。作者建立了一种资源敏感的迁移结果，沿真实执行路径界定全状态部署偏差，同时保留学习者与比较器各自的自身历史分布律；此外还给出累积生成机会界，通过明确的质量、覆盖度与硬预算权衡，将局部生成可靠性与长期性能联系起来。全部十三个编号理论结果的条件证明链均在Lean中形式化，其中包括一个含策略重复增长与不完美验证的原生实例。
zh.significance: 针对策略选择与动作生成的已有保证，本身并不能为完整的反思型智能体提供长期性能保证；这些结果在考虑资源约束的设定下填补了该空白。经Lean机器检查的形式化提升了证明链的可信度，并有助于对具备记忆且受预算约束的智能体进行严格的部署分析。

title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
summary: HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent) is an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three feedback channels: an independent reviewer that critiques each candidate, a structured wiki supplying task-specific knowledge, and a verifier that checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA attains perfect scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026, near-full marks on IChO 2026, and solves all 672 problems on PutnamBench; on the Lean-Eval leaderboard it ranks first with 251 of 304 problems solved (82.6%). With Kimi-K3, HOA reaches full scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI and 97.1% on IChO, closely matching or exceeding the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline and showing that systematic feedback can narrow gaps in base-model capability.
significance: The work addresses brittleness in single-session LLM agents, where early errors propagate, missing domain knowledge stalls progress, and apparent success may hide a weakened task interpretation. By releasing both an open framework and complete inference stack, unlike prior milestone systems, and by combining review, knowledge, and formal verification channels, HOA shows that workflow design can close capability gaps between open and closed models on olympiad and formal proof benchmarks.

title: SqueezeBench: Saturation-Resilient Evaluation of Mathematical Capability
summary: SqueezeBench is a saturation-resilient benchmark for measuring mathematical progress. Each problem fixes an integer function f(n) known only for small n, and the benchmark maintains certified lower and upper records: computable Lean functions with machine-checked proofs that they bound f. A submission must prove its function bounds f, is no worse than the current record at every n, and is strictly better at some n; once accepted, the improved bound becomes the record the next submission must beat. The gap between the two records at each n quantifies how far the certified bounds remain from determining f(n). Proofs are checked by two independent Lean kernels, and the checks reject trivial exhaustive-search computations at small n, with maintainers inspecting reports for such searches at larger n. The release covers ten problems from extremal combinatorics with twenty proved initial records and admission tools. Agents built on a frontier language model, given at most one hour per record, produced 82 accepted submissions that improved every record without exceeding published literature; agents built on two newer models then added 60 accepted submissions and improved 19 of the 20 records again. For eight of the ten problems, at least one record remains asymptotically behind the best published bound.
significance: Solved-problem benchmarks saturate while open-problem benchmarks can be surpassed only once, so neither supports sustained comparison of mathematical AI systems. SqueezeBench instead makes each successful submission raise the bar, giving a continual, machine-verified measure of progress in both bound quality and proof synthesis. Automated Lean checking removes referee effort, and the released records, tools, and two-wave agent results provide an immediately reusable testbed where substantial headroom remains against the literature.

zh.title: SqueezeBench：对饱和具有稳健性的数学能力评测
zh.summary: SqueezeBench 是一个对饱和具有稳健性的数学能力评测基准。每个问题固定一个整数函数 f(n)，其值仅在较小的 n 上已知；基准维护经过认证的下界纪录与上界纪录，即可计算的 Lean 函数，附带机器检查的证明以说明其为 f 的界。一次提交必须证明：该函数是 f 的界，在每个 n 上都不劣于当前纪录，并在某个 n 上严格更优；一旦被接受，改进后的界就成为下一次提交必须超越的纪录。在每个 n 上，两条纪录之间的差距刻画了认证界与确定 f(n) 之间仍有多远。所有证明由两个独立的 Lean 内核检查，检查还会拒绝用穷举搜索在较小 n 上计算 f 的函数，维护者只需阅读提交报告并在更大的 n 上排查此类搜索。该发布包含来自极值组合学（extremal combinatorics）的十个问题、二十条已证明的初始纪录以及准入工具。基于某一前沿语言模型的智能体在每条纪录至多一小时的条件下，共有 82 次提交被接受，改进了全部纪录，且未超出已发表文献；基于两个更新模型的智能体随后从这些纪录出发，又获得 60 次接受的提交，并再次改进了 20 条纪录中的 19 条。十个问题中有八个，至少一条纪录在渐近意义上仍落后于已发表的最优界。
zh.significance: 已解问题基准会饱和，而开放问题基准只能被超越一次，因此二者都无法支持对数学 AI 系统的持续比较。SqueezeBench 让每次成功提交都抬高门槛，从而在界的质量与证明合成两方面给出可持续、经机器验证的进展度量。自动化的 Lean 检查省去了人工审稿负担，而发布的纪录、工具与两轮智能体结果构成了可直接复用的测试平台，且相对文献仍有可观的改进空间。

title: MathVis: Can AI Reason through Drawing? A Benchmark for Mathematical Figure Generation
summary: MathVis is a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can visualize frontier mathematical problems and use diagrams in their reasoning. It contains 512 tasks, each with a mathematical statement, a reference diagram, executable TikZ or SVG code, a Gold Intermediate Representation (IR), atomic rubrics, and error codes. In evaluation, GPT-6-Astra, Claude Fable 5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview reached pass@1 scores of 31.25%, 26.56%, and 22.85%, respectively. The authors find that although these tasks require visualization, LLM outputs are dominated by formal languages, symbols, and graphics programs rather than explicit diagram-mediated reasoning, and solutions that contain all necessary elements are often visually confusing to humans. The benchmark is intended to advance the visualization of mathematical problems and research on making LLM reasoning simpler through visual diagrams.
significance: MathVis provides a structured, code-grounded testbed with reference diagrams and fine-grained rubrics for measuring visual mathematical reasoning, a capability that existing text-centric evaluations largely miss. The reported results reveal a clear gap: current frontier models can assemble the right mathematical content but struggle to turn it into diagrams that genuinely support reasoning and human comprehension, motivating new work on diagram-mediated reasoning for LLMs.

title: Surfing the Activation Wave: Analyzing the Information and Geometry of LLM Hidden States for Speculative Decoding
summary: This work develops a principled framework for selecting multi-layer hidden states in speculative decoding, where exhaustive subset search is combinatorially infeasible. The authors analyze layer-wise Shannon entropy, aggregate entropy of concatenated hidden states, and pairwise centered kernel alignment (CKA) across depth, revealing distinct informational and geometric compartments within decoder representations. They propose entropy- and CKA-based layer selection algorithms that favor sets that are both highly informative and minimally redundant, together with token-entropy filtering that discards hidden states of low predictive-entropy tokens to improve selection statistics. In EAGLE3-style speculative decoding, the selected sets outperform fixed heuristics, including the default [2, N//2, N-3] rule, while clarifying why such defaults can remain competitive.
significance: Selecting target-model layers is a combinatorial bottleneck in speculative decoding, and existing fixed heuristics offer no principled justification. This work grounds layer choice in matrix-entropy and CKA analysis, delivering an effective selection recipe that beats standard defaults while exposing the information and geometry of LLM decoder hidden states that drive the gains.

zh.title: 乘着激活之浪：分析大语言模型隐藏状态的信息与几何以服务于投机解码
zh.summary: 本研究为投机解码（speculative decoding）中的多层隐藏状态选择建立了一套原则性框架，其中穷举子集搜索在组合上不可行。研究者分析了逐层香农熵（Shannon entropy）、拼接隐藏状态的聚合熵，以及沿深度方向的成对居中核对齐（centered kernel alignment, CKA），揭示了解码器表示中存在不同的信息与几何分区。作者提出基于熵与 CKA 的层选择算法，倾向于同时具备高信息量与低冗余的隐藏状态集合，并引入词元熵过滤（token-entropy filtering），剔除低预测熵词元对应的隐藏状态，从而改进层选择统计量的质量。在 EAGLE3 风格的投机解码中，所选集合超越了固定启发式方案（包括默认的 [2, N//2, N-3] 规则），同时阐明了这类默认方案为何仍具竞争力。
zh.significance: 在投机解码（speculative decoding）中，目标模型层的选择是一个组合瓶颈，而现有固定启发式缺乏原则性依据。本工作将层选择建立在矩阵熵与 CKA 分析之上，给出一套超越标准默认方案的实用选择方法，并揭示了驱动性能提升的大语言模型（LLM）解码器隐藏状态的信息与几何结构。

title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
summary: GeoReform is a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than fixed parser output. It runs the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. The paper shows that naive structure injection on Geometry3K fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones across 200 examples, while GeoReform raises Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0% to 56.0% on Geometry3K, with further experiments across geometry reasoning benchmarks supporting the importance of effective formalization.
significance: The results identify representation organization, rather than extraction of more geometric facts, as a key bottleneck in multimodal geometry reasoning, and offer a measurable improvement by optimizing formalization itself. The reported error analysis and the 14-point accuracy gain on Geometry3K give concrete evidence that formalization quality directly affects downstream reasoning performance.

title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models
summary: The paper proposes a self-improvement loop for reasoning models built on hindsight idea extraction: even when a problem is beyond a model's current ability, a supplied solution can still yield useful solution ideas. The method jointly trains one model on three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems paired with known solutions, and solving problems given provided ideas. The loop alternates between reverse-engineering ideas from solved problems and using those ideas as extra supervision for joint training. The authors give a formal specification and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving with the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation is left to future work.
significance: The approach offers a way to mine training signal from problems a model cannot yet solve, potentially widening the pool of useful data and turning full solutions into reusable hints rather than all-or-nothing targets. The Lean instantiation shows how such idea-level supervision could attach to formal, checkable mathematical reasoning, though the effectiveness of the loop remains unverified experimentally.

zh.title: 通过回顾来学习规划：用于训练推理模型的后见层级
zh.summary: 论文提出一种面向推理模型的自我改进循环，其基础是后见的思路提取：即使问题超出了模型当前的解题能力，向模型额外提供解答后，它仍可能事后提取出有用的解题思路。该方法让同一个模型联合训练三种能力：仅从问题预测解题思路、从问题与已知解答中反向推导思路、利用给定思路解题。该循环交替进行两个阶段：先从附带解答的问题中反向推导思路，再把这些思路作为额外监督信号用于三种能力的联合训练。作者给出了方法的形式化规范（formal specification），以及面向交互式定理证明（interactive theorem proving）和 Lean 定理证明器（Lean theorem prover）的具体实现；实验评估留待未来工作。
zh.significance: 这一方法从模型尚无法解决的问题中挖掘训练信号，有望扩大可用数据范围，并把完整解答转化为可复用的提示，而非非全即无的训练目标。该研究提出的 Lean 实现展示了思路层面的监督如何与形式化、可校验的数学推理相结合，但该循环的实际效果仍有待实验验证。

title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
summary: LEVER is a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search rather than only after a proof is found. It scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph by combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so objectives such as computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and weighted combinations of these guide search before completion, with the Lean kernel guaranteeing correctness. On PutnamBench in Lean 4 under matched budgets, LEVER uses 34% less cost than a strong single-conversation agent while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%. On topical impurity it achieves a 42% reduction versus 33% for post-hoc refactoring at two-thirds the cost and with greater reliability, while on proof length it approaches refactoring. Varying the objective weights traces a quality-cost trade-off curve that lets users choose how much a better proof is worth.
significance: Existing LLM theorem provers mostly optimize only for finding any correct proof, leaving proof quality to expensive post-hoc refinement. LEVER unifies quality optimization and cost control inside the search procedure itself, with correctness still enforced by the Lean kernel, and reports stronger solve rates at lower cost alongside tunable, user-configurable trade-offs between proof quality and computational expense.

title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
summary: NanoProof is presented as the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making the system end-to-end reproducible with open-source resources. The authors release a dataset of structured proof trees together with a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier, while emphasizing compute efficiency to keep training and evaluation accessible. NanoProof attains 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, surpassing HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL at roughly 90x and 7x less compute respectively, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof.
significance: The work shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources, in contrast to stronger open-weight provers that are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline. Releasing the dataset, extraction tooling, pipeline, and weights together gives the research community a fully reproducible baseline, and the compute savings make automated theorem proving experiments feasible for groups without large-scale resources.

title: RISR: Residual-Informed Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
summary: RISR is a residual-informed symbolic regression method that uses error patterns across inputs rather than aggregate fit scores to guide formula discovery. It compresses aligned inputs, targets, predictions, and residuals into continuous tokens that condition a language model on formula proposals, and a dual-view relational encoder leverages additive and regularized multiplicative residuals to predict the post-fit utility of candidate corrections. On LLM-SRBench scientific tasks, RISR reaches 63.57% and 38.50% ID accuracy at 1% and 0.1% pointwise relative-error tolerances, with 56.07% and 38.24% OOD accuracy, outperforming reported baselines with the same backbone.
significance: By exploiting the structure of residual error, RISR addresses a limitation of symbolic regression pipelines that reduce quality to a single fit score, improving both in-distribution and out-of-distribution equation recovery. The reported gains over same-backbone baselines indicate that residual-informed guidance is a practical route to more accurate scientific equation discovery with large language models.

humanContribution: The human authors designed and built RISR's residual encoder, dual-view relational encoder, and formula-proposal pipeline, and evaluated the system on the scientific benchmark tasks.

title: Beyond the Ergodic Wall: A Discrete Geometric Physics Sandbox for Analysing AI Scaling Limits and Complexity Collapse
summary: The paper argues that deep learning is ergodic and thermodynamically inefficient, averaging historic human knowledge rather than producing semantic novelty, which it says requires a path-dependent, spatiotemporally bounded observer it calls a Data LifeCone. It proposes a digital physics sandbox built on a Holographic E8 Projection Engine, in which spacetime is a nested face-centered cubic lattice of Planck-scale spheres, with cut-and-project geometry from the E8 root lattice yielding quasi-crystalline structure, integer microstate counts on Bekenstein-boundary surfaces as rest mass, lattice dislocations as stable particles, and continuum physics recovered through variational renormalization-group flows and Fourier Neural Operators toward the Schrödinger equation. The paper further claims that restricting algorithm proposal spaces to physically conserved causal trajectories could collapse NP-to-P complexity to deterministic polynomial-time paths, and frames human-AI symbiosis as a thermodynamic necessity for a mature ASI.
significance: The work brings physical containment and discrete-geometric simulation proposals into AI safety discussions, connecting scaling-limit concerns to information-theoretic models of matter and to claimed complexity-class reductions. As presented, these are proposed mechanisms and conjectural claims rather than established results, so their value lies in the stated research agenda: hard physical containment of models, integer-arithmetic verification against real-world constraints, and testable lattice-based derivations of particle and continuum physics.

zh.title: 超越遍历之墙：用于分析 AI 规模扩展极限与复杂度坍缩的离散几何物理沙盒
zh.summary: 论文认为，深度学习具有遍历性且热力学效率低下，只是对历史上人类知识取统计平均，而非产生语义上的新意；论文主张，真正的语义新意需要由一个路径依赖、在时空上有界的观察者，即 Data LifeCone，注入非遍历洞见，从而取得 KL 散度（KL divergence）并避免流形锁定。论文提出一个基于全息 E8 投影引擎（Holographic E8 Projection Engine）的数字物理沙盒：时空被建模为嵌套的面心立方（FCC）晶格，由普朗克尺度的振荡球体构成，以最大化局域信息与熵密度；由 E8 根格（root lattice）的剪切-投影方法（cut-and-project）产生准晶几何，其中四面体空隙支撑 SU 手征结构，弹性剪切特征值给出候选质量谱。静止质量被视为局域全息边界（贝肯斯坦界（Bekenstein bound））上的离散整数微态计数，以严格整数运算取代浮点近似，从而给出物质的信息论定义。稳定粒子作为反复出现的晶格位错涌现，连续极限则通过变分重整化群（renormalization group）流与 Fourier Neural Operators 学习连续谱算子来恢复，把薛定谔方程（Schrödinger equation）作为涌现的统计描述。论文进一步声称，这些自上而下的拓扑约束为所谓 NP-to-P 复杂度坍缩提供机制：将算法的提议空间限制在物理守恒的因果轨迹上，可把组合搜索树剪枝为确定性的多项式时间路径。
zh.significance: 该工作把物理隔离与离散几何模拟的设想引入 AI 安全讨论，将规模扩展极限问题与物质的信息论模型以及所声称的复杂度类归约联系起来。就论文所述内容而言，这些是提议的机制与猜想性主张，而非已确立的结果；其意义在于所提出的研究纲领：对模型实施硬性物理隔离、以整数运算针对真实世界约束进行验证，以及从晶格模型中可检验地推导粒子物理与连续物理。

title: Bolzano: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
summary: Bolzano is a multi-agent open-source system that combines parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. In initial manual use on expert-selected problems it produced 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Run without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems drawn from four sets of papers, it solved about 200 of them. In one experiment using papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science, it answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by the authors.
significance: The results suggest that a prover system can move from expert-guided proof search to largely automated open-problem solving at scale, while keeping a human-readable research state and applying both a verifier agent and external checks by domain experts and paper authors to the resulting claims.

title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification
summary: CoCo-Prover formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, built on two-level proof graphs: an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations. At each step it selects open goals symbolically via a topological pass and chooses actions through an agentic router that prices each bounded specialist invocation as a separate best-effort computation, routing among heterogeneous specialist agents and configurations under rules that evolve with accumulating evidence. Evaluated on five Lean 4 benchmarks, including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, it attains the best solve rate on every benchmark, up to 100% on two, and cuts cost by up to 30.9% versus the strongest baseline paired with the strongest LLM.
significance: Real software generates hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so proving many theorems economically matters more than maximizing the pass rate for a single theorem at unlimited budget. By exposing a success-versus-cost frontier, CoCo-Prover makes machine-checked correctness for LLM-generated code more practical to obtain at scale, while its symbolic selection plus priced agent orchestration offers a reusable design pattern for cost-aware proof search.

zh.title: 通过智能体编排实现程序验证（program verification）中的成本高效定理证明

zh.significance: 真实软件往往产生数百个相互依赖的证明义务（proof obligation），因此在大规模场景下重要的不是在不计预算的前提下证明单条定理，而是经济地证明尽可能多的定理。CoCo-Prover 揭示了成功率与成本之间的权衡前沿，使对 LLM 生成代码进行机器可检验的正确性保证（machine-checkable correctness）在大规模应用中更具可行性；其符号化目标选择与按价计费的智能体编排，也为成本感知的证明搜索（proof search）提供了可复用的设计模式。

title: Can the Library Speak? Self-Advertised Method Selection for Formal Proving
summary: The paper frames lemma and proof retrieval for LLM-based formal provers as an applicability-aware method-selection problem, arguing that semantic relevance does not establish that a method's prerequisites, target, action, and residual obligations fit the theorem at hand. It introduces self-advertisement, in which a model generates a problem-specific proposal for every candidate method—describing the part of the goal it targets, the action it would take, and the conditions required—before ranking, with vague or unsupported proposals demoted. The authors organize 82 reusable methods drawn from Putnam 2000-2014 as Method Contracts, pairing applicability descriptions with Mathlib anchors, a checked example or scaffold, and expected proof obligations. A single batched call elicits proposals across the whole library and returns an inspectable ranked shortlist. The work also analyzes when similarity-based representations cannot separate methods with differing applicability, how errors in applicability estimates degrade shortlist quality, and what a checked scaffold guarantees under its stated assumptions. Empirically, self-advertisement reaches 95.0% hit@5 on Putnam 2015-2025 versus 84.2% for the strongest reranker, and 91.7% versus 88.3% on IMO ProofBench, indicating improved coverage of annotated methods in retrieved shortlists.
significance: Method selection is a bottleneck for automated theorem provers that retrieve from large libraries: choosing a related but inapplicable lemma or technique wastes search effort and can derail a proof. Self-advertisement gives a library an inspectable account of how and when each method may be used, rather than a bare similarity score, and the Method Contracts make applicability knowledge reusable and checkable via Mathlib-anchored scaffolds. The gains over lexical, embedding, and embedding-plus-LLM reranking baselines, especially the 10.8 point hit@5 improvement on Putnam, suggest that explicit applicability reasoning is a practical route to better shortlist coverage in LLM-based formal proving.

zh.title: 数学库能自我表达吗？面向形式证明的自我宣称方法选择
zh.summary: 论文把基于大语言模型的形式证明（formal proving）系统中的引理与既有证明检索，表述为一个考虑适用性的方法选择问题：语义相关并不能说明某方法的前提、目标、拟采取的动作及剩余证义务是否适用于当前定理（theorem）。作者提出自我宣称（self-advertisement）机制：在候选方法排序之前，模型为每个候选方法生成针对当前问题的提案，说明它作用于目标的哪一部分、将采取什么动作、该动作需要哪些条件；含糊或缺乏支撑的提案会被降级。研究者把取自 Putnam 2000-2014 的 82 个可复用方法整理为方法契约（Method Contracts），将适用性描述与 Mathlib 锚点、已核查的例子或脚手架以及预期证明义务配对。单次批量调用即可在整个方法库中生成提案，并输出带有可检视论断的排序候选清单。论文还分析了基于相似度的表示何时无法区分适用性不同的方法、适用性估计误差如何影响候选清单质量，以及已核查脚手架在其声明的假设下能保证什么。实验上，自我宣称在 Putnam 2015-2025 上取得 95.0% 的 hit@5，最强重排器为 84.2%；在 IMO ProofBench 上为 91.7%，对比 88.3%，表明检索候选清单对已标注方法的覆盖有所提升。
zh.significance: 方法选择是自动定理证明器从大型库中检索时的瓶颈：选中看似相关但不适用的引理或方法会浪费搜索开销，甚至使证明中断。自我宣称让数学库为每个方法的使用方式与适用条件给出可检视的说明，而不只是相似度分数；方法契约借助 Mathlib 锚定的脚手架，使适用性知识可复用、可核查。相对于词法、嵌入以及嵌入加大语言模型重排的基线，该方法在 Putnam 上 hit@5 提升 10.8 个百分点，说明显式的适用性推理是提升基于大语言模型的形式证明中候选清单覆盖质量的可行路径。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 该论文中基于 LLM 的 self-advertisement 方法选择系统在 Putnam 2015-2025 上达到 95.0% 的 hit@5，在 IMO ProofBench 上达到 91.7%，在为形式证明检索可适用方法方面优于基于词法和嵌入的重排序基线。
zh.humanContribution: 人类提出了面向可适用性的方法选择问题，将 82 个可复用的 Putnam 方法整理为包含 Mathlib 锚点、已核查示例与预期证明义务的 Method Contracts，并设计、分析和评估了 self-advertisement 方法。

title: Beyond Type-checking: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Formal Specification Generation
summary: The paper assembles a unified dataset of 350 Lean tasks, including 189 from VERINA and 161 from CLEVER, and proposes a holistic evaluation framework for specification generation (SpecGen) spanning formal validity, reference similarity and equivalence, and behavioural adequacy. The framework makes each metric's evidence scope explicit and separates acceptance of required inputs from acceptance of valid outputs and rejection of invalid outputs. Results show measurement coverage matters: restricting generalized tree edit distance (GTED) similarity to 32 jointly measurable VERINA tasks moves a SpecGen configuration from second to fourth in mean similarity. An authored control further shows a specification scoring 100% positive test recall and negative test rejection while accepting 0% of required inputs, exposing the limits of postcondition-only scoring.
significance: Proof checking only certifies correctness relative to a generated specification, so a specification that misrepresents intended behaviour can still be proven and shipped. Evaluation must therefore assess intent capture as well as formal validity, and separate feedback on input coverage from feedback on output constraints can prevent verifiable code that is unusable in practice.

zh.title: 超越类型检查：迈向形式化规范生成（formal specification generation）的整体评估
zh.summary: 论文汇集了350个 Lean 任务的统一数据集，其中189个来自 VERINA，161个来自 CLEVER，并提出面向规范生成（SpecGen）的整体评估框架，涵盖形式有效性、参考相似度与等价性、行为充分性，明确每个指标的证据范围，并将接受必需输入与接受合法输出、拒绝非法输出区分开来。结果表明测量覆盖度很关键：将广义树编辑距离（generalized tree edit distance, GTED）这一参考相似度度量限定在32个可共同测量的 VERINA 任务上时，某配置在平均相似度上的排名从第二变为第四。研究者还设计了一项对照实验，其中一份规范在正例测试召回与负例测试拒绝上均达到100%，却接受0%的必需输入，暴露了仅看后置条件（postcondition）得分的局限。
zh.significance: 定理证明器（theorem prover）只能证明实现相对于所生成规范的正确性，因此误述预期行为的规范也可能通过证明并被交付使用。评估必须检验规范是否忠实表达用户意图，而将输入覆盖反馈与输出约束反馈分开，有助于避免产出形式上可验证却无法实际使用的代码。

zh.significance: 该研讨会将可靠性视为人工智能所生成技术成果与可信科学结果之间的核心障碍，并把形式化认证以及可靠的数学化高效人工智能的进展与这一目标联系起来。

title: SpecGuard: Proving a Task Is Broken Before the Agent Cheats
summary: SpecGuard detects and formally certifies conflicts between a task's intent and its tests before any agent acts. Given only a task description and codebase, it autoformalizes intended behavior into a Lean 4 specification, formalizes the tests independently, and has the Lean kernel check whether any implementation could satisfy both. When none can, it emits a machine-checked certificate of inconsistency. On conflicted SWE-bench tasks, SpecGuard detects up to 72.8% of conflicts and certifies up to 51.1%, with a nearly five-fold lower conflict miss rate than model-based judgment.
significance: Prior work shows coding agents facing contradictory tasks rarely flag the conflict and instead cheat in ways that can cause real damage, such as deleting a security defense to make a corrupted test pass. SpecGuard supplies independently verifiable, kernel-checked evidence of task-level conflicts at specification time, closing off reward-hacking opportunities before agent behavior is observed and offering a pre-execution safety gate grounded in formal verification rather than model opinion.

zh.title: SpecGuard：在智能体作弊之前证明任务存在错误指定
zh.summary: SpecGuard 可在智能体执行任何操作之前检测并形式化地认证任务意图与测试之间的冲突。仅给定任务描述与代码库，该方法将预期行为自动形式化（autoformalization）为 Lean 4 规范，并独立地形式化测试，随后由 Lean 内核检查是否存在同时满足两者的实现。若不存在，则生成经机器检验的不一致证书。在存在冲突的 SWE-bench 任务上，SpecGuard 最多检测出 72.8% 的冲突，最多形式化认证 51.1%，冲突漏检率约为基于模型判断方法的五分之一。
zh.significance: 既有研究显示，面对自相矛盾的任务时，编码智能体很少指出冲突，而是选择作弊，其行为可能造成实际损害，例如为了让损坏的测试通过而删除安全防护。SpecGuard 在规范阶段就提供可独立验证、经内核检验的证据来证明任务层面的冲突，在观察到任何智能体行为之前封堵奖励作弊（reward hacking）的机会，并以形式化验证而非模型判断为依据，提供执行前的安全检查。

title: Multi-Aspect Runtime Verification for Simulation-Based V&V of LLM-Enabled Autonomous Agents
summary: The paper presents a multi-aspect runtime-verification framework for LLM-based autonomous agents performing decision-support work in defence settings, where binding policy obligations are written in natural language and model retraining is unavailable. The framework decomposes a policy clause into a typed spatial/temporal/semantic triple over a canonical event stream, monitors each aspect with its own specification, and fuses verdicts through a four-valued algebra carrying provenance. Spatial obligations are checked over a weighted two-sorted location graph unifying mission geometry and information-release topology, and the authors show these obligations are not in general subsumed by a first-order temporal specification. The past-time aspect runs on the unmodified MonPoly engine, which agrees with the reference monitor at every time point. Experiments across casualty evacuation, contested sustainment, and one civil domain show that the composed precautionary blocking policy drives attack success to zero with no observed false positives and microsecond-scale per-event cost, while every single aspect and every pair of aspects leaves a substantial share of attacks succeeding. In a closed-loop experiment a policy-naive planner reaches a violating state in most unshielded missions and in none when shielded, with four of five refused episodes recovering to a compliant outcome.
significance: LLM agents interfacing with real operational systems need enforcement that does not depend on retraining proprietary models, and per-event guardrails cannot catch violations that emerge across multi-step tool-attack chains. By treating policy compliance as a composed multi-aspect monitoring problem and proving that spatial obligations cannot simply be folded into temporal logic, the work gives practitioners a principled, low-overhead runtime shield, and the ablation evidence shows that any incomplete combination of aspects leaves exploitable gaps.

zh.title: 面向大语言模型赋能自主智能体的基于仿真的验证与确认（V&V）的多方面运行时验证
zh.summary: 本文针对国防参谋工作中执行决策支持任务的大语言模型（LLM）自主智能体，提出一个多方面运行时验证框架；此类场景中具约束力的政策义务以自然语言书写，且无法通过再训练进行管控。该框架将政策条款分解为作用于统一事件流上的类型化空间、时间、语义三元组，为每个方面配置独立的监控规约，并通过携带溯源信息的四值代数融合判定结果。空间方面在加权二部位置图上解释，将任务几何与信息释放拓扑统一为同一对象；作者证明这些空间义务一般不能被一阶时序规约（first-order temporal specification）所涵盖。过去时态方面在未经修改的 MonPoly 引擎上运行，在每个时间点均与参考监控器一致。在伤亡后送、对抗性持续保障两个任务域以及一个民事域上的实验表明，组合式的预防性阻断策略将攻击成功率降至零，未观察到误报，单事件开销为微秒量级；而单独任一方面或任意两方面组合都仍留下大量攻击成功的情形。闭环实验中，缺乏政策意识的规划器在多数未加防护的任务中到达违规状态，加防护后则无一出现；被拒绝的五个回合中有四个仍恢复为合规结局。
zh.significance: 让大语言模型智能体接入真实业务系统时，需要不依赖对专有模型再训练的强制执行手段，而逐事件护栏无法捕捉跨多步工具攻击链产生的违规。本文将政策合规性建模为组合式的多方面监控问题，并证明空间义务无法简单归入时序逻辑，从而为实践者提供了原理清晰、开销低的运行时防护盾；消融实验也表明，任何不完整的方面组合都仍存在可被利用的缺口。

title: An AI-Assisted Formalization of the Poincaré Conjecture
summary: This work presents an AI-assisted Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture, undertaken in an area where little reusable formal infrastructure existed for the underlying geometric analysis. The team organized the effort around a proof blueprint prepared by mathematicians, augmented with explicit milestone statements. These milestones supported parallel agent work and gave mathematicians clear points to identify blockers and supply effective mathematical guidance. The authors analyze the human interventions and organizational choices that shaped the workflow, and frame the project as groundwork for reusable infrastructure that could eventually lower the cost of verifying results in geometric analysis.
significance: Formalizing a deep result like the Poincaré conjecture tests how AI agents and mathematicians can divide labor when reusable libraries are scarce. The milestone-based blueprint offers a concrete organizational pattern for parallel agent collaboration with targeted human guidance, and the reusable infrastructure built along the way may reduce verification costs across geometric analysis more broadly.

title: SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner
summary: SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) is a Lean proof pipeline in which a language model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone, versus 18/218 for DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock time, while DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Controlled corruption of 2,617 reference proofs supports a power law bounding the pass rate by per-integer accuracy raised to the number of content integers, and feeding the decision frame the current rather than the lagged engine state lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite.
significance: The work shows that restricting free generation and keeping decision-time state visible is a more direct route to certified theorem proving than scaling the model. Because Lean compilation checks validity without human scoring, the empirical claims are machine-checkable, and the reported ablations identify current state visibility as a key driver while chain-end loss up-weighting is harmful. Multi-step reasoning here costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text.

title: zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models
summary: zkLLMPoT is a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained large language model checkpoint by forward evaluation on auditor-chosen challenge sequences instead of verifying the full optimization trajectory. In its two-phase protocol the trainer fixes the architecture and commits the model weights before the auditor selects the challenge data, preventing the trainer from adapting the checkpoint to the audit, after which the trainer proves the objective value attained on those sequences. Certification cost is thus independent of the number of training iterations, while model weights remain hidden and private training data stays inaccessible. Built on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments, the system supports next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Operator-level benchmarks across four model families report proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at sequence length 512.
significance: Auditing claimed training outcomes is difficult when weights and data are private, and cryptographically proving full training is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. By moving the burden from the optimization trajectory to certified forward evaluation, zkLLMPoT makes proofs of training practical for billion-parameter models, offering a route to verifiable and privacy-preserving claims about trained checkpoints.

zh.title: zkLLMPoT：面向大语言模型的高效训练零知识证明
zh.summary: zkLLMPoT 是一种零知识证明（zero-knowledge proof）框架，通过对审计方选定的挑战序列进行前向评估，来认证已训练的大语言模型（large language model，LLM）检查点所满足的审计方定义属性，而不必验证完整的优化轨迹。该协议包含两个阶段：首先由训练方固定模型架构并提交模型权重，随后审计方选择挑战序列，从而防止训练方根据审计数据修改检查点；然后训练方证明所提交模型在这些序列上达到的目标函数值。由此，认证开销与训练迭代次数无关，且无需公开模型权重或访问私有训练数据。该方法基于 sumcheck 与查找表（lookup）论证来认证 Transformer 的计算过程，并支持下一词元损失（next-token loss）和任务特定的审计目标。在四个模型族上进行的算子级基准测试显示：对 1.1B 至 1.5B 参数模型，覆盖算子的证明时间为 41 至 59 秒；13B 参数模型为 131 秒；在序列长度 512 下验证时间低于半秒。
zh.significance: 在模型权重与训练数据均为私有的情况下，审计训练宣称的结果十分困难，而在 Transformer 规模上以密码学方式证明完整训练过程又代价过高。zkLLMPoT 将负担从优化轨迹转移到可认证的前向评估上，使十亿参数级模型的训练证明成为可行方案，为已训练检查点的可验证且保护隐私的声明提供了路径。

title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
summary: LeanPlan is the first planning system that finds optimal plans using LLM-generated heuristic functions whose admissibility is machine-checked. An agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof, and the required domain assumptions; the heuristic, the proof, and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search are implemented in Lean 4. Evaluated on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, with test tasks containing up to 57 times as many objects as training tasks, LeanPlan with GPT-5.6 Sol in the loop generated heuristics and admissibility proofs for every domain. The resulting heuristics usually expanded fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solved more tasks overall.
significance: The work pairs LLM-generated search heuristics with machine-checked admissibility certificates, ensuring optimal plans rather than merely satisficing ones. Its Lean 4 formalization of grounding and search, together with generalization to test tasks far larger than training tasks, shows a practical route to combining language-model creativity with formal guarantees in automated planning.

title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
summary: The paper presents the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology for teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, drawing on more than a decade of use in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. Classical higher-order logic serves as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics, so that a single proof assistant such as Isabelle/HOL, together with its automated theorem provers and model finders, becomes one environment for learning, experimenting with, and comparing logics. After arguing for proof assistants in the logic classroom, the authors give a graded sequence of examples: a liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle motivates modal logic, the Wise Men puzzle leads to dynamic epistemic logic, Boolos's curious inference shows the value of a higher-order metalogic even for automated proof search, Chisholm's paradox moves the sequence into deontic and dyadic deontic logic, and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. The paper also answers the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL amounts to monism rather than pluralism, reflects on three years of teaching the course, and sketches portability beyond Isabelle.
significance: The work offers a tested, decade-long pedagogy in which formal semantics and proof assistant tooling let students compare diverse logics in one uniform environment, connecting logic education with automated theorem proving and countermodel finding. The graded example sequence shows how modelling needs drive the shift between logics, from propositional to modal, dynamic epistemic, and deontic settings, up to a formalized metaphysical argument, while the discussion of pluralism and portability addresses practical adoption questions for teaching with proof assistants.

zh.title: 用于逻辑教学的数学证明辅助工具：LogiKEy 方法论
zh.summary: 本文提出具有逻辑多元主义色彩的 LogiKEy 方法论，用于向计算机科学、数学与哲学专业混合的学生群体教授逻辑，其依据是在课程、暑期学校与教程中使用超过十年的经验。该方法以经典高阶逻辑（classical higher-order logic）作为通用元逻辑（metalogic），通过定义语义把各种对象逻辑（object logic），无论经典还是非经典，编码其中；借助这些语义嵌入（semantic embedding），单一证明辅助工具（proof assistant）如 Isabelle/HOL，连同其自动定理证明器与（反）模型查找器，成为学生学习、实验并比较各种逻辑的统一环境。在论证证明辅助工具进入逻辑课堂的理由之后，作者给出一组循序渐进的课堂示例：说谎者与诚实者谜题引出模态逻辑（modal logic），智者谜题（Wise Men puzzle）引出动态认知逻辑（dynamic epistemic logic），Boolos 的奇妙推理展示高阶元逻辑所能带来的益处，即使在自动证明搜索中也是如此，Chisholm 悖论把序列带入道义逻辑（deontic logic），并从标准道义逻辑走向二元道义逻辑（dyadic deontic logic），Gödel 的本体论论证则把序列推进到研究级的形而上学论证。论文还回应了将一切嵌入经典高阶逻辑属于一元论而非多元论的质疑，回顾三年的教学经验，并勾勒该方法向 Isabelle 之外移植的可能。
zh.significance: 这项工作提供了一套经过十余年检验的教学方法，借助形式语义与证明辅助工具，让学生在统一环境中比较多种逻辑，从而把逻辑教学与自动定理证明和反模型查找连接起来。循序渐进的示例序列展示了建模需求如何推动逻辑的切换，从命题逻辑（propositional logic）到模态逻辑（modal logic）、动态认知逻辑（dynamic epistemic logic）和道义逻辑（deontic logic）的场景，直至一个形式化的形而上学论证；关于多元主义与可移植性的讨论则回应了在教学中采用证明辅助工具的实际问题。

title: Navier-Stokes lost in translation: Why Lean verification of AI autoformalisation does not guarantee correct natural language proofs
summary: The article argues that mechanically verifying a Lean formalisation gives no guarantee that the original natural language mathematical argument is correct, because translation into Lean must resolve ambiguities in mathematical natural language, a task shown to lie arbitrarily high in the Solvability Complexity Index (SCI) hierarchy, i.e. SCI = infinity, harder than the Halting problem (SCI = 1). It gives examples of AI mistranslations of statements and proofs into Lean, including OpenAI's announced proof of blow-up of solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations, and shows that the formalised Lean proof does not correspond to the natural language proof of blow-up.
significance: A successful Lean verification only certifies the formal statement produced by autoformalisation, not the natural language claim it was meant to capture, so AI-generated proofs can pass verification while the underlying argument is mistranslated or invalid. The result underscores that semantic faithfulness is a fundamental obstacle for autoformalisation pipelines and urges caution when announced AI proofs are accepted on the strength of formal verification alone.

zh.title: 纳维-斯托克斯（Navier-Stokes）迷失在翻译中：为何对AI自动形式化（autoformalisation）的Lean验证不能保证自然语言证明的正确性
zh.summary: 文章指出，对Lean形式化结果进行机械验证并不能保证原始的自然语言数学论证正确，因为翻译成Lean必须消解数学自然语言（natural language, NL）中的歧义，而这一任务处于可解性复杂度指标（Solvability Complexity Index, SCI）层次，即算术层次（arithmetical hierarchy）中的任意高位，SCI = ∞，比停机问题（Halting problem，SCI = 1）更难。文中给出AI将陈述和证明误译为Lean的若干实例，包括OpenAI公布的关于纳维-斯托克斯方程（Navier-Stokes equations）解爆破（blow-up）的证明，并说明该形式化的Lean证明与自然语言的爆破证明并不对应。

title: When Tools Lie: Reliability of Mathematical Agents Under Corrupted Tool Feedback
summary: This paper builds a controlled corruption framework in which a hidden interceptor replaces tool call results with plausible but incorrect information on targeted problems. Agents are evaluated on 31 problems under four verification designs: no verification, mandatory same-context reflection, optional fresh-context verification, and optional structural verification. Without verification, accuracy falls from 100% to 72.4%; mandatory reflection fully restores it to 100%, while optional verification improves accuracy only when models actively invoke it. Checking frequency correlates strongly with robustness, and a recovery experiment shows that restarting the whole problem succeeds in 100% of cases after corruption is explicitly detected.
significance: Mathematical agents delegate deterministic computation to tools and implicitly trust their outputs, yet tools can fail silently. The results show that verifier availability and verification policy are separate determinants of reliability: mandatory policies enforce verification, whereas optional policies depend on the model's own decision to check. This highlights that robust agent design must address both the presence of verification mechanisms and the conditions under which they are actually used.

aiRole.description: The paper evaluates mathematical agents across 31 problems under a controlled tool-corruption framework and four verification designs. Agents dropped from 100% to 72.4% accuracy without verification, while mandatory reflection restored 100%, and restart after explicit detection recovered every case.

humanContribution: Humans built the controlled corruption framework and interceptor, selected the 31-problem evaluation set, and designed the four verification policies while analyzing how often agents invoked them.

zh.title: 当工具说谎：工具反馈被篡改时数学智能体的可靠性
zh.summary: 本文构建了一个受控篡改框架，其中隐藏拦截器会在指定题目上将工具调用结果替换为看似合理但错误的信息。研究者在31道题目上评估智能体，采用四种验证设计：不验证、强制同上下文反思、可选的全新上下文验证，以及可选的结构化验证。在不验证的情况下，准确率从100%下降到72.4%；强制反思可将其完全恢复到100%，而可选验证仅在模型主动调用时才提升准确率。检查频率与鲁棒性差异高度相关，一项恢复实验表明，在明确检测出篡改后，完整重解问题的成功率为100%。
zh.significance: 数学智能体（mathematical agents）将确定性计算委托给工具并默认信任其输出，但工具可能静默失效。研究结果表明，验证器的可用性与验证策略是影响可靠性的两个独立因素：强制策略确保执行验证，而可选策略依赖模型自身是否决定检查。这说明鲁棒的智能体设计必须同时考虑验证机制是否存在，以及这些机制在何种条件下才会被真正使用。

title: Mathematical Invariant-Enabled Topological Neural Networks for Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
summary: This work introduces mathematical invariant-enabled topological neural networks (MITNNs), a framework that represents molecular and materials structures through multiple complementary mathematical views integrated with topological neural architectures. MITNNs combine multiscale invariants drawn from topology, spectral theory, commutative algebra, differential geometry, and discrete curvature, capturing complementary structural information from a single system. Invariant-subset, architecture-subset, and ensemble analyses show that predictive performance depends on how mathematical representations are paired with neural architectures, with selected combinations outperforming both individual models and the aggregation of all available components. MITNN consistently surpasses existing methods on protein-ligand binding, metal-organic framework property, mutation-induced protein solubility, and molecular toxicity prediction tasks.
significance: Molecular and materials learning often relies on narrow structural representations that capture only part of three-dimensional structure. By combining invariants from several mathematical disciplines and analyzing how they pair with neural architectures, MITNN demonstrates that principled mathematical multimodality can deliver consistent gains across diverse scientific prediction benchmarks, offering a stronger design basis for scientific machine learning.

aiRole.description: The paper introduces MITNNs, which combine multiscale mathematical invariants with topological neural architectures, and reports that MITNN consistently outperforms existing methods on protein-ligand binding, metal-organic framework, protein solubility, and molecular toxicity prediction benchmarks.

humanContribution: Humans designed the framework, chose and integrated the mathematical invariant views, built and trained the neural architectures, curated the benchmark datasets, and performed the subset and ensemble analyses.

title: Eliciting Specifications: When Does Interactive Clarification Help?
summary: This work studies whether an elicitation agent (EA) that asks bounded clarification questions to a reference-grounded simulated developer can improve LLM-generated Lean specifications from underspecified task descriptions. On 189 Verina Lean 4 specification-generation tasks, elicitation is compared with single-shot generation at question budgets of k=3 and k=10, in same-model and cross-model pipelines. Eliciting specifications is not a uniform accuracy booster: the same-model Claude Sonnet 4.6 pipeline yields negative strict pass@1 estimates at both budgets, while the Sonnet 4.6-to-GPT-5.6 and Sonnet 4.6-to-Gemini 3.8 Flash pipelines yield positive strict estimates, peaking at 65.6% (+6.3 points, +12 tasks) for Sonnet 4.6-to-GPT-5.6. Six of eight conditions show positive compile-conditional estimates, with a maximum cross-model difference of +4.9 points among compiling outputs. Treatment effects also vary across basic and advanced splits, with the largest advanced-task change in the Sonnet 4.6-to-GPT-5.6 configuration at k=10, from 42.0% to 50.6%. Failure analysis identifies postconditions as the largest source of degradation, and the authors argue that autoformalization systems should treat elicited natural-language specifications as intermediate artifacts and jointly optimize semantic correctness among compiling outputs and faithful translation of clarified information into Lean.
significance: Autoformalization (自动形式化) from ambiguous natural language is a bottleneck for reliable formal specification and theorem proving (定理证明) tooling, and this study quantifies when interactive clarification actually helps rather than assuming it does. The mixed results across model pairings and question budgets show that elicitation gains depend on how clarified requirements are transferred into Lean, with postconditions identified as the main failure point. The findings guide the design of future prover-interaction pipelines that combine clarification agents with formalizers and evaluate them on semantic correctness as well as compilation.

aiRole.description: The paper reports Verina Lean 4 specification-generation benchmark results earned by its LLM pipelines, with the best strict result reaching 65.6% (+6.3 points) in the Sonnet 4.6-to-GPT-5.6 configuration.

humanContribution: Humans designed the elicitation agent and experimental configurations, set the question budgets, selected the 189 benchmark tasks, and checked outcomes through failure analysis of degrading postconditions.

zh.title: 引出规约：交互式澄清何时有益？
zh.summary: 本文研究引出代理（elicitation agent, EA）通过向基于参考答案的模拟开发者提出有限数量的澄清问题，能否改进由任务描述生成的 Lean 规约（specification）。在 189 个 Verina Lean 4 规约生成任务上，研究者将引出式流程与单次生成进行比较，问题预算为 k=3 与 k=10，并覆盖同模型与跨模型配置。引出规约并非一致提升准确率：同模型 Claude Sonnet 4.6 流程在两种预算下严格 pass@1 估计均为负，而 Sonnet 4.6-to-GPT-5.6 与 Sonnet 4.6-to-Gemini 3.8 Flash 流程的严格估计为正，其中 Sonnet 4.6-to-GPT-5.6 达到最高 65.6%（+6.3 个百分点，+12 个任务）。八个条件中有六个的编译条件估计为正，在编译通过的输出中最大跨模型差异为 +4.9 个百分点。处理效应在基础与进阶分组间同样存在差异，进阶任务上最大变化出现在 Sonnet 4.6-to-GPT-5.6 配置的 k=10 设定，从 42.0% 升至 50.6%。失败分析指出后置条件（postcondition）是性能下降的最大来源。作者建议，自动形式化（autoformalization）系统应把引出的自然语言规约视为中间产物，并同时优化编译通过输出的语义正确性与将澄清信息忠实翻译为 Lean 的可靠性。
zh.significance: 从含混的自然语言进行自动形式化（autoformalization）是可靠的形式规约（formal specification）与定理证明（theorem proving）工具的瓶颈之一，本研究量化了交互式澄清真正有益的条件，而非预设其必然有效。不同模型组合与问题预算下结果不一，说明引出的收益取决于澄清后的需求如何传递到 Lean，且后置条件（postcondition）被识别为主要失败环节。这些发现为设计结合澄清代理与形式化器的证明交互流程提供了指导，即在评估时既要考察编译，也要考察语义正确性。

title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
summary: The paper presents the CKG Clinical Explanation Engine, a downstream layer for a frozen, training-free clinical knowledge-graph reasoner that converts patient inference states and disease knowledge into typed facts, explicit rule-application traces, provenance-linked conclusions, and policy-licensed recommendations. The design separates measurement availability, representation completeness, and disease-specific activation, so observed zero-activation evidence is not treated as missing and partial representation is distinguished from unobserved evidence; optional language generation is confined to symbolically licensed content. Evaluation across five usable workbooks covering 6,720 patients, 20,160 patient-disease traces, and 1,021,440 feature-evidence rows reported 100% IG-range validity and knowledge provenance, 100% numerical cross-sheet fidelity (120,960/120,960), 100% exported logical/report trace completeness (20,160/20,160), and 99.7028% availability representation consistency (1,018,404/1,021,440), with all 3,036 disagreements confined to three systematic feature-cohort patterns. The corpus included 86,783 observed zero-activation and 139,949 observed partially represented instances, and a seeded 25-patient end-to-end audit passed all pre-specified trace, licensing, provenance, and state-consistency checks without execution failure. The authors state these results establish structural and implementation auditability, not clinical correctness or utility.
significance: Auditable links between patient observations, encoded knowledge, conclusions, and recommendations are a persistent gap in clinical decision support, and this work demonstrates that such links can be produced and verified at scale with explicit rule traces and provenance. Separating availability, representation completeness, and disease activation addresses a subtle source of misinterpretation in medical reasoning systems, while restricting generation to licensed content reduces unsupported output. The large-scale fidelity and trace-completeness results provide a reproducible engineering benchmark for proof-grounded medical reasoning, even though clinical validity remains to be established.

zh.title: 从知识图谱推理生成有证明依据的患者特异性临床解释

zh.significance: 患者观测、编码知识、结论与推荐之间的可审计关联一直是临床决策支持的薄弱环节，本研究表明借助显式规则轨迹与溯源，可以在规模上生成并验证这种关联。将可得性、表示完整性与疾病激活相区分，回应了医学推理系统中一种微妙的误读来源，而将生成限制在已许可内容内则减少了无依据输出。大规模一致性与轨迹完整性结果为有证明依据的医学推理提供了可复现的工程基准，尽管临床有效性仍有待验证。

title: Second-Order Problem Solving for Recursive Self-Improvement in Formal Verification
summary: The paper introduces SO-RSI, a framework that upgrades recursive self-improvement (RSI) from a first-order patching loop into second-order diagnostic inquiry. SO-RSI passively monitors execution traces for three structural anomalies—recurrence, opposing edits, and expectation mismatch—to trigger mechanism investigations via lightweight diagnostic probes and a persistent inquiry memory that accumulates causal evidence across RSI rounds. On Lean 4 proof generation and Verus-based verifiable code generation, SO-RSI raises final held-out pass rates over Naive RSI by 21.8 and 25.8 percentage points under matched 24-hour search budgets, while substantially suppressing failure recurrence and eliminating unproductive zero-progress optimization loops.
significance: Standard RSI often thrashes by patching surface symptoms, and this work shows that explicit causal diagnosis of failure mechanisms yields large, budget-matched gains on two formal verification tasks. The approach offers a practical route to more reliable self-improving proof and code verification agents, with behavioral evidence that the gains come from resolving underlying mechanisms rather than from additional search effort.

zh.title: 形式化验证（formal verification）中递归自我改进的二阶问题求解
zh.summary: 本文提出 SO-RSI 框架，将递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement, RSI）从一阶补丁式优化升级为二阶诊断式探究。SO-RSI 被动监控执行轨迹中的三类结构异常——复发（recurrence）、相反编辑（opposing edits）与预期不匹配（expectation mismatch），以触发针对性的机制调查；通过执行轻量级诊断探针，并在多轮 RSI 之间维护持久的探究记忆，累积因果证据以指导系统性的流程修改，而非零散的参数补丁。在 Lean 4 证明生成与基于 Verus 的可验证代码生成任务上，在相同的 24 小时搜索预算下，SO-RSI 的最终留出集通过率分别比 Naive RSI 提高 21.8 与 25.8 个百分点。行为分析进一步表明，SO-RSI 大幅抑制了失败复发，并消除了毫无进展的无效优化循环。
zh.significance: 标准 RSI 往往停留在修补表面症状上，容易陷入反复试错的震荡；本文表明，对失败机制进行显式的因果诊断，可在两项形式化验证（formal verification）任务上、在搜索预算相同的前提下带来显著收益。该方法为构建更可靠的自我改进式证明与代码验证智能体提供了可行路径，且行为层面的证据显示，其收益源于真正解决底层机制，而非单纯增加搜索投入。

title: RESOLVE: Language-Agnostic Validation of GPU Kernels Through Testing, Reduction, and Proof
summary: RESOLVE is a language-agnostic pipeline that validates GPU kernels by combining three steps: binary instrumentation that perturbs execution timing to expose race-induced nondeterminism, agent-based rewriting of candidate and reference kernels into reduced-concurrency versions with bitwise-identical outputs, and formal analysis in the F*/Pulse framework proving the reduced kernels compute the same function over the real numbers, eliminating numeric tolerances. Evaluated on KernelBench, RESOLVE proves equivalence of fused GEMMs across CUTLASS, Triton, and Gluon, analyzes hard-to-validate mega-kernels, and uncovers four previously unreported issues including two clear bugs that agents then repaired with minimal performance loss.
significance: Random-input testing with numeric tolerances can miss race conditions and mask real bugs, a gap that undermines trust in AI-generated and AI-optimized GPU code. By pairing timing-perturbation testing with formal equivalence proofs over the real numbers, RESOLVE provides rigorous, tolerance-free validation across languages and frameworks, and its successful bug finding and repair on mega-kernels shows that agents can optimize aggressively when strong correctness checking is available.

zh.title: RESOLVE：通过测试、化简与证明实现 GPU 内核的跨语言验证
zh.summary: RESOLVE 是一条不依赖编程语言的 GPU 内核验证流程，包含三个步骤：利用二进制插桩扰动执行时序以暴露竞态引发的非确定性；由智能体（agent）把候选内核与参考内核改写为并发度降低的版本，这些版本更易分析且在所有测试中产生逐位一致的输出；最后在 F*/Pulse 框架中对化简后的内核进行形式化验证（formal verification），证明二者在实数上执行相同计算，从而无需数值容差。在 KernelBench 上的评估表明，RESOLVE 能证明 CUTLASS、Triton 与 Gluon 中融合 GEMM 的等价性，并可分析难以验证的 mega-kernel，发现四项此前未报告的问题，其中包括两个明确的缺陷；智能体随后在性能损失极小的情况下修复了这些问题。
zh.significance: 依靠随机输入测试与数值容差来比对输出，可能遗漏竞态条件并掩盖真实缺陷，这会削弱人们对 AI 生成和 AI 优化的 GPU 代码的信任。RESOLVE 将时序扰动测试与基于实数的等价性形式化证明相结合，提供严格且不依赖数值容差的跨语言、跨框架验证。其在 mega-kernel 上成功定位并修复问题的结果表明，在具备强正确性检验手段时，智能体可以进行激进的性能优化。

title: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness
summary: AIProver is an agentic framework for autonomous proof auto-formalization and proof synthesis (AFPS) that jointly post-trains a 119B open-weight language model and evolves its tool-calling harness with HarnessEvolve. Verifiers check type correctness, proof completeness, and semantic correctness, returning rewards and diagnostic certificates that drive model fine-tuning, alternating reinforcement learning via symbolic feedback, and a certificate-driven evolutionary search over the full harness control flow. For research-level training and evaluation the authors introduce LoCoBench, 58.9k instances drawn from Mathlib, CSLib, Mizar Math Library, and a bounded-arithmetic textbook, including a 771-instance validation split with no public Lean formalization. Against 39 frameworks, AIProver raises pass@4 semantic correctness from 15.7% to 36.7% over its Leanstral-1.5 base, surpassing all other open-weight systems and Aristotle; used as a Claude Code and Codex skill, it lifts their semantic correctness to 79.8% and 62.4%, and it is 24% cheaper than Numina-Lean-Agent.
significance: Research-level proof auto-formalization is hindered by concepts absent from libraries such as Lean's Mathlib, by translations that compile yet distort meaning or reasoning, by scarce aligned natural-language/formal-language data, and by dependence on costly frontier models and hand-built harnesses. AIProver combines model post-training with harness search driven by verifiers and diagnostic certificates, and its reported gains show this improves semantic correctness while lowering cost. LoCoBench also supplies a larger, harder research-level evaluation resource whose held-out theorem-proof pairs lack public Lean formalizations.

title: When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution
summary: This work asks whether short-budget test-time runs can forecast how mathematical reasoning improves with additional compute. It proposes a Discovery-Execution (DE) framework that combines strategy discovery with conditional execution to predict aggregate held-out scaling curves under alternate compute allocations, drawing on independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs. Evaluated with four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced, the framework shows that near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as seen for the GPT models, while for Claude Opus 4.8 incorporating measured execution substantially improves one- and two-arm held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart achieve lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy.
significance: Measuring conditional execution captures information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture, enabling better forecasts of scaling and better continue-versus-restart choices under a fixed compute budget, without first running full-length budgets on hard proof problems.

title: SPERA: Spherical Prior EEG Foundation Model with Geometry- and Frequency-Aware Latent Prediction
summary: SPERA is an EEG foundation model built on the joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), predicting in latent space rather than reconstructing the raw signal. It introduces a Legendre-polynomial spatial prior inside attention to handle varying scalp electrode geometries, plus factorized temporal and spatial attention interleaved with periodic full-attention blocks and a relational spectral regularizer that aligns latent similarity structure with spectral views. Pretrained on roughly 80,000 hours of EEG from 29,048 subjects across 106 datasets, SPERA attains the highest average balanced accuracy over nine downstream tasks in clinical, cognitive, and BCI settings, with strong parameter efficiency under linear probing and robustness across recording conditions.
significance: Heterogeneous subjects, devices, and electrode montages have limited the generality of EEG models, while reconstruction objectives fit non-neural signal content. SPERA's geometry-aware spherical prior and spectral regularization address these limitations directly, and its leading results across nine diverse tasks suggest a practical general-purpose backbone for clinical, cognitive, and brain-computer interface EEG analysis.

title: EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization
summary: EDISCO is the first discrete diffusion model for Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems such as TSP and CVRP whose generative distribution over node-index solutions is exactly E(2)-invariant. It combines an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling enables efficient multi-step inference. This yields a local geometric inductive bias in which edge neighborhoods with matching relative geometry and combinatorial context are treated consistently regardless of absolute position or orientation. EDISCO exceeds previous learning-based state-of-the-art solvers on synthetic TSP with 100 to 10000 nodes and CVRP with 50 to 2000 customers while using only 33-50% of the training instances, and, despite training only on uniform synthetic data, it beats competing learning-based baselines under spatial distribution shift and CVRP constraint-tightness shift.
significance: Exact E(2)-equivariance removes the need for data augmentation or regularization that merely approximates this symmetry, delivering better learning efficiency and more robust inference. Strong scaling to large instances, low training-data requirements, and robustness to distribution and constraint shifts indicate practical value for large-scale Euclidean routing problems, and the released code supports reproducibility and follow-up work.

title: Viva La Vida: Verification and Accumulation Failures in Multi-Agent Proof Search
summary: An end-to-end instrumentation of a multi-agent prover working on open problems analyzed 51,754 traced observations across three full runs lasting 186 hours and costing $5,694, revealing three linked failure modes in a system whose verifier and lemma library are themselves language models. The three-model verifier required unanimity and counted parse or API failures as non-approval, so in 10 of 12 verification events at least one member produced no parseable output or an API error, making acceptance arithmetically impossible. When the ensemble did function, one verifier approved 3 attempts that GPT rejected, each claiming to resolve the open problem, so a single-verifier design would have announced a solution three times. Because nothing could be approved, every review functioned as a refutation, yet the lemma extractor mined reviews alongside proofs, producing 24 of 93 lemmas (26%) from rejected arguments with their refutational context stripped away. The authors conclude that without external verification, supervision is itself a critical trust boundary, requiring systems to distinguish abstention from rejection, preserve informative disagreement, and retain the provenance and polarity of information before it becomes future context.
significance: Open-problem proving without formal verification outsources truth judgments to model-based verifiers and lemma libraries, so their hidden failure modes can silently corrupt both acceptance decisions and the growing context used for later work. The measured findings give concrete design requirements for agentic provers: separate abstention from rejection, keep verifier disagreement visible, and track where extracted knowledge came from and whether it affirmed or refuted an argument, or else unsound claims and decontextualized refutations can propagate.

zh.title: Viva La Vida：多智能体证明搜索中的验证与累积失败
zh.summary: 对一个求解未解问题的多智能体证明器进行端到端追踪，在三次完整运行中分析了51,754条追踪观测，总耗时186小时、花费5,694美元，揭示了该系统的三种相互关联的失败模式，而该系统的验证器与引理库本身都是判断模型输出的语言模型。三模型验证器要求全体一致，并将解析失败或API错误计为不予批准，因此在12次验证事件中有10次至少有一名成员未返回可解析输出或出现API错误，从算术上使批准不可能发生。当集成验证器确实正常运作时，有一名验证器批准了GPT拒绝的3个尝试，每个都声称解决了该未解问题，因此单验证器设计会三次宣布得到解答。由于没有任何内容能被批准，每次审查都成了反驳，而引理提取器同时挖掘审查与证明，导致93条引理中有24条（26%）来自被否定的论证，且其反驳语境被移除。作者总结指出，在缺乏外部验证的情况下，监督本身就是关键的信任边界，系统必须区分弃权与否定、保留有信息量的分歧，并在信息进入未来上下文之前保留其来源与极性。
zh.significance: 在没有形式化验证的情况下求解未解问题，实质上把真假判断交给了基于模型的验证器与引理库，因此其隐性失败模式会悄然破坏批准决策以及后续工作所使用的累积上下文。这些实测结果为智能体证明器提出了明确的设计要求：将弃权与否定分开、让验证器的分歧保持可见，并记录所提取知识的来源及其是在肯定还是在反驳某个论证，否则不可靠的断言与失去语境的反驳都会不断传播。

title: A Tropical Geometry View of Forgetting: A Per-Unit Projector for Knowledge-Preserving Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on new text degrades what it already does. Replay-free projectors such as Adam-NSCL and GPM forbid one shared subspace of a layer's inputs in every row of the update. The tropical geometry of a ReLU layer shows why this is too coarse. In data space, the units' walls are tropical hypersurfaces whose cells are dual to the upper vertices of a zonotope; in weight space, each old token is a hyperplane, and the tokens cut out a polyhedron, the closure of the weights that keep every token on its side. An exact identity joins the two pictures: the squared change of the layer's output under any weight change splits into in-cell, open-to-closed and closed-to-open terms, and the first two live on the tokens each unit fires on. The identity names a gate-aware per-unit projector, and a budget-separation theorem prices exact protection: it costs a unit the rank of its own open tokens, while a shared subspace pays at least the rank of their union in every row. On OPT-1.3b, where 96% of (token, unit) pairs are closed, the projector forgets less than Adam-NSCL at all six matched budgets from 9 to 60 constrained directions per row, the gap widening from $1.1\times$ to $4.3\times$; with 1/5.5 of the directions it halves the forgetting of Adam-NSCL at GPM's energy threshold. On OPT-6.7b, it matches Adam-NSCL's forgetting at matched budget while learning more. As the theory predicts, the open/closed partition is the operative variable: open tokens beat random, sign-blind and anti-gate token sets on 18 of 18 seed-pairs. In pruning repair, every derivative-based local model of the output error at the dense weights is blind to pairs that open: the minimisers of the gate-weighted objective can leave the polyhedron, the objective's closed-form solution is 1.94 nats worse than no repair on OPT-1.3b, and a convex one-sided penalty bounds the escape.

zh.title: 遗忘的热带几何视角：面向知识保持微调的逐单元投影器
zh.summary: 用新文本微调语言模型会损害其已有能力。无需回放的投影器（如 Adam-NSCL 与 GPM）在更新的每一行中都禁止层输入的同一个共享子空间。ReLU 层的热带几何（tropical geometry）表明这种做法过于粗糙。在数据空间中，各单元的"墙"是热带超曲面（tropical hypersurface），其胞腔与带状多胞形（zonotope）的上顶点对偶；在权重空间中，每个旧 token 对应一个超平面（hyperplane），这些 token 切出一个多面体（polyhedron），即保持每个 token 位于原侧的权重集合的闭包。一个精确恒等式把两幅图景联系起来：在任意权重变化下，层输出的平方变化可分解为胞内项、开到闭项与闭到开项，其中前两项只涉及各单元激活的 token。该恒等式导出一个门控感知的逐单元投影器；预算分离定理（budget-separation theorem）为精确保护定价：它只需耗费一个单元其自身开放 token 的秩（rank），而共享子空间必须在每一行至少付出这些 token 并集的秩。在 OPT-1.3b 上，96% 的（token, 单元）对为闭状态；在每行 9 至 60 个受约束方向的六个匹配预算下，该投影器的遗忘均低于 Adam-NSCL，差距从 1.1 倍扩大到 4.3 倍；仅用 1/5.5 的方向，便在 GPM 的能量阈值下将 Adam-NSCL 的遗忘减半。在 OPT-6.7b 上，该投影器在匹配预算下与 Adam-NSCL 的遗忘持平，同时学到更多。正如理论所预测，开/闭划分是关键变量：开放 token 在 18 对种子组合中的全部 18 对上均优于随机、符号无关和反门控的 token 集合。在剪枝修复中，密集权重处输出误差的任何基于导数的局部模型都会对"开"的对失明：门控加权目标的最小值点可能离开该多面体，该目标的闭式解在 OPT-1.3b 上比不修复还差 1.94 奈特（nats），而凸单侧惩罚项可约束这种逃逸。
zh.significance: 这项工作说明，微调遗忘并非不可避免的副作用，而是可被精确测量的几何代价：用逐单元的 token 多面体取代整层共享子空间，就能以远低的预算换取更少的遗忘。其开/闭划分理论提供了可检验的预测，并解释了为何常见剪枝修复的局部模型会系统性失效，为知识保持微调、剪枝修复及大模型更新中容量与遗忘的权衡给出了实用设计原则。

title: Dense Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning in a Unified Geometry State
summary: The paper formulates geometry problem solving as dense neural-symbolic coupling, where neural guidance and symbolic execution share a typed state and exchange executable actions at every search step. Neural proposals contribute theorem instances, constructions, and algebraic bridges, while the symbolic runtime applies registered rules, propagates exact constraints, and records provenance. A nested controller allocates computation first between neural and symbolic proposal sources and then among admitted actions. The framework is instantiated in OmniGeo, a single solver for plane, analytic, and solid geometry. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, OmniGeo reports 94.2%, 88.5%, and 89.8% on FormalGeo7K, Conic10K, and SolidFGeo (90.8% macro average) and solves 21 of 30 problems on IMO-AG-30.
significance: Tight coupling at every search step combines the flexibility of neural proposals with exact, provenance-tracked symbolic deduction in a shared state, making the alternation between structural proposal and formal deduction a single managed process. A unified solver across plane, analytic, and solid geometry with strong results on three benchmarks and IMO-level problems shows the practical value of the design.

zh.title: 统一几何状态中的稠密神经符号推理
zh.summary: 论文将几何问题求解（Geometry problem solving）表述为稠密神经符号耦合，其中神经引导与符号执行共享一个带类型的状态，并在每个搜索步骤通过可执行动作进行通信。神经提议贡献定理实例（theorem instances）、作图构造和代数桥接；符号运行时应用注册规则、传播精确约束并记录来源。嵌套控制器先在神经与符号提议来源之间分配计算，再在获准动作之间分配计算。该框架在 OmniGeo 中实现为单一求解器，覆盖平面几何（plane geometry）、解析几何（analytic geometry）和立体几何（solid geometry）。配合 Claude Sonnet 4.6，OmniGeo 在 FormalGeo7K、Conic10K、SolidFGeo 上分别达到 94.2%、88.5%、89.8%（宏平均 90.8%），并在 IMO-AG-30 上解决 30 题中的 21 题。
zh.significance: 在每个搜索步骤紧密耦合，将神经提议的灵活性与精确且带来源记录的符号演绎结合在共享状态中，使结构提议与形式演绎的交替成为统一受控的过程。单一求解器覆盖平面几何、解析几何和立体几何，并在三个基准及 IMO 级别问题上取得强结果，显示了该设计的实际价值。

title: Symbolic Search Is Not Exhausted: Persistent Proof-Space Exploration in Lean4
summary: ViaLean is a Lean4 prover that organizes symbolic reasoning as bounded exploration of a persistent proof-state graph. The search preserves coverage across complementary reasoning modes, merges semantically equivalent goals, retains verified intermediate structure, and observes short symbolic futures before committing to a transition. The model-free configuration solves 122 of 244 problems on the complete miniF2F test split, giving 50.0% pass@1. Comparisons spanning Lean's earlier tidy search and modern grind and SMT-backed verification indicate that proof-space organization remains a substantial source of capability. The same persistent state also serves as an interface for neural-symbolic agents, where neural reasoning operates over verified regions and intermediate objects while Lean continuously expands and validates the local proof space.
significance: The quality of the symbolic search substrate determines how much useful mathematical structure can be accumulated, reused, and exposed under a finite inference budget, so reorganizing proof-space exploration can deliver capability gains without learned guidance. By retaining verified intermediate structure and merging equivalent goals, the approach offers reusable assets for both purely symbolic and neural-symbolic provers.

zh.title: 符号搜索并未穷尽：Lean4 中的持久化证明空间探索
zh.summary: ViaLean 是一个 Lean4 证明器，它将符号推理（symbolic search）组织为对持久化证明状态图的有界探索。该搜索在互补的推理模式之间保持覆盖，合并语义等价的目标，保留已验证的中间结构，并在提交转换前观察短的符号未来。在完整的 miniF2F 测试集上，无模型配置解决了 244 道题目中的 122 道，pass@1 达到 50.0%。与 Lean 早期的 tidy 搜索以及现代的 grind 和 SMT 支撑的验证（SMT-backed verification）等参照点的对比表明，证明空间组织仍然是能力的重要来源。同一持久化状态也为神经-符号智能体提供了自然接口：神经推理可在已验证区域和中间对象上运作，而 Lean 持续扩展并验证局部证明空间。
zh.significance: 符号搜索基底的质量决定了在有限推理预算下能够积累、复用并呈现多少有用的数学结构，因此重组证明空间探索可以在不依赖学习式引导的情况下带来能力提升。通过保留已验证的中间结构并合并等价目标，该方法为纯符号证明器和神经-符号证明器都提供了可复用的资产。
zh.aiRoleDescription: ViaLean 是一个基于对持久化证明状态图进行有界探索的 Lean4 证明器，其无模型配置在完整的 miniF2F 测试集上解决了 244 道题中的 122 道（pass@1 为 50.0%）。
zh.humanContribution: 作者设计并实现了该证明器的证明空间组织、搜索策略以及经验证的符号执行机制，并在 miniF2F 上与参考基线进行了对比评估。

title: CADForge: Agentic Single-View CAD Reconstruction with Explicit Geometry Reasoning
summary: CADForge is an agentic framework that turns a single image into editable parametric CAD models expressed as executable CadQuery programs. It decomposes an object into CAD-meaningful components and performs explicit geometric reasoning for each one, first identifying CAD-relevant constraints and then converting them into precise modeling parameters through mathematical code before synthesizing programs component-wise. A review agent evaluates the resulting geometry and provides targeted feedback for iterative refinement, while a failure-guided toolkit construction mechanism distills accumulated experience into tools and a compact parametric CAD memory supplies modeling context on demand. Experiments on single- and multi-part objects report better reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality than existing baselines.
significance: Reconstructing editable parametric CAD models from a single-view image is valuable for modern manufacturing but is hindered by incomplete geometric observations and complex inter-part relationships. CADForge's explicit geometric reasoning, agentic review loop, and reusable tool and memory mechanisms point toward more accurate and editable CAD output from ordinary images, outperforming existing baselines on diverse objects.

aiRole.description: CADForge, an agentic framework, progressively converts a single image into executable CadQuery programs through explicit geometric reasoning and review-agent-driven iterative refinement, and experiments show it outperforms existing baselines in reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality.

humanContribution: Humans designed and built the CADForge framework, including its component decomposition, review agent, failure-guided toolkit construction and parametric CAD memory, and ran the evaluations against baselines.

zh.title: CADForge：采用显式几何推理的智能体式单视图CAD重建
zh.summary: CADForge 是一个智能体（agentic）框架，可将单张图像转化为以可执行 CadQuery 程序表示的可编辑参数化CAD模型。该方法将物体分解为符合CAD语义的部件，对每个部件进行显式几何推理（explicit geometric reasoning）：先识别与CAD相关的几何约束（geometric constraints），再通过数学代码将其转换为精确的建模参数，随后逐部件合成 CadQuery 程序。一个审查智能体对生成的几何进行评估并给出有针对性的反馈以实现迭代优化；此外，失败引导的工具构建机制将积累的经验沉淀为工具，紧凑的参数化CAD记忆（parametric CAD memory）按需提供建模上下文。在单部件与多部件物体上的实验表明，其重建保真度与感知质量优于现有基线方法。
zh.significance: 仅凭单视图重建可编辑的参数化CAD模型对现代制造具有重要实用价值，但受限于几何观测不完整与部件间关系复杂。CADForge 的显式几何推理、审查迭代机制以及可复用的工具与记忆机制，有望从普通图像生成更准确、可编辑的CAD模型，并在多样物体上超越现有基线方法。
zh.aiRoleDescription: CADForge 是一个智能体框架，通过显式几何推理和评审智能体驱动的迭代改进，逐步将单张图像转换为可执行的 CadQuery 程序；实验表明其在重建保真度和感知质量上优于现有基线。

title: Solving VeriContest with a Lean-Backed Rust Verifier
summary: Rust-Prover restates VeriContest's 1007 competitive-programming problems in Lean 4, turning each specification into a theorem, and proves all 1325 theorems with Lean's kernel as final check. 1259 theorems were proved in one run under 32 hours on Claude Opus 5.5 at median 3.2 minutes and $1.17 per proof, with 70% solved on first iteration. Restated specifications were validated against test suites or review, and translated Lean programs matched Rust outputs on all 21,413 test cases. Model sweeps show near-total success across Claude and GPT models, where extra reasoning effort raises cost but not proof counts.
significance: It shows a Lean-backed pipeline can eliminate the proof-generation bottleneck that limited Verus-based solving to 13.95% first-attempt success, while providing kernel-checked guarantees and independently validated specification fidelity and program equivalence. The cost and scaling findings also suggest that more reasoning effort is not the route to more proofs, informing how formal-methods agents should be configured and evaluated.

zh.title: 用 Lean 支撑的 Rust 验证器求解 VeriContest
zh.summary: Rust-Prover 将 VeriContest 的 1007 道竞赛编程题重新表述并翻译到 Lean 4 中，每条规范对应一个定理（theorem），并以 Lean 的内核（kernel）作为最终检查，证明了全部 1325 个定理。其中 1259 个定理在 Claude Opus 5.5 上一次运行不足 32 小时内完成，每个证明中位耗时 3.2 分钟、成本 1.17 美元，且 70% 在第一轮迭代完成。重新表述的规范经基准测试套件核对，无测试套件适用时经人工审查，均未出错或被削弱；翻译后的 Lean 程序在 21413 个测试用例上的输出与 Rust 程序完全一致。在四个 Claude 模型和四个 GPT 模型、五档推理强度设置下的比较显示，当前前沿模型在各设置下几乎都能证明十定理样本，提高推理强度只增加成本而不增加证明数量。研究者还用 Claude Opus 5.5 重跑了基准自身的 Verus 协议，测试参考证明最长的 50 道题，Opus 5.5 单独只有一道题未能证明。
zh.significance: 这项工作表明，以 Lean 为支撑的流程可以消除使基于 Verus 的求解首次尝试成功率仅为 13.95% 的证明生成瓶颈，同时提供内核检查的保证，并独立验证规范保真性与程序等价性。成本与扩展性结果还表明，增加推理强度并非获得更多证明的途径，这对形式化方法（formal methods）智能体的配置与评估方式具有参考价值。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 借助 Lean 4 支撑的 Rust 验证器 Rust-Prover，AI 智能体证明了涵盖 VeriContest 全部 1007 道题的 1325 个定理，其中 1259 个在 Claude Opus 5.5 上单次运行不到 32 小时内完成，每个证明中位耗时 3.2 分钟、成本 1.17 美元。研究还给出了 Claude 与 GPT 各模型的对比，其中 Sonnet 5.5 低推理强度证明了全部 50 个最难定理。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建了 Lean 支撑的验证器，并将 Verus 规约与 Rust 代码重新表述并翻译为 Lean。他们对照基准的测试套件检查了重新表述的规约，或在无适用套件时进行人工审查，并用 21,413 个测试用例核验了翻译后的程序。

title: Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers
summary: The paper trains a transformer for symbolic regression on a deliberately shaped set of training formulae, addressing the overfitting that makes existing models fit training data well yet fail to extrapolate to unseen input ranges. Fine-tuning on data with noise-corrupted target values further improves robustness to observation noise. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench the model synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget, while search-based methods surpass its accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.
significance: Symbolic regression is a central route to recovering compact, interpretable laws from data. This work shows that shaping the pre-training formula distribution and fine-tuning on noisy targets can make transformer-based formula synthesis substantially more extrapolative and noise-robust at low computational cost, narrowing the accuracy gap with expensive search-based approaches.

aiRole.description: The authors' transformer synthesizes compact physics formulae from input-output data, extrapolating better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget on SRBench and LLM-SRBench and producing a formula in about ten seconds.

humanContribution: Humans built and trained the transformer, shaped the set of formulae used for training, and fine-tuned it on data with noise-corrupted target values to improve extrapolation and noise robustness.

zh.title: 用 Transformer 合成物理公式
zh.summary: 论文在一个经过刻意设计的训练公式集合上训练用于符号回归（symbolic regression）的 Transformer，以缓解过拟合问题——现有模型往往能很好拟合训练数据，却无法外推到训练期间未见过的输入范围。在目标值中加入噪声进行微调后，合成公式对观测噪声的鲁棒性进一步提高。在 SRBench 与 LLM-SRBench 上，该模型约十秒即可合成一个公式，在相同预算下外推性能优于所有被评估方法；搜索式方法（search-based methods）只有在多出一到三个数量级的运行时间时才在准确率上超过该模型。
zh.significance: 符号回归（symbolic regression）是从数据中恢复紧凑、可解释规律的核心途径。本工作表明，通过构造预训练公式分布并对含噪目标进行微调，可以让基于 Transformer 的公式合成以较低计算成本获得显著更强的外推能力与噪声鲁棒性，从而缩小与昂贵搜索式方法在准确率上的差距。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者的 transformer 从输入输出数据中合成简洁的物理公式，在 SRBench 和 LLM-SRBench 上约十秒即可合成一个公式，且在同等预算下的外推能力优于所有被评估方法。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建并训练了该 transformer，设计了用于训练的公式集合，并在目标值受噪声干扰的数据上进行微调，以提升外推能力和抗噪性。
