title: Electronic Density versus Geometry for Machine-Learned Molecular Absorption Spectra
summary: This study compares ground-state electron density against molecular geometry as inputs to machine-learned surrogates for molecular optical absorption spectra, using 6874 molecules selected from the QM7 dataset with densities computed by DFT and spectra computed by linear-response TDDFT. Motivated by the Hohenberg-Kohn and Runge-Gross theorems and by the fact that the ground-state density encodes bonding, charge localisation and electronic delocalisation, a density-based convolutional neural network reaches a validation correlation of 0.9926, versus 0.9795 for the best geometry-based graph model, reducing residual decorrelation by approximately 64% and thereby outweighing the extra single-point DFT calculation.
significance: The results indicate that a physically motivated representation built from the ground-state electron density can outperform raw molecular geometry for learned absorption spectra, offering guidance on representation choice for accurate, low-cost spectral prediction over large molecular sets where first-principles excited-state calculations are too expensive.

aiRole.description: The paper reports benchmark results from its own ML models for predicting molecular absorption spectra: a density-based convolutional neural network reaches a validation correlation of 0.9926 versus 0.9795 for the best geometry-based graph model, reducing residual decorrelation by about 64% on a QM7-derived training…

humanContribution: Humans selected the 6874-molecule training set from QM7, computed the ground-state densities with DFT and the absorption spectra with LR-TDDFT, and built and trained the density-based convolutional and geometry-based graph models whose scores are compared.

zh.title: 机器学习分子吸收光谱中的电子密度与几何结构
zh.summary: 本研究以从QM7数据集选取的6874个分子为训练集，比较基态电子密度与分子几何结构作为机器学习（machine learning, ML）模型输入预测分子光吸收光谱的效果，其中密度由密度泛函理论（density functional theory, DFT）计算，光谱由线性响应（linear-response, LR）含时密度泛函理论（time-dependent DFT, TDDFT）计算。由于Hohenberg-Kohn定理（Hohenberg-Kohn theorem）与Runge-Gross定理（Runge-Gross theorem），以及基态电子密度编码了成键、电荷局域化与电子离域等信息，基于密度的卷积神经网络达到0.9926的验证相关性，而最好的基于几何的图模型为0.9795，残差去相关减少约64%，其收益超过额外一次单点DFT计算的代价。
zh.significance: 结果表明，基于基态电子密度的物理驱动表示在学习吸收光谱方面可优于原始分子几何，为在第一性原理激发态计算成本过高、需对大型分子集合进行快速准确光谱预测的场景中如何选择表示提供了指导。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 本文报告了其自有机器学习模型预测分子吸收光谱的基准结果：以电子密度为输入的卷积神经网络验证相关系数达到 0.9926，而最优的基于分子几何的图模型为 0.9795，在从 QM7 选出的 6874 个分子的训练集上将残差去相关降低约 64%。
zh.humanContribution: 研究人员从 QM7 中挑选了 6874 个分子的训练集，用 DFT 计算基态密度、用 LR-TDDFT 计算吸收光谱，并构建和训练了被比较的密度卷积网络与几何图模型。

title: Preserving Mathematical Reasoning in Compressed Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory-Aware Low-Rank Approximation
summary: The paper studies compression of diffusion language models (dLLMs), where calibration on clean, fully visible activations mismatches the partially masked intermediate states visited during inference. It formulates a trajectory-aware low-rank objective averaging approximation quality over corruption levels and masking realizations, and proposes Traj-MC, a Monte Carlo estimator of the trajectory second moment that attains exact sampled-state optimality and population consistency. Under matched compression budgets, trajectory-aware calibration improves reconstruction along the generation trajectory and preserves substantially more mathematical reasoning than clean calibration on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
significance: The work shows that the choice of calibration states directly affects how much mathematical reasoning survives dLLM compression, connecting trajectory-aware low-rank optimality to retained reasoning capability. This gives practitioners a principled, sampleable objective for compressing diffusion language models without sacrificing reasoning performance, and the released code enables reproduction and further study.

aiRole.description: The authors characterize trajectory-aware low-rank optimality for diffusion language model compression and report that their Traj-MC method yields exact sampled-state optimality and population consistency, preserving substantially more mathematical reasoning than clean calibration on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

humanContribution: Humans formulated the trajectory-aware low-rank objective, designed and built the Traj-MC estimator, and ran and evaluated the compression experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

zh.title: 通过轨迹感知低秩近似在压缩扩散语言模型中保留数学推理能力
zh.summary: 本文研究扩散语言模型（dLLM）的压缩问题：在干净、完全可见的激活上做校准，与推理过程中经过的部分遮蔽中间状态并不匹配。研究者提出了一个轨迹感知低秩目标，在腐蚀程度与遮蔽实现上平均近似质量，并给出 Traj-MC，通过对轨迹二阶矩进行蒙特卡洛估计，达到精确的采样状态最优性与总体一致性。在相同压缩预算下，轨迹感知校准改善了沿生成轨迹的重建效果，并在数学推理（mathematical reasoning）基准上相比干净校准保留了显著更多的数学推理能力。
zh.significance: 该工作表明，校准状态的选择会直接影响压缩后 dLLM 保留多少数学推理能力，从而把轨迹感知低秩最优性与压缩后保留的推理能力联系起来。这为压缩扩散语言模型提供了一个有原则、可采样估计的目标，使模型在压缩的同时不牺牲推理表现，公开的代码也便于复现与后续研究。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者刻画了扩散语言模型压缩中的轨迹感知低秩最优性，并报告其 Traj-MC 方法达到精确的采样态最优性和总体一致性，在数学推理基准上比干净校准保留了明显更多的数学推理能力。
zh.humanContribution: 人类提出了轨迹感知低秩目标，设计并构建了 Traj-MC 估计器，并在数学推理基准上运行和评估了压缩实验。

title: Reasoning with Evidence, Not Merely Rationales: Verifiable Preference Proofs for LLM-Based Recommendation
summary: This paper identifies the grounding-influence gap in LLM-based recommendation: a generated rationale may be weakly supported by the evidence it cites and may have little effect on the final ranking. The authors propose PROVE-REC, a two-pass framework for verifiable preference reasoning. Pass A compresses the complete pre-target interaction history into a compact preference proof of positive and avoidance claims linked to selected evidence entries; Pass B predicts the next item using only that proof and its evidence, so the recommender cannot bypass the reasoning path. Grounding is verified by comparing masking of selected evidence against masking of a comparable control entry, and influence is verified by removing a preference claim and measuring the drop in the target item's ranking margin. A ranking-preservation objective retains useful information from the full history. Experiments across diverse real-world datasets show consistent gains over strong sequential, generative, and LLM-enhanced baselines, up to 7.45%, with ablations supporting both the two-pass design and the verification objectives, yielding claims that are better grounded in history and more influential to the recommendation.
significance: The work targets a concrete reliability failure in LLM-based recommendation, where fluent rationales can be post-hoc and causally inert rather than driving predictions. By making evidence-to-proof grounding and proof-to-ranking influence explicitly testable through masking and claim-removal interventions, PROVE-REC turns preference reasoning into a verifiable component instead of uncheckable narrative, and the reported accuracy gains indicate that such verification can improve, not merely constrain, recommendation quality.

aiRole.description: The authors introduce PROVE-REC, a two-pass framework for verifiable preference reasoning in LLM-based recommendation, and report that it outperforms strong baselines by up to 7.45% on real-world datasets with more grounded and influential preference claims.

humanContribution: Humans designed and built the two-pass framework and its verification objectives, curated the real-world datasets, and ran the controlled ablations and experiments evaluating the system.

zh.title: 基于证据而非仅凭理由的推理：面向LLM推荐的可验证偏好证明
zh.summary: 本文指出了基于LLM的推荐中的接地—影响鸿沟（grounding-influence gap）：模型生成的理由可能与其所引用的证据缺乏充分支撑，也可能对最终排序几乎没有影响。作者提出PROVE-REC，一个用于可验证偏好推理的两阶段框架。Pass A将目标之前的完整交互历史压缩为简洁的偏好证明，其中包含与所选证据条目相关联的正向偏好与回避偏好断言；Pass B仅使用该证明及其所选证据预测下一个物品，使推荐器无法绕过推理路径。为验证证据到证明的接地性，作者将掩蔽所选证据的效果与掩蔽可比对照条目的效果进行比较；为验证证明到推荐的影响力，作者移除一条偏好断言并衡量目标物品排序间隔的下降幅度。排序保持目标进一步保留完整历史中的有用信息。在多样的真实世界数据集上的实验表明，PROVE-REC持续优于强序列基线、生成式基线和LLM增强基线，最高提升达7.45%。受控消融实验验证了两阶段架构与验证目标的有效性，所得断言在历史证据中的接地更牢固、对推荐的影响力更强，同时保持了排序质量。
zh.significance: 这项工作针对LLM推荐中一个具体而普遍的可靠性问题：流利的理由可能只是事后编造，对预测没有实际驱动作用。通过掩蔽干预和断言移除干预，将证据到证明的接地性与证明到排序的影响力变为可检验的量，PROVE-REC把偏好推理从不可核查的叙述转变为可验证的组成部分；报告的精度提升还表明，这类验证既能提升推荐质量，而非仅仅对其施加约束。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者提出了用于 LLM 推荐中可验证偏好推理的两阶段框架 PROVE-REC，并报告其在真实数据集上以最高 7.45% 的幅度优于强基线，且产生的偏好主张更具证据依据、对推荐更有影响力。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计并构建了该两阶段框架及其验证目标，整理了真实世界数据集，并开展了受控消融实验与评估。

title: Continual Graph Memory for Mathematical Research Agents
summary: Ansatz is a mathematical research agent built around Continual Graph Memory, a graph-based, evolvable, cross-problem memory system that organizes the full proof search process and reuses knowledge from earlier exploration trajectories. Its unified graph memory stores intermediate results such as facts, plans, and counterexamples with explicit relationship edges; dependency-aware retrieval supplies targeted local context; an evidence-sensitive curator updates the research frontier and distills lessons from prior attempts; and scoped recall brings back earlier statements and negative findings for local re-proving rather than uncritical reuse. Experiments cover all ten First Proof Second Batch problems plus four component studies, with Ansatz reporting closure on all ten research tasks and demonstrating sustained, resumable long-horizon search. Beyond these problems, Ansatz also produces solutions to the Jamison caterpillar conjecture and Erdős Problems 289, 348, and 488 without human intervention, and makes partial progress on several open problems.
significance: Long-horizon proof search at scale generates vast amounts of intermediate results that are hard to organize and reuse; Ansatz shows that an explicit, dependency-aware, evidence-sensitive graph memory can sustain and resume multi-agent mathematical exploration across problems. Reporting solution closure on ten benchmark research tasks and autonomous solutions to the Jamison caterpillar conjecture and Erdős Problems 289, 348, and 488, the work suggests that structured memory and scoped recall, rather than raw agent count, are key enablers for AI systems attacking open mathematical problems.

title: VeriPy Source-Preserving Verification and Compatibility Checking for Python Components
summary: VeriPy is a workflow for keeping annotated Python components aligned with their formal guarantees. Contracts, invariants, and proof hooks are written as Python comments, and auxiliary lemmas are refined with source-located diagnostics. Direct encoders emit Dafny or Lean artifacts while preserving admitted executable bodies and explicit models of dependencies. A relational product determines whether an updated component still admits old inputs and preserves returned values and modeled exceptions, and the workflow records the assumptions behind each guarantee. Code is available at https://github.com/astrio-labs/veripy.
significance: Specifications drifting from the code that actually runs, and updates breaking callers, are persistent problems in maintaining verified software. VeriPy ties source-level proof development to functional verification and backward compatibility checking within one workflow, targeting both human developers and AI agents, and produces Dafny and Lean artifacts while keeping the executable implementation and dependency assumptions visible.

zh.title: VeriPy：面向 Python 组件的源保持验证与兼容性检查
zh.summary: VeriPy 是一套用于保持带标注的 Python 组件与其形式化保证一致的工作流。契约（contracts）、不变量（invariants）和证明钩子（proof hooks）以 Python 注释的形式书写，辅助引理（auxiliary lemmas）则借助带有源码位置的诊断信息进行精化。直接编码器生成 Dafny 或 Lean 产物，同时保留被承认（admitted）的可执行函数体以及依赖的显式模型。关系积（relational product）用于检查更新后的组件是否仍接受旧输入，并保持返回值与建模的异常；该工作流还记录每项保证成立所依赖的假设。代码见 https://github.com/astrio-labs/veripy。
zh.significance: 规格说明与实际运行的代码脱节，以及更新破坏既有调用方，是维护经过验证的软件时长期存在的问题。VeriPy 将源码级证明开发与功能验证（functional verification）及向后兼容性检查纳入同一工作流，兼顾人类开发者与 AI 智能体，同时生成 Dafny 和 Lean 产物，并使可执行实现及其依赖假设保持可见。

title: Learning What to Investigate Next: Meta-Reasoning for Long-Horizon Research Agents
summary: The paper introduces MIRA, a hierarchical framework that separates the choice of what to investigate next from how to carry out each investigation. An outer-loop meta-reasoner reads a persistent research record and issues work orders or terminates, while a fresh inner-loop executor performs each order. Without policy training, MIRA improves long-horizon inference and compute allocation in theorem proving and open-ended neural-architecture research. Its decision boundaries enable credit assignment through a generative critic that forecasts expected remaining return from partial states, outperforming token-level alternatives, with cross-environment pretraining yielding a transferable prior. This prior initializes MIRA-AC, a generative actor-critic trained jointly to forecast remaining return and select the next investigation. Trained on self-generated proxy hill-climbing signals, MIRA-AC improves gold performance across four autoresearch environments, and its actor transfers with cross-environment value initialization.
significance: Long-horizon research decisions are sparse and their effects are delayed, making them hard to credit and optimize. By turning meta-reasoning into an explicit policy with well-defined decision boundaries, the work makes long-horizon reinforcement learning feasible without directly optimizing the lengthy execution traces, and offers a reusable way to value partial research progress across environments.

zh.title: 学习下一步研究什么：长程研究智能体的元推理
zh.summary: 本文提出 MIRA，一种分层框架，将下一步研究什么与如何执行每次研究分离开来。外层元推理器读取持久化的研究记录，写出工作指令或结束该轮；每条指令由全新的内层执行器完成。在不进行策略训练的情况下，MIRA 在定理证明（theorem proving）与开放式神经架构研究中改善了长程推理并更有效地分配计算资源。其决策边界支持信用分配（credit assignment）：团队训练一个生成式评论家，从部分状态预测期望剩余回报，表现优于基于词元的替代方案，而跨环境预训练带来可迁移的先验。该先验用于初始化 MIRA-AC，即一个同时预测剩余回报并选择下一项研究的生成式演员-评论家（actor-critic）。在模型自身的代理爬山信号上训练后，MIRA-AC 在四个自动研究环境中提升黄金指标表现，且其演员通过跨环境价值初始化实现迁移。
zh.significance: 长程研究决策出现稀疏、效果延迟显现，因此难以进行信用分配与优化。该工作把元推理变成具有明确决策边界的显式策略，使长程强化学习（reinforcement learning）成为可能，而无需直接优化其触发的冗长执行轨迹，并提供了一种跨环境评估部分研究进展价值的可复用方法。

title: Proving at Scale for Universal Algebra
summary: SemiBase computes and formally certifies finite identity bases for small semigroups, a task that goes beyond single first-order validity queries because each result requires either a completeness proof for a candidate basis or a proof that no finite basis exists. LLM-guided agents search for these proofs, a referee agent rebuilds them from source, and the Lean kernel checks the corpus in a final audit, with humans selecting targets and approving outcomes. The project certifies every semigroup of order at most 6: 1309 semigroups of order at most 5 and 15973 of order 6, including proofs that the four known nonfinitely based semigroups admit no finite basis. The order-6 bases define 505 distinct varieties, whose inclusion order Vampire determines except for four pairs.
significance: The resulting catalogue machine-checks results scattered across the literature and gives a tested foundation for extending the census to order 7. title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
summary: This work frames counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against deterministic per-theorem Python verifiers and releases SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with an executable verifier that doubles as a reward function. Training Qwen3-4B with SFT followed by GRPO exposes an imitation trap: counterexample-only SFT drops true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR with a sparse outcome-only reward repairs and surpasses the base model at 0.66, with the collapse replicating across four seeds and on Gemma-3-4B. Sparse and dense rewards give statistically indistinguishable in-domain success but diverge by 33 points on a held-out calibration probe, a dissociation attributed to the partial-credit term. The resulting 4B model outperforms every evaluated 7B open-weights math specialist, stays competitive with six frontier commercial APIs, and transfers under unchanged prompting to GSM8K, MATH-500 and MMLU-college-math. A human audit of 177 verifier decisions reports 97.7% accuracy; code, data, verifier modules and annotations are released.
significance: The results show that supervised fine-tuning on counterexample-only data can actively destroy a model's ability to recognize true theorems, an imitation trap with direct consequences for any falsification-oriented mathematical training pipeline. Rewarding against executable per-theorem verifiers with sparse outcome-only RLVR both repairs and improves this capability, suggesting a practical route to closing the falsification gap. SymCE additionally provides a reusable training and evaluation environment, and the sparse-versus-dense reward dissociation offers concrete guidance on reward design for verifiable mathematical reasoning.

title: Hesitation Has a Geometry: Entropy-Trained Hyperbolic Probes for Sparse Activation Steering
summary: The paper proposes Hyperbolic Entropy Steering (HEST), which embeds language-model hidden states in the Poincaré ball using a lightweight probe supervised only by the model's own next-token entropy and, at tokens where that entropy exceeds a threshold, moves the state along the geodesic of steepest descent of a probe readout before mapping the change back to the hidden state. For the Busemann readout of a learned ideal point, the authors prove that a fixed-length step lowers the readout by the same amount at every state. Across three instruction-tuned models from the Qwen2.5-Math and Llama-3.1 families, HEST with the Busemann readout improves greedy accuracy on MATH-500 and GSM8K in five of six settings, by up to 1.8 points, while a contrastive steering vector added at every token lowers accuracy; a Euclidean probe trained in the same way loses this gain on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct, and the improvements are largest on problems where the model hesitates often.
significance: The work connects the tree-like, branching structure of mathematical reasoning to hyperbolic geometry and shows that entropy-gated, geometry-aware steering can outperform applying one fixed Euclidean steering vector at every token, with gains concentrated on problems where the model hesitates. The proved constant-lowering property of the Busemann readout gives a principled mechanism for the steering step.

title: The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: This paper probes whether Large Language Models (LLMs) truly understand the structure behind mathematical solutions by introducing the notion of Mathematical Primitive and a new benchmark evaluating reasoning along four dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Systematic diagnosis shows that aggregate solution accuracy hides distinct capability profiles, that primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and that Discovery is the dominant bottleneck. Post-training analysis finds discovery-limited failures especially repairable, motivating a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into a student model, yielding consistent improvements over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.
significance: It reframes mathematical reasoning in LLMs as a set of separable capabilities rather than a single accuracy number, pinpointing Discovery as the main obstacle and showing that targeted primitive-guided post-training can repair it. The benchmark and distillation framework give the community concrete diagnostic and improvement tools for building math-specialized models.

title: SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers
summary: SkillEvoLean is a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. It jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge, including mathematical concepts and proving techniques, through progressive updates derived from successful and failed trajectories plus mutation-based generation of new skill candidates, triggered when no complete proof is produced and selected under Lean verifier feedback. With GPT-5.5 under matched backbone model, trajectory-sampling budget, and test-time compute, the method achieves proof success rates of 100.0% on MiniF2F, 90.6% on PutnamBench, 4/6 on IMO 2025, and 4/6 on USAMO 2026, outperforming baseline methods. Concept-guided mutation beats random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, and solves one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.
significance: Skill evolution improves LLM agents without parameter updates, but prior methods fail to learn update directions when every sampled trajectory fails and largely ignore reference knowledge beyond the root instruction file. By combining progressive evolution with verifier-guided mutation over mathematical concepts, SkillEvoLean addresses both gaps and reports strong results across competition benchmarks, suggesting a practical route to stronger skill-augmented Lean provers.

title: Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: The paper introduces Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), which links subproblem graphs to Python implementations and combines them with multi-verifier feedback for mathematical reasoning. A policy first learns code generation from function graphs via supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) applies answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment. The authors curate a benchmark from GSM8K, MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH that pairs public function graphs with private verification specifications. Under a unified protocol, GRPO raises final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% over SFT, with teacher-supervised continued reinforcement learning adding further gains, indicating that the improvement is not merely about producing correctly formatted code.
significance: Final-answer rewards rarely identify where a multi-step derivation goes wrong, while executable code alone does not certify correctness. By assigning credit at the span level with verifier feedback, FSG-RL offers a practical route to training models that decompose, compute, and aggregate reliably, and the reported gains across four established datasets suggest the approach generalizes beyond code formatting or a single benchmark.

title: Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search
summary: APIVIS is a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning within RLVR rollouts. It mixes direct and searched responses in each rollout group so that search-discovered improvements yield informative relative rewards, and applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens to keep a learning signal when uniform group rewards make GRPO ineffective. The paper proves that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the full rollout policy, with an approximate version under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks and across model sizes show substantial gains over competitive search-based methods.
significance: Prior search-augmented RLVR methods increase trajectory diversity but do not guarantee that the induced policy improves on the current one. title: Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures
summary: The paper introduces a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) that predicts cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact integer-weighted lookup tables, so each score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. Evaluated on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC on 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]), while official-fold ROC-AUC, matched-budget F1, and a second external set showed unresolved or absent gains.
significance: ACF offers a compact predictor with a fully inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue-level scores, valuable where auditability is required. The external results confirm real signal but also show that the advantage is dataset-dependent, tempering claims of generalization.

title: FORALL-LEAN-AGENT for Auditable Reasoning in Formal Mathematics and Software Verification
summary: The paper presents FORALL-LEAN-AGENT, a frontend-agnostic framework for auditable reasoning in formal mathematics and software verification. It combines isolated workspaces, Lean tools, and fresh review with statement comparison, axiom audits, and independent proof checking where supported, binding verification evidence and reviewer decisions to the same candidate artifact. Evaluations on VeriSoftBench, PutnamBench, and both problems of the Lean Eval softwareverification track show that on a 100-task VeriSoftBench subset the framework raises benchmark-rule success for GPT-5.6 Sol at low effort from 93 to 100 while cutting cost from $69 to $62, and that PutnamBench accepts all 672 problems at an average of $4.72 each.
significance: The framework addresses the gap between successful Lean compilation and genuine proof of the intended statement under acceptable assumptions, making agent acceptance traceable through artifact-bound evidence. Reported results indicate that harness design can improve both correctness and efficiency of Lean proof agents while supplying evidence beyond aggregate solve counts.

title: Lingtai: What Concept Geometry Reveals--and Does Not Reveal--About LLM Inference
summary: Lingtai is a training-free concept telemetry layer that projects residual states at each autoregressive generation step onto a bank of named concept anchors built without labeled examples, outcome labels, gradient fitting, or activation-space optimization, yielding structured per-step concept coordinates. On code generation (HumanEval, MBPP) and grade-school mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), these coordinates robustly associate with predictive uncertainty: the association survives problem-identity and token-position controls, is not driven by a single token type, is not a simple correct/incorrect mixture on GSM8K, and is absent for matched random anchors, while K-means and PCA projections show weaker or direction-inconsistent effects. Two structures appear: a recurring uncertainty-linked activity signal with task-conditioned functional geometry, and an execution-specific trajectory identity with strong local inertia but weak re-instantiation invariance — under completion-only elastic alignment, corruption at k=32 recovers the archived episode 62.0% of the time versus 11.7–16.0% for a fresh execution. A matched audit finds no stable correctness coordinate in the scalar concept-activity signal under the tested protocol, so correctness is treated as externally supplied. The 161-anchor code implementation adds 0.7–1.6% per-token decode overhead with unchanged generated tokens.
significance: The work offers an online, probe-free way to read internal computation during autoregressive inference and links concept geometry to predictive uncertainty across code and mathematical reasoning, with controls that rule out several trivial explanations. It also draws an honest boundary: the method identifies execution-specific trajectories but does not yield a stable correctness signal, so it should be used for uncertainty telemetry rather than self-assessment, at low runtime cost.

zh.title: Lingtai：概念几何揭示了什么，又未能揭示什么——关于大语言模型推理
zh.summary: Lingtai 是一种免训练的概念遥测层：在自回归生成的每一步，将残差状态投影到一组具名概念锚点构成的概念库上，该概念库的构建不依赖带标注的概念示例、结果标签、梯度拟合或激活空间优化，从而产生结构化的逐步概念坐标信号。在代码生成（HumanEval、MBPP）与小学数学推理（GSM8K）任务上，该信号与预测不确定性呈现稳健关联：这一关联在控制问题身份与词元位置后依然成立，不源于单一词元类型，在 GSM8K 上不能由简单的正确/错误混合解释，且在匹配的随机锚点中无法复现；相比之下，K-means 与 PCA 投影中的效应明显更弱或方向不一致。研究呈现两种结构：一是反复出现的、与不确定性相关的活动信号，其功能几何随任务条件而变（HumanEval、MBPP 与 GSM8K 上的活动熵形状各不相同）；二是执行特定的轨迹标识，具有强局部惯性但重现实例化的不变性较弱——在仅对补全部分做弹性对齐的条件下，在匹配的重复执行子集上，k=32（约为补全中位长度的四分之一）处的损坏样本仍有 62.0% 能检索到归档轨迹，而全新执行的检索率仅为 11.7–16.0%。一项匹配审计未发现本文所用的标量概念活动信号在测试方案下提供稳定的正确性坐标，因此作者将正确性视为外部提供。161 锚点的代码实现仅增加 0.7–1.6% 的逐词元解码开销，且生成词元完全不变。

title: Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs
summary: This paper formalizes data selection for LLM fine-tuning as Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS), separating how samples are scored (attribution) from which subset is chosen (selection) while modeling non-additive interactions among samples. Experiments on a real instruction-tuning data pool reveal substantial cross-domain complementarity and within-domain redundancy. The proposed Mixture-then-Select algorithm first allocates sample counts across domains, then ranks samples within each domain by attribution score; its gap to the optimal subset is linear in selection size and independent of pool size. Empirically it beats strong baselines by 20 to 54%, is robust across attribution methods, models, and pool sizes, and extends to budget-constrained data purchasing with varying sample prices.
significance: Data selection methods that score samples independently ignore domain mix and sample interaction, the two factors shown here to dominate real fine-tuning gains. Mixture-then-Select offers a principled and practical alternative with a clean guarantee and broad empirical robustness, pointing toward more efficient use of heterogeneous data pools for modern LLMs.

zh.title: 选择混合比例，而非单个样本：面向大语言模型的组合式数据选择
zh.summary: 本文将大语言模型（LLM）微调中的数据选择问题形式化为组合数据选择（Combinatorial Data Selection, CDS），把样本如何打分（归因，attribution）与最终挑选哪个子集（选择，selection）分离开来，并刻画样本之间的非可加交互。在一个真实指令微调数据池上的实验显示，跨域数据存在显著互补性，而同一域内存在冗余。据此，研究者提出两阶段算法 Mixture-then-Select：先决定从每个域取多少样本，再按归因分数在各域内对样本排序。理论上，其与最优子集的差距关于选择规模呈线性，且与数据池大小无关。实验中该方法比强基线提升 20 到 54%，对不同归因方法、不同模型和不同数据池规模均表现稳健，并可推广到样本价格不一、预算受限的数据购买问题。
zh.significance: 独立为样本打分的数据选择方法忽视了域配比和样本间交互，而本文表明这两点才是真实微调中收益的关键来源。Mixture-then-Select 提供了一种原理清晰、切实可行的替代方案，兼具简洁的理论保证和广泛的实验稳健性，为更高效地利用异构数据池训练现代大语言模型指出了有前景的方向。

title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
summary: Cogentic is a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. It operates through an iterative prove-verify loop in which an orchestrator assigns independent provers to distinct proof directions, specialized components adversarially check their output, and confirmed intermediate results are promoted into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. With Gemini 3.1 Pro or an early version of Gemini 4 Argon as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on open problems in online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers, with results listed at the project website.
significance: Single-shot generation often fails on open problems that demand exploration of multiple competing conjectures, navigation of subtle technical obstructions, and retention of intermediate progress over long horizons. Cogentic's orchestration and verified ledger let confirmed partial advances accumulate across rounds, supporting proof discovery at the research level in mathematics and theoretical computer science.

title: Learning to Cover Locally: Graph Neural Combinatorial Optimization under a Hard Information Horizon
summary: This paper formalizes combinatorial optimization under a hard information horizon, where each node commits to its share of a global solution using only its k-hop neighborhood and all commitments must compose into a feasible solution. It instantiates the model as local set cover on weighted multipoint relay (MPR) selection, the NP-hard 2-hop covering problem of OLSRv2 (RFC 7181), where the horizon is imposed by the protocol. Two main results are proved: any deterministic selector whose horizon is one hop short of the requirement must either fail coverage or incur a factor Δ gap from optimal, and an L-layer GNN read out at the deciding node is exactly an L-hop selector, so model capacity cannot compensate for missing radius; conversely, at the required horizon a GNN of depth O(Δ) reproduces the RFC 7181 covering greedy and at width O(c_max Δ) its metric-aware weighted analogue, both inheriting the (1+ln Δ₂)-approximation. Empirically, a 3-layer GATv2 with a coverage-completing decoder, behavior-cloned from the CP-SAT optimum, reaches cost/opt = 1.030±0.001 versus greedy's 1.138, closing 79.1% of the gap at 100% coverage, while the same learner restricted to one hop drops to 1.344. Transfer checks show the unmodified OLSRv2 selection code matches the cardinality greedy on 200/200 unit-cost instances, and a frozen model closes 48% of the gap on 40,308 real battalion mobility instances at full coverage.
significance: The work gives a principled account of when distributed neural combinatorial optimization is feasible, proving an impossibility result linking solution quality to information radius and a matching positive result showing that sufficient horizon suffices to recover classical greedy guarantees. It establishes that information horizon, rather than model capacity, is the decisive variable, and it validates the framework on a protocol-mandated NP-hard problem with strong empirical gains over greedy plus realistic mobility transfer, offering guidance for deploying learned optimizers in genuinely decentralized settings such as routing.

zh.title: 学习局部覆盖：硬信息视野下的图神经组合优化
zh.summary: 本文形式化了硬信息视野（hard information horizon）下的组合优化问题：每个节点仅依据其 k 跳邻域决定其对全局解的份额，且这些决定必须组合成全局可行解。作者将该模型实例化为加权多点中继（MPR）选择上的局部集合覆盖（local set cover），即 OLSRv2（RFC 7181）中 NP 难的 2 跳覆盖问题，其中信息视野由协议规定而非由建模者选择。论文证明了两个结果：任何视野短缺一跳的确定性选择器，要么无法完成覆盖，要么与最优值相差 Δ 倍；而在决定节点读出的 L 层图神经网络（GNN）恰好是 L 跳选择器，因此模型容量无法弥补半径不足。反之，在所需视野上，深度为 O(Δ) 的 GNN 能复现 RFC 7181 的覆盖贪心算法，在宽度为 O(c_max Δ) 时还能复现其考虑度量的加权版本，两者均继承 (1+ln Δ₂) 的近似保证。实验上，一个带有补全覆盖解码器的 3 层 GATv2 从 CP-SAT 最优解进行行为克隆，达到 cost/opt = 1.030±0.001，优于贪心的 1.138，在 100% 覆盖率下弥合了 79.1% 的差距；将同一学习器限制为一跳、在相同实例与相同解码器和示范下，其结果恶化至 1.344，远差于贪心。两项迁移检验面向真实网络：OLSRv2 未修改的选择代码在 200/200 单位成本实例上与本文基数贪心一致；在 40,308 个真实营级机动实例上，冻结的模型在满覆盖率下弥合了 48% 的差距。
zh.significance: 该工作为分布式神经组合优化何时可行提供了原则性刻画：一方面证明了将解质量与信息半径联系起来的不可能性结果，另一方面给出匹配的正面结果，表明足够的视野足以恢复经典贪心的近似保证。研究确立了信息视野而非模型容量才是决定性变量，并在一个由协议规定的 NP 难问题上验证了该框架，相对贪心取得显著经验收益，同时在真实机动数据上完成迁移，为路由等真正去中心化场景中部署学习型优化器提供了指导。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者的 3 层 GATv2 配合补全覆盖的解码器，从 CP-SAT 最优解进行行为克隆，达到 cost/opt = 1.030 ± 0.001，而贪心为 1.138，在 100% 覆盖率下弥合了 79.1% 的差距；冻结模型在真实营级移动实例上弥合 48% 的差距；将其限制为单跳后性能崩溃至 1.344。

title: Growing an Agent/Prover Interface: Evolutionary Tool Design for Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving in Rocq and Lean
summary: The paper proposes an evolutionary method in which a frontier model incrementally proposes new interface features and retains only those that improve the overall performance of smaller models when interacting with proof assistants. Applied to Rocq, the method produces ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE, a new MCP server. On the held-out test split of miniF2F-Rocq, an agent using ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE beats both a baseline exposing only the Rocq compiler and an established MCP server across four models from two families in success rate, cost per solve, and time per solve. Although evolved for Rocq, the server transfers to Lean, reducing cost and time per solve on a subset of PutnamBench. The server and its Lean port are released.
significance: Agent-facing prover interfaces are still borrowed from human-oriented tooling and are not tuned for the cost of agent interaction. This work shows that an evolutionary loop driven by a frontier model can systematically grow such interfaces and deliver measurable gains in success rate, cost per solve, and time per solve for smaller models. The demonstrated transfer from Rocq to Lean suggests the evolved interface features capture broadly useful interaction patterns rather than prover-specific tricks, offering a practical route to cheaper machine-checked proof certificate generation.

title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
summary: FYAN is a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization, coordinating specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with independent supervision and human guidance. Its central feature is evidence-grounded semantic auditing: a language model builds structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, and a deterministic validator checks that evidence to yield reproducible judgments. When an accepted deviation is substantive but admissible, FYAN demands an explicit proof-transfer obligation linking the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. Using DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at every stage, FYAN proves 86 of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict Lean check versus 69 for a general agent harness, and raises the natural-language proof score from 0.501 to 0.851. On ConsistencyCheck, its semantic audit detects more inconsistent statements than a direct LLM judge, with recall 0.777 versus 0.636 on source-verified labels and 0.873 versus 0.820 on original labels, localizing each reported mismatch to a specific hypothesis, conclusion, or scope. FYAN also built ODENumLib, a 9,355-line Lean library for the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equations.
significance: Autoformalization at document level risks silently mistranslating informal mathematics, and pure model-based judging is hard to trust or reproduce. FYAN shows that grounding semantic audits in model-constructed evidence checked by a deterministic validator improves both statement-consistency detection and downstream proving results, while explicit proof-transfer obligations make accepted formal deviations auditable. The reported gains on FormalTCS and ConsistencyCheck, plus the reusable ODENumLib library, indicate practical value for scaling reliable formalization workflows.

zh.title: Fyan：带语义审计的人机协同文档级形式化工作台
zh.summary: FYAN 是一个人机协同的文档级数学形式化（document-level formalization）工作台，统一协调规范撰写、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean 证明构造、知识整理与验证等环节，并支持独立监督与人类引导。其核心是基于证据的语义审计：语言模型在局部对应、遗漏、作用域与逻辑关系上构造结构化证据，再由确定性验证器核验这些证据并给出可复现的判定。当某个实质性但可接受的偏差被采纳时，FYAN 要求提交显式的证明迁移义务，将形式化语句重新联系到面向原始来源的解释。在所有阶段统一使用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的条件下，FYAN 在严格 Lean 检查下证明了 143 道 FormalTCS 定理中的 86 道，通用智能体工作台为 69 道，并将自然语言证明得分从 0.501 提升至 0.851。在 ConsistencyCheck 上，其语义审计比直接 LLM 判定发现更多不一致语句：在经来源核验的标签上召回率为 0.777 对 0.636，在原始标签上为 0.873 对 0.820，且把报告的每处不一致定位到具体的假设、结论或作用域。FYAN 还构建了 ODENumLib，一个面向常微分方程数值分析（numerical analysis of ordinary differential equations）的 9,355 行 Lean 库。
zh.significance: 文档级自动形式化（Autoformalization）可能悄悄误译非形式化数学内容，而单纯依赖模型的判定难以信赖与复现。FYAN 表明，把语义审计建立在模型构造的证据之上并交由确定性验证器核验，既能提升语句一致性检测能力，也改善下游证明结果；显式的证明迁移义务则使被采纳的形式化偏差变得可审计。报告在 FormalTCS 与 ConsistencyCheck 上的性能提升，加上可复用的 ODENumLib 库，显示出该方法在扩展可靠形式化流程方面的实用价值。

title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents
summary: This work studies how expert diagnosis of verification failures can be converted into reusable guidance for coding agents that must both verify programs against specifications and check that specifications capture intended behavior. The approach combines executable language definitions in the K framework with procedures for constructing specifications, repairing proofs, and auditing adequacy. A human-guided campaign on HumanEval, a benchmark of 164 Python tasks, reaches 164/164 success based on final AI audit Pass verdicts after two targeted repairs. To test whether auditing catches problems that successful proofs leave unresolved, the authors construct 12 author-reviewed clean/defective package pairs: every package passes its K proofs, and completed audits flag all defective packages and accept all clean ones. Using KleverBench, the study evaluates specification and proof construction on 31 programs with changed operator meanings; comparisons against complete acceptance rules and equally long generic advice give mixed results across two model and budget settings. Human-reviewed Optimism proofs confirm expected pause reverts for six operations within declared input bounds under London semantics with unbounded gas.
significance: The results show that passing formal proofs alone does not certify that a specification is adequate, since an audit-based procedure detected all injected defects while every package still passed its K proofs. The work also offers a reusable workflow for turning expert verification-failure analysis into guidance coding agents can apply, while its mixed KleverBench outcomes highlight open problems in selecting effective guidance under limited compute and context budgets.

zh.title: 从验证失败到面向编程智能体的可复用指导
zh.summary: 本研究探讨如何将专家对验证失败的诊断转化为面向编程智能体的可复用指导，这类智能体既要验证程序满足规范，又要检验规范是否覆盖预期行为。方法将 K framework 中可执行的语言定义与一套构造规范、修补证明和审计证明充分性的流程相结合。在包含 164 个 Python 编程任务的 HumanEval 基准上，一场由人引导的开发活动在两次针对性修补后达到 164/164 的成功率，依据为最终 AI 审计的 Pass 判定。为检验审计能否发现成功证明仍未解决的问题，作者构造了 12 对经作者审阅的干净包与缺陷包：每个包都通过其 K 证明，而已完成的审计标出全部缺陷包并接受全部干净包。研究还用 KleverBench 评测对 31 个运算符含义被更改的程序进行规范构造与证明构造的表现；与完整接受规则及等长通用建议的比较，在两种模型与预算配置下结果不一，说明在资源受限时如何选取有用指导仍需进一步研究。经人工审阅的 Optimism 证明在 London 语义且不设燃气上限的条件下，在声明的输入边界内确认六个操作的预期暂停回退行为。
zh.significance: 结果表明，仅通过形式化证明显式不足以保证规范充分，因为审计流程发现了全部注入缺陷，而每个包仍通过了其 K 证明。该研究还提供了把专家对验证失败的分析转化为编程智能体可执行指导的可复用工作流，同时其在 KleverBench 上不一致的结果凸显了在有限算力与上下文预算下选取有效指导这一开放问题。

title: Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents
summary: This work introduces Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), a pre-signing defense for AI agents controlling wallets that closes the state drift gap, where a check describes chain state at check time but the transaction executes in a later state an adversary can shape. PGS simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price within an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions covering wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps, and ownership, and proves that every execution satisfying those post-conditions satisfies the policy, with the agent's smart-contract wallet enforcing them atomically. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios spanning 14 attack families (including five drift and two adaptive families) and 12 benign families, harm was measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy. PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of benign ones, versus 57.9% for simulation-only checking and 71.4% for a static allowlist. None of the 50 drift scenarios yielded attacker gain under PGS; the only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1 to 0.2 s per check.
significance: State drift is a systematic weakness of static allowlists, LLM reviewers, and transaction simulation, since adversarial front-running, contract upgrades, or token-parameter changes can invalidate a check between check time and execution. PGS shifts the guarantee from the checked state to the executed transaction by encoding policy as atomically enforced on-chain post-conditions proved sufficient for the policy. The finding that an LLM reviewer shown a clean pre-drift simulation became more likely to approve a drift attack suggests that realistic-looking simulations can actively mislead learned reviewers, while solver-checked, execution-anchored guards offer measurable robustness at modest cost.

title: LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression
summary: LeanPolish is a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local proof edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts to study what language models learn from verified supervision. The study shows that first-success search leaks a goal-independent ordering shortcut and that teacher-selected evaluation sites reward trivial deletions; continuing menu evaluation past the first success removes this shortcut, letting a trained ranker choose the best candidate on 70.1% of held-out states versus 36.9% for the strongest frozen baseline. Iterating the symbolic compression pass raises miniF2F savings from 19.7% to 27.5%, outperforming tested neural hybrids, while matched frozen-model controls show that verified neural editing gains need not come from training. Fine-tuning does improve whole-proof rewriting, raising verified token reduction from 2.8% to 5.5% on 19 PutnamBench proofs. The released edits, candidate pools, and controlled evaluations separate imitating a search policy from genuinely improving on that search.
significance: Proof-generation datasets built from search traces can reward shortcut policies rather than real proof-improvement skill, distorting what models learn from verification feedback. LeanPolish diagnoses these artifacts and provides controlled releases and evaluations that keep correctness, compression, and edit policy distinct, giving the theorem proving and formal mathematics (定理证明与形式化数学) community a reproducible basis for building and assessing proof-improvement systems.

title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
summary: This paper formalizes layerwise loss-to-go functions for decoder-only transformers: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining blocks. Near successful validation trajectories, the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum separates output-sensitive from approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream; for causal transformers this induces a tokenwise curvature score, a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of target logits to hidden-state perturbations, which vanishes outside the target's causal ancestor set and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings. Estimated with matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluated on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb, this geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to reverse KL and skew KL distillation objectives.
significance: The work offers a loss-aware geometric account of transformer hidden states that can be measured and exploited, providing an alternative to attention magnitude and practical gains in compression, rank allocation, token pruning, and autoregressive distillation.

title: Mathematical Transfer in LLMs Follows Reasoning Approach More Than Topic
summary: The study tests whether LLM fine-tuning transfers mathematics better through shared reasoning approach or shared topic. In two counterbalanced 2×2 designs—probability and combinatorics crossed with invariant reasoning and double counting (2,000 problems), and number theory and geometry crossed with complement and pigeonhole reasoning (800 problems)—same-approach (SA) sources share the target's solution method but differ in topic, while same-topic (ST) sources share the topic but differ in method. Across five base models and three training seeds per design, SA beat ST in all 40 seed-pooled model–target comparisons, with mean advantages of 10.8 percentage points in the primary design and 14.3 in the second; all ten model-level 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. ST sources were more similar to targets under embedding and lexical measures, so the SA advantage runs opposite to statement-level resemblance.
significance: Selecting training data by reasoning approach rather than topic yields consistently stronger mathematical transfer in the evaluated combinations, and the finding holds despite same-topic data being superficially more similar to targets. This offers a practical data-selection principle for fine-tuning math-capable LLMs and suggests that shared solution methods drive transfer more than shared mathematical domains.

zh.title: 大语言模型中的数学迁移更依赖推理方式而非主题
zh.summary: 本研究检验大语言模型微调时，数学迁移究竟更多由共享推理方式还是共享主题驱动。研究采用两个平衡交叉的 2×2 设计：概率论（probability）与组合学（combinatorics）分别与不变性推理（invariant reasoning）和双重计数（double counting）交叉（2,000 道题），以及数论（number theory）与几何（geometry）分别与补集原理（complement）和鸽巢原理（pigeonhole）交叉（800 道题）。同方式（SA）来源与目标共享解题方法但主题不同，同主题（ST）来源与目标共享主题但方法不同。在每个设计的五个基础模型和三个训练随机种子上，SA 在全部 40 个按种子汇总的模型–目标比较中均优于 ST，主设计平均领先 10.8 个百分点，第二个设计平均领先 14.3 个百分点；十个模型层面的 95% 置信区间均不包含零。在嵌入相似度和词汇相似度度量下，ST 来源与目标更为相似，因此 SA 的优势与语句层面的相似性排序相反。
zh.significance: 在所评估的主题–方式组合中，按推理方式而非主题挑选训练数据能带来更一致的数学迁移增益，而且这一结论在同主题数据表面上更接近目标的情况下依然成立。这为微调具备数学能力的大语言模型提供了可操作的数据选择原则，并提示共享解题方法比共享数学领域更能促进迁移。

title: Dynamic Proof Theory for Dynamic Epistemic Logic
summary: The paper introduces a proof calculus for Dynamic Epistemic Logic (DEL) built on dynamic hypersequents, a structural framework designed to represent the dynamics of epistemic models. Agent indices and an event store are added to dynamic hypersequents, giving a uniform encoding of epistemic events. The calculus's logical rules are proved invertible, while all structural rules including contraction and the cut-rule are shown admissible. The authors state that it is the only known proof-theoretic calculus for DEL that combines a classical S5 basis with inherent dynamism.
significance: A structural, dynamic calculus for DEL could give automated reasoning about knowledge change a principled proof-theoretic foundation. Invertibility of the logical rules supports systematic proof search, while admissibility of contraction and cut simplifies normalization and meta-theoretic analysis. Anchoring the system in classical S5 also makes it compatible with standard epistemic reasoning while handling model-changing events natively.

zh.title: 动态认知逻辑的动态证明论
zh.summary: 本文为动态认知逻辑（Dynamic Epistemic Logic, DEL）提出了一种基于动态超序列（dynamic hypersequents）的演算，该框架以纯结构化的方式刻画认知模型（epistemic models）的动态变化。研究者为动态超序列加入智能体指标与事件存储，从而统一表示认知事件。所得演算的逻辑规则被证明是可逆的，而包括收缩规则（contraction rules）与切规则（cut-rule）在内的所有结构规则均被证明是可容许的。作者指出，据其所知，这是唯一一个既建立在经典 S5 框架之上又具有内在动态性的 DEL 证明论演算。
zh.significance: 面向 DEL 的结构化动态演算，有望为关于知识变化的自动推理提供有原则的证明论基础。逻辑规则的可逆性有利于系统化的证明搜索，而收缩规则与切规则的可容许性则简化了规范化及元理论分析。该系统以经典 S5 为基础，因而可与标准认知推理兼容，同时原生处理改变模型的事件。

title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning
summary: Proof-R1 is a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. A generated intermediate conclusion is admitted into the verified proof state only when its reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. The framework also recovers the answer-supporting dependency closure to trace the proof structure behind the final answer and align outcome credit with proof dependencies. Experiments show improved answer accuracy on three logical reasoning benchmarks across four backbone models, along with better reasoning-process verifiability than training-free agents and training-based methods.
significance: Existing methods can assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant reasoning steps because intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies are not machine-checked. Proof-R1 ties reinforcement learning credit assignment to formal verification, producing proofs that are both verifiable and aligned with the final answer.

title: Beyond Compression: Diagnosing How Post-Training Changes Mathematical Reasoning
summary: The paper probes how post-training alters mathematical reasoning in large language models by supplementing endpoint pass@1 with cross-surface pass@K across verbatim prompts, paraphrases, numerical isomorphisms, and translations, together with consistency, distribution-shape, and verified SFT-membership analyses. Comparing sufficiently trained off-policy distillation trajectories, released Qwen3 off-policy-plus-on-policy distillation endpoints, and a DeepSeek-Math endpoint trained with GRPO, it identifies two regimes. On easier AMC problems the large-K ceiling is near saturation, so post-training mainly compresses sampling cost; on harder AIME problems it raises the large-K ceiling over the base model, with sufficient off-policy distillation already helping and Qwen3 endpoints going further, while DeepSeek-Math GRPO does not dominate sufficient off-policy distillation at large K. English-dominant distillation improves non-English reasoning but leaves language-tier gaps, and a controlled-overfit audit shows limited sensitivity in current SFT-membership probes.
significance: The work shows that compression of sampling cost is only one regime of post-training rather than a universal explanation, and gives a diagnostic toolkit that separates newly reachable solutions from cheaper recovery of latent ones. This matters for evaluating math-specialized models, since endpoint pass@1 alone cannot distinguish these mechanisms. The findings also expose weak spots in current evaluation practice: membership probes may not reliably detect memorisation, and language-tier gaps persist even after cross-lingual gains.

zh.title: 超越压缩：诊断后训练如何改变数学推理
zh.summary: 本文通过在逐字提示、改写、数值同构和翻译上测量跨表面 pass@K，并结合一致性、分布形态和经过验证的 SFT 归属分析，探究后训练（post-training）如何改变大语言模型的数学推理（mathematical reasoning），而不局限于终点 pass@1。研究对比了三条后训练路径：训练充分的离策略蒸馏（off-policy distillation）轨迹、已发布的 Qwen3 离策略加在策略（on-policy）蒸馏终点，以及使用组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimisation, GRPO）训练的 DeepSeek-Math 终点，发现两类情形。在较易的 AMC 问题上，大 K 上限接近饱和，后训练主要压缩采样成本；在较难的 AIME 问题上，后训练相对基座模型抬高了大 K 上限，训练充分的离策略蒸馏已能提升该上限，Qwen3 终点进一步提升，而 DeepSeek-Math GRPO 在大 K 下并不优于训练充分的离策略蒸馏。以英语为主的蒸馏能改善非英语推理，但语言层级差距依然存在。受控过拟合审计显示，现有的 SFT 归属探测敏感度有限。
zh.significance: 研究表明，压缩采样成本只是后训练的一种情形，而非普遍解释，并给出一套诊断工具，把新近可达的解与对潜在解的更廉价采样区分开来。这对评测数学专用模型很重要，因为单看终点 pass@1 无法分辨这些机制。结果也暴露了当前评测的薄弱环节：归属探测未必能可靠检出记忆（memorisation），且即使出现跨语言收益，语言层级差距仍然持续存在。

title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
summary: GenLimitLib is a source-aligned Lean 4 library formalizing the literature on language generation in the limit, a theoretical setting introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024 that asks how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. The library covers developments from 30 papers, extracting shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving each paper's assumptions and statements and recording relationships across papers. Mathematical case studies and LLM experiments show how the library can support both human and AI-assisted mathematical research. The library is available at https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.
significance: The work offers a concrete, structured formalization of a young and fast-moving area arising from LLM questions, turning scattered paper-level results into reusable Lean 4 components with explicit links between them. As a testbed for large-scale formalization, it can speed literature navigation for researchers and give AI systems verifiable material for mathematical discovery and proof.

title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Synapse and Neuron Proofreading in Connectomics
summary: This work benchmarks vision-language models on the annotator decisions used in connectomics electron microscopy analysis: synapse proofreading (presence and polarity) and neuron proofreading (split and merge errors). For synapse tasks, the study evaluates 19 open and 2 closed models of varied architectures and sizes under zero-shot, four-shot in-context learning, and LoRA settings, comparing them with specialist models on datasets built from public resources. For neuron tasks, it evaluates 3 open and 2 closed models on the ConnectomeBench2 dataset, including cross-species transfer from fly and mouse to human and zebrafish. Most models performed at chance zero-shot, while in-context examples mainly benefited closed and the largest open models; LoRA fine-tuning on a few thousand labels brought open models to specialist-model level. On unseen species, the best adapted vision-language models outperformed specialist models in identifying merge errors. The project will be publicly released upon acceptance.
significance: The results show that large-scale labels are not required for vision-language models to match specialist models on connectomics proofreading, since LoRA with a few thousand annotations suffices, and that adapted models can surpass specialists on merge-error detection in unseen species. This points to practical, transferable tools for scaling up synapse and neuron proofreading across organisms in electron microscopy pipelines.

aiRole.description: The paper reports benchmark results for vision-language models on synapse and neuron proofreading decisions in connectomics, with adapted VLMs outperforming specialist models at identifying merge errors on unseen species.

humanContribution: Humans built the benchmark datasets from public resources, provided in-context examples and thousands of labels, applied LoRA adaptation and steering of the models, and set up the specialist-model comparisons and evaluation.

zh.title: 连接组学（connectomics）中突触与神经元校对的视觉-语言模型基准测试
zh.summary: 本研究对视觉-语言模型（vision-language model，VLM）在连接组学（connectomics）电子显微镜图像分析中由标注者执行的判断任务上进行了基准测试，包括突触校对（存在性与极性）和神经元校对（分裂错误与合并错误）。在突触任务上，研究评估了19个开源模型和2个闭源模型，涵盖多种架构与规模，分别在零样本、四样本上下文学习（in-context learning）和 LoRA 设置下进行测试，并与专用模型对比，所用数据集由研究团队基于公开资源构建。在神经元任务上，研究在 ConnectomeBench2 数据集上评估了3个开源模型和2个闭源模型，包含从果蝇和小鼠到人类与斑马鱼的跨物种迁移。大多数模型在零样本下表现接近随机水平，而少量示例主要使闭源模型和最大的开源模型受益；用几千条标注进行 LoRA 微调即可让开源模型达到专用模型的水平。在未见过的物种上，适配最好的视觉-语言模型在识别合并错误方面超过了专用模型。该项目将在论文录用后公开发布。
zh.significance: 结果表明，视觉-语言模型无需大规模标注即可在连接组学校对任务上追平专用模型，几千条标注的 LoRA 微调便已足够；同时，适配后的模型在未见物种的合并错误识别上可超越专用模型。这为在电子显微镜流程中跨物种扩展突触与神经元校对提供了实用且具迁移性的工具。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 本文报告了视觉语言模型在连接组学中突触与神经元校对任务上的基准测试结果，其中适配后的 VLM 在未见物种的合并错误识别上超过了专用模型。
zh.humanContribution: 人类利用公开资源构建了基准数据集，提供了上下文示例与数千条标签，对模型进行 LoRA 适配与引导，并设置了与专用模型的对比及评测流程。

title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization
summary: HeurEvo is an automated plan–code–component co-evolution framework for designing solver-augmented heuristics under tight runtime budgets. A planner selects and combines algorithmic components and allocates runtime across stages, a coder turns plans into executable code, and a component evolver maintains a shared pool of reusable components. Within an island-based evolutionary loop, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and spots improvement opportunities. On combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within strict time limits, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art solvers given hours or days of computation, and it improves the best previously reported results on nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing.
significance: Practical optimization often demands strong solutions in seconds or minutes, yet existing methods tune heuristic pieces inside fixed procedures or optimize solver settings separately. HeurEvo shows that jointly searching over algorithmic structure, implementation, and component reuse with execution feedback yields heuristics competitive with heavyweight solvers and even new best results, advancing automated algorithm design for time-critical optimization.

humanContribution: Humans built and designed the HeurEvo framework, including its planner, coder, component evolver and interpreter agents, and evaluated it on combinatorial optimization benchmarks and MIPLIB instances.

zh.title: HeurEvo：面向时间关键型数学优化的求解器增强启发式智能体进化
zh.summary: HeurEvo 是一个自动化的规划—代码—组件协同进化（plan–code–component co-evolution）框架，用于在严格的运行时间预算下设计求解器增强的启发式方法。规划器选择并组合算法组件、在各阶段间分配运行时间，编码器将规划转化为可执行代码，组件进化器维护一个共享的可复用组件池。在岛屿式进化框架中，规划与实现协同进化，并由一个解释器智能体（interpreter agent）分析执行结果、识别改进机会。在多个组合优化基准和具有挑战性的 MIPLIB 实例上，HeurEvo 能在严格的时间限制内找到高质量解，其表现常与给定数小时乃至数天计算时间的最先进的优化求解器相当或更优；在六边形填充（hexagon packing）等若干非线性几何问题上，它还刷新了此前报告的最好结果。
zh.significance: 实际优化场景往往要求在数秒或数分钟内得到优质解，而现有方法通常只在预定义流程中改进启发式部件，或单独调整求解器配置。HeurEvo 表明，借助执行反馈对算法结构、实现和组件复用进行联合搜索，可以得到能与重型求解器竞争的启发式方法，甚至取得新的最好结果，从而推进了时间关键型优化中自动化算法设计的研究。
zh.aiRoleDescription: HeurEvo 是一个基于智能体的计划-代码-组件协同进化框架，可在严格运行时预算内为组合优化基准和 MIPLIB 实例找到高质量解，常与最先进的求解器持平或超越它们，并在六边形堆叠等问题上刷新此前最佳结果。

title: Proofs Without Nominals: Gödel's Ontological Argument, its Shallow Embedding, and the Open Questions of the Monatshefte Notes
summary: This article examines the shallow embedding of higher-order modal logic in classical higher-order logic used in Benzmüller and Scott's Notes on Gödel's and Scott's variants of the ontological argument, showing that its quantifiers range over domains containing the nominals and satisfaction operators of hybrid logic, so an embedding proof establishes a theorem of the embedding, not necessarily of the modal logic. The author proves that every statement the Notes establish has an embedding proof substituting nothing outside the object language, with 294 such proofs made explicit, and that the Notes' own proofs substitute nothing external either, only prover-introduced terms being flagged. A soundness theorem over general models closed under the object language, together with a separating sentence of that language, fixes the meaning of the certificate. The Notes' three open questions are settled using the empty instance of the conjunction axiom; a non-degenerate reading of Gödel's footnote, restricting the axiom to at least two different conjuncts, settles them again without nominals, refuting the possible existence of a God-like being in one variant, with the answers restored once the Notes' non-emptiness clause is confined to Gödel's essence. Every theorem is verified in Isabelle/HOL and independently in Lean 4, the separating model in its propositional part, with countermodels produced by Nitpick and checked by the build.

zh.title: 无名词的证明：Gödel 本体论论证、其浅嵌入与 Monatshefte 札记中的开放问题
zh.summary: 本文考察 Benzmüller 与 Scott 的《Notes》中将高阶模态逻辑（higher-order modal logic）浅嵌入（shallow embedding）经典高阶逻辑（classical higher-order logic）的做法，说明其量词所取值的论域包含混合逻辑（hybrid logic）的名词（nominals）与满足算子（satisfaction operators），因此嵌入中的证明确立的是嵌入的一个定理，而不一定是该模态逻辑的定理。作者证明：《Notes》所确立的每一命题，都存在一个在对象语言之外不作任何代换的嵌入证明，并将 294 个此类证明明确给出；同时《Notes》本身的证明也未代换任何外部对象，被标记的只是定理证明器引入的项。一个适用于对对象语言封闭的一般模型（general models）的可靠性定理（soundness theorem），连同该对象语言中的一个分离语句（separating sentence），确定了该证书的含义。《Notes》的三个开放问题借助合取公理（conjunction axiom）的空实例得以解决；对 Gödel 脚注作一种非退化解读，即将该公理限制为至少两个不同的合取项，则在不使用名词的情况下再次解决了这些问题，并在某一变体中否定了类上帝存在者存在的可能性；一旦将《Notes》的非空条款限定于 Gödel 的本质（essence），原有答案即得以恢复。所有定理均在 Isabelle/HOL 中得到验证，并在 Lean 4 中独立验证，分离模型在其命题部分中验证，反模型由 Nitpick 生成并经构建检查。
zh.significance: 该工作精确阐明了浅嵌入中的证明在何种条件下可算作底层模态逻辑的定理，并给出两种证书：在演算中的显式证明重放，以及对证明所作代换内容的分析。它解答了三个开放问题。

title: MechBench: Can AI Scientific Agents Discover Mechanisms Beyond Phenomenal Laws?
summary: MechBench is a new benchmark that separates phenomenal-law recovery from mechanism discovery in scientific agents. Each task pairs a mechanistic model—structured scientifically meaningful relations whose joint consequences yield an observable phenomenal law—with observational data and scientific context given to the agent. Mechanism recovery is measured by mechanism probes asking for internal scientific consequences not inferable from the phenomenal law alone. To avoid memorized textbook answers, the benchmark builds unfamiliar variants via controlled, interpretable mutations of canonical mechanisms and screens out cases admitting comparable competing mechanisms. Experiments show a large gap: Codex with GPT-5.6-sol reaches 35.00% phenomenal-law accuracy but only 13.75% mechanism accuracy on the Core-set, and fails mechanism recovery in 64.29% of cases where the phenomenal law is correct. The gap grows with heavier mutation, and even supplying the correct phenomenal law leaves mechanism recovery below 50%.
significance: Symbolic regression and scientific-agent benchmarks have largely tested only whether systems can fit observable laws, not whether they identify the generating mechanisms. By isolating mechanism discovery and measuring it with internal-consequence probes, MechBench exposes a substantial generalization gap in mechanistic reasoning that phenomenal-law accuracy conceals, establishing mechanism discovery as a distinct and largely unsolved challenge.

aiRole.description: The paper introduces MechBench and reports benchmark scores earned by scientific agents, with Codex with GPT-5.6-sol reaching 35.00% phenomenal-law accuracy but only 13.75% mechanism accuracy on the Core-set, revealing a substantial gap in mechanistic reasoning.

humanContribution: Humans designed the benchmark, constructed unfamiliar mechanism variants via controlled mutations, screened for mechanistic indistinguishability to exclude ambiguous instances, and evaluated the agents.

zh.title: MechBench：AI 科学智能体能否超越现象定律发现机制？
zh.summary: MechBench 是一个将现象定律（phenomenal law）恢复与机制（mechanism）发现区分开来的科学智能体基准。每项任务由一个机制模型（mechanistic model）定义——即一组结构化的、具有科学意义的关系，其联合推论构成一条可观察的现象定律——而智能体仅获得观测数据与科学背景。机制恢复通过机制探针（mechanism probe）衡量，即询问那些无法仅由现象定律推断的内部科学推论。为减少对背诵教科书机制的依赖，基准通过对经典机制进行受控且科学可解释的变异来构造陌生变体，并筛除存在可比竞争机制的歧义实例。实验显示了明显差距：Codex 搭配 GPT-5.6-sol 在 Core-set 上现象定律准确率达 35.00%，而机制准确率仅为 13.75%；在现象定律正确恢复的案例中，机制恢复有 64.29% 失败。随着机制变异程度加深，差距进一步扩大；即便直接提供正确的现象定律，机制恢复率仍低于 50%。
zh.significance: 符号回归（symbolic regression）与科学智能体基准此前主要考察系统能否拟合可观察的定律，而非能否识别生成这些定律的机制。MechBench 将机制发现单独分离出来，并用内部推论探针加以度量，从而揭示出机制推理中被现象定律准确率所掩盖的显著泛化差距，使机制发现成为一个独立且大体上尚未解决的挑战。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文提出 MechBench，并报告科学智能体取得的基准成绩：Codex with GPT-5.6-sol 在 Core-set 上的唯象定律准确率达 35.00%，而机制准确率仅为 13.75%，揭示出机制推理方面的显著差距。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了该基准，通过受控变异构建非教科书式的机制变体，筛查机制不可辨识性以排除含糊实例，并对智能体进行评测。

title: SRHarness: A Harness for Agentic Symbolic Regression
summary: SRHarness is a domain-specific runtime harness for agentic symbolic regression that wraps scientific search around three mechanisms: composable scientific actions providing a common interface over raw, transformed, and candidate-derived quantities; persistent scientific state that retains evaluated hypotheses and exposes compact model-facing views; and trajectory lifecycle management covering continuation, branching, restart, and termination. On LLM-SRBench, SRHarness consistently improves numerical generalization and symbolic recovery under matched LLM backbones. With DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731, it reaches 93.69% symbolic accuracy on LSR-Transform versus 62.16% for SR-Scientist, and 72.97% on an anonymized variant stripped of scientific descriptions and variable semantics versus 39.64% for SR-Scientist. Under the same backbone, SRHarness outperforms Codex by 72.97% to 20.72% and approaches Codex with GPT-5.5, while simply giving Codex the same scientific tools does not replicate the gain.
significance: The results indicate that progress in agentic symbolic regression depends not only on stronger models or better tools, but on structured runtime support for organizing scientific actions, accumulated hypotheses, and long-horizon search. The anonymized-variant results further suggest that such infrastructure preserves discovery ability when variable semantics and domain descriptions are removed, a promising direction for open-ended scientific discovery.

zh.title: SRHarness：一个面向智能体符号回归的运行框架
zh.summary: SRHarness 是一个面向智能体符号回归（symbolic regression）的领域专用运行框架，围绕三项机制组织科学搜索：可组合的科学动作，为原始量、变换量与候选推导量提供统一接口；持久化科学状态，保存已评估的假设并生成紧凑的面向模型的视图；以及轨迹生命周期管理，协调继续、分支、重启与终止。在 LLM-SRBench 上，在相同 LLM 骨干模型下，SRHarness 在数值泛化与符号恢复两方面均有稳定提升。使用 DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 时，SRHarness 在 LSR-Transform 上取得 93.69% 的符号准确率，而 SR-Scientist 为 62.16%；在去除科学描述与变量语义的匿名化版本上仍保持 72.97% 的准确率，SR-Scientist 为 39.64%。在同一 DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 骨干模型下，SRHarness 也大幅超过 Codex（72.97% 对 20.72%），并达到与 GPT-5.5 配合 Codex 相当的表现，而仅向 Codex 提供相同的科学工具并不能复现这一优势。
zh.significance: 这些结果表明，智能体符号回归的进展不仅取决于更强的模型或更好的工具，还取决于用于组织科学动作、累积假设与长程搜索的结构化运行时支持。匿名化版本上的结果进一步说明，即使移除变量语义与领域描述，这类基础设施仍能保持发现能力，这对开放式科学发现具有积极意义。
zh.aiRoleDescription: SRHarness 是一个面向智能体符号回归的运行时框架，可显著提升 LLM 智能体在 LLM-SRBench 上的数值泛化与符号恢复能力：在 DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 下于 LSR-Transform 达到 93.69% 符号准确率，在去除科学描述与变量语义的匿名变体上保持 72.97%，超过 SR-Scientist 与 Codex 基线。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计并构建了 SRHarness 运行时基础设施，包括可组合的科学动作、持久的科学状态以及轨迹生命周期管理，并在基准问题上评估了由此得到的 LLM 符号回归系统。

title: ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization
summary: ProofLoom is a fully automated LLM-agent system for proof-obligation-driven theory construction, taking a published algorithm, a target theorem, and a source proof and autonomously building the Lean model and supporting domain theory. Open proof obligations drive the creation of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans; signature contracts record evidence and obligations when a model is revised, and an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims and Audit checks that the Lean proof follows it. Across tasks, SOptLib accumulates verified mathematics and construction experience, extracting, generalizing, and verifying reusable results while recording modeling decisions and failed proof routes for later retrieval. On fifteen textbook and research-paper tasks, ProofLoom achieves mean human ratings of 6.3/7 and 6.4/7, versus 4.9/7 and 5.0/7 for the strongest of six baselines. Across 33 developments it produces 490,693 lines of algorithm-local Lean code with no sorry, and its formalizations expose 28 incorrect formulas, proof gaps, and algorithm-analysis mismatches in published sources across 22 developments, each backed by checked evidence.
significance: Research-level stochastic optimization resists autoformalization because proofs fail without a carefully shaped algorithm model and connecting domain theory, and repairing a model can silently alter the intended claim. ProofLoom addresses this with obligation-driven construction plus independent checking of assumptions, conclusions, and proof fidelity, and with a library that carries verified results and failure records between tasks. The results suggest such an agent system can both raise the quality of formalized research mathematics and serve as a rigorous auditor of published arguments, where it flagged dozens of checked errors.

zh.title: ProofLoom：面向研究级随机优化自动形式化的证明义务驱动理论构造
zh.summary: ProofLoom 是一个全自动的 LLM 智能体系统，用于证明义务驱动的理论构造，接收已发表的算法、目标定理及原始证明，自主构建 Lean 模型与配套的领域理论。未决的证明义务驱动定义、接口、引理和证明计划的生成；签名契约在模型修订时记录证据与义务，独立的 Judge 会拒绝缺乏支撑的假设和被弱化的结论。Planner 将已发表的论证展开为中间断言，Audit 检查 Lean 证明是否遵循该论证。在各项任务间，SOptLib 积累经验证的数学成果与构造经验，将可复用结果提取、推广并验证，同时记录建模决策和失败的证明路径供后续检索。在十五个教科书与研究论文任务上，ProofLoom 的人工评分均值为 6.3/7 与 6.4/7，而六个基线中最强者为 4.9/7 与 5.0/7。在 33 个构造中，ProofLoom 产出 490,693 行算法局部的 Lean 代码且不含 sorry；其形式化还在 22 个构造中揭示了已发表来源里 28 处错误公式、证明缺口和算法分析不匹配，每一处均附有经过检查的证据。
zh.significance: 研究级随机优化（stochastic optimization）难以自动形式化（autoformalization），因为缺少精心设计的算法模型与连接性领域理论时证明无法完成，而修改模型又可能悄然改变预期的数学主张。ProofLoom 通过义务驱动的构造，加上对假设、结论与证明忠实度的独立检查来应对这一问题，并通过可复用的库在任务之间传递已验证结果与失败记录。这些结果表明，此类智能体系统既能提升研究级数学形式化的质量，也能充当对已发表论证的严格审计工具，在论文来源中发现了数十处经核实的错误。

title: Domain Theory Meets Interaction Trees in Rocq
summary: This work gives a domain-theoretic formalization of interaction trees in the Rocq prover that does not rely on Rocq's built-in coinduction, thereby avoiding earlier complications such as inserting artificial silent steps to satisfy the productivity checker, treating monad laws as weak bisimulations, and doing coinductive bisimulation reasoning. It defines an inductive program equivalence as the congruence closure of a base relation on primitive effects with respect to action sequencing and least upper bounds, so equivalences of possibly non-terminating programs reduce to equivalences of their terminating approximations, proved by induction. The relation is shown correct: whenever the base relation is correct, equivalent computations have equal denotations in any monad that faithfully implements the effects. The framework is illustrated by proving equivalent two programs encoding the Syracuse sequence, whose termination is an open mathematical conjecture.
significance: The approach removes the need for coinduction in mechanized equivalence reasoning about non-terminating effectful programs, provides a reusable correctness criterion connecting program equivalence to denotational semantics in any faithful monad, and demonstrates the method on a machine-checked equivalence closely tied to an open termination conjecture.

title: CPUNeSy: Controlling Model Writes for Reliable Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
summary: CPUNeSy is a serving architecture that restricts an LLM's writes to symbolic state through a task-defined predicate interface and a certificate gate that abstains when grounding passes disagree. Component analysis on multi-hop law and formal mathematics tasks shows that deterministic symbolic execution recovers most of the accuracy gap over chain-of-thought and retrieval baselines, with full-pool gains up to 35.0 points, while controlled writes mainly improve selective reliability by withholding unsupported or inconsistent answers at a coverage cost. On LeanDojo Benchmark 4, kernel-restricted pools match BM25 recall@15 at 89.3%. With grounding traces fixed on ContractNLI, source rechecking removes a quarter of DeepSeek's wrong answers that survive two-vote agreement, and routing withheld cases to an uncertified same-model fallback raises full-pool accuracy on MedCalc-Bench Verified by 13.9 and 4.9 points for Seed and DeepSeek, gains not attributable to the certified channel. Certificates guarantee derivational validity relative to admitted premises, while semantic faithfulness to natural-language sources remains conditional on the source checker.
significance: The work separates the source of accuracy gains from the source of reliability gains in neuro-symbolic LLM systems: deterministic execution drives accuracy, whereas certified writes act as a selective-serving control. This is directly relevant to formal mathematics and autoformalization pipelines, where derivation steps must be kernel-checkable and premises must be source-supported. The reported dependence of gains on the grounder's error regime, consistent with the authors' voting bound, gives practitioners guidance on when restricted grounding pools and certification pay off, and the abstention and fallback results quantify the accuracy-coverage trade-off in safety-sensitive settings.

title: When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?
summary: The paper asks whether structured mathematical knowledge improves LLM theorem proving in Lean 4, and whether the effect depends on the model and the problem. MathAgent builds MathKG, a knowledge graph linking 364 Mathlib theorems and definitions through 9,434 typed semantic edges inferred by LLM-based relation extraction anchored to verified Mathlib declarations. A controlled ablation compares four augmentation modes (no context, knowledge-graph context, Mathlib retrieval, both) across Qwen3-8B/32B, their Lean-specialized derivatives Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 on miniF2F, with PutnamBench and MathOlympiadBench added for Sonnet. Three findings emerge. First, specialization dominates augmentation: Lean fine-tuning adds 33-38 percentage points of solve rate in every mode, a specialized 8B model beats a 4x larger general model by 29-35 points, and no augmentation mode improves solve rate by more than 3 points. Second, augmentation is capability-conditioned: knowledge-graph context helps small models but hurts large ones, and the specialized model gains more relative to its general base at every scale. Third, the augmentation modes solve different problems: an oracle selecting the best mode per problem solves 6% to 58% more than the unaugmented prover, with the complementarity effect strengthening on harder problems (32% more on PutnamBench). The authors argue for adaptive strategies that select augmentation based on model capability and problem.
significance: As Mathlib grows past 285,000 verified theorems, the semantic layer mathematicians rely on for discovery — analogy, generalization, cross-domain links — remains implicit in syntactic dependencies, and this work tests whether an explicit LLM-inferred knowledge graph can make it useful for proving. The results give a clear negative signal for uniform augmentation and a positive one for complementarity: raw solve-rate gains are small, but different modes unlock different problems, so per-problem, per-model selection could recover substantial value. The controlled ablation across model sizes and specialization levels offers practical guidance for building Lean theorem provers and for deciding where to invest in fine-tuning versus retrieval.

zh.title: 结构化知识何时有助于神经定理证明？
zh.summary: 本文探讨结构化数学知识能否提升大语言模型在 Lean 4 中的定理证明（theorem proving）能力，以及这一效果是否依赖于模型和具体问题。MathAgent 构建了知识图谱（knowledge graph）MathKG，通过基于大语言模型的关系抽取、并锚定到已验证的 Mathlib 声明，将 364 个 Mathlib 定理与定义用 9,434 条带类型的语义边连接起来。受控消融实验比较四种增强模式（无上下文、知识图谱上下文、Mathlib 检索、二者结合），涉及 Qwen3-8B/32B、其 Lean 专门化版本 Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B，以及 Claude Sonnet 4.6，在 miniF2F 上评测，另为 Sonnet 增加 PutnamBench 与 MathOlympiadBench。研究得出三点发现。第一，专门化的影响超过增强：在每种模式下 Lean 微调带来 33 至 38 个百分点的解题率提升，一个 8B 规模的专门化模型比大 4 倍的通用模型高出 29 至 35 个百分点，而没有任何增强模式能将解题率提升超过 3 个百分点。第二，增强效果取决于模型能力：知识图谱上下文帮助小模型却损害大模型，并且在每一规模上专门化模型相对其通用基座的收益都更大。第三，不同增强模式解出的题目并不相同：逐题选择最优模式的预言机比未增强的证明器多解 6% 至 58% 的题目，这种互补效应在更难的问题上更强（在 PutnamBench 上多解 32%）。作者据此主张采用依据模型能力与问题特点选择增强方式的自适应策略。
zh.significance: 随着 Mathlib 超过 285,000 个已验证定理，数学家在发现过程中所依赖的语义层——类比、推广、跨领域联系——仍隐含于语法依赖之中，本文检验了一个由大语言模型推断出的显式知识图谱能否使其服务于证明。结果对"一律增强"给出了明确的否定信号，对"互补性"则给出了肯定信号：整体解题率增益很小，但不同模式能解锁不同题目，因此逐题、逐模型的选择有望挽回可观价值。该受控消融实验覆盖不同模型规模与专门化程度，为构建 Lean 定理证明器，以及在微调与检索之间如何分配投入提供了实用指导。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者提出了 MathAgent，它构建覆盖 Mathlib 的语义知识图谱（MathKG），并用其增强 LLM 定理证明器。在 miniF2F、PutnamBench 和 MathOlympiadBench 上对五个模型进行的受控消融实验发现：Lean 专业化远比增强重要；知识图谱上下文对小模型有帮助但对大模型有害；各增强模式解决的问题具有互补性，按问题选取最优模式的 oracle 相比未增强证明器提升 6% 到 58%。
