title: LieDiscover: Adaptive Symbolic Library Construction for Explicit Open-form Symmetry Discovery
summary: LieDiscover addresses the inability of existing data-driven symmetry discovery methods to determine the exact number and mathematical form of unknown infinitesimal generators. The framework casts symmetry discovery as a joint optimization problem over both a function library and its coefficients, and uses an encoder-decoder architecture that dynamically generates symbolic expressions to expand the library. Expression generation is optimized with reinforcement learning using step-wise rewards to speed exploration of the symbolic search space. Experiments show the method recovers open-form infinitesimal generators involving high-order polynomials or transcendental functions that defeat existing approaches, and that the discovered symmetries improve downstream PDE solving and discovery tasks.
significance: Exact and open-form symmetry discovery is foundational for scientific modeling, yet prior explicit methods depend on fixed function libraries that cannot express complex generators. By adaptively constructing the library itself, LieDiscover extends the reach of symbolic symmetry discovery to high-order polynomial and transcendental cases, and the resulting symmetries deliver measurable gains in PDE solving and equation discovery.

aiRole.description: LieDiscover, an encoder-decoder framework trained with reinforcement learning, uncovered open-form infinitesimal symmetry generators involving high-order polynomials or transcendental functions and improved downstream PDE solving and discovery tasks.

humanContribution: Humans formulated symmetry discovery as a joint optimization problem and designed, built and trained the encoder-decoder framework with reinforcement learning to generate symbolic expressions.

title: Towards Eliminating Catastrophic Forgetting in the Curriculum Learning of Math Reasoning Tasks
summary: This paper analyzes catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning for mathematical reasoning tasks, arguing from parameter update dynamics that forgetting arises from divergence among task optima, which is also what drives the faster convergence of curriculum learning, so it cannot be fully eliminated. The authors propose IV-EWC, which integrates Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) into the curriculum objective and uses influence functions to build a representative validation set from curriculum training data for dynamic regularization. An extended theoretical analysis supports EWC-based regularization as a mitigation. Experiments on three backbone models and three benchmarks confirm catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning; IV-EWC reduces forgetting by 162% on average versus vanilla curriculum learning and produces positive backward transfer, improving easier-task performance after training on harder tasks.
significance: The work supplies a theoretical account of why forgetting is inherent to curriculum learning, not merely an optimization defect, and pairs it with a practical method, IV-EWC, that measurably curbs forgetting in mathematical reasoning training. Reported backward transfer gains also suggest that hard-task training need not degrade easier skills, informing how curriculum-based math reasoning systems are designed and evaluated.

aiRole.description: The authors report that backbone models trained with their IV-EWC curriculum method reduced catastrophic forgetting by 162% on average and achieved positive backward transfer on three math reasoning benchmarks, alongside theoretical analyses of forgetting.

humanContribution: Humans developed IV-EWC, derived the theoretical analyses of parameter update dynamics and regularization, constructed the validation set via influence functions, and designed and ran the empirical evaluations on three backbones and three benchmarks.

title: Quizzing the Translation: A Prover-Grounded Evaluation Metric for NL$\rightarrow$FOL
summary: The paper introduces SIV, a prover-grounded metric for evaluating translations from natural language into first-order logic. From the target formula SIV derives two probe types, verified by a theorem prover: positive probes the candidate must entail (catching dropped content) and contrastive probes it must not entail (catching over-assertion). On controlled perturbed FOLIO translations, error severity explains 80% of SIV score variance versus at most 17% for prior metrics; across six error classes on a disjoint pool, SIV ranks the reference above the perturbed candidate in over 99% of pairs. Because each probe is labeled with what it tests, failure patterns yield labeled error traces that recover the perturbation class at macro-F1 0.638, nearly double a score-only baseline. On 434 expert-audited real LLM translations, SIV attains the top AUC, uniquely detects and grades expert-labeled major errors, and abstains rather than mis-scoring on out-of-vocabulary translations.
significance: Translation is the bottleneck of symbolic reasoning pipelines over natural-language problems, and surface-overlap metrics such as BLEU, BERTScore, and Smatch++ can reward the most semantically broken translations. SIV grounds scoring in prover-verified entailment, so its scores track error severity, and its labeled probes turn evaluation into a diagnostic tool for finding and classifying translation errors.

title: What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?
summary: The paper isolates masking strategy as a variable in EEG foundation model pre-training, formalizing spatio-temporal masking choices and training 58 models under a single pipeline across two self-supervised frameworks, MAE and JEPA. Evaluated by linear probe on the 12 datasets of OpenEEGBench, both frameworks converge on the same optimal masking configuration and share failure modes. Performance is otherwise robust: 11 MAE and 9 JEPA configurations are statistically indistinguishable from the best. The authors also report a JEPA-specific failure mode they call bias-inflation collapse, which standard detectors cannot see, and show that with a well-chosen mask their pipeline matches REVE-level downstream performance at a fraction of REVE's pre-training compute.
significance: Masking determines what a model must predict and from which context, but until now it was always confounded with backbone and objective changes, leaving pre-training pipelines poorly understood. A clean ablation gives practitioners concrete guidance on mask geometry, shows that many configurations work nearly equally well, and exposes a silent failure mode that could otherwise go unnoticed in JEPA training, all while lowering the compute cost of reaching strong downstream EEG decoding.

title: Diagnosing Sampled LLM Reasoning in Formal Geometry: Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence
summary: The paper presents Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence (CRV), an evaluation protocol for sampled large language model (LLM) reasoning over formal geometry states. Coverage measures answer availability in a candidate pool frozen before readouts are compared, realization measures readout accuracy on that pool, and validity evidence is a label-blinded critic judgment of derivational support rather than a proof certificate. On HardShift441, a 441-problem set where a reference solver leaves 406 problems unsolved, a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B generator achieves 24.2% average single-sample accuracy and 68.9% pass@16, while verifier-weighted self-consistency (WSC) reaches 38.0%. Readout accuracy is especially low when the correct answer occurs only once or twice in the pool. In a separate audit of 195 covered problems, the critic labels 12 correct-answer representatives as supported, 181 as refuted, and two as uncertain, showing that the three quantities are distinct and should be reported separately.
significance: Repeated sampling can surface a correct numerical answer without producing a dependable final readout or a genuinely supported derivation. CRV separates answer availability, readout success, and derivational support, preventing inflated pass@k-style results from being mistaken for valid reasoning. The audit finding that most covered correct answers are judged refuted shows that high coverage does not imply trustworthy derivations, and the multiplicity analysis reveals when readout methods are most fragile.

title: Predicting the Next State Is Not Enough: JEPA Representations for Lean Theorem Proving
summary: This paper tests whether one-step Lean state transitions can serve as a self-supervised signal for ordering candidate successor states in neural theorem proving. A JEPA-style model predicts latent successor representations and scores only kernel-validated, nonterminal successors produced by a fixed pretrained ByT5 proposer. On a same-theorem ranking diagnostic, JEPA beats a matched InfoNCE baseline in Top-1 accuracy (50.18% versus 31.55%), but solves on average 282.3 of 987 theorems over three seeds versus 308 for proposer ordering, while requiring more tactic checks. The authors conclude that accurate one-step transition ranking is insufficient as a long-horizon search value. The evaluation is controlled to separate representation quality from proposal quality, with kernel-checked proof completion as the primary endpoint.
significance: The result cautions that self-supervised transition prediction can look strong on local ranking metrics while degrading whole-proof search, arguing for end-to-end kernel-checked completions rather than proxy metrics as the primary measure. The controlled setup also offers a template for isolating representation learning from tactic proposer quality in neural theorem provers.

title: The third symmetric product of a set is a set in HoTT
summary: This paper deformalizes an LLM-generated proof within Homotopy Type Theory (HoTT), showing that SP^3(X) is a set whenever X is a set, via an iterated pushout construction for SP^3(X). significance: The work demonstrates how LLM-generated formal mathematics can be converted into readable mathematical exposition, while pushing a known symmetric-product argument from SP^2 to SP^3 and stress-testing the encode-decode technique in a higher-stage setting.

title: Learning from a Thoughtful Teacher: Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: This work identifies a limitation of on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) for mathematical reasoning: teacher utility and student learnability diverge, as a small fraction of high-disagreement tokens dominate the distillation signal and short teacher continuations there leak privileged information (PI) more than they convey transferable correction cues. The proposed Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation (AOPSD) encodes each solution as a reasoning DAG, orders problems by the student's evolving capability, exposes only the affordable subgraph and its next frontier as PI, and uses short teacher continuations as probes to curb PI-conditioned shortcuts. AOPSD reaches 72.5% Pass@8 across HMMT25, AIME24, AIME25, and BRUMo25, exceeding OPSD by 6.7 percentage points and the strongest competing baseline by 4.2, while cutting training time by 15 percentage points at lower cost.
significance: The results show that how privileged information is selected and weighted, rather than the use of a larger external teacher, is central to effective self-distillation on mathematical reasoning tasks. By aligning teacher guidance with what the student can actually absorb, AOPSD both strengthens learning signals and suppresses shortcut leakage, yielding better accuracy together with lower training time and cost.

title: Explaining Textual Entailment with Lexical Entailments: Using LLMs to Supply Lexical Relations for Formal Proofs
summary: The paper asks whether large language models can identify all lexical knowledge needed to solve natural language inference (NLI) problems, and how much such knowledge contributes to proof search in a logic-based NLI system. The authors curate a dataset for a new task: explaining sentence-level entailment labels by sets of lexical entailments, such as chinchilla being a small animal. This dataset is used to intrinsically evaluate LLM generation of structured lexical explanations. The generated relations are then supplied to LangPro, a natural-logic theorem prover for natural language, in a simple neuro-symbolic setting for an extrinsic evaluation of their usefulness. Even hosted proprietary LLMs find the task challenging, and their contribution to theorem proving is moderate: the generated relations are often only partially sound and may be tailored to individual NLI problems rather than constituting generally valid lexical knowledge.
significance: The work measures the gap between the lexical knowledge LLMs appear to store and the knowledge they actually deploy in reasoning, and it tests machine-generated lexical axioms as input to a transparent, formally grounded prover. The results indicate that LLM-supplied lexical relations remain an insufficient and partly unreliable resource for proof search, motivating verification or grounding before such relations are used in formal reasoning pipelines.

title: From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: This paper defines strategy utility as the probability that a high-level strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor, and introduces SURE, a framework for learning and using relative strategy utility. SURE separates high-level strategies from detailed reasoning, builds pairwise preferences from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, and trains a Strategy Reward Model to estimate relative utility. The frozen reward model scores only the extracted strategy, with its score combined with correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Across three policy backbones, SURE raises average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% over outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, while matching or exceeding stronger reward baselines at substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.
significance: The work isolates the quality of high-level strategy choices, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, from their downstream execution, turning an aspect of mathematical reasoning that outcome-only rewards cannot distinguish into a learnable signal. The reported gains across three policy backbones, together with lower training compute than stronger reward baselines, suggest that strategy-level supervision is a practical route to more efficient reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

title: LANTERN: Illuminating Hidden Mathematical Knowledge in Language Models
summary: LANTERN is a fast, cost-efficient pipeline that uses a classifier over pretrained-model activations to rank candidate mathematical relations, followed by staged filtering, hypothesis generation, executable verification, and analytical checking. Applied to the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), it ranked 50 million pairs among 10,000 frequently referenced sequences and found 62 verified relations lacking an existing OEIS cross-reference. A content screen retained 13 relations worth presenting; nine were judged informative or insightful, including four that appear to be entirely novel to the best of the authors' knowledge. The full process took under 8 hours.
significance: LANTERN demonstrates that internal language-model representations can help prioritize promising mathematical connections at a scale beyond manual search. The verified relations show that this approach can uncover useful, apparently novel links among well-studied integer sequences while remaining computationally practical.

title: Solving Every Step Is Not Enough: Milestone Oracles Reveal a Composition Gap in LLM Math Reasoning
summary: The paper introduces OracleLadder, a diagnostic evaluation that localizes failures in large language model (LLM) math reasoning by supplying increasing levels of oracle help: a teacher model writes a fixed roadmap of intermediate sub-goals (milestones), and a deterministic symbolic verifier grades every answer. Testing models with no help, with the roadmap, with the roadmap plus milestone answers, and on each milestone alone sorts each failure into one of five reasoning gaps. Across 354 NuminaMath problems and six models from 8B to 671B parameters (Qwen3, gpt-oss, Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-V3.1), the largest gap for every model is the composition gap, a stricter form of the compositionality gap, covering 33-48% of problems and 24-37% after removing problems flagged as grading errors by an LLM review. Accuracy and milestone-help recovery rank the two strongest models differently, and two RLVR runs with similar accuracy gains move problems differently. The roadmap effect replicates on MATH500 and AIME 2024/25, per-problem recovery agrees for 83-87% of problems under an independent second teacher, and the help ladder transfers to code generation. Data, roadmaps, prompts, and code are released.
significance: The results show that solving every intermediate step individually is not sufficient for solving a full multi-step math problem, identifying composition of steps rather than step-level competence as the dominant bottleneck in LLM math reasoning. OracleLadder provides a graded diagnostic beyond aggregate accuracy, distinguishes models and reinforcement learning runs that look equivalent by score, and offers reusable data and tooling for studying and improving multi-step mathematical reasoning.

zh.title: 仅解决每一步还不够：里程碑预言机揭示大语言模型数学推理中的组合缺口
zh.summary: 本文提出诊断性评测方法 OracleLadder，通过逐级提供预言机（Oracle）帮助来定位大语言模型（LLM）在数学推理中的失败环节：由教师模型写出固定的中间子目标路线图（里程碑，milestone），再由确定性符号验证器对每个答案评分。分别在无帮助、仅有路线图、路线图加各里程碑答案、以及单独求解每个里程碑的条件下测试模型，可将每类失败归入五种推理缺口（reasoning gap）之一。在 354 道 NuminaMath 题目与六个参数量从 8B 到 671B 的模型（Qwen3、gpt-oss、Llama 3.3、DeepSeek-V3.1）上，每个模型占比最大的都是组合缺口（composition gap），即组合性缺口（compositionality gap）的一种更严格形式，覆盖 33-48% 的题目，剔除被大语言模型评审标记为评分错误的题目后为 24-37%。按准确率与按里程碑帮助恢复情况对两个最强模型的排名并不一致，两次准确率提升相近的 RLVR 运行所改变的题目也各不相同。路线图效应在 MATH500 与 AIME 2024/25 上得到复现，独立的第二个教师模型在 83-87% 的题目上给出一致的逐题恢复结论，该帮助阶梯还可迁移到代码生成任务。作者公开了数据、路线图、提示词与代码。
zh.significance: 研究结果表明，即使能单独求解每个中间步骤，也未必能解决完整的多步数学题，这说明大语言模型数学推理的主要瓶颈在于步骤之间的组合，而非单步能力。OracleLadder 提供了超越单一准确率的分级诊断手段，能够区分在总分上看似相当的模型与强化学习运行，同时为研究和改进多步数学推理提供了可复用的数据与工具。

title: CompassPlay: Rewarding the Proposer for Where It Moves the Solver
summary: CompassPlay is a self-play method in which a proposer generates verifiable tasks for a solver, and the proposer is rewarded through gradient alignment: tasks whose solver loss gradients align with reference tasks representing target capabilities receive higher reward. Drawing on a first-order approximation to learning progress, the method scores each eligible task without additional solver training. In coding self-play with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, a small external reference set guides task generation, yielding gains of 1.5 percentage points in average accuracy over AZR's difficulty reward on in-domain coding and 2.7 points on out-of-domain mathematics. In Lean4 theorem proving, CompassPlay matches the difficulty baseline's cumulative coverage over 150 iterations using 40% fewer GPU-hours.
significance: Task-difficulty rewards are a common default in self-play, but equally difficult tasks can differ sharply in training value. CompassPlay offers a cheap, gradient-based signal that steers task generation toward target capabilities, improving both downstream accuracy and compute efficiency, and it transfers across coding and formal theorem proving settings.

title: Instruct, Not Answer: Using Instruction Privileges in On-Policy Context Distillation
summary: On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) transfers privileged teacher context to a student by minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence on student-generated tokens, and prior work finds that gold answers or gold demonstrations as the default privilege can hurt training, especially out of distribution. The authors instead craft short, general instructions targeting common student mistakes observed in training samples and apply each one uniformly to every sample. Across 7 of 8 experiments using ProverQA, ProofWriter, and ProntoQA with the Qwen3-Thinking and Olmo3-Thinking model families, such matched instruction privileges beat gold by 4 to 17 points out of distribution while staying on par in domain, and in autoformalization a matched formatting instruction outperforms gold in OOD accuracy by a large margin.
significance: The results show that a few-sentence instruction carrying far less information than instance-specific gold can be substantially more transferable in OPCD while preserving in-domain performance, offering a simple alternative privilege choice for self-improvement training and for autoformalization pipelines where robustness to distribution shift matters.

title: Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications
summary: The article proposes algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a configurable framework for compressed computation, exploiting a reduction to purely integer arithmetic that permits error-free multiply-accumulate operations. A matrix multiplication engine built on this property achieves performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. The authors further introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and report accuracy competitive with the industry-standard MX format across diverse models and benchmarks at equivalent bits-per-parameter budgets. The experiments use degree-two algebraic integers (quadratic integers); extensions to higher-order and multidimensional algebraic integers are left as promising future directions.
significance: Quantization formats that trade accuracy for efficiency are central to deploying large language models on constrained hardware, and this work connects that engineering problem to number-theoretic structure: algebraic integers permit exact integer multiply-accumulate arithmetic while allowing the number system itself to be tuned to a workload, a degree of freedom absent from floating-point and fixed-point formats. The reported competitiveness with the MX format at matched bit budgets suggests such formats are practically relevant, while the unexplored higher-order and multidimensional cases point to further computational gains.

zh.title: 面向机器学习应用的代数整数量化
zh.summary: 本文提出代数整数数字格式（algebraic integer number formats，AINF）作为一种高度可配置的压缩计算框架，其关键性质是可直接化归为纯整数运算，从而实现无误差的乘累加（multiply-accumulate）运算。研究者基于该性质开发了一个矩阵乘法引擎，其性能在现代硬件加速器上处于可预测的、相对最高效数值方案的因子范围内。作者进一步提出代数整数量化（algebraic integer quantization，AIQ），一种面向大语言模型（LLM）推理的有损压缩格式，并给出实验结果：在相同的每参数比特预算下，AIQ 在多种模型与基准上的精度可与行业标准 MX format 相竞争。本文实验采用二次整数（quadratic integers），即二次代数整数；推广到高次乃至多维代数整数有望带来更大的计算优势，是未来工作的有前景方向。
zh.significance: 以精度换取效率的量化格式是大语言模型在受限硬件上部署的核心问题，而这项工作将该工程问题与数论结构联系起来：代数整数（algebraic integer）既允许精确的整数乘累加运算，又使数字系统本身可根据工作负载特性进行选择，这是浮点（floating-point）与定点（fixed-point）格式所不具备的自由度。在同等比特预算下与 MX format 相当的精度表现说明此类格式具有实际价值，而尚未探索的高次与多维情形则指向进一步的计算收益。

title: Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization
summary: Choir is an open protocol for distributed multi-agent autoformalization. It decomposes a formalization project into tasks that independent contributors can complete with their own agents and LLM subscriptions, coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository instead of a single centralized team. Every contribution passes a deterministic gate before merge, and the protocol supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq; it is open source and modular so projects can replace components or extend the protocol.
significance: Formalizing textbooks and major theorems has so far concentrated agent runs and their full computational cost in single teams. Choir spreads that cost across independent contributors while keeping quality control deterministic and mergeable, which could widen access to large-scale formalization and let proof assistant projects adapt the tooling to their own needs.

title: Nonparametric In-Context Learning under Growing Geometric Complexity: Minimax Optimality and Local Geometry-Adaptivity of Transformers
summary: This paper studies nonparametric in-context learning for prediction when the data geometry is unknown and heterogeneous, modeled as sample-size-dependent mixtures of manifolds with varying dimensions, smoothness, and sampling masses. Under this growing geometric complexity regime, the authors establish a minimax lower bound reflecting the aggregate difficulty of the components and construct an oracle tangent local polynomial estimator with a matching upper bound. This estimator is realized by a structure-informed two-stage softmax transformer featuring a geometric preconditioner and local polynomial solvers, which attains negligible approximation error relative to the minimax rate with logarithmic depth and polynomial size. The paper further derives an in-context generalization bound for near empirical risk minimizers over this class, yielding conditions under which the predictor exploits local geometry and achieves the minimax rate.
significance: Existing theory for nonparametric in-context learning mostly assumes Euclidean domains or a single manifold, leaving complex real-world data settings unexplained. These results provide an end-to-end account, from statistical lower bounds through an explicit transformer construction to generalization guarantees, showing when and how transformers adapt to local geometry and reach optimal prediction rates on heterogeneous geometric data.

zh.title: 增长几何复杂度下的非参数上下文内学习：极小极大最优性与Transformer的局部几何自适应性
zh.summary: 本文研究当数据几何未知且异质时的非参数上下文内学习（in-context learning）预测问题，将几何建模为随样本量变化的流形（manifold）混合，其中各分量的维度、光滑度与采样质量各不相同。在这一增长几何复杂度模型下，作者证明了反映各分量总体难度的极小极大下界（minimax lower bound），并构造了具有匹配上界的神谕切空间局部多项式估计量。该估计量由一个结构化的两阶段softmax Transformer实现，配备几何预条件器与局部多项式求解器，以对数深度和多项式规模达到相对极小极大速率可忽略的逼近误差。作者还为该函数类中的近似经验风险最小化（ERM）导出了上下文内泛化界，给出预测量利用局部几何并达到极小极大速率的条件。
zh.significance: 现有非参数上下文内学习理论大多假设欧几里得域或单一流形，难以解释真实世界复杂任务中的表现。本工作从统计下界、显式Transformer构造一直到泛化保证，提供了端到端的理论链条，说明Transformer在何种条件下能自适应地利用局部几何，并在异质几何数据上达到最优预测速率。

title: DepthEvidence: Unifying Metric Depth Prediction and Geometric Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
summary: DepthEvidence is a 4B multimodal language model that unifies dense metric depth prediction with language-based geometric reasoning. A camera-conditioned decoder predicts full-resolution metric depth from multi-scale visual features with high-resolution RGB refinement, and a dense-to-language interface converts predicted depths and decoder features into object-aligned continuous geometry tokens anchored to object identifiers. Geometric supervision keeps metric information recoverable before and after language-context interaction, while instruction tuning enables object measurement and compositional reasoning. The authors introduce the Depth-VQA benchmark covering object-depth queries, relative comparisons, and decisions combining spatial and numerical constraints. Across nine datasets, the model achieves the highest average dense δ₁ among evaluated methods, leads the evaluated methods in instance-level metric depth estimation and on both relative and metric reasoning tracks, and broadly preserves general VQA performance while improving spatial understanding over the base model.
significance: The work bridges dense metric depth estimators and multimodal language models by feeding the model's own depth predictions back as object-grounded evidence, keeping numerical geometry intact during language reasoning. The Depth-VQA benchmark provides a focused test of spatial and numerical reasoning, and the reported gains in metric depth estimation and relative and metric reasoning without loss of general VQA performance point toward spatially grounded, measurement-faithful multimodal reasoning.

aiRole.description: The DepthEvidence 4B multimodal model achieves the highest average dense δ1 across nine datasets and leads evaluated methods on instance-level metric depth estimation and relative and metric reasoning tracks, while preserving general VQA performance.

humanContribution: Humans designed the architecture and dense-to-language interface, provided geometric supervision and instruction tuning, and built the Depth-VQA benchmark used for evaluation.

zh.title: DepthEvidence：在多模态语言模型中统一度量深度预测与几何推理
zh.summary: DepthEvidence是一个4B多模态语言模型，统一了稠密度量深度预测（metric depth prediction）与基于语言的几何推理（geometric reasoning）。相机条件解码器利用多尺度视觉特征并配合高分辨率RGB细化，预测全分辨率的度量深度；稠密到语言的接口把预测深度与解码器特征转换为以对象标识符锚定的对象对齐连续几何token。几何监督促使度量信息在语言上下文交互前后均可恢复，指令微调则支持对象测量与组合推理。作者提出了Depth-VQA基准（benchmark），覆盖对象深度查询、相对比较以及结合空间与数值约束的决策。在九个数据集上，该模型在所比较方法中取得最高的平均稠密δ₁，在实例级度量深度估计以及相对推理与度量推理两个赛道的总体准确率上均领先，并在大体保持通用视觉问答（VQA）能力的同时，相对基座模型提升了空间理解。
zh.significance: 这项工作把稠密度量深度估计器与多模态语言模型衔接起来，将模型自身的深度预测作为对象接地的证据回传给语言生成，使几何数值在语言推理过程中保持完整。Depth-VQA基准为结合空间与数值的推理提供了有针对性的评测，而模型在度量深度估计以及相对推理与度量推理上的提升，且未损失通用视觉问答表现，显示出通向空间接地、测量忠实的多模态推理的可行路径。
zh.aiRoleDescription: DepthEvidence 4B 多模态模型在九个数据集上取得最高的平均 dense δ1，并在实例级度量深度估计以及相对与度量推理轨道上领先于被比较方法，同时保持了通用 VQA 性能。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了模型架构与 dense-to-language 接口，提供了几何监督和指令微调，并构建了用于评估的 Depth-VQA 基准。

title: Order-Invariant Answers, Order-Sensitive Representations in Mathematical Reasoning
summary: This study examines whether mathematically equivalent orderings of rule sets induce invariant internal representations in language models. Using synthetic multi-step function-composition problems presented under multiple rule orderings with identical correct answers, the authors measure accuracy alongside permutation signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), which captures how distinctly ordering patterns are represented relative to variation across problem instances. Across 16 language models of 1B to 8B parameters, models that solve reordered problems more accurately represent rule orderings more distinctly: layer-averaged permutation SNR is positively rank-correlated with accuracy in every synthetic setting evaluated, with Spearman correlations reaching 0.86. The results support a separation between answer invariance and representation invariance, since successful rule composition can coexist with distinct internal representations of equivalent rule orderings.
significance: The findings show that answer accuracy alone can mask substantial representational variation among semantically equivalent inputs, motivating a representational perspective on evaluating mathematical reasoning beyond correctness. Tracking permutation SNR could help diagnose how models compose rules, guide more robust architectures and benchmarks, and inform the design of mathematical agents that behave consistently under meaning-preserving reformulations.

zh.title: 数学推理中的答案不变性与表示敏感性
zh.summary: 本研究考察了数学上等价的规则集合重排序是否会引发语言模型中不变的内部表示。作者使用合成的多步函数复合（function composition）问题，每道题以多种规则顺序呈现且正确答案相同，并测量准确率与置换信噪比（permutation signal-to-noise ratio，SNR），后者刻画排序模式相对于不同题目实例间差异的表示清晰程度。在1B到8B参数规模的16个语言模型中，能更准确求解重排问题的模型对规则顺序的表示也更为分明：在所评估的每个合成场景中，逐层平均的置换SNR与准确率呈正秩相关，Spearman相关系数最高达0.86。这些结果支持答案不变性（answer invariance）与表示不变性（representation invariance）的区分，因为成功的规则复合可以与对等价规则顺序的不同内部表示并存。
zh.significance: 研究结果表明，仅凭答案准确率会掩盖语义等价输入之间的显著表示差异，因而推动从表示的角度、而非仅以正确性来评估数学推理。追踪置换SNR有助于诊断模型如何复合规则，指导更稳健的架构与基准设计，并为设计在保持语义的改写下行为一致的数学智能体提供参考。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 该研究在以多种规则顺序呈现的合成多步函数组合问题上评估了 16 个 1B 至 8B 参数的语言模型，测量准确率与 permutation SNR。研究发现，对重排问题解答更准确的模型对不同规则顺序的内部表征区分更明显，Spearman 相关最高达 0.86。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了合成函数组合问题及其重排变体，定义了 permutation SNR，选取并评估了 16 个语言模型，并分析了表征区分度与准确率之间的相关性。

title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
summary: The paper defines the intrinsic interestingness of a theorem as the ratio of its proof length to its statement length and shows that this measure correlates strongly with an extrinsic measure of downstream utility. The authors identify the difficulty of a proof conditioned on a set of premises as a useful primitive for computing these metrics, and train a 27B model that predicts proof difficulty more accurately than frontier general-purpose models. Optimizing for the interestingness metric yields a model that produces more interesting theorems while reducing substantial or full overlap with Mathlib from 91.9% to 30.6%, indicating more out-of-distribution mathematics. The system can generate candidate theorems, select the most interesting ones, and iteratively build on a self-expanding, machine-verified library.
significance: The metrics offer a practical, quantifiable signal for ranking conjectures and guiding proof search inside formal mathematical libraries. By letting the system choose worthwhile statements on its own, the framework points toward self-expanding, machine-verified mathematics that does not depend on human-supplied targets, helping address the question of whether machine-generated theorems are interesting or useful rather than merely numerous.

zh.title: 学习发现有趣的数学
zh.summary: 本文将定理（theorem）的内在有趣度定义为证明长度与陈述长度之比，并表明该度量与外部的下游效用度量高度相关。研究者将以一组前提为条件的证明难度识别为计算这些指标的有效基本量，并训练了一个 27B 模型，在预测证明难度方面比前沿通用模型更准确。针对有趣度指标进行优化得到的模型能生成更有价值的定理，同时将与 Mathlib 的实质性或完全重叠从 91.9% 降至 30.6%，显示产生了更多分布外数学。该系统能够生成候选定理（theorem），挑选其中最有趣者，并在可自我扩展的机器验证库上迭代构建。
zh.significance: 这些指标为在形式化数学库（formal mathematical library）中对猜想（conjecture）排序并指导证明搜索（proof search）提供了实用且可量化的信号。通过让系统自主选择有价值的陈述，这一框架指向可自我扩展、经机器验证的数学库，不再依赖人工指定目标，有助于回答机器生成的定理（theorem）究竟有无价值或用途，而不只是数量众多这一问题。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者的 AI 系统训练了一个 27B 模型来预测证明难度，其准确性优于前沿通用模型；按其有趣度指标优化后，模型能产生更有趣的定理，并将与 Mathlib 的实质性或完全重合从 91.9% 降至 30.6%。该系统还能生成候选定理、筛选出最有趣者，并迭代构建可自我扩展的机器验证数学库。
zh.humanContribution: 人类定义了内在与外在有趣度指标，构建并训练了 27B 证明难度模型，并设计了优化流程与可自我扩展的数学库流水线。

title: Agentic-IC3: Enabling Semantic Proof Search in IC3 Model Checking
summary: Agentic-IC3 integrates a language-model agent into IC3 hardware model checking built on Pono's word-level infrastructure, using RTL design semantics to propose high-level lemmas through SAT and UNSAT generalization, introduce derived observation signals, and backtrack from unproductive proof branches, while a persistent backend checks every proposal before updating the proof state to preserve soundness. On 14 benchmarks spanning security information-flow verification and functional verification of communication protocols, processors, and functional units, it solves 10 cases within a one-hour timeout, including 4 unsolved by the baselines rIC3, Pono-IC3Bits, and A-IC3.
significance: Semantic guidance from RTL may overcome the generalization bottleneck of bit-level IC3 engines, and a checked-proposal interface lets a language model contribute to proof search without compromising soundness, with 4 uniquely solved cases indicating gains over existing IC3 variants.

aiRole.description: Agentic-IC3 integrates a language-model agent into IC3 to guide semantic proof search over RTL design information, proposing high-level lemmas and derived observation signals; on 14 benchmarks it solves 10 within a one-hour timeout, including 4 unsolved by all three evaluated baselines.

humanContribution: The humans built the framework on Pono's word-level model-checking infrastructure, designed the agent-oriented interface and proof-state backend, and assembled the 14-benchmark suite of security information-flow and functional verification tasks.

title: Provably Complete Generalized Planning with LLMs
summary: This work addresses the fact that LLM-generated generalized plans, typically written as Python programs, have only been evaluated on test instances rather than proven correct for all instances of a planning domain. The authors present a pipeline that converts PDDL domain specifications into Lean in a semantics-preserving way and uses GPT-5.6-Sol to generate both a generalized plan and a formal proof that the plan solves every instance satisfying the given domain constraints. Lean's kernel certifies the completeness proof. On 13 standard benchmark domains, the approach produced generalized plans with valid completeness proofs for 12 domains, which the authors describe as a major advance over prior automatic completeness-proof methods.
significance: Automatically proving that a generalized plan works for every instance in a domain, rather than merely passing tests, turns LLM plan synthesis into a formally verified result with guarantees checked by a trusted kernel. The semantics-preserving PDDL-to-Lean conversion also connects standard planning benchmarks to proof assistants, suggesting a practical route toward certified program and plan synthesis in general.

aiRole.description: The authors use GPT-5.6-Sol to generate generalized plans in Lean together with formal proofs of completeness relative to given domain constraints, obtaining valid plans and proofs for 12 of 13 benchmark domains. Lean's kernel determines the correctness of the completeness proofs.

humanContribution: Humans built the semantic-preserving PDDL-to-Lean conversion and overall approach, provided the domain constraint specifications and benchmark domains, and relied on Lean's kernel to check the generated proofs.

zh.title: 基于LLM的可证明完备广义规划
zh.summary: 这项工作针对这样一个问题：由大语言模型（LLM）生成的广义规划（generalized planning）通常写成Python程序，此前只能在测试实例上评估，而无法证明其对规划领域（planning domain）的所有实例都成立。作者提出了一套流程，将PDDL领域规范以保持语义的方式转换为Lean，并使用GPT-5.6-Sol同时生成广义规划及其形式化证明，证明该规划可解决所有满足给定领域约束的实例。完备性证明由Lean的内核检验。在13个标准基准领域中，该方法为其中12个领域生成了带有有效完备性证明的广义规划，作者称其相对于此前的自动完备性证明方法是重大进展。
zh.significance: 自动证明广义规划对领域内所有实例都有效，而不是仅仅通过测试，使LLM的规划综合成为由可信内核检验的形式化结果，从而提供严格保证。保持语义的PDDL到Lean转换还将标准规划基准与证明助理连接起来，为一般意义上的认证程序综合与规划综合提供了可行路径。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 生成 Lean 中的广义规划及其相对于给定域约束的完备性形式证明，在 13 个基准域中的 12 个上得到有效规划与证明。完备性证明的正确性由 Lean 的 kernel 判定。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建了语义保持的 PDDL-to-Lean 转换和整体方法，提供了域约束规范与基准域，并依靠 Lean 的 kernel 检查生成的证明。

title: Math Reasoning in LLMs is Organized by Approach, Not Topic
summary: The paper tests whether open math-capable LLMs organize internal mathematical computation by benchmark topic or by reusable reasoning approach, using a generation-replay protocol that extracts activation-importance signatures over reasoning tokens from a model's own generated solution. Unsupervised clustering of these signatures across eight models and five mathematical reasoning sources beats matched-size random baselines in all 40 model-source cells. Two independent frontier-LLM judges attribute approach-level coherence to 77-82% of real clusters versus 6-11% of within-source controls, and approach-controlled prompting shifts cluster assignment in seven of eight model conditions while paraphrases largely preserve it. The evidence supports reasoning approach, not topic, as the key organizing axis.
significance: If models compute by reasoning approach rather than topic, then topic-stratified benchmarks and topic-balanced training corpora can remain systematically imbalanced along the axis that actually shapes model behavior. The findings suggest that evaluation and corpus design should balance and analyze reasoning approaches directly, and that activation-based unsupervised structure can serve as a diagnostic tool for how models organize mathematical work.

zh.title: 大语言模型中的数学推理按推理方法而非主题组织
zh.summary: 本文检验开放的数学能力大语言模型（LLM）是按基准测试主题还是按可复用的推理方法（reasoning approach）组织内部数学计算，采用生成-回放协议（generation-replay protocol），从模型自行生成的解答中提取推理词元上的激活重要性特征。对来自 8 个模型和 5 个数学推理（mathematical reasoning）数据来源的这些特征进行无监督聚类，结果在全部 40 个模型-来源组合中优于同规模随机基线。两个独立的前沿大语言模型裁判将方法层面的一致性归于 77-82% 的真实聚类，而来源内对照仅为 6-11%；在控制推理方法的提示设置中，8 个模型条件里有 7 个在改变所要求的推理方法时聚类归属发生转移，而改写措辞基本保持归属不变。证据支持推理方法而非主题是关键的组织轴。
zh.significance: 若模型按推理方法而非主题进行计算，那么按主题分层的基准测试（benchmark）和按主题平衡的训练语料，可能在真正影响模型行为的轴上仍存在系统性失衡。研究结果表明，评测与语料设计应直接对推理方法加以平衡和分析，同时基于激活的无监督结构可作为诊断工具，揭示模型如何组织数学工作。

title: EquivSVA: A Formally Verified Dataset of Behavioral Assertions Across Equivalent RTL Implementations
summary: EquivSVA is a formally verified dataset for testing whether generated SystemVerilog Assertions capture externally observable behavior rather than incidental details of a single RTL implementation. It organizes 120 behavior families across 12 categories, each with four structurally distinct but behaviorally equivalent RTL implementations, shared interface-level gold properties, three controlled mutants, and formal-validation evidence: 480 reference implementations, 914 gold properties, and 360 mutants in total. Every family passes a fixed 17-job suite covering RTL equivalence, gold-property proofs, property reachability, mutant distinguishability, and gold-property checks on mutants, and fixed family-safe train, development, and test splits are provided. In a demonstration on the held-out test split, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct produced 293 interface-only properties, of which 93 are formally sound, with sound-property counts varying across equivalent implementations for 14 of 24 test families. The dataset, generators, validation scripts, and case-study artifacts are publicly released.
significance: Existing assertion-generation benchmarks do not directly test whether a generated assertion is implementation-robust. title: An Exposition of GPT Astra's Proof of Lower Bound on DP Continual Counting
summary: This note presents a detailed proof, to the best of the authors' understanding, of the recent Harrison and Leeman presentations (arXiv:2609.17650v01 and arXiv:2609.17650v02) of GPT Astra's lower bound for differentially private continual counting. The authors believe a more natural and simpler proof is possible and hope this exposition helps that effort. The note also places the argument in context: Bairaktari and Larsen (arXiv:2607.00876) previously gave an elegant lower bound of Ω(log^{3/2}(n)) for both pure and approximate differential privacy, and later published an optimal Ω(log^{2}(n)) bound for pure differential privacy in joint work with Dahl (arXiv:2607.00876v3), which extends their technique for approximate differential privacy. The two proofs are technically different, but the Astra argument uses related tree geometry introduced by Bairaktari and Larsen.
significance: The note makes an AI-generated lower-bound argument for differential privacy accessible for independent scrutiny and reconstruction, and it links that argument to the tree-geometric techniques behind the known Ω(log^{2}(n)) optimal bound for pure differentially private continual counting. Such detailed expositions can help researchers verify machine-produced proofs and search for simpler, more conceptual proofs.

aiRole.description: The note gives a detailed exposition of a proof by the AI system GPT Astra of a lower bound for differentially private continual counting, as presented by Harrison and Leeman (arXiv:2609.17650v01 and v02). The authors state the proof is Astra's and relate it to tree geometry from Bairaktari and Larsen's human work.

humanContribution: Harrison and Leeman presented Astra's proof in preprints arXiv:2609.17650v01 and v02, and the authors of this note reconstructed and explained the argument in detail to the best of their understanding.

title: SLED-IFV: Solver-Validated LLM-Guided Decomposition for Scalable Hardware Information-Flow Verification
summary: The paper identifies two proof barriers in self-composed hardware information-flow verification, implementation complexity and relational inductive complexity, and introduces two semantic proof decomposition forms to address them: functional simplification, which replaces proof-hard RTL regions with validated over-approximate summaries, and relational strengthening, which exposes and proves the cross-copy public-control relations needed for induction. SLED-IFV is an LLM-guided flow in which, given a self-composed miter and an oracle-free decision sheet, the LLM proposes and materializes a decomposition into proof artifacts checked by a controller, which compiles the artifacts into proof obligations accepted only by the formal verification backend. Across nine nontrivial benchmarks built from real RTL, the method achieves up to 603x solver-only speedup, converts two 12-hour timeouts into completed proofs, and yields verifier-accepted decompositions in all cases.
significance: Formal hardware information-flow verification offers strong guarantees against secret-dependent timing and control behavior but often fails to scale to realistic RTL. By automating the selection and construction of proof decompositions while leaving acceptance entirely to the formal verification backend, SLED-IFV shows how LLM-guided proof structuring can turn previously intractable verification tasks into completed proofs without weakening the trust placed in the solver.

aiRole.description: SLED-IFV, an LLM-guided decomposition flow for hardware information-flow verification, produced verifier-accepted semantic proof decompositions for all nine benchmarks built from real RTL, yielding up to 603x speedup over solver-only solving and completing two proofs that previously timed out after 12 hours.

zh.title: SLED-IFV：面向可扩展硬件信息流验证的求解器验证式 LLM 引导分解
zh.summary: 本文识别出硬件信息流验证（information-flow verification, IFV）在自组合（self-composed）方法中的两类证明障碍：实现复杂性，即证明困难的数据通路逻辑占据主导，而所需性质仅依赖一个紧凑的边界关系；以及关系归纳复杂性，即证明依赖跨副本的公共控制事实，而后端证明器无法高效推断这些事实。为此，作者提出两种语义证明分解形式：函数化简（functional simplification），用经验证的过近似摘要替换证明困难的 RTL 区域；关系强化（relational strengthening），显式给出并证明归纳所需的跨副本关系。SLED-IFV 是一种求解器验证的 LLM 引导流程：给定自组合 miter 和无预言机决策表，LLM 提出分解方案并将其物化为受控制器检查的证明构件，控制器将这些构件编译为证明义务，而形式化验证后端是验收的唯一权威。在九个源自真实 RTL 的非平凡基准上，该方法实现最高 603 倍的纯求解器加速，将两个 12 小时超时转化为完成的证明，并在所有案例中产出被验证器接受的分解方案。
zh.significance: 硬件信息流验证（information-flow verification, IFV）能够对依赖秘密的时序与控制行为提供强保证，但往往难以扩展到真实规模的 RTL。SLED-IFV 自动完成证明分解的选择与构造，同时将验收权完全交给形式化验证后端，表明 LLM 引导的证明结构化可以在不削弱求解器信任前提下，把此前难以处理的验证任务转化为完成的证明。

title: Direct Optimization of Generators for Search in Automated Theorem Proving
summary: This work extends Compute-Aligned Training (CAT) to tree search in Automated Theorem Proving, where LLM policies must explore and recover via off-trace states that supervised demonstrations do not capture. The authors derive tractable, trace-supported search-aware losses through an abstraction of policy-guided search, and add a search-agnostic uniform-allocation (UA) loss that accounts for budget without committing to a specific search strategy. Both methods induce scalar weights on per-tactic cross entropy gradients. The analysis characterizes how off-trace behavior shapes the search-aware weights, including conditions for vanishing approximation error at large budgets. On a Lean benchmark, both approaches outperform cross entropy in observed proof-success rate across six search strategies, with a single shared UA adapter giving strong results, and budget sweeps showing larger gains at 16 than at 256 expansions, suggesting CAT benefits scale with test-time compute.
significance: Training objectives for ATP models have typically been misaligned with how those models are actually used, inside tree search rather than in one-shot generation. These search-aware and budget-aware losses offer a practical way to close that gap: they require only trace-supported signals, generalize across search strategies, and can be shared in one adapter. The finding that gains grow at smaller expansion budgets suggests such alignment is especially valuable when test-time compute is limited, and the large-budget error analysis gives theoretical grounding for the approximation.

zh.summary: 本研究将计算对齐训练（Compute-Aligned Training, CAT）扩展到自动定理证明（Automated Theorem Proving, ATP）中的树搜索（tree search）场景，其中作为策略的语言模型（LLM）必须通过监督演示中不存在的离轨状态进行探索与恢复。作者通过对策略引导搜索的抽象，推导出可处理的、有轨迹支撑的搜索感知损失，并提出不依赖具体搜索方式、仅考虑预算的搜索无关均匀分配损失（uniform-allocation loss, UA）。两种方法都在逐战术的交叉熵（cross entropy）梯度上施加标量权重。分析刻画了离轨行为如何影响搜索感知权重，包括大预算下逼近误差消失的条件。在 Lean 基准上，两种方法在六种搜索策略中的观测证明成功率均高于交叉熵，单个共享的 UA 适配器取得强劲结果；预算扫描显示在 16 次扩展时的增益大于 256 次扩展时，表明 CAT 随测试时计算量增加而扩展。
zh.significance: 自动定理证明（Automated Theorem Proving, ATP）模型的训练目标通常与其实际使用方式不一致——模型是嵌入树搜索（tree search）中使用，而非一次性生成。这些搜索感知与预算感知的损失函数为弥合这一差距提供了实用途径：它们只需要有轨迹支撑的信号，可跨搜索策略泛化，并能整合进单个适配器。在扩展预算较小时增益更大的发现表明，这种对齐在测试时计算量受限时尤其有价值，而大预算下的误差分析则为该近似提供了理论依据。

title: Formal verification of tilt estimation using the Rocq prover
summary: This work develops a Rocq prover library for stability analysis to formally verify tilt estimation for humanoid robots. The authors formalize a theory of ordinary differential equations, including a local Cauchy-Lipschitz (Picard-Lindelof) existence and uniqueness theorem built on quotient support in the Mathematical Components library, and extend it to global existence and continuous dependence on initial conditions. They then build a theory of Lyapunov stability compatible with an existing formalization of LaSalle's invariance principle, extend a library for robot manipulator statics to dynamical systems, and apply these components to verify a state-of-the-art tilt estimation method for a humanoid robot.
significance: Accurate tilt estimation is safety-critical for humanoid robots, and formally verified methods can give machine-checked guarantees for the differential equations and stability arguments underpinning them. The reusable formalization of ordinary differential equations, Lyapunov stability, and manipulator dynamics also expands the Rocq ecosystem toward robotics and control applications.

zh.title: 使用 Rocq prover 对倾斜估计进行形式化验证
zh.summary: 本工作在 Rocq prover 中开发了一个用于稳定性分析的库，以形式化验证仿人机器人的倾斜估计。研究者形式化了常微分方程（ordinary differential equations）理论，其中包括利用 Mathematical Components library 的商（quotient）支持建立的局部柯西-利普希茨定理（Cauchy-Lipschitz theorem），即皮卡-林德勒夫定理（Picard-Lindelof theorem）的存在性与唯一性，并将其扩展到整体存在性及对初始条件的连续依赖性。随后，作者建立了与既有 LaSalle 不变性原理（LaSalle's invariance principle）形式化相容的李雅普诺夫稳定性（Lyapunov stability）理论，将已有的机器人操作臂静力学库扩展到动力系统，并将这些组件应用于验证一种面向仿人机器人的前沿倾斜估计方法。
zh.significance: 准确的倾斜估计对仿人机器人的安全运行至关重要，形式化验证方法能够为支撑该估计的微分方程与稳定性论证提供机器检查的保证。常微分方程、李雅普诺夫稳定性及操作臂动力学的可复用形式化工作，也推动 Rocq 生态向机器人与控制领域的应用拓展。

title: PermuFormer: Multi-Task Pretraining for Permutation Representation in Algebraic Combinatorics
summary: PermuFormer is an autoregressive transformer pretrained on a 2.8 billion token multi-task, multi-encoding corpus of permutations for tasks in algebraic combinatorics. Fine-tuning it on unseen basic tasks and more complex research-level tasks frequently outperforms the same architecture trained from scratch, baseline MLPs, and a generic language model of comparable size. Analysis of its internal mechanisms shows that some tasks can be linearly decoded from the prompt's internal representation, while others require multiple rounds of generation before the answer can be decoded.
significance: The results show that specialized models trained directly on mathematical objects benefit substantially from diverse pretraining rather than from-scratch training, yielding reusable permutation representations for downstream combinatorics tasks. The mechanistic analysis also reveals differing internal decoding behavior across tasks, informing the design of future math-specialized models.

title: Human-LLM Deliberation as Interactive Proof: Conditions for Verifiability Without Transparency
summary: The paper models human-LLM deliberation as an interactive proof in which a computationally unbounded LLM acts as prover and a resource-bounded human acts as verifier, checking requested details without access to the LLM's internals and accumulating evidence toward an acceptance threshold. Given task-supplied bounds on false passes and human checking errors, the authors prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level. For a true claim, acceptance within the budget has probability at least the product of the per-round probabilities that the LLM responds adequately and the human checks correctly, provided the threshold is reachable in time. Each extra check guards against false claims but adds another chance for a true claim to fail, so suitable review length depends on verifier effort, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. Under equal resources, the paper gives conditions under which the bounds certify a review built from local checks but not a one-shot check. In LLM-only simulations on GPQA Diamond and Humanity's Last Exam, the accuracy of answers accepted without revision varied by task and model pair.
significance: The results provide formal acceptance guarantees for LLM arguments that humans cannot independently reproduce, requiring verifiability rather than access to model internals. The soundness and completeness bounds let practitioners choose review lengths that meet explicit error targets, and the conditions separating local-check reviews from one-shot checks offer concrete guidance for designing human review protocols around LLM-generated mathematical or analytical content.

zh.title: 作为交互式证明的人机协同审议：无透明性条件下的可验证性条件
zh.summary: 本文将人机协同审议建模为交互式证明（interactive proof）：计算能力无界的 LLM 充当证明者，资源受限的人类充当验证者，在不查看 LLM 内部机制的情况下检查其要求的细节，并逐步积累证据直至达到接受阈值。在给定任务层面的误通过上界与人类检查错误上界的条件下，作者证明了针对自适应证明者的任意时刻有效（anytime-valid）的可靠性（soundness）：最终接受虚假主张的概率至多为所选错误水平。对于真实主张，在阈值可于预算内达到的前提下，预算内获接受的概率至少为每一轮 LLM 充分应答概率与人类正确检查概率的乘积。每增加一次检查都能抵御虚假主张，却也给真实主张多一次失败机会，因此合适的审查长度取决于验证者的投入、认知负荷、专业程度与疲劳程度。在资源相同的条件下，本文给出一组条件，使该界能认证由局部检查构成的审查，却无法认证一次性检查。在 GPQA Diamond 与 Humanity's Last Exam 上的纯 LLM 模拟中，未经修改即被接受的答案的准确率随任务与模型组合而异。
zh.significance: 这些结果为人类无法独立复现的 LLM 论证提供了形式化的接受保证，要求的是可验证性而非对模型内部机制的访问。可靠性与完备性的界使实践者能够选择满足明确错误目标的审查长度，而区分局部检查审查与一次性检查的条件，则为围绕 LLM 生成的数学或分析性内容设计人类审查流程提供了具体指导。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文证明了人机审议协议的任意时刻有效可靠性与接纳概率界，并在 GPQA Diamond 和 Humanity's Last Exam 上进行了纯 LLM 模拟，发现未经修改即被接纳的答案其准确率因任务和模型组合而异。

title: Formal Verification of Proofs from Automated Theorem Provers for Higher-Order Logic
summary: This work identifies common challenges and requirements for verifying proofs from automated theorem provers in the Dedukti logical framework and develops a general methodology for deriving encodings of calculus rules and proof steps, including clausification. The methodology is applied to the EP calculus for higher-order logic and integrated into Leo-III, where the prototype automatically reconstructs about 80% of generated proof steps. Leo-III becomes the first higher-order automated theorem prover to support independently checkable proof reconstruction, and the implementation uncovered several bugs in Leo-III.
significance: Independently checkable proof reconstruction closes a trust gap between automated theorem provers and formal verification environments. The general encoding methodology supports reuse across proof systems and tools, while the reported bug findings demonstrate that formal reconstruction can also improve the reliability of the underlying prover.

zh.title: 高阶逻辑（higher-order logic）中自动定理证明器（automated theorem provers）证明的形式化验证

zh.significance: 可独立检查的证明重构弥合了自动定理证明器（automated theorem provers）与形式化验证环境之间的信任缺口。通用编码方法有助于在不同证明系统和工具之间实现复用，而所报告的缺陷发现也表明，形式化重构能够提升底层证明器的可靠性。

title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
summary: EviGraph is a framework for public-service recommendation that separates critical decision requirements from details that may remain unresolved. A language agent grounds these requirements in evidence from a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker verifies that each recommendation is supported. On a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references, this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. The authors also find that added verification can withdraw recommendations that were already supported without improving decision quality.
significance: Public-service guidance systems must justify answers against service, scope, and date constraints, yet over-strict evidence handling can block useful recommendations. EviGraph shows that explicitly identifying which requirements are decisive, rather than requiring more verification overall, can improve the reliability and usefulness of evidence-based navigation.

title: A Lean and Spec-Driven AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle for Applied AI Education: The AI-SDLC Approach
summary: The paper presents AI-SDLC, a lightweight, spec-driven software development lifecycle for governed agentic software engineering. It combines established software engineering practices with repository-local guidance delivered through specifications, AGENTS.md files, and phase-specific agent skill files, giving AI coding agents bounded autonomy across planning, implementation, testing, and repository-level task execution. The approach was developed in the FHNW course AI-assisted Software Development and applied by students to business-oriented software use cases; its educational and practical applicability was explored through a student survey combining closed rating items with open-ended questions. The result is a process-oriented framework operating within an explicit, reviewable, and test-oriented lifecycle.
significance: As AI coding agents take on tasks well beyond code completion, their use often stays loosely connected to established software engineering practice. AI-SDLC offers a concrete, structured way to govern agentic development through explicit specifications and phase-specific guidance, making agent behavior more reviewable and test-oriented. Its deployment in a real university course with student projects provides evidence on how such a lifecycle can be taught and applied in applied AI education and business software settings.

title: Garlene: Guarded Recursion in Lean
summary: Garlene implements Nakano's guarded recursion as an embedded language in Lean, addressing the lack of support for guarded recursion in major interactive theorem provers and the resulting reliance on pen-and-paper proofs or unmaintained provers. The language combines a simply-typed lambda calculus for definitions with a higher-order logic for reasoning, offers an intuitive syntax for guarded recursive definitions plus a dedicated proof mode via Lean's metaprogramming support, and is given a presheaf model that establishes soundness and lets users export guarded recursive definitions and their theorems into standard Lean developments. Several case studies demonstrate programming and reasoning with the system.
significance: Extending recursion principles has a history of introducing consistency bugs, so a type-based, sound mechanism such as guarded recursion matters for safe extensions of type theory. Garlene brings guarded recursion into a maintained, mainstream interactive theorem prover with machine-checked soundness and interoperability with ordinary Lean code, making it practical for applications such as programming with infinite structures like streams and for reasoning about advanced programming language features via synthetic guarded domain theory.

zh.title: Garlene：Lean 中的守卫递归（guarded recursion）
zh.summary: Garlene 将 Nakano 的守卫递归（guarded recursion）作为嵌入式语言实现在 Lean 中，填补了主流交互式定理证明器不直接支持守卫递归的空白，使用户不必依赖未机械化的纸笔证明或无人维护的定理证明器。该语言以简单类型 lambda 演算（simply-typed lambda calculus）书写定义，以高阶逻辑（higher-order logic）进行推理，借助 Lean 的元编程（metaprogramming）支持提供直观的守卫递归定义语法和专用证明模式；研究者为其给出了预层模型（presheaf model），以此证明该语言的可靠性（soundness），并允许用户将守卫递归定义及其定理导出到标准 Lean 开发中。论文通过若干案例展示了利用该语言进行编程与推理。
zh.significance: 扩展递归原则历史上屡次引发一致性漏洞，因此守卫递归这类基于类型、可靠的机制对安全扩展类型理论具有重要意义。Garlene 将守卫递归带入一个持续维护的主流交互式定理证明器，并提供机器检查的可靠性证明及与普通 Lean 代码的互操作性，从而使其可用于对流（streams）等无限结构进行编程，以及通过合成守卫域论（synthetic guarded domain theory）推理高级编程语言特性等实际场景。

title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
summary: This work studies error diagnosis in propositional-logic proof tutoring, introducing a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, the authors compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier, with each diagnosis passed through shared rationale and feedback agents so the effect of the initial diagnosis is isolated. The zero-shot detector reaches a macro-F1 of 0.191, while fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but still produces systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally faithfully carry the diagnosis they receive, and feedback can remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while still addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness; expert ratings and automatic feedback evaluations were reported as largely uneven. The results show that apparent feedback quality can hide upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness.
significance: LLM tutoring systems are often judged on surface feedback quality, but this work shows such quality metrics can mask misdiagnosis that is faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Separating diagnosis from generation, and grounding diagnosis in a symbolic verifier over formal inference rules, offers a concrete design pattern for trustworthy tutoring in logic and potentially other proof-based domains. The reported gap between expert and automatic evaluations also cautions against relying on automated feedback metrics alone.

aiRole.description: The study reports benchmark results for LLM-based error diagnosis in propositional-logic proof tutoring, with a verifier-grounded architecture achieving the highest diagnostic correctness and showing that faithful feedback can propagate incorrect diagnoses.

humanContribution: Humans built the symbolic verifier and verifier-grounded architecture, assembled the 600 balanced student actions, and rated feedback quality as experts.

zh.title: 诊断正确，反馈更好：用于逻辑证明中忠实性 LLM 辅导反馈的符号验证器
zh.summary: 本研究面向命题逻辑（propositional logic）证明辅导中的错误诊断问题，提出一种将诊断与语言生成分离的、以验证器为基础的架构。研究者使用 600 个平衡的学生动作，比较零样本 LLM 检测器、微调检测器和符号验证器（symbolic verifier）三种方案，其中每个诊断都经由共享的说理与反馈智能体处理，从而隔离初始诊断的影响。零样本检测器的 macro-F1 为 0.191；微调将其提升至 0.709，但在结构相关的类别之间仍存在系统性错误。说理部分总体上忠实保留了输入的诊断，反馈也可以在忠实于其说理、不泄露答案且符合教学规范的同时，针对错误的问题作出回应。基于验证器的反馈取得最高的诊断正确性；专家评分与自动反馈评估被报告为存在较大不一致。研究结果表明，表面上的反馈质量可能掩盖上游的诊断错误，忠实性（faithfulness）必须与正确性（correctness）分开评估。
zh.significance: LLM 辅导系统常依据表面反馈质量来评价，但本研究表明，这类质量指标可能掩盖被忠实传递到后续环节的错误诊断。将诊断与生成分离，并以基于形式推理规则（inference rules）的符号验证器为基础进行诊断，为逻辑及其他基于证明的领域中可信辅导系统提供了具体的设计思路。专家评分与自动评估之间的差距也提示，不能单独依赖自动反馈指标作出判断。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 该研究报告了命题逻辑证明辅导中基于 LLM 的错误诊断基准结果，其中验证器支撑的架构取得了最高的诊断正确率，并表明忠实的反馈也可能传播错误的诊断。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建了符号验证器及验证器支撑的架构，整理了 600 个平衡的学生动作样本，并以专家身份对反馈质量进行了评分。

title: LogicTrack: Auditing Reasoning Trajectories of Large Language Models with Formal Logic Solvers
summary: LogicTrack is a neuro-symbolic framework that audits large language model reasoning trajectories by auto-formalizing each Chain-of-Thought (CoT) step into symbolic representations and verifying it with automated theorem provers. It introduces Solver-Based Backtracking Reward (SBR), a step-wise scoring mechanism that quantifies logical soundness and guides backtracking tree search at inference time. The framework is further extended to build supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data from its own backtracking traces, so that fine-tuned models internalize step-wise auditing as an intrinsic capability. Experiments across 8 reasoning benchmarks and 7 LLMs report improvements in both the verifiability of reasoning chains and final answer pass rate.
significance: Most optimization methods rely on outcome-based feedback, so a correct final answer can be reached through logically flawed intermediate steps. LogicTrack shifts verification to the step level using formal logic (formal logic) solvers, strengthening the soundness and trustworthiness of Chain-of-Thought reasoning in high-stakes domains.

zh.title: LogicTrack：用形式逻辑求解器审计大语言模型的推理轨迹
zh.summary: LogicTrack是一个神经符号（neuro-symbolic）框架，通过将每一步思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理自动形式化为符号表示，并用自动定理证明器（automated theorem provers）加以验证，从而审计大语言模型的推理轨迹。该框架提出基于求解器的回溯奖励（Solver-Based Backtracking Reward, SBR），这是一种逐步评分机制，用于量化逻辑可靠性并在推理时引导回溯树搜索（backtracking tree search）。研究者进一步利用框架自身轨迹中的回溯记录构建监督微调（supervised fine-tuning, SFT）数据，使微调后的模型将逐步审计内化为固有能力。在8个推理基准和7个大语言模型上的实验表明，推理链的可验证性与最终答案通过率均得到提升。
zh.significance: 多数优化方法依赖基于结果的反馈，因此即便中间推理步骤在逻辑上有缺陷，模型仍可能得出正确的最终答案。LogicTrack借助形式逻辑求解器将验证推进到单步层面，增强了思维链推理的可靠性与在高风险领域中的可信度。

title: SWE-Proof: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World Issues with Machine-Checked Proofs?
summary: The paper introduces Benchproofer, a pipeline that converts coding tasks with known correct patches into formally verified ones by synthesizing specifications, axiomatizing called functions, and admitting only instances that pass mechanical and adversarial gates. Applied to SWE-bench Verified it yields SWE-Proof, 500 real issues with formally verified correctness, and it extends to SWE-bench Pro. Evaluation with Claude Opus 4.8 shows formal verification catches what tests miss: about a quarter of test-passing patches admit counterexamples, and a correct formal specification raises resolution from 85% to 95%, whereas a structured natural-language specification does not fix the problem. An agent writing its own specification gains nothing over an unaided baseline, and only 56% of such specifications pass the audit; the dominant failure is unfaithfulness, and specification quality strongly tracks outcomes (92% failure on unresolved instances versus 51% on resolved ones), making faithful specification synthesis a concrete open problem.
significance: It shows that test-suite correctness in agentic code generation benchmarks is incomplete and memorization-prone, while machine-checked proofs give a stronger guarantee on real repository-level issues. The results isolate specification writing, not proof search, as the bottleneck, establishing faithful specification synthesis as a concrete open problem for AI coding agents.

zh.title: SWE-Proof：语言模型能否用机器检查的证明解决真实世界的问题？
zh.summary: 论文提出 Benchproofer，一条把带有已知正确补丁的编程任务转换为形式化验证（formal verification）任务的流水线：它为新代码撰写规范，用公理概括该代码调用的现有函数，并且仅在机械门与对抗门均通过后才收录实例。将该流水线应用于 SWE-bench Verified 得到 SWE-Proof，包含 500 个正确性经形式化验证而非测试检验的真实问题，并可扩展至 SWE-bench Pro。对 Claude Opus 4.8 的评测显示，形式化验证能捕捉测试遗漏之处：约四分之一通过测试的补丁存在反例（counterexample），结构化的自然语言规范无法修复这一问题，而正确的形式化规范把解决率从 85% 提升到 95%。让智能体自行撰写规范并未优于无辅助基线，且这类规范只有 56% 通过审核；最常见的失败是规范不忠实，即只约束所需行为的一部分而放任其余部分自由，规范质量与结果高度相关（未解决实例中 92% 规范有问题，已解决实例中为 51%），使忠实的规范合成成为具体开放问题。
zh.significance: 这项工作表明，在智能体代码生成基准中，依赖测试套件的正确性判定并不完备且易受记忆效应影响，而机器检查的证明（machine-checked proof）能对真实仓库级问题给出更强的保证。结果把瓶颈定位在规范撰写而非证明搜索，从而为 AI 编程智能体确立了忠实规范合成这一具体开放问题。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者提出 Benchproofer 流水线，构建 SWE-Proof，即 500 个正确性经形式化验证的真实 SWE-bench Verified 问题，并在其上评估 Claude Opus 4.8。他们报告验证能发现四分之一通过测试的补丁存在反例，而正确形式化规范将解决率从 85% 提升至 95%；由智能体自行撰写的规范相比无辅助基线没有提升，且仅 56% 通过其审计。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建了 Benchproofer 流水线，通过机械与对抗性关卡筛选并整理出 500 个形式化验证实例，撰写并审计规范，并设计了对 Claude Opus 4.8 的评估。

title: NeuSOGA3D: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable 3D Geometric Reconstruction
summary: NeuSOGA3D is a neuro-symbolic framework for reconstructing 3D geometry from unorganized point clouds. It projects point clouds onto principal orthographic planes, builds symbolic implicit spline representations from the resulting observations, and fuses them via shape-preserving constructive solid geometry operations to form a coarse visual hull, recovering additional detail through cross-sectional decomposition and volumetric reconstruction using Partial Shape-Preserving Splines. Unlike neural implicit methods that hide geometry in latent representations, the framework yields explicit symbolic entities such as control polygons, implicit spline fields, cross-sections, and volumetric lofts. Experiments on all forty categories of ModelNet40 show that the approach recovers structurally meaningful, CAD-compatible representations from diverse point-cloud observations.
significance: By turning observations into explicit symbolic geometry, NeuSOGA3D addresses the interpretability and reuse limits of neural implicit reconstruction, producing representations that are explainable and usable in engineering and CAD workflows. The results provide evidence that combining learned perceptual priors with symbolic geometric reasoning can advance explainable geometric intelligence.

zh.title: NeuSOGA3D：一种面向可解释三维几何重建的神经符号框架
zh.summary: NeuSOGA3D 是一种面向无组织点云的神经符号框架。该方法把点云投影到主正交平面上，从所得观测中构造符号式隐式样条表示，并通过保形的构造实体几何（constructive solid geometry）操作将它们融合，生成粗略的视觉外壳（visual hull）；随后借助截面分解与使用 Partial Shape-Preserving Splines 的体积重建来恢复更多几何细节。与把几何编码在隐表示中的神经隐式方法不同，该框架把观测逐步转化为显式的符号实体，包括控制多边形（control polygon）、隐式样条场（implicit spline field）、截面（cross-section）和体积放样（volumetric loft）。在 ModelNet40 的全部四十个类别上的实验表明，该方法能从多样化的点云观测中恢复出结构上有意义且与 CAD 兼容的几何表示。
zh.significance: NeuSOGA3D 通过把观测转化为显式符号几何，缓解了神经隐式重建在可解释性与复用性上的局限，产出可用于工程与 CAD 流程的可解释表示。实验结果表明，将学习到的感知先验与符号几何推理相结合，有助于推进可解释的几何智能。

title: Long-horizon autoformalization of a core theorem underlying MIP* = RE
summary: FormalFlow coordinates AI proving agents under human supervision to handle statement drift and proof composition over long horizons, using a shared blueprint that guides nested planning, proving, and review loops. With FormalFlow, the authors completed a machine-checked Lean 4 proof of the quantum soundness of the classical low individual-degree test, a core theorem underlying MIP* = RE, in 63 days. The resulting library spans 126,367 lines of Lean code, all agent-generated, and the formalization corrects side conditions and intermediate error bounds in the published proof while improving the error exponent of the main theorem.
significance: The work delivers a machine-checked foundation for a core ingredient of quantum complexity theory, and its corrections and improved error exponent strengthen the published proof of MIP* = RE. The 63-day development record and reusable workflow tools demonstrate how AI agent teams can be supervised and verified on research-scale mathematics.

title: MAGS: Multi-agent Auto-formalization Guarantees Safety for Agentic Outputs
summary: MAGS is a multi-agent framework that produces executable programs carrying machine-checked formal safety guarantees. It freezes human-audited APIs and safety requirements, translates generated code into Dafny as a verification-aware intermediate representation, repairs violations using verifier feedback, and compiles verified programs back into executable code. Evaluated on 100 CUDA kernels, 100 terminal scripts, and 20 robotic-arm tasks, MAGS achieved a 100% success rate in producing programs with non-trivial safety guarantees against frozen specifications across all 220 examples. Independent safety and functional evaluations showed strong performance in all three domains, while exposing failures where the auto-formalized semantics did not fully capture the intended behavior.
significance: As LLM coding agents generate complex programs at a scale that outstrips human review, testing and LLM-based verification can miss edge cases; MAGS shows how formal verification can be automated end to end to give machine-checkable safety guarantees for agent-produced code. The reported results also isolate a key limitation: guarantees are only as strong as the formalized specification, so gaps between formalized semantics and target behavior remain a central obstacle for reliable auto-formalization.

title: Scaling Zero Knowledge UNSAT Verification via Normalized Chaining
summary: This paper addresses the prover memory bottleneck in ZkUnsat, a protocol for zero-knowledge certification of UNSAT that proves the validity of a weakened resolution proof without revealing the proof itself. The authors introduce a preprocessing technique inspired by efficient plaintext verification formats such as LRAT: the proof is normalized so that every derived clause is justified by a resolution chain of fixed public length k, eliminating chain-length leakage and reducing prover memory usage. With k = 16, the method certifies roughly 62% more instances than baseline ZkUnsat on the SAT 2002 competition benchmarks, and for an equivalent number of certified instances the memory footprint falls below 25% of the baseline requirement.
significance: UNSAT proofs often contain proprietary or security-sensitive information, so zero-knowledge certification lets a prover demonstrate validity without disclosure. The prover memory overhead of ZkUnsat has limited its use on real-world instances; lowering that overhead while introducing no additional leakage makes zero-knowledge UNSAT verification practical for substantially larger problems.

zh.title: 通过归一化链式推理扩展零知识不可满足性验证
zh.summary: 本文针对 ZkUnsat 的证明者内存瓶颈展开研究。ZkUnsat 是一种不可满足性（UNSAT）零知识（zero-knowledge）认证协议，通过证明一个弱化归结证明（resolution proof）的有效性，在不泄露证明本身的前提下完成验证。受 LRAT 等高效纯文本验证格式的启发，作者提出一种预处理技术：将证明归一化，使每个导出子句都由固定公开长度 k 的归结链来证明，从而消除链长泄露并降低证明者内存占用。在 k = 16 时，该方法在 SAT 2002 竞赛基准上认证的实例数比基线 ZkUnsat 大约多 62%；在认证实例数相同的情况下，内存占用降至基线需求的 25% 以下。
zh.significance: UNSAT 证明常包含专有或涉及安全的信息，零知识认证使证明者能够在不泄露证明内容的情况下展示其有效性。ZkUnsat 的证明者内存开销限制了其在真实世界实例上的应用；在不引入额外泄露的前提下降低这一开销，使零知识 UNSAT 验证能够扩展到规模大得多的问题。

title: Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction
summary: Sage (Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine) is an agentic framework for translating informal mathematics into Lean 4, replacing monolithic translation with a four-stage decomposed generation pipeline and a dual-signal semantic correction loop that pairs Lean 4 compiler diagnostics with multi-dimensional semantic feedback. The design targets the illusion of rigor where type-checker-accepted statements silently drop hypotheses or distort bounds, and it distinguishes open-ended queries from declarative formal targets to prevent answer guessing. Sage reduces answer leakage from 70.9% in monolithic baselines to 2.7%, reaching 73.3% pass@4 joint compilation and semantic fidelity on Omni-MATH without proofs versus 42.0% for the fine-tuned Goedel-Formalizer-V2 baseline. On IMO-Unformalized, a new set of 175 unformalized International Mathematical Olympiad problems, Sage attains 87.4% pass@4 verified fidelity against 19.4% for the baseline and wins over 79% of blind pairwise evaluations.
significance: Type-checking alone does not guarantee that a formal statement faithfully reflects the intended informal mathematics, so compiler acceptance can mask lost hypotheses, vacuous truths, or altered bounds. Sage shows that combining compiler diagnostics with explicit semantic feedback, while structurally separating question answering from formal target construction, can suppress unverified answer leakage and still yield high formalization fidelity. The strong zero-shot results on olympiad problems suggest the approach generalizes beyond the benchmarks it was tuned on.

zh.title: Sage：带有语义修正的形式化
zh.summary: Sage（Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine）是一个将非形式化数学表述翻译为 Lean 4 的智能体框架，它以四阶段分解式生成流程取代整体式翻译，并采用双信号语义修正回路，把 Lean 4 编译器诊断信息与多维度语义反馈相结合。该设计针对的是“严谨性错觉”（illusion of rigor），即类型检查器接受的语句暗中丢失假设或扭曲数学界；框架还显式区分开放性问题与陈述式形式化目标，以防止模型猜测未验证的答案。Sage 将答案泄漏率从整体式基线的 70.9% 降至 2.7%，并在不含证明的 Omni-MATH 上取得 73.3% 的 pass@4 编译与语义保真联合成绩，而微调版 Goedel-Formalizer-V2 基线为 42.0%。在 IMO-Unformalized 这一包含 175 道未形式化国际数学奥林匹克（International Mathematical Olympiad）题目的新测试集上，Sage 达到 87.4% 的 pass@4 已验证保真率，基线仅为 19.4%，并在超过 79% 的盲评成对比较中胜出。
zh.significance: 仅通过类型检查（type checking）并不能保证形式语句忠实反映预期的非形式化数学内容，编译通过可能掩盖丢失的假设、空洞真命题或被改动的数学界。Sage 表明，把编译器诊断与显式语义反馈相结合，并在结构上把问题求解与形式化目标构造分开，既能抑制未验证答案的泄漏，又能保持较高的形式化（formalization）保真度。在奥林匹克题目上的强零样本（zero-shot）结果表明，该方法能够泛化到调优所用基准之外的数据。
zh.aiRoleDescription: Sage 是一个智能体化形式化框架，可将非形式化的数学陈述转化为 Lean 4 并进行语义纠正，在 Omni-MATH without proofs 上取得 73.3% pass@4 的编译与语义保真联合通过率，在 IMO-Unformalized 上取得 87.4% pass@4 的经验证保真率。它将答案泄漏从单体基线的 70.9% 降至 2.7%。

title: The AR Fairness Metamodel: A Structured Framework for Fairness Measures
summary: The paper introduces the AR fairness metamodel, a structured framework for representing, analyzing, and comparing fairness scenarios built around agents, resources, and their attributes. It supports systematic definition and comparison of fairness measures, illustrated with discrete and continuous examples including equality, equity, group fairness, individual fairness, the Gini index, the Theil index, Jain's fairness index, and a detailed measure for Australia's Child Care Subsidy. Relationships among group fairness, individual fairness, and envy-freeness are established with formal proofs. The conceptual modeling approach builds on the Tiles framework, whose modular components can be composed to capture diverse fairness definitions, and an open-source implementation of Tiles supports fairness modeling and evaluation across applications.
significance: The framework gives fairness measures a common structured vocabulary, making it practical to define, compare, and evaluate them across different domains rather than treating each measure in isolation. Formal proofs connecting group fairness, individual fairness, and envy-freeness strengthen the reliability of such comparisons, while the open-source Tiles implementation makes the approach usable in practice for applications such as policy analysis.

zh.title: AR 公平性元模型：一个用于公平性度量的结构化框架
zh.summary: 本文提出 AR 公平性元模型（AR fairness metamodel），这是一个用于表示、分析和比较公平性场景的结构化框架，围绕智能体（agent）、资源（resource）及其属性构建。该框架支持对公平性度量（fairness measure）进行系统化的定义与比较，并以离散和连续度量为例加以说明，涵盖平等（equality）、公平（equity）、群体公平（group fairness）、个体公平（individual fairness）、Gini 指数（Gini index）、Theil 指数（Theil index）、Jain 公平指数（Jain's fairness index），以及针对澳大利亚儿童保育补贴（Australia's Child Care Subsidy）的详细度量。研究还以形式化证明（formal proof）确立了群体公平、个体公平与无嫉妒（envy-freeness）之间的关系。在概念建模（conceptual modeling）层面，该方法基于 Tiles 框架（Tiles framework），其模块化组件可组合连接以刻画多种公平性定义；Tiles 框架的开源实现可用于跨应用的公平性建模与评估。
zh.significance: 该框架为公平性度量提供了统一的结构化语言，使不同领域中的度量不再孤立处理，而是可以被实际地定义、比较和评估。群体公平、个体公平与无嫉妒之间关系的形式化证明增强了此类比较的可靠性，而 Tiles 的开源实现则使该方法可应用于儿童保育补贴等政策分析场景。

title: Voice of Reason: Reinforcement Learning for Spoken Math
summary: The work applies reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards to the GLM-4-Voice speech model to close the gap between text and speech on mathematical problem solving. After supervised fine-tuning on synthesized spoken question-answering data, RL improves GSM8K accuracy beyond levels speech models reached only with supplementary reasoning traces, and combining it with existing streaming reasoning techniques yields 74.8% free-form accuracy, a new state-of-the-art for speech-native models.
significance: Mathematical reasoning has been a weak point for speech language models relative to text models, limiting their use for spoken tutoring and problem solving. Showing that RL with verifiable rewards transfers effectively to a speech-native model, and reaches new spoken math accuracy without extra reasoning tokens, suggests a practical route to spoken assistants that reason reliably while preserving low latency and paralinguistic cues.

zh.title: 理性之声：面向口语数学的强化学习
zh.summary: 本研究将带可验证奖励的强化学习（reinforcement learning）应用于 GLM-4-Voice 语音模型，以缩小文本模型与语音模型在数学问题求解上的差距。研究者先在合成的口语问答数据上进行监督微调（supervised fine-tuning），随后证明即使不添加额外的推理标记，强化学习也能把 GSM8K 的准确率提升到语音模型此前只有借助补充推理轨迹才能达到的水平；再结合现有的流式推理技术，自由形式准确率达到 74.8%，创下语音原生模型口语数学能力的新最优结果。
