title: A Four-Stage Decomposition of Word-Problem Solving and Mechanistic Fragility in LLM Math Reasoning
summary: The paper offers a mechanistic account of how large language models solve grade-school math word problems and why a single irrelevant clause can destroy accuracy. It shows the internal computation unfolds as a four-stage sequential pipeline, Schema Abstraction, Operation Planning, Operand Binding, and Computation, with each stage producing a distinct intermediate representation in an identifiable band of layers. Applying the same scaffold to diagnose distractor-induced failure, the authors localize the corruption to a single stage, Operation Planning, and validate bidirectionally the causal role of the attention heads implementing it. The result is a mechanistic interpretation of both word-problem reasoning and distraction failure in LLMs.
significance: Explaining why LLMs are simultaneously accurate and brittle on elementary word problems is central to understanding and eventually fixing their mathematical reasoning. Layer-resolved, stage-specific localization of the failure to Operation Planning, backed by bidirectional causal evidence, goes beyond behavioral analysis and points to concrete intervention targets for making math reasoning models robust to irrelevant information.

zh.title: 大语言模型数学推理中应用题求解的四阶段分解与机制脆弱性
zh.summary: 本文为大语言模型（LLM）求解小学数学应用题为何既准确又脆弱提供了机制性解释：插入一个无关分句即可使解题崩溃。研究显示，模型的内部计算展开为一个四阶段顺序流水线，即模式抽象（Schema Abstraction）、运算规划（Operation Planning）、操作数绑定（Operand Binding）与计算（Computation），每个阶段在可辨识的层带内产生独特的中间表示。借助同一诊断框架分析干扰项诱发的失败，作者团队将损坏定位于单一阶段——运算规划，并对实现该阶段的一组注意力头（attention heads）进行了双向因果验证。由此，研究给出了关于大语言模型应用题推理及其受干扰时失败的机制性解释（mechanistic interpretability）。
zh.significance: 解释大语言模型在基础应用题上为何既高准确率又极度脆弱，是理解并最终修复其数学推理能力的关键。研究将失败精确定位到运算规划这一单一阶段，并以双向因果证据加以支持，其深度超越了行为层面的分析，为增强数学推理模型对无关信息的鲁棒性指出了具体的干预靶点。

title: Autoformalizing Argumentative Material Inferences
summary: This paper recasts autoformalization of natural-language arguments as guard completion: a non-monotonic material inference is converted into monotonic formal inference relative to an explicitly constructed guard set, capturing the implicit warrants, background commitments, and exception conditions the text leaves unstated. A completion is accepted only if its proof passes the theorem prover and survives contrastive tests of premise dependence and claim selectivity, preventing a system from proving the claim outright, dropping the original premise, or proving more than the claim. The authors implement this in GUARD, a neuro-symbolic framework where LLMs construct and formalize candidate guards, Isabelle/HOL verifies the resulting theories and returns step-level feedback for iterative refinement, and the system abstains when no faithful completion is found. On Debatepedia and ARCT across different LLMs, GUARD improves verified-faithful outcomes by +35.3 and +32.9 points and reduces leakage by 25.9 and 21.9 points over the state-of-the-art LLM-driven theorem proving approach; ablations attribute most of these gains to the symbolic soft critique and the explicit assumption layer, with the soft critique also raising initial context validity and cutting iterations needed for successful verification.
significance: Making natural-language reasoning machine-checkable requires inventing missing premises, and unchecked premise addition can make any claim provable while silently overstating or misattributing the conclusion. GUARD turns this construction step into a constrained, testable procedure combining LLM-based guard elicitation with Isabelle/HOL verification, abstention, and contrastive faithfulness checks. The reported gains in verified faithfulness and leakage reduction show that explicit assumption management and symbolic critique materially improve the reliability of automated formalization for argumentative reasoning.

aiRole.description: The neuro-symbolic framework GUARD, in which LLMs construct and formalize candidate guards and Isabelle/HOL verifies the theories, achieved significant gains in verified-faithful autoformalization on Debatepedia and ARCT while reducing leakage versus the state-of-the-art LLM-driven theorem proving approach.

humanContribution: Humans formulated the guard-completion approach, built and implemented GUARD, designed the contrastive verification tests, and evaluated the system on Debatepedia and ARCT.

zh.title: 论证性实质推理的自动形式化
zh.summary: 本文将自然语言论证的自动形式化（autoformalization）重构为守卫补全（guard completion）：把非单调（non-monotonic）的实质推理（material inference）转化为相对于显式构造的守卫集的单调（monotonic）形式推理，以补全文本中隐含的担保、背景承诺与例外条件。一个补全只有在证明通过定理证明器（theorem prover），并且经受前提依赖性（premise dependence）与论断选择性（claim selectivity）的对比检验（contrastive tests）后才被接受，从而防止系统直接断言论断、丢弃原始前提，或证明超出论断本身的内容。研究者实现了 GUARD 框架，这是一个神经符号系统，由 LLM 构造并形式化候选守卫，Isabelle/HOL 验证所得理论并返回步骤级反馈（step-level feedback）以迭代改进，在无法得到忠实补全时系统选择弃权。在 Debatepedia 与 ARCT 上使用不同 LLM 的实验中，GUARD 在经验证忠实（verified-faithful）指标上分别提升 +35.3 与 +32.9 个百分点，泄漏（leakage）分别降低 25.9 与 21.9 个百分点，优于当前最先进的 LLM 驱动定理证明方法；消融实验表明这些收益主要来自符号软批评（soft critique）与显式假设层（explicit assumption layer），其中软批评还提高了所引出上下文的初始有效性，并减少了成功验证所需迭代次数。
zh.significance: 要让自然语言推理可被机器检验，就必须构造缺失的前提，而不加约束的前提添加会让任何命题都可证，并可能悄然夸大结论或歪曲论断与前提的关系。GUARD 将这一构造过程转化为受约束、可检验的流程，把基于 LLM 的守卫引出与 Isabelle/HOL 验证、弃权机制和对比性忠实检验结合起来。经验证忠实度的提升与泄漏的显著下降表明，显式假设管理与符号批评能够实质提高论证性推理自动形式化的可靠性。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 神经符号框架 GUARD 中 LLM 构造并形式化候选 guards，Isabelle/HOL 验证理论，其在 Debatepedia 与 ARCT 上的忠实验证自动形式化显著提升，同时相比最先进的 LLM 驱动定理证明方法降低了泄漏。
zh.humanContribution: 人类提出了 guard completion 方法，构建并实现了 GUARD，设计了对比验证测试，并在 Debatepedia 与 ARCT 上对系统进行了评估。

title: NeuralCert: certified computational discovery of extremal mathematical constructions
summary: NeuralCert presents a discovery-to-certification workflow in which neural optimization learns high-dimensional variational trial functions as compact separable representations, then spectrally diagnoses and prunes them before certifying them exactly through multimodular evaluation, yielding fully explicit and independently verifiable proofs on a standard personal computer. Applied to three extremal problems, the framework delivers improved constructions, identifies empirical invariants that lead to proofs, and exposes optimization barriers whose geometry motivates new analytic or numerical representations. The results argue for AI-assisted mathematics in which computational discovery and exact certification operate as complementary parts of one rigorous workflow.
significance: The work addresses the core objection to stochastic neural methods in mathematics — that their outputs lack exactness — by pairing flexible search with machine-checkable certification. The framework's modest hardware requirements and its demonstration across three distinct roles (finding constructions, revealing provable invariants, and diagnosing optimization barriers) make rigorous AI-assisted mathematical discovery more practical and reproducible.

aiRole.description: NeuralCert learns high-dimensional variational trial functions and discovers improved extremal constructions, empirical invariants that lead to proofs, and optimization barriers that motivate new representations across three extremal problems, with results certified exactly via multimodular evaluation.

humanContribution: Humans built the discovery-to-certification framework, designed the separable representation, spectral pruning and exact multimodular certification procedures, and checked the resulting proofs as explicitly verifiable.

zh.title: NeuralCert：极值数学构造的认证计算发现
zh.summary: NeuralCert 提出一套从发现到认证（discovery-to-certification）的工作流程：用神经优化将高维变分试探函数（variational trial functions）学习为紧凑的可分表示（separable representation），再经谱诊断（spectral diagnosis）与剪枝，最后通过多模数算术求值（multimodular evaluation）给出严格认证，从而得到完全显式且可独立验证的证明，并可在标准个人计算机上运行。在三个极值问题（extremal problems）中，该流程实现了三种不同贡献：发现更优构造、揭示可导出证明的经验不变量、暴露优化障碍（optimization barriers），而这些障碍的几何结构启发了新的解析或数值表示。结果表明，AI 辅助数学可以将灵活的计算发现与严格认证结合为同一严谨工作流程中的互补环节。
zh.significance: 该工作直面神经方法用于数学时的核心质疑，即随机模型的输出缺乏精确性，通过将灵活搜索与机器可检验的认证相结合来解决这一问题。该框架对硬件要求不高，并在三种不同角色中得到验证：寻找构造、揭示可证明的不变量、诊断优化障碍（optimization barriers），这使严谨的 AI 辅助数学发现更加实用且可复现。
zh.aiRoleDescription: NeuralCert 学习高维变分试探函数，在三个极值问题上发现了改进的构造、导向证明的经验不变量，以及启发新表示的优化障碍，并通过多模数求值进行精确验证。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建了从发现到认证的框架，设计了可分表示、谱剪枝和多模数精确验证流程，并核查了所得证明的可独立验证性。

title: Teaching Vampire New Tricks: An Experimental Study of Neural Clause Selection
summary: The paper experimentally evaluates a neural clause-selection guidance approach for the Vampire theorem prover on several ITP-derived benchmark sets and examines its interaction with existing proving strategies. Neural guidance consistently improves performance within individual benchmark domains, but models applied across benchmarks underperform Vampire's plain default strategy. Training a single model on all datasets at once largely restores performance across the full suite, at higher training cost. Results on combined strategies are less clear, suggesting that neural guidance retains value but with diminishing returns.
significance: The study delineates where neural clause-selection guidance generalizes and where it does not, offering practical guidance on how such models should be trained and deployed alongside standard strategies in automated theorem proving.

aiRole.description: The authors experimentally evaluate neural clause-selection guidance in the Vampire theorem prover, finding it improves success rates within individual benchmark domains while cross-benchmark models underperform the default strategy. Training one model on all datasets at once lets Vampire nearly match performance…

humanContribution: Humans built and trained the neural guiding models, curated the ITP-derived benchmark sets, and designed and ran the experimental study.

zh.title: 让Vampire学会新技巧：神经网络子句选择的实验研究
zh.summary: 本文在多个由ITP衍生的基准集上，对定理证明器Vampire中一种神经网络子句选择（neural clause selection）引导方法进行了实验评估，并考察了该方法与既有证明策略的交互。神经引导在各个单一基准领域内都能稳定提升性能，但跨基准应用的引导模型表现不及Vampire的默认策略。一次性在全部数据集上训练单一模型，可以在更高的训练成本下，使性能在整体数据集上基本恢复。在组合策略下的结果则不那么明确，表明神经引导仍有价值，但收益在递减。
zh.significance: 该研究界定了神经网络子句选择引导在哪些场景下能够泛化、哪些场景下不能，为定理证明（theorem proving）中此类模型应如何训练、如何与标准策略配合部署提供了实用参考。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者实验评估了 Vampire 定理证明器中的神经子句选择引导，发现其在单一基准领域内提升成功率，而跨基准的引导模型表现不及默认策略。在所有数据集上同时训练单一模型可使 Vampire 在各数据集上的性能接近基准，组合策略下收益呈递减趋势。
zh.humanContribution: 研究人员构建并训练了神经引导模型，整理了 ITP 派生的基准数据集，并设计与执行了该实验研究。

title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
summary: Stellar Colosseum is a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across long-horizon research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. It explores alternative strategies before proof construction, applies a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents proof plans as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected argument. It generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and merges candidates and critiques into a single artifact via overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The workflow is integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern. With Gemini 3.1 Pro, Colosseum produced several new results addressing open problems from papers at venues such as FOCS and JMLR; on TCS-Bench it reached 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and in a Codeforces evaluation with Gemini 3.1 Pro the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solved 218 of 222 problems.
significance: Long-horizon research problems remain difficult for language models because progress chains together uncertain, interdependent decisions. Colosseum addresses this by structuring proof planning, decomposition, verification feedback, and parallel candidate falsification into a single pipeline that works across models. Its reported gains on TCS-Bench, Codeforces, and open problems from top-venue papers suggest that such orchestration can extend model reliability beyond short proofs toward research-level mathematical and theoretical computer science work.

zh.title: Stellar Colosseum：面向数学与理论计算机科学长周期研究的多智能体框架
zh.summary: Stellar Colosseum 是一个模型无关的框架，用于在数学与理论计算机科学（theoretical computer science）的长周期研究中分配推理资源。它在证明（proof）构造之前探索备选策略，用就绪门限判断某一路径是否成熟到可以分解，将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题，并把验证器的发现路由回论证的相应部分。该流程并行生成候选方案，以定向证伪（falsification）加以攻击，再通过重叠随机采样树聚合把候选方案及其批评合并为单一研究成果。该工作流已作为 Long Proof 模式集成到 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架中。配合 Gemini 3.1 Pro，Colosseum 取得了若干新结果，涉及 FOCS 和 JMLR 等顶级会议与期刊论文中提出的开放问题（open problems）；在 TCS-Bench 上，使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 Gemini 3.7 Flash 达到 71.0% 准确率；在 Codeforces 评测中，使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的带执行反馈的证明导向流程解决了 222 道题中的 218 道。
zh.significance: 对语言模型而言，长周期研究问题依然困难，因为进展依赖于一系列不确定且相互关联的决策。Colosseum 通过把证明规划、分解、验证反馈与并行候选证伪整合进单一且跨模型的流程来应对这一挑战。其在 TCS-Bench、Codeforces 以及顶级会议与期刊论文开放问题上的表现表明，这类编排方式有望把模型的可靠性从简短证明扩展到研究级的数学与理论计算机科学工作。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 借助 Stellar Colosseum 框架与 Gemini 3.1 Pro，作者报告了若干解决 FOCS、JMLR 等会议论文中开放问题的新结果，在 TCS-Bench 上以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash 取得 71.0% 准确率，并在 Codeforces 评测中解决 222 道题中的 218 道。该框架在构建证明前先探索备选策略，用就绪门判断路线是否成熟，并将计划分解为章节级子问题，再把验证器发现反馈到受影响的论证部分。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计并构建了 Stellar Colosseum 框架，包括就绪门、证明计划分解、证伪与验证器反馈阶段及树状聚合流程，并将其集成到 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架中作为 Long Proof 模式。他们还组织并运行了文中报告的定理证明与竞赛编程评测。

title: Gödel's and Scott's Variants of the Ontological Argument in Lean 4 and TPTP THF
summary: The work ports the Isabelle/HOL formalization of Gödel's ontological argument and Scott's variant to Lean 4, where all 548 statements parse identically, every named result is re-proved, and five results the original reports without replay are proved. It exports a benchmark in TPTP THF and SMT-LIB with 294 theorems and 45 statements that are refuted or open. Axiom analysis shows Scott's necessary existence and modal collapse need only a symmetric frame, so KB suffices. Automated provers prove 227 theorems within ten seconds and 232 within sixty, and none proves any of the 45; E and Leo-II solve the most.
significance: The work makes a philosophically contested argument machine-checkable across two proof assistants and independent automated provers, and pinpoints the exact modal axioms each result consumes. The released benchmark gives higher-order provers a standardized target, while the comparative evaluation includes a repaired and modernised Leo-II release 2.2 and measured prover portfolios and schedules.

zh.title: Gödel 和 Scott 的本体论证变体在 Lean 4 与 TPTP THF 中
zh.summary: 该工作将 Benzmüller 与 Scott 对 Gödel 的本体论证（ontological argument）及 Scott 变体的 Isabelle/HOL 形式化移植到 Lean 4，全部 548 条陈述解析后一致，每个命名结果均重新得证，原研究报告中未重放的五条结果也在此得证。项目在 TPTP THF 与 SMT-LIB 中导出基准，含 294 条定理与 45 条被反驳或悬而未决的陈述。公理分析表明 Scott 的必然存在（necessary existence）与模态坍缩（modal collapse）仅需对称框架（symmetric frame），故 KB 已足够。自动定理证明器在十秒内证明 227 条定理，六十秒内证明 232 条，且无一证明那 45 条陈述中的任何一条；E 与 Leo-II 解出的最多。
zh.significance: 该工作使哲学上争论不休的论证可在两个证明助理与独立的自动定理证明器中进行机器验证，并精确确定每条结果所使用的模态公理。发布的基准为高阶（higher-order）证明器提供了标准化目标，而比较评测包括修复并现代化的 Leo-II release 2.2，以及对各证明器组合与配置的实测结果。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 该研究将 Benzmüller 与 Scott 基于 Isabelle/HOL 的 Gödel 与 Scott 本体论证形式化移植到 Lean 4 及 TPTP THF/SMT-LIB，得到 294 条定理与 45 条被反驳或未决的陈述。自动定理证明器在该语料上取得基准成绩：五个 THF 证明器与 cvc5 在十秒内证明 227 条定理、六十秒内证明 232 条，其中 E 与 Leo-II 解出的最多。
zh.humanContribution: 人类在证明助手之间迁移这些理论并保留结构与名称，核对 548 条陈述解析结果一致，重放每一条具名结果并补证原文未重放的五条结果，并用 #print axioms 判定各证明所依赖的公理。人类还修复并现代化 Leo-II 发布 2.2 版本，配置证明器实验。

title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
summary: ProIQA is a process-aware framework for fine-grained quality assessment of automatically generated math items. It formulates item quality assessment (IQA) across three dimensions, knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies, from a unified process-aware perspective, and builds a process-enhanced dataset by augmenting item data with structured reasoning trees derived from raw solutions. The method uses Large Language Models to construct hierarchical reasoning trees, Graph Neural Networks (GNN) to encode their topological dependencies and procedural semantics, and fuses the resulting solving representation with stem semantics through a dual-view Stem + Solving architecture. Experiments on K12 mathematics datasets show that ProIQA captures process-oriented features and provides a scalable data-driven way to evaluate outputs of Automatic Item Generation (AIG).
significance: Current item quality assessment relies on manual review or shallow stem-based metrics that overlook the reasoning process behind mathematical problem-solving. By modeling that process explicitly and combining it with stem content, ProIQA offers a scalable, fine-grained evaluation signal across knowledge, difficulty, and competency dimensions, which could improve quality control for generated practice items in intelligent education and personalized learning systems.

aiRole.description: ProIQA reports experimental results on K12 mathematical datasets showing its process-aware framework effectively captures process-oriented features for fine-grained math item quality assessment, with Large Language Models constructing hierarchical reasoning trees encoded by Graph Neural Networks.

humanContribution: Humans formulated the unified process-aware IQA perspective, built and augmented the IQA resource with structured reasoning trees, designed the dual-view architecture, and conducted the experimental evaluation.

zh.title: ProIQA：基于过程的数学题目质量细粒度评估框架
zh.summary: ProIQA 是一个面向自动生题质量细粒度评估的基于过程的框架。该研究在统一的过程感知视角下，围绕三个维度刻画题目质量评估（Item Quality Assessment, IQA），即知识概念、难度和学科核心素养，并通过从原始解答中抽取结构化推理树来增强题目数据，构建了过程增强的 IQA 资源。在技术层面，ProIQA 利用 Large Language Models 构建层级推理树，采用图神经网络（Graph Neural Network, GNN）编码其拓扑依赖与程序性语义，并通过双视图（题目 + 求解）架构将求解表示与题干语义融合，从而实现面向学习目标的综合评估。在 K12 数学数据集上的大量实验表明，ProIQA 能有效捕捉面向过程的特征，为智能教育系统中自动题目生成（Automatic Item Generation, AIG）结果的评估提供了可扩展的数据驱动方案。
zh.significance: 现有题目质量评估方法依赖人工评审或浅层的题干指标，难以刻画数学问题求解背后的推理过程。通过显式建模这一过程并与题干内容相融合，ProIQA 在知识、难度和素养维度上提供了可扩展的细粒度评估信号，有望提升智能教育与个性化学习系统中生成练习题的质量控制能力。
zh.aiRoleDescription: ProIQA 报告了在 K12 数学数据集上的实验结果，表明其过程感知框架能有效捕捉过程导向特征，用于数学题目质量的细粒度评估；其中由 Large Language Models 构建层级推理树，并由 Graph Neural Networks 进行编码。
zh.humanContribution: 人类提出了统一的过程感知 IQA 视角，构建并扩充了带有结构化推理树的 IQA 资源，设计了双视图架构，并开展了实验评估。

title: Math for AI safety: an invitation for mathematicians
summary: This essay invites mathematicians to contribute to AI safety, arguing that new mathematics is needed to make AI systems legible, steerable, and cooperative with humanity. It organizes the research agenda by mathematical field: logic and game theory for cooperation, probability for agency and world-models, algebra and representation theory for learned features, and analysis and geometry for generalization and training dynamics. Each section ends with an open problem accessible to a working mathematician without prior experience in AI safety.
significance: The essay offers a field-by-field roadmap that lowers the entry barrier for mathematicians seeking to work on AI alignment and control. By pairing each area with an accessible open problem, it gives researchers concrete starting points for applying existing mathematical expertise to AI safety.

zh.title: 数学与AI安全：致数学家的邀请
zh.summary: 这篇文章向数学家发出参与AI安全研究的邀请，主张需要新的数学来设计对人类清晰可读、可控并与人类合作的AI系统。文章按数学领域组织研究议程：用逻辑（logic）与博弈论（game theory）研究合作，用概率论（probability）研究智能体与世界模型，用代数（algebra）与表示论（representation theory）研究学到的特征，用分析（analysis）与几何（geometry）研究泛化与训练动力学。每一节结尾都给出一个开放问题，供没有AI安全背景的在职数学家着手研究。
zh.significance: 这篇文章提供了按领域划分的路线图，降低了数学家进入AI对齐与控制研究的门槛。作者在每个领域都配上一个可入手的开放问题，为研究者将既有数学专长应用于AI安全提供了具体起点。

title: Semiotic Relations and Proof Methods: A Cross-Genre Study of Argument Structure with Large Language Models
summary: The paper proposes a semiotic framework for indirect proving, in which one moves from a statement S to a related statement S* from which S can be proved. Drawing on the four master tropes of semiotic research, it defines syntagmatic, paradigmatic, antithetic, and meronymic relations, corresponding to metonymy, metaphor, irony, and synecdoche, and argues these relations yield proof by inference, proof by analogy, proof by contradiction, and proof by case analysis. To test the framework, the authors turn the four relations into explicit operational definitions and apply them via a panel of large language models to a cross-genre corpus of mathematical, legal, and everyday argument. The relations are used very unevenly across genres: mathematical proofs draw on all four, while legal and everyday reasoning rely almost entirely on inference.
significance: The work offers a systematic typology linking semiotic relations to standard proof techniques, and supplies a reproducible, LLM-annotated cross-genre corpus to study how such relations actually appear in argument. The finding that mathematical reasoning exploits the full range of proof strategies while other genres are dominated by inference helps characterize what is distinctive about mathematical argumentation and may inform the design and evaluation of automated theorem proving and AI systems for mathematical reasoning.

zh.title: 符号关系与证明方法：基于大语言模型的跨体裁论证结构研究
zh.summary: 论文提出一个符号学框架来刻画间接证明：当陈述 S 直接证明困难时，可转向某个与 S 相关的陈述 S*，再由 S* 证明 S。研究借鉴符号学研究的四大主导转义，定义组合关系（syntagmatic）、范式关系（paradigmatic）、对立关系（antithetic）与整体-部分关系（meronymic），分别对应转喻（metonymy）、隐喻（metaphor）、反讽（irony）与提喻（synecdoche），并主张这四种符号关系分别导出推理证明、类比证明、反证法（proof by contradiction）与分情况证明。为检验该框架，作者将四种关系转化为明确的操作性定义，并借助大语言模型面板将其应用于包含数学、法律与日常论证的跨体裁语料库。结果显示这些关系在不同体裁中的使用极不均衡：数学证明动用全部四种关系，而法律与日常推理几乎完全依赖推理证明。
zh.significance: 该工作提出了将符号关系与经典证明方法系统对应的类型学，并提供了一套可复现的、由大语言模型标注的跨体裁语料库，用于考察这些关系在实际论证中的分布。数学论证运用全部证明策略而其他体裁以推理为主的发现，有助于刻画数学推理的独特性质，并可能为自动定理证明及面向数学推理的人工智能系统的设计与评估提供参考。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 该研究将四种符号关系转化为可操作的定义，并用一组大语言模型对数学、法律和日常论证的跨体裁语料进行分析，发现数学证明会用到全部四种关系，而法律与日常推理几乎完全依赖推断。
zh.humanContribution: 研究人员构建了将符号关系与证明方法对应的理论框架，制定了明确的可操作定义，并整理了跨体裁语料；大语言模型则被用于分析这些关系在不同论证类型中的分布。

title: Improving Mathematical Reasoning Capabilities in Large Language Models via Reasoning Process Error Classification
summary: This work studies mathematical reasoning errors in large language models by analyzing cases where LLMs produce incorrect answers on mathematical datasets. The authors manually examine reasoning errors, define and classify 21 error classes, and identify the most frequent ones. Building on this analysis, they design a prompt targeting eight error classes and show that it improves reasoning performance, while finding that the frequent error types appear across LLMs of comparable scale.
significance: The study provides a structured error taxonomy for diagnosing LLM reasoning failures and converts that diagnosis into a practical prompting method that improves mathematical reasoning. Its cross-model findings suggest that common error patterns can guide broadly applicable improvements.

title: Geometric Signatures of Conceptual Reorganization: A Counterfactual Embedding Framework for Detecting Scientific Revolutions
summary: This work proposes document embedding geometry as a quantitative observable of conceptual reorganization and introduces a counterfactual ablation framework that measures how individual concepts shape the organization of scientific knowledge. The observable is the geometric perturbation caused by removing documents tied to a candidate concept from the embedding space before and after its historical emergence. Statistical validation on five historical case studies in physics, mathematics, and machine learning — special relativity, Gödel's incompleteness theorems, the Higgs mechanism, deep learning, and the attention mechanism behind transformer architectures — finds measurable geometric signatures of conceptual reorganization, while also exposing limitations from document assignment and sparse historical data. The results position embedding geometry as a medium for quantifying how scientific fields restructure over time.
significance: Detecting scientific revolutions has largely relied on qualitative historical analysis; this framework offers a reproducible, geometrically grounded measurement of conceptual reorganization at field scale. By testing the method against five well-documented episodes across physics, mathematics, and machine learning, the authors show both the approach's promise and its boundary conditions, and they identify document assignment and data sparsity as key issues for future quantitative studies of scientific change.

zh.title: 概念重组的几何特征：用于检测科学革命的反事实嵌入框架
zh.summary: 本文提出以文档嵌入几何（embedding geometry）作为概念重组的定量观测量，并建立一个反事实消融（counterfactual ablation）框架，用于衡量单个概念如何影响科学知识的组织结构。该观测量定义为：在候选概念于历史上出现的前后，从嵌入空间中移除与该概念相关的文档所引起的几何扰动。研究在物理学、数学和机器学习领域的五个历史案例上进行统计验证，涉及狭义相对论（special relativity）、Gödel 的不完备性定理（Gödel's incompleteness theorems）、Higgs 机制（Higgs mechanism）、深度学习（deep learning）以及构成 transformer 架构基础的注意力机制（attention mechanism）。在这些历史案例中，该框架识别出与概念重组相关的可测量几何特征，同时验证研究也揭示出文档归属判定与历史数据稀疏所带来的关键局限。研究结果将嵌入几何确立为量化概念重组的一种媒介，为考察科学领域如何随时间重构提供了新途径。
zh.significance: 对科学革命（scientific revolutions）的判定长期依赖定性历史分析，而该框架为概念重组提供了可复现的、以几何为基础的领域尺度测量方法。作者在物理学、数学和机器学习中五个文献记载充分的历史事件上检验了该方法，既展示其潜力，也明确其适用边界，并指出文档归属判定与数据稀疏是未来科学变迁定量研究需要解决的核心问题。

title: The Case for Automated Hyperspecialization: Evidence from SAT
summary: The paper proposes hyperspecialization, building software optimized for a single class of inputs rather than one system handling many, and conjectures that coding agents make this cheap, effective, and safe for problems with measurable performance and checkable outputs. The specialists beat competition-winning general-purpose solvers by 5x on average and by over 10x on a quarter of benchmark families, and a general-purpose solver assembled from over a hundred prototypes won the SAT track at the 2026 SAT Competition.

If the approach generalizes, it could reshape how specialized mathematical software is built and delivered, and the competition result shows the specialists can also be composed into a single strong general-purpose solver.

title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Func-R1 is a framework for mathematical function reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that addresses a modality interference phenomenon, in which models performing textual computational reasoning tend to disregard or misinterpret essential visual cues. It builds on an explicitly decoupled architecture with a hierarchical post-training framework that progressively identifies critical visual evidence and then conducts in-depth theoretical reasoning, complemented by the Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) strategy, which steers policy updates toward internalizing fundamental theoretical properties while dynamically correcting heterogeneous visual information during reasoning. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show Func-R1 achieves the best performance among open-source MLLMs, surpassing GPT-5 by 8.4% on MathVerse's function-oriented tasks.
significance: Mathematical function problems in visual settings demand both precise perception and rigorous symbolic logic, and the reported modality interference shows that even advanced models fail to reliably connect the two. Func-R1's decoupled architecture, staged post-training, and PATO optimization offer a targeted way to align visual evidence with theoretical reasoning, and its reported gains over GPT-5 on function-oriented tasks indicate a meaningful advance for open-source MLLMs on math-specialized benchmarks.

aiRole.description: The authors propose Func-R1, a multimodal LLM trained with a hierarchical post-training framework and the PATO optimization strategy, which achieves optimal performance among open-source MLLMs and surpasses GPT-5 by 8.4% on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.

humanContribution: Humans designed the decoupled architecture, built and trained the Func-R1 model, devised the post-training and PATO strategies, curated benchmark evaluations, and analyzed the modality interference phenomenon.

title: AlgoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Theoretical Computer Science Education -- A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Algorithm Analysis and Complexity Theory
summary: AlgoRAG is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that pairs a large language model (LLM) with a curated theoretical computer science knowledge base built from textbooks, 847 lecture slides, 312 solved practice problems, 156 worked proof templates, and 89 complexity worksheets. It adds mathematical entity recognition, notation-aware retrieval, and pedagogical re-ranking. Evaluation on 179 exam-style questions covering asymptotic analysis, recurrence relations, dynamic programming, graph algorithms, NP-completeness, sorting, and divide-and-conquer reports a 100% success rate with a mean response time of 38.0 seconds. BLEU-4 is zero, attributed by the authors to the mismatch between n-gram matching and the varied notation of equivalent proofs, while ROUGE-1 F1 reaches 0.0963, ROUGE-L F1 0.0683, and pedagogical quality 0.7620. Performance is highest on NP-completeness and graph algorithms.
significance: The work offers a domain-adapted RAG design for teaching abstract topics that demand formal proofs and asymptotic reasoning, combining proof templates and notation-aware retrieval rather than relying on a general chatbot. Its reported metrics suggest structured, didactically sound explanations despite low lexical overlap, though the zero BLEU-4 score and modest ROUGE values show that evaluating mathematical explanations remains difficult, and the results rest on one curated benchmark of 179 questions.

aiRole.description: AlgoRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation system coupling an LLM with a domain-specific knowledge base, achieved a 100% success rate and a pedagogical quality score of 0.7620 on 179 curated exam-style questions in algorithm analysis and complexity theory.

humanContribution: Humans built the AlgoRAG system and its optimizations, curated the domain knowledge base and the 179 evaluation questions, and designed the evaluation framework and pedagogical quality metric.

title: Proving olympiad geometry theorems on a superconducting quantum processor
summary: Researchers report the experimental realization of automated geometry theorem proving on a fully programmable superconducting quantum processor. Two complementary quantum proving frameworks are developed: one implements Wu's algebraic elimination method via quantum pseudo-division, with multivariate polynomials encoded in superposition states, enabling quantum algebraic theorem proving; the other implements the full-angle method as backward symbolic reasoning within a hybrid quantum strategy-guided architecture, demonstrating a general route toward quantum symbolic proof search. The processor proves the perpendicularity of the diagonals of a square and a 1978 International Mathematical Olympiad geometry problem.
significance: The work establishes automated logical reasoning as a viable task for near-term quantum processors, showing that structured symbolic deduction can be executed experimentally on quantum hardware rather than being confined to classical architectures. It provides a concrete pathway toward quantum-enhanced symbolic intelligence and quantum acceleration of geometric and algebraic deduction.

aiRole.description: The authors report that their automated quantum proving frameworks proved two geometry theorems on a fully programmable superconducting quantum processor: the perpendicularity of the diagonals of a square and a 1978 International Mathematical Olympiad geometry problem.

humanContribution: Humans developed the two quantum proving frameworks, implementing Wu's algebraic elimination with quantum pseudo-division and a hybrid quantum strategy-guided full-angle method, and ran the experiments on the superconducting processor.

title: A latent dimension of Condorcet's jury theorem for multiple AI advisers
summary: The paper studies what happens when multiple AI advisers answer the same question, as in self-consistency and LLM-as-a-judge panels. Condorcet's jury theorem predicts that adding independent, competent advisers raises majority reliability, but from the user's viewpoint adding advisers also exposes disagreement. A binomial model shows that this visible dissent becomes nearly certain as the panel grows, and that the rates at which reliability and disagreement approach certainty cross at adviser accuracy 4/5 (0.8); below that level, visible dissent eventually becomes more likely than a correct majority. Thus even ideal panels of independent, competent advisers may be correct in aggregate while appearing divided, so disagreement alone does not indicate aggregation failure. The splitting patterns of advisers also give a common basis for predictive multiplicity, reconciliation load, and reliance miscalibration, separating aggregation from disclosure and framing testable questions about how disagreement should be shown and interpreted.
significance: Panels built from many AI advisers are widely used for robustness, yet the results show that their outputs can look unstable even when aggregation is working exactly as theory predicts. The threshold at accuracy 4/5 gives a quantitative reference point for judging when dissent is expected noise rather than a signal of failure, and the framework supports concrete research on presenting disagreement to users, reducing reconciliation burden, and avoiding over- or under-reliance on panel judgments.

zh.title: 面向多个AI顾问的孔多塞陪审团定理（Condorcet's jury theorem）的一个隐含维度
zh.summary: 本文研究多个AI顾问回答同一问题时的情形，例如自洽性（self-consistency）与LLM-as-a-judge面板。孔多塞陪审团定理（Condorcet's jury theorem）预测，增加独立且胜任的顾问会提高多数意见的可靠性，但从用户的视角看，增加顾问也会让分歧更易被察觉。二项模型（binomial model）表明，这种可见异议（visible dissent）随顾问数量增长几乎不可避免，并且可靠性与分歧趋近于确定性的速率在顾问准确率为4/5（0.8）处相交；低于该水平时，可见异议最终会比正确的多数意见更可能出现。因此，即便由独立且胜任的顾问组成的理想面板，也可能在整体上正确却显得意见分裂，这种分歧本身并不意味着聚合失败。顾问的分组方式还为预测多重性（predictive multiplicity）、协调负担（reconciliation load）与依赖校准偏差（reliance miscalibration）提供了共同基础，从而将聚合与披露区分开来，并把后者转化为关于应如何呈现与解读分歧的可检验问题。
zh.significance: 由多个AI顾问构成的面板被广泛用于提升稳健性，而这些结果表明，即使聚合完全按理论预期运作，面板输出仍可能显得不稳定。准确率4/5这一阈值为判断分歧是预期噪声还是失败信号提供了量化参照，该框架也支持关于向用户呈现分歧、降低协调负担以及避免对面板判断过度依赖或依赖不足的具体研究。

title: Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations
summary: The paper develops a framework for deciding what cognitive capacities can be attributed to a system that acquires and uses representations it did not itself produce. Its core contribution is a five-part attribution table separating effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse, with each entry pairing a positive capacity commitment with a claim that needs further support. The argument concedes meaningful content, causal efficacy, and productive inference, so the limits it draws do not rest on treating representations as inert encodings. Map and category examples show that full application competence leaves acquisition capacity undetermined, and that learning a criterion from a description differs from discovering it in examples. Short formal proofs appear in an appendix, and the framework is applied to Andrew Ng's world-model reading of Othello-GPT and to indicators discussed in recent accounts of machine concepts, preserving demonstrated recognition, classification, inference, and qualified acquisition while leaving criterion discovery and accumulation unestablished. The result bounds the scope of cognitive attribution rather than defining the conditions of concept possession.
significance: Claims about machine understanding often slide from showing that a system can use a representation to crediting it with the capacities that produced that representation. This framework makes that gap explicit and separates what is demonstrated from what is asserted, giving interpreters of models such as Othello-GPT a disciplined way to assign credit. For AI-assisted mathematics and discovery systems in general, it offers a vocabulary for saying precisely which competencies an acquired formal structure licenses before stronger cognitive attributions are claimed.

zh.title: 地图使用者与制图者：从已获表征出发的认知归因范围
zh.summary: 论文提出一个框架，用于判定对一个使用并非由自身产生的表征的系统可以归因哪些认知能力。核心贡献是一张五分归因表，区分有效追踪、应用已获结构、从明确规范中获取（acquisition from explicit specifications）、从识别性观察中获取（acquisition from identifying observations）以及保留与复用，每一项都配有一项正面能力承诺和一项仍需额外支持的主张。论证刻意让步于表征具有意义内容、因果效力与生产性推理，因此其结论并不依赖于把表征视为惰性编码。地图与范畴（category）的例子表明，完整的应用能力仍无法确定获取能力，而从描述中习得一个判据与在例子中发现该判据并不相同。附录给出简短形式化证明，并将框架应用于 Andrew Ng 对 Othello-GPT 的世界模型解读，以及当代机器概念论述中讨论的具体指标：既保留已展示的识别、分类、推理与有保留的获取，又指出判据发现与累积方面尚未确立之处。结果关涉认知归因的范围，而非概念拥有的构成条件。
zh.significance: 关于机器理解的论述，常常从“系统能够使用某表征”滑向“把产生该表征的能力也归功于系统”。这一框架把该缺口显式化，区分已被证明与被断言的内容，为 Othello-GPT 等模型的解释者提供一种审慎分配功劳的方式。对 AI 辅助的数学发现（Mathematical Discovery）与符号计算（Symbolic Computation）系统而言，它提供了一套词汇，可在作出更强的认知归因之前，精确说明某个已获形式结构究竟支持哪些能力主张。

title: Mechanizing Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems and Provability Logic
summary: A research team mechanized proofs of Gödel's first and second incompleteness theorems, Solovay's arithmetical completeness theorem for the logic GL, and related results in the Lean 4 theorem prover. title: When Edit Localization Amplifies Relative Selection Bias: Gradient Geometry, Target Mismatch, and Importance Weighting
summary: This paper studies how edit localization interacts with selective human feedback at a fixed model checkpoint. Localizing the gradient to edited spans is shown to amplify, reduce, or nonmonotonically alter squared relative selection bias, a ratio of quadratics whose derivative reduces to the sign of an explicit quadratic polynomial, depending on component biases and gradient geometry. Oracle importance weighting recovers the population mean for each fixed localization objective, but different localization objectives target different quantities; measured against one common full-gradient target, the authors derive finite-sample mean-squared error, an analytic optimal retention coefficient, and a fixed-clipping extension. Exact finite-population calculations and 10,000 Monte Carlo repetitions per sample size verify the identities and counterexamples. Experiments use public human post-edit data in two translation directions with pretrained models and declared synthetic selection; an English-German extension differentiates 73.89 million native parameters. In all three settings, hard localization yields higher relative bias but lower absolute bias than full retention, with nonzero untouched-component biases and negative inner products among selected component means, so the general criterion applies where a simple unbiased or aligned explanation fails. Output-bias diagnostics show consistent endpoint ordering of relative bias across directions with one interior maximum. The authors reuse each language's records with a mixture rather than independent replications, and make no claims about translation-quality gains or actual complaint propensities.
significance: Selective human feedback is increasingly used to train and adapt language models, but treating corrections as representative can distort gradient estimates in ways that are easy to miss. The analysis shows why editing to the corrected spans can look favorable or unfavorable depending on whether one measures relative or absolute bias, and it gives practitioners concrete tools: an MSE expression, an optimal retention coefficient, and a clipping scheme, plus caution that localizing a gradient changes its estimation target. The verified counterexamples and diagnostics help researchers interpret edit-based adaptation results and design better feedback sampling and weighting.

zh.title: 当编辑局部化放大相对选择偏差时：梯度几何、目标错配与重要性加权
zh.summary: 本文研究在固定模型检查点上，编辑局部化（edit localization）与选择性人类反馈之间的交互。将梯度局部化到被编辑片段会放大、减小或非单调地改变平方相对选择偏差（squared relative selection bias），该量是二次型之比，其导数的符号归结为一个显式二次多项式，方向取决于各分量偏差与梯度几何。对每个固定的局部化目标，神谕重要性加权（oracle importance weighting）可恢复总体均值，但不同局部化目标对应不同的估计目标；相对于一个共同的全梯度目标，研究者推导出有限样本均方误差（mean-squared error）、解析形式的最优保留系数以及固定截断扩展。精确有限总体计算与每种样本量 10,000 次蒙特卡洛重复验证了这些恒等式与反例。实验使用公开的人类译后编辑数据，覆盖两个翻译方向与预训练模型，并声明采用合成选择机制；英语-德语扩展对 7389 万个原生参数做微分。在三种设定中，硬局部化相比完全保留都呈现更高的相对偏差但更低的绝对偏差；未编辑分量偏差非零，且被选分量的均值具有负内积，因此当简单的无偏或对齐解释失效时，一般性准则仍然适用。输出偏差诊断在两个方向上呈现相同的相对偏差端点排序，且中间存在一个极大值。各语言的记录被复用并混合，不构成独立重复；研究者未对翻译质量提升或实际投诉倾向作推断。
zh.significance: 选择性人类反馈正被日益用于语言模型的训练与适配，但若把人类修正当作代表性样本，梯度估计可能以容易被忽视的方式失真。该分析解释了为何按修正片段做局部编辑，在衡量相对偏差与绝对偏差时会给出看似相反的结论，并为实践者提供了具体工具：均方误差表达式、最优保留系数与截断方案，同时提醒局部化梯度会改变其估计目标。经验证的反例与诊断工具有助于研究者解读基于编辑的适配结果，并设计更好的反馈采样与加权方法。

title: Algebraic Expressivity Certificates for Shallow Polynomial Neural Networks
summary: The paper studies exact representability of bias-free shallow polynomial neural networks over the complex numbers using algebraic geometry. A width-r network with activation z ↦ z^d computes a sum of r d-th powers of linear forms, whose Zariski closure is a Veronese secant variety, so ideal elimination yields polynomial certificates of nonrepresentability. The authors implement this as a generic architecture-to-certificate pipeline; for quadratics they recover the exact symmetric determinantal description and explain its dimension via orthogonal symmetry, while in higher degree the implementation recovers classical catalecticant and secant equations and maps the practical reach of direct elimination across a finite architecture sweep. They also derive the exact population loss floor for a rank-two quadratic network on the sphere, showing how an algebraic obstruction creates irreducible approximation error.
significance: The work converts expressivity limits of shallow polynomial networks into explicit, checkable algebraic certificates, backed by an implemented pipeline that shows which architectures remain tractable for direct elimination. Exact quadratic and rank-two results link algebraic obstructions to measurable irreducible loss, giving a principled way to diagnose when a network architecture cannot represent a target function.

zh.title: 浅层多项式神经网络的代数表达能力证书
zh.summary: 本文运用代数几何（algebraic geometry）研究无偏置浅层多项式神经网络的精确表示能力。在复数域上，宽度为 r、激活函数为 z ↦ z^d 的网络计算 r 个线性形式的 d 次幂之和，其扎里斯基闭包（Zariski closure）是韦罗内塞割线簇（Veronese secant variety），因此理想消元（ideal elimination）可生成关于不可表示性的多项式证书。研究者将该构造实现为通用的“架构到证书”流水线：对于二次情形，恢复出精确的对称行列式描述，并用正交对称性解释其维数；在更高次数下，实现恢复了经典的 catalecticant 方程（catalecticant equations）与割线方程（secant equations），并在有限架构扫描中刻画直接消元的实际适用范围。作者还推导出球面上秩二二次网络的精确总体损失下界，说明代数障碍如何产生不可消除的逼近误差。
zh.significance: 该工作把浅层多项式网络的表达能力限制转化为显式、可检验的代数证书，并配有实现流水线，能够判断哪些架构仍适合直接消元处理。二次情形与秩二情形的精确结果将代数障碍与可度量的不可消除损失联系起来，为诊断网络架构何时无法表示目标函数提供了有原则的方法。

title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
summary: ZGCM-1 is a fully open 7B dense foundation model trained from scratch with a focus on data, system, and algorithmic efficiency. Its core premise is that compact models cannot passively memorize the open web, but can exceed parametric capacity limits by combining deliberate internal reasoning with active external tool use. The recipe includes interleaved gated sliding-window and full attention, a stable FP8 Muon optimizer, progressive context scaling through 16K, 64K and 256K, and reformulation of interaction traces as Markov Decision Processes during mid-training, plus an agent-swarm workflow for cluster operations, data curation and diagnostics. ZGCM-1-7B is reported competitive with 7B-class models on general benchmarks and with far larger frontier models such as Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.1 on challenging mathematical reasoning and agentic search suites, with roughly a 4.2x efficiency gain in 16K pre-training time-to-loss. The team distills eight empirical findings across architectural scaling, SFT quality pruning, long-context generalization and agentic co-training, and releases weights, checkpoints, code, per-stage data recipes and W&B logs.
significance: Mathematical reasoning and agentic search remain areas where small open models lag far behind frontier systems; this work shows a compact model can stay competitive by coupling extended internal thinking with deliberate tool use, supported by an end-to-end open training recipe and a reported 4.2x pre-training speedup. Fully releasing weights across pre-training, mid-training and post-training, together with intermediate checkpoints, data recipes and logs, gives the community reproducible artifacts for studying mathematical agents and long-context, tool-augmented reasoning.

title: Beyond Generation and Accuracy: Diagnosing and Enhancing Visual Chain-of-Thought for Geometry Problem Solving
summary: This work introduces GeoVAD-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for Visual Chain-of-Thought (VCoT) in geometry problem solving that pairs fine-grained trajectory diagnosis across perception, auxiliary quality, utilization, deductive reasoning, and final correctness with controlled No-Aux, Auto-Aux, and GT-Aux interventions. The benchmark shows that high-quality auxiliary aids yield substantial theoretical gains but autonomous generation suffers from compounding errors in geometric perception, visual manipulation, visual-state grounding, and deduction. Using these diagnostics, the authors build a data construction pipeline and a progressive SFT plus multimodal RL framework, producing GeoWeave-8B, which improves final geometric accuracy by +25.3% and process average across four intermediate diagnostic dimensions by +30.4% over the base model.
significance: Most existing evaluations judge visual generation and answer accuracy separately, obscuring whether auxiliary constructions are geometrically valid, actually used in reasoning, and causally responsible for success. This benchmark isolates intermediate error modes and the autonomy gap in producing auxiliary aids, and the resulting training recipe translates those diagnostics into measurable gains for multimodal geometry reasoning.

title: Reality Is the Final Verifier: On Two Key Gaps in Agentic Software Engineering
summary: This position paper frames agentic software engineering around an implementation-verification loop in which an evaluator checks an implementation against requirements under a model of the deployment environment. It identifies two irreducible gaps: the requirement gap, where requirements only approximate stakeholder intent, and the model gap, where the modeled environment only approximates reality. Together these form a two-gap framework that unifies reward hacking, which exploits omissions in requirements or models, and hallucination, which widens the gaps by fabricating requirements or environment assumptions. Because neither gap can be certified closed in an open, changing world, the paper proposes an assurance-revision loop that uses deployment evidence to revise requirements, models, or evaluators when stakeholders reject observed behavior, and casts assured agentic development as resource allocation across human judgment, agent capability, and compute. Predeployment verification remains a proxy; actual deployment behavior is the final verifier.
significance: The framework reframes the goal of agentic software development from proving correctness against fixed specifications to continuously narrowing gaps that cannot be closed, giving research on reward hacking and hallucination a common structural explanation. The proposed assurance-revision loop and the matching bottleneck pair, human judgment for the requirement gap and faithful but costly evaluation for the model gap, suggest where verification research, tooling, and human oversight should be concentrated to make deployed agents trustworthy.

zh.title: 现实是最终验证者：论智能体软件工程的两大关键缺口
zh.summary: 这篇立场论文围绕智能体软件工程（agentic software engineering）中的实现-验证循环（implementation-verification loop）展开：开发者或智能体反复修改实现，直到评估器（如测试套件）按一组需求并以部署环境的模型为前提接受该实现。论文指出两处不可消除的缺口：需求缺口（requirement gap），即需求仅近似反映利益相关者的意图；模型缺口（model gap），即所建模的环境仅近似真实部署环境。二者构成双缺口框架（two-gap framework），统一解释智能体软件工程的主要失败模式：奖励劫持（reward hacking）利用需求或模型中的遗漏，而幻觉（hallucination）通过捏造需求或环境假设来扩大这两处缺口。由于在开放且不断变化的世界中，通常无法证明任一缺口已闭合，目标便从闭合缺口转为持续收窄缺口。为此论文提出保障-修订循环（assurance-revision loop）：当利益相关者拒绝部署后出现的行为时，利用部署证据来修订需求、模型或评估器。论文还将有保障的智能体开发表述为在人类判断、智能体能力与算力之间进行资源配置的问题；两大主要瓶颈正对应两处缺口，即需求缺口对应人类判断，模型缺口对应可靠但成本高昂的评估。现实是最终验证者：实际部署条件下的可接受行为才是终极检验，而部署前的评估始终只是其代理。
zh.significance: 该框架把智能体软件开发的目标从针对固定规范证明正确性，重新定位为持续收窄无法闭合的缺口，为奖励劫持（reward hacking）与幻觉（hallucination）的研究提供了统一的结构性解释。所提出的保障-修订循环（assurance-revision loop）以及与之对应的瓶颈配对，即需求缺口（requirement gap）对应人类判断、模型缺口（model gap）对应可靠但成本高昂的评估，指明了验证研究、工具建设与人工监督应着力的方向，以提升部署后智能体的可信性。

title: Learning the Geometry of Collider Events with Metric-Aware Deep Sets
summary: The paper develops a Deep Sets surrogate for optimal transport between variable-size weighted point clouds that enforces non-negativity, exchange symmetry, and zero self-distance while leaving the triangle inequality unconstrained. Applied to the Energy Mover's Distance between collider events in a particle physics application, the Metric-Aware Particle Flow Network achieves percent-level mean absolute percentage error and significantly higher inference throughput than the surveyed exact and approximate methods. Across 10^6 held-out event triplets, triangle-inequality violations fall from 199 to 2 and the maximum violation from 149.5 to 5.8 GeV compared with a matched unconstrained network.
significance: Fast neural surrogates for optimal transport often lose metric structure, degrading their geometric reliability. This work shows that targeted architectural inductive biases can recover that fidelity cheaply, roughly halving... no, cutting triangle-inequality violations by two orders of magnitude while accelerating large pairwise analyses in particle physics.

title: Magenta: Closing the Loop Between Mathematical Reasoning and Lean Verification
summary: Magenta is a training-free agentic pipeline that integrates Lean signals into informal LLM-based mathematical reasoning. Given only a natural-language problem, it produces an answer, formalizes it as a Lean 4 statement, and constructs a machine-checked proof. A statement judge checks that the formalization preserves the original problem, while an error-attribution judge routes failed attempts either to mathematical re-derivation or to local Lean repair. The paper reports 100% accuracy on evaluated olympiad benchmarks including AIME 2025, AIME 2026, and HMMT February 2026, and, when paired with the open-weight K2-Horizon-7B reasoner, solving all six IMO 2026 problems. The analysis indicates that statement adjudication is essential to avoid false certificates and that feedback-guided correction outperforms independent resampling on difficult problems.
significance: The work closes a gap between informal mathematical reasoning and machine-checkable formal verification, showing how Lean feedback can be folded into LLM reasoning without training. By detecting when formalization drifts from the original problem, it reduces the risk of confident but false proof certificates, while targeted correction of failed attempts appears more effective than repeated independent sampling on hard problems.

zh.title: Magenta：在数学推理与 Lean 验证之间闭合循环
zh.summary: Magenta 是一个免训练的智能体流程，将 Lean 信号整合进基于 LLM 的非形式化数学推理（mathematical reasoning）过程。仅给定自然语言问题，该流程即可生成答案，将其表述为 Lean 4 语句，并构造经机器检查的证明。其中，语句判定器检验形式化是否忠实保留原问题，错误归因判定器则将失败尝试路由到数学重新推导或局部 Lean 修复。论文报告称，在包括 AIME 2025、AIME 2026 和 HMMT February 2026 在内的竞赛基准上取得 100% 准确率；配合开源权重的 K2-Horizon-7B 推理器时，解决了 IMO 2026 全部六道题。分析表明，语句裁决对防止虚假证明证书至关重要，且在难题上基于反馈的修正优于独立重采样。
zh.significance: 这项工作弥合了非形式化数学推理与可机器检查的形式化验证之间的鸿沟，展示了如何在无需训练的情况下将 Lean 反馈融入 LLM 推理过程。通过检测形式化是否偏离原问题，该方法降低了自信但错误的证明证书出现的风险，同时对失败尝试进行针对性修正，在难题上似乎比反复独立采样更为有效。
zh.aiRoleDescription: Magenta 这一免训练的智能体流程生成了答案、Lean 4 陈述和机器检查的证明，在 AIME 2025、AIME 2026 和 HMMT February 2026 等评估的奥赛基准上达到 100% 准确率，并与 K2-Horizon-7B 推理器配合解决了全部六道 IMO 2026 问题。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建并设计了 Magenta 流程，包括陈述判定器和错误归因判定器，并将其与开放权重的 K2-Horizon-7B 推理器配合使用。

title: Polyhedral Geometry of Time-to-First-Spike Neural Networks
summary: This work studies the expressivity of time-to-first-spike neural networks in a regime where the input-output map is continuous and piecewise linear, with affine pieces constrained by causal feasibility conditions governing spike orderings. It shows that each neuron's firing time has a maxout-like representation with exponentially many constrained affine pieces, formalizes causal regions as polyhedra with fixed causal sets, and derives upper and lower bounds on the maximal number of such regions for shallow and multilayer feedforward spiking networks. Theoretical and experimental results indicate that spiking networks can partition the input space more richly than conventional feedforward ReLU networks.
significance: A polyhedral characterization of causal regions gives a geometric account of the computational power of spiking networks and supports quantitative comparison with ReLU networks. The bounds on region counts clarify how event-driven timing, causal structure, and network depth jointly increase representational complexity.

zh.title: 脉冲神经网络的多面体几何结构
zh.summary: 本文研究时间至首次脉冲（time-to-first-spike）神经网络的表达能力，所考虑的设置中输入输出映射为连续分片线性映射，其仿射片段受因果可行性约束支配，这些约束决定了突触前脉冲是否先于神经元放电。研究首先证明，每个神经元的放电时间具有类似 maxout 的表示，其中包含指数多个且受到高度约束的仿射片段。随后，研究将因果区域（causal regions）形式化为具有固定因果集合的多面体区域，并推导出浅层与多层前馈脉冲网络中因果区域最大数量的上下界。理论与实验结果表明，脉冲网络能够对输入空间形成比传统前馈 ReLU 网络更丰富的划分。
zh.significance: 因果区域的多面体刻画为脉冲网络的计算能力提供了几何解释，并支持其与 ReLU 网络的定量比较。关于区域数量的上下界阐明了事件驱动时序、因果结构与网络深度如何共同提升表示复杂度。

title: Diversity of EML-type operators
summary: The article enumerates and classifies variants of the EML operator beyond the binary EML, clarifying misconceptions about these operators and their differing properties. It notes that the main goal, symbolic regression within an architecture closely matching proven neural networks combining matrix multiplication with a single univariate non-linear activation function, remains out of reach. Instead the authors propose a Möbius layer, replacing matrix operations with rational functions, and showcase the activation function eml(x,1/x), which recovers exp(x) and ln(x) separately and thereby evaluates all elementary functions within a rational generalization of the neural network.
significance: A systematic classification of EML-type operators consolidates a scattered landscape of variants and corrects misunderstandings that could misdirect future work. The proposed Möbius layer and the eml(x,1/x) activation offer a concrete architecture in which all standard explicit purely transcendental elementary functions are computable, advancing the long-term objective of symbolic regression grounded in provable neural-network structures.

zh.title: EML 型算子的多样性
zh.summary: 本文对 EML 算子（EML operator）的二元 EML 之外的各类变体进行枚举与分类，并澄清关于这些算子及其不同性质的常见误解。文中指出，主要目标即在尽可能接近已获证明的神经网络（neural network）的架构中实现符号回归（symbolic regression），这类网络将矩阵乘法与单变量非线性激活函数相结合，但该目标目前仍无法实现。作者转而提出 Möbius 层，用有理函数（rational function）取代矩阵运算，并展示激活函数（activation function）eml(x,1/x)；该函数可分别复原 exp(x) 与 ln(x)，从而在神经网络的有理推广中实现所有初等函数（elementary function）的求值。
zh.significance: 对 EML 型算子的系统分类整合了原本分散的变体图景，并纠正可能误导后续研究的误解。所提出的 Möbius 层与 eml(x,1/x) 激活函数给出了一种具体架构，使所有标准的显式纯超越初等函数均可在其上计算，从而推动在可证明的神经网络结构基础上实现符号回归这一长期目标。

title: SaltBench: A Referee-Gated Protocol for Measuring Method Effects in Machine-Checked Software Work
summary: SaltBench is a referee-gated protocol for measuring how a machine referee (proof kernel, program verifier, or withheld test suite) changes a coding agent's behavior, with outcomes scored outside the agent's toolchain, pre-run isolation from network and reference solutions, dated prediction freezes, and a cost cap treated as a halt rather than a failure. Five Rust systems components on a pinned Verus toolchain are refereed by withheld test suites. The salt-diet arm, instructed to specify and verify its code, cost more on all five components: no cost premium exceeded 2.8879x, three cheapest fell below 1.4x, and the premium rises with component size, a bound for this population only. The registered sign test at k=4 reached no verdict (3 of 4, p = 0.3125). The pilot matrix spans 200 conditions over four models, with 181 having a result of record, 16 inexpressible, and 3 unreached at the cost cap. A post hoc correctness reading counts 447 passing cells, 40 failures, 10 censored at a registered budget, 4 unscorable, and 42 read by condition; salt-diet's pass-rate interval lies below plain's on 8 greenfield and 5 brownfield rows and above on 2 greenfield rows, but this reading is descriptive over three cells of record per condition, runs no test, and draws no conclusion about correctness effects.
significance: Rigorous evaluation of method effects for coding agents requires separation of the agent's toolchain from scoring, registered predictions, and honest budget stops; SaltBench supplies such a protocol with isolation walls and a full public record. Its measured cost premiums quantify the practical price of specifying and verifying code, while its explicitly non-confirmatory statistics and post hoc correctness reading show both what the benchmark can support and where verdicts remain unavailable.

aiRole.description: SaltBench reports benchmark outcomes earned by four coding agents on five Rust components under referee-gated conditions, including cost premiums for a specify-and-verify method and withheld-test-suite pass rates against a plain baseline.

humanContribution: Humans designed the protocol and registered its arms and conditions, built the machine referee and withheld test suites, imposed the network wall and budget stops, and read and analyzed the recorded outcomes.

zh.title: SaltBench：一种用于度量机器检查软件工作中方法效应的裁判门控协议
zh.summary: SaltBench 是一种裁判门控协议，用于衡量机器裁判（machine referee，如证明内核（proof kernel）、程序验证器（program verifier）或保留测试套件（withheld test suite））如何改变编码智能体（coding agent）的工作方式，其结果在智能体工具链之外判定，运行前设有隔离墙以屏蔽网络与参考解法，预测按日期冻结以授权每次运行，且预算停止视作中止而非失败。五项 Rust 系统组件在固定的 Verus 工具链上分别由保留测试套件裁判。salt-diet 组被指示为其代码编写规格并进行验证，在全部五项组件上成本更高：成本溢价上限为 2.8879 倍，最低三项低于 1.4 倍，且溢价随组件规模上升，这只是该总体的界限而非更大总体的承诺。在 k=4 时注册的符号检验（sign test）未得出结论（4 中 3，p = 0.3125）。试验矩阵覆盖四个模型上的 200 个条件，其中 181 个有记录结果，16 个无法表达，3 个在成本上限处未达到。一项事后声明的正确性解读统计到 447 个单元通过保留测试套件、40 个失败、10 个在注册预算处删失、4 个不可评分、42 个按条件解读；salt-diet 的通过率区间在 8 个全新开发（greenfield）行与 5 个存量改造（brownfield）行上完全低于 plain，在 2 个全新开发行上完全高于 plain。但该解读仅在每条件三个记录单元上作描述性统计，未做任何检验，也不能说明该方法使代码更正确或更不正确。
zh.significance: 对编码智能体的方法效应作严格评测，需要将智能体工具链与评分过程分离，并配合注册预测与如实的预算中止；SaltBench 提供了带有隔离墙且完整公开记录的此类协议。其测得的成本溢价量化了编写规格并进行验证的实际代价，而明确标注为非确认性的统计结果与事后正确性解读则同时展示了该基准能支持什么、以及哪些问题仍无结论。
zh.aiRoleDescription: SaltBench 报告了四个 coding agent 在裁判门控条件下对五个 Rust 组件取得的基准结果，包括 specify-and-verify 方法的成本溢价，以及相对于 plain 基线的留出测试套件通过率。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了该协议并注册其 arms 与条件，构建了机器裁判和留出测试套件，设置了网络隔离墙与预算停止规则，并阅读和分析了记录的结果。

title: AI in mathematics and the Navier–Stokes problem
summary: A post from the Isaac Newton Institute discussing OpenAI's claim that one of its internal models solved the Clay Millennium Problem on Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness. The piece stresses that the approach, the prompting of the agents, and the initial progress came from human work, which should be recognized alongside the excitement over the announcement.
significance: The post addresses questions of credit and attribution in AI-assisted mathematics at a moment when a major open problem has been claimed to be solved, and it underscores that human contributions remain central to the mathematical advance.

title: Weighted Empirical Risk Minimization for Machine Learning under Long-Range Dependence: Exact Pathwise Rates and Learning-Error Geometry
summary: The paper develops an exact almost-sure learning theory for smooth parametric models trained by regularly weighted empirical risk minimization on data drawn from a fixed finite window of a stationary Gaussian sequence. When the loss gradient at the population minimizer has Wiener-chaos rank m with a nonzero low-frequency coefficient, the finite-lag score in the long-memory interior regime collapses on the iterated-logarithm scale to a single weighted Hermite chaos. This yields an almost-sure Bahadur representation, an exact limsup law for the learned parameter, and, for m at least 2, the functional cluster set of the full learning trajectory. The polynomial learning exponent depends only on the memory parameter and the chaos rank and is invariant under admissible power weights, while the sharp pathwise constant and cluster geometry do depend on the weights. In rank one, global optimization over the admissible power exponents gives only positive optimizers, and time-series prediction and classification examples illustrate the theory.
significance: The results give exact, high-probability-in-the-limit descriptions of how learning algorithms behave under long-range dependent data, where classical asymptotics fail. Separating the weight-independent polynomial rate from the weight-dependent sharp constant and cluster geometry clarifies exactly how sample weighting affects optimization, and the rank-one result identifies optimal weight choices. The framework covers both prediction and classification and may guide algorithm design on persistent temporal signals.

zh.title: 长程依赖（long-range dependence）条件下的机器学习加权经验风险最小化：精确路径速率与学习误差几何
zh.summary: 本文针对平稳高斯序列（stationary Gaussian sequence）的固定有限窗口所产生的数据，建立了由正则变动样本权重（regularly varying weights）的经验风险最小化（empirical risk minimization）训练的光滑参数模型的精确几乎必然（almost sure）学习理论。当总体极小点处损失梯度的维纳混沌（Wiener chaos）秩为 m 且低频系数非零时，在长记忆内部区域，有限滞后得分在迭代对数尺度下归结为单个加权埃尔米特混沌（Hermite chaos）。由此得到几乎必然的巴哈杜尔表示（Bahadur representation）、学习参数的精确上极限律，以及当 m 不小于 2 时完整学习轨迹的泛函聚点集（cluster set）。多项式学习指数仅由记忆参数（memory parameter）与混沌秩（chaos rank）决定，在可容许的幂次权重下保持不变，而精确的路径常数与聚点集几何则依赖于权重。在秩一情形，对可容许幂次作全局优化可得全部最优者均为正；文中以时间序列预测与分类为例说明结果。
zh.significance: 这些结果为长程依赖数据下经典渐近失效

title: An Open Recipe for IMO Gold: Training Nemotron for Olympiad Mathematics
summary: Starting from Nemotron 3 Ultra, the authors study how post-training and test-time inference design affect natural-language proof generation for hard olympiad mathematics, training two specialist checkpoints with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning and evaluating checkpoint choice, verification, and refinement. They build an open-model test-time-compute pipeline in which three Nemotron 3 Ultra checkpoints — the general-availability model and the two post-trained specialists — iteratively generate, verify, and refine candidate proofs entirely in natural language, with no formal prover, external tools, or internet access, while a separate high-compute stage selects each final submission. The system scored 30 out of 42 at IMO 2026, reaching the gold-medal threshold, and the team releases the two specialist checkpoints, training data, training and inference code, submitted solutions, and Nemotron-IMO-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 novel olympiad-level problems.
significance: The work shows that an open-weight model, using only natural-language reasoning with iterative verification and refinement plus a final selection stage, can reach the IMO gold-medal threshold without any formal prover or external tooling. Releasing the checkpoints, data, code, solutions, and a fresh 200-problem benchmark makes the full recipe reproducible and gives the community concrete resources for advancing AI-assisted olympiad-level mathematics.

aiRole.description: Researchers trained Nemotron 3 Ultra specialist checkpoints and built a test-time pipeline that generated, verified, refined, and selected natural-language proofs, scoring 30/42 at IMO 2026 to reach the gold-medal threshold. They also released the checkpoints, training data, code, solutions, and the Nemotron-IMO-Bench…

humanContribution: Humans designed the post-training and inference pipeline, built and curated the training data, trained and evaluated the checkpoints, and checked the submitted solutions.

zh.title: IMO 金牌的开放配方：训练 Nemotron 处理奥林匹克数学
zh.summary: 以 Nemotron 3 Ultra 为起点，作者研究了模型后训练与测试时推理设计如何影响高难度奥林匹克数学中的自然语言证明生成，通过监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）与强化学习（reinforcement learning）训练两个专用检查点，并评估检查点选择、验证与精炼策略。团队构建了一个开放模型测试时计算流水线，其中三个 Nemotron 3 Ultra 检查点——通用可用模型与两个后训练专用模型——完全以自然语言迭代生成、验证并精炼候选证明，不使用形式化证明器（formal prover）、外部工具或互联网访问，另有一个高算力阶段负责选出每道题的最终提交。该系统在 IMO 2026 得到 42 分中的 30 分，达到金牌分数线，团队公开了两个专用检查点、训练数据、训练与推理代码、提交的解答，以及 Nemotron-IMO-Bench——一个包含 200 道全新奥林匹克难度问题的新基准。
zh.significance: 这项工作表明，一个开放权重模型仅依靠自然语言推理、迭代验证与精炼，加上最终的选择阶段，即可达到 IMO 金牌分数线，全程无需形式化证明器或外部工具。作者公开了检查点、数据、代码、解答以及一套全新的 200 题基准，使完整配方可复现，并为推动人工智能辅助的奥林匹克数学研究提供了具体可用的资源。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 研究人员训练了 Nemotron 3 Ultra 专家检查点并构建了测试时推理流水线，生成、验证、精炼并选取自然语言证明，在 IMO 2026 获得 42 分中的 30 分，达到金牌分数线。他们还发布了检查点、训练数据、代码、提交的解答以及 Nemotron-IMO-Bench 基准。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了后训练与推理流水线，构建并整理了训练数据，训练并评估了检查点，并核查了提交的解答。

title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
summary: This work presents a framework that equips a pure LLM with a Geometric Vision Parser, converting geometry diagrams into symbolic form, and a Symbolic Solver that carries out formal deduction. The design aims to reduce hallucination and produce interpretable reasoning on complex plane geometry problems. The authors curate a benchmark of challenging items from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, chosen for data novelty and for testing deeper deductive skill. Experiments report performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while yielding clearer, human-like solutions.
significance: The results suggest that a specialized LLM pipeline can match state-of-the-art LMMs on geometry reasoning without their typical computational intensity and opacity. The modular, symbolic route offers interpretable step-by-step solutions, and the new Zhongkao-based benchmark provides a fresh testbed for measuring genuine deductive ability in geometric reasoning (几何推理).

zh.title: 从符号感知到逻辑推理：引导语言模型进行几何推理的框架
zh.summary: 本研究提出一种框架，为纯 LLM 配备 Geometric Vision Parser，将几何图形转化为符号形式，再由 Symbolic Solver 执行形式化演绎，以期在复杂平面几何问题上减少幻觉并产出可解释的推理过程。作者从 2025 年中国中考（Zhongkao）试题中整理出一套高难度基准，注重数据新颖性并考查更深层的演绎能力。实验显示，该方法达到与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 相当的表现，同时给出更清晰、更接近人类的解题过程。
zh.significance: 结果表明，配备专用模块的 LLM 流程能够在几何推理上媲美先进的 LMM，同时避免后者常见的高计算开销与不透明性。模块化的符号路线提供了可解释的逐步解答，而基于中国中考的新基准为评估几何推理中真正的演绎能力提供了新的测试平台。

title: Every $\mathrm{AW}^*$-Algebra is Normal
summary: Using set-theoretic methods, the authors prove that every AW*-algebra is normal, resolving a question of Wright open for 46 years; the case of AW*-factors was previously known from work of Saitô and Wright. They further show that a ZFC model containing an AW*-algebra that is not monotone complete yields a forcing extension containing a non-monotone-complete AW*-factor, so any ZFC proof that all AW*-factors are monotone complete automatically yields one for all AW*-algebras. Both results build on transfer principles for Boolean-valued factor representations developed by Ozawa. The work was assisted by the Danus LLM orchestration system.
significance: The result settles a long-standing structural question about AW*-algebras and links the general monotone completeness problem to the factor case, so that a proof confined to factors would settle the general case. It also demonstrates how set-theoretic and forcing techniques, along with Boolean-valued transfer principles, can advance operator-algebraic structure theory, with assistance from an LLM orchestration system.

aiRole.description: The paper proves that every AW*-algebra is normal and derives transfer results connecting non-monotone-complete AW*-algebras to AW*-factors; it says only that the work was assisted by the Danus LLM orchestration system, without specifying what the AI produced or what role the humans played.

title: Sequence-Informed Geometric Evaluation of RNA 3D Structures
summary: SIRGE is a sequence-informed geometric evaluator for RNA 3D structures that conditions structural representations on nucleotide embeddings drawn from a pretrained RNA language model. Early results show it outperforms established evaluators in Kendall-τ alignment, Top-1 selection, and Top-3 ranking. Controlled comparisons indicate that sequence conditioning corrects errors made by an otherwise matched geometric model and improves target-level rank structure, providing initial evidence that pretrained sequence representations offer ranking information complementary to geometric reasoning.
significance: RNA structure pipelines generate many candidate conformations for a single sequence, so reliable evaluation must check sequence compatibility rather than geometry alone. The reported gains show that nucleotide embeddings from a pretrained RNA language model supply ranking signals beyond geometric features, which could improve the selection of native-like structures in computational RNA modeling.

title: Proof-Carrying Cognition: Closing the Verification Gap with Reality-Settled Reward
summary: The paper argues that the binding constraint on language-model reasoning progress is the verification gap: the lack of a scalable, incorruptible reward outside formal domains. It offers four contributions. A joint-Gaussian theory of best-of-N selection shows that verifier-gold correlation rho is the exact exchange rate between test-time compute and capability, with unsound verifiers paying a polynomial penalty N^(1/rho^2), and a margin-free copula form predicts real LLM-judge soundness to 4% median error. In program-synthesis testbeds with executable ground truth, including a pre-registered scaled replication, unsound verifiers degrade from 0.94 to 0.32 Soundness-under-Pressure at N=4096 while a sound verifier improves monotonically; reality-anchored settlement drives the hacking gap from about 0.27 to near zero under i.i.d. and adversarial pressure, soundness grows log-linearly with settled labels, and on-policy settlement is about 10x more label-efficient than random labeling. With real LLM judges and unit-test execution as gold, weak judges lose soundness under best-of-N (p<0.001), and selection alone manufactures +0.53 hacking gaps from honest samples. Under real GRPO training, a frozen reward model shows full overoptimization (executed reward collapses 90%), while the same model refit on a 10% settlement stream preserves 6x the executed reward. The paper proposes the proof-carrying cognition paradigm, in which reasoning steps are typed probabilistic claims priced by a self-built world model trained only on held-out reality and settled by proper scoring rules, and specifies Soundness-under-Pressure as the headline metric for a reality-settled reasoning benchmark.
significance: The work gives a quantitative account of why scaling best-of-N amplifies verifier exploits rather than capability, and turns that diagnosis into an empirical design principle: anchoring reward to executed reality preserves soundness as optimization pressure grows. The settlement results, especially the roughly 10x label-efficiency of on-policy settlement and the 6x executed-reward retention under GRPO, suggest practical routes to reliable reward beyond formal domains, while Soundness-under-Pressure offers a benchmark metric aimed at making overoptimization and reward hacking measurable and comparable across systems.

zh.title: 证明携带式认知：以现实结算奖励弥合验证差距
zh.summary: 本文论证，语言模型推理进展的制约瓶颈是验证差距（verification gap）：在形式化领域之外缺少可扩展且不可腐蚀的奖励信号。文章提出四点贡献。在最优-N（best-of-N）选择的联合高斯模型中，验证器与真实值的相关性 rho 是测试时计算量与能力之间的精确兑换率，不可靠验证器需支付多项式惩罚 N^(1/rho^2)，而一个无边距的 copula 形式可将真实 LLM 评判器的可靠性预测到 4% 中位误差。在具有可执行真实值的程序合成测试平台上（含一项预注册的规模化复现），随着优化压力增大，不可靠验证器的压力下可靠性（Soundness-under-Pressure）由 0.94 降至 N=4096 时的 0.32，而可靠验证器则单调提升；在独立同分布与对抗压力下，以现实为锚的结算将作弊差距（hacking gap）从约 0.27 降至接近 0；可靠性随结算标签数量呈对数线性增长，且策略内（on-policy）结算的标注效率约为随机标注的 10 倍。以真实 LLM 评判器与单元测试执行结果作为真实值时，较弱评判器在最优-N 下可靠性显著下降（p<0.001），较强评判器更为稳健，而仅靠选择即可从诚实样本中制造出 +0.53 的作弊差距。在真实 GRPO 训练中，冻结的奖励模型呈现完整的过优化曲线（执行奖励崩溃 90%），而同一模型用 10% 结算数据流重新拟合后保留了 6 倍的执行奖励。文章提出证明携带式认知（proof-carrying cognition）范式：推理步骤是带类型的概率性主张，由仅在留出现实数据上训练的自建世界模型定价，并用恰当评分规则（proper scoring rules）结算；同时将以现实结算的推理基准的头号指标指定为压力下可靠性。

title: Which Tokens Should SFT Actually Learn? A Token-Trimming Perspective on Mathematical Reasoning
summary: The paper identifies a limitation of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which applies a uniform cross-entropy loss to every target token despite unequal learning signals across tokens in mathematical reasoning. The proposed method, TrimSFT, reweights the SFT loss by the logit gap between the gold token and its strongest competitor, trimming supervision from both tokens the model has already mastered (large gap) and tokens it weakly supports (small or negative gap), and concentrating learning in an intermediate gap region. The weights follow a Gaussian centered at margin m with bandwidth τ, requiring no reference model or extra forward pass. Across six base models from the Llama, Qwen, and DeepMath families and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, TrimSFT beats standard SFT, giving the best average on five of six models and gains up to +26.9 points on MATH500. Further analysis shows that τ matters more than the exact margin location, that half-trim variants trimming only one side give inferior trade-offs, and that TrimSFT reshapes model confidence more evenly than uniform SFT or monotonic reweighting.
significance: The results show that uniform token-level supervision is suboptimal for mathematical reasoning and that trimming both over-mastered and low-confidence tokens yields a cheap, broadly effective alternative. Since TrimSFT needs only the logits already computed during training, it offers a practical improvement to SFT pipelines, while the logit-gap analysis provides insight into how reweighting shapes model confidence during reasoning training.

aiRole.description: Models fine-tuned with the authors' TrimSFT token-reweighting method achieved the best average performance on five of six base models across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with gains of up to +26.9 points over standard SFT on MATH500.

humanContribution: Humans designed the TrimSFT loss-reweighting method, trained the fine-tuned models, and selected and ran the benchmark evaluations and analyses.

zh.title: SFT究竟应该学习哪些词元？数学推理（mathematical reasoning）的词元裁剪视角
zh.summary: 论文指出监督微调（supervised fine-tuning, SFT）对所有目标词元施加统一的交叉熵损失存在局限：在数学推理（mathematical reasoning）中，不同词元提供的学习信号并不均等。团队提出 TrimSFT，依据正确词元（gold token）与其最强竞争词元之间的 logit 间隔（logit gap）对 SFT 损失重新加权，从两端裁剪监督信号：既去掉模型已经掌握的词元（间隔很大），也去掉模型支持较弱的词元（间隔很小或为负），把学习集中在中间的间隔区间。权重采用以间隔 m 为中心、带宽为 τ 的高斯形式，无需参考模型或额外前向计算。研究者在来自 Llama、Qwen、DeepMath 系列的六个基础模型上，于五个数学推理基准进行评测，TrimSFT 一致优于标准 SFT，在六个模型中的五个上取得最佳平均成绩，在 MATH500 上最高提升 +26.9 分。进一步分析表明，带宽 τ 比间隔中心的具体位置更关键，只裁剪一侧的半裁剪变体权衡效果更差；词元级 logit 间隔分布分析显示，相比统一 SFT 或单调重加权方法，TrimSFT 对模型置信度的重塑更为均衡。
zh.significance: 结果表明，统一的词元级监督并非数学推理的理想选择，同时裁剪过度掌握与低置信度词元可带来廉价且广泛有效的改进。TrimSFT 只利用训练中已算出的 logit，便于整合进 SFT 流程；logit 间隔分析则有助于理解重加权如何影响推理训练中模型置信度的形成。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 使用作者提出的 TrimSFT 词元重加权方法微调的模型，在五个数学推理基准中的六个基础模型上取得五个模型的最佳平均成绩，在 MATH500 上比标准 SFT 最多提升 +26.9 分。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了 TrimSFT 损失重加权方法，训练了微调模型，并选定和运行了基准评测与分析。

title: Teacher Geometry Shapes Learnability in Teacher-Student Networks
summary: This work studies how the geometric structure of teacher neural networks affects the learnability of teacher-student systems, where a teacher network generates training labels for a student network. Learnability is formalized as the success rate of converging to the global minimum as a function of overparameterization, learning algorithm, student initialization, and teacher geometry. The authors construct an easy distribution maximizing node dissimilarity and a hard distribution minimizing it, and show these yield sharply different success rates across many settings and activation functions. By analyzing small networks containing two kinds of suboptimal local minima, out-of-bounds (OOB) minima and interior minima, the authors reduce the loss landscape to two dimensions under infinite data and a fast readout layer, showing the attraction region of interior minima depends on teacher structure. In larger networks, maximally dissimilar teachers produce more interior minima while minimally dissimilar teachers produce more OOB minima. Motivated by this analysis, increasing the learning rate of the readout layer relative to the inner biases raises success rates.
significance: The common practice of drawing teacher parameters randomly and normally hides large variation in how learnable different teachers are. Quantifying how teacher geometry shapes optimization outcomes gives a more faithful account of learning in teacher-student models and narrows the gap between these stylized settings and the structured functions encountered in practice, while the landscape analysis suggests concrete learning-rate design choices that improve training success.

zh.title: 教师几何结构决定教师-学生网络的可学习性
zh.summary: 本研究考察教师神经网络的几何结构如何影响教师-学生系统的可学习性，其中教师网络生成训练标签供学生网络学习。研究将可学习性（learnability）形式化为收敛到全局极小值（global minimum）的成功率，并将其视为过参数化（overparameterization）、学习算法、学生初始化与教师几何结构的函数。作者构造了最大化节点不相似度的简单分布与最小化节点不相似度的困难分布，并表明这两种分布，在多种设置与不同激活函数（activation functions）下产生显著不同的成功率。通过分析包含两类次优局部极小值（local minima）的小型网络，即越界（out-of-bounds, OOB）极小值与内部极小值，作者在无限数据与快速读出层（readout layer）假设下将损失景观（loss landscape）约化为二维，表明内部极小值的吸引域随教师结构而变化。在更大网络中，最大不相似的教师诱导更多内部极小值，而最小不相似的教师诱导更多 OOB 极小值。基于这些分析，作者证明提高读出层的学习率并降低内部偏置的学习率可提升成功率。
zh.significance: 常见做法是随机生成服从正态分布的教师参数，这掩盖了不同教师之间可学习性的巨大差异。量化教师几何结构如何影响优化结果，能更真实地刻画教师-学生模型中的学习过程，也有助于缩小这类理想化设置与实践中结构化函数之间的差距；同时损失景观分析给出了可直接指导实践的学习率设定方法，从而提升训练成功率。

title: StochBench: A Domain-Specific Benchmark for Stochastic Processes in Lean
summary: The paper introduces StochBench, a Lean 4 benchmark of 450 graduate-level stochastic-processes problems at varying abstraction levels, each paired with its natural-language source. The collection spans finite and countable Markov chains, renewal processes, random walks, martingales, stopping times, queues, Brownian motion, stochastic calculus, weak convergence, and Poisson and continuous-time Markov processes, targeting a field underrepresented in Mathlib. An Opus 4.8-based agent proves 157 of 450 problems (34.9%) under a 15-minute per-problem limit.
significance: Leading formal theorem proving benchmarks are small sets drawn from competition math such as the IMO and Putnam, which poorly capture field-specific applications. StochBench supplies a substantial domain-specific testbed for applied mathematics and shows that such material remains challenging for advanced provers, helping measure progress beyond competition-style problems.

title: Length Generalization for Transformers via Compression
summary: This paper refines the C-RASP hypothesis using the recently proposed fragments C-RASP+ and C-RASP1, which have computable length generalization bounds but required double exponential sample sizes in the worst case. The authors resolve the open question of tightness by proving an exponentially tighter bound, and use a novel connection to power words to obtain a polynomial length generalization bound for transformers when compressed strings are adopted. As an application, the results yield a fine-grained analysis of the C-RASP conjecture that reconciles seemingly contradictory experimental evidence against it.
significance: The work closes an open question about the sample complexity of C-RASP+ and C-RASP1 and strengthens the theoretical foundations of transformer length generalization, turning previously uncomputable bounds into explicit ones. The compression-based polynomial bound offers a practical route to better length generalization, while the refined analysis of the C-RASP conjecture explains conflicting empirical results rather than leaving them as counterexamples.

zh.title: 通过压缩实现 Transformer 的长度泛化
