title: Measuring Systematic Generalization in Neural Proof Generation with Transformers
summary: The paper examines how Transformer language models (TLMs) handle natural-language logical reasoning grounded in first-order logical proofs, using them to generate proofs in natural language and evaluating both the logical consistency of the generated proofs and the accuracy of the final inference. The models show length-generalization failures on sequences longer than those seen in training, but improve after being exposed to longer, exhaustive proofs. Backward-chaining proofs yield better generalization than forward-chaining ones, even though forward-chaining proofs are easier to generate. Models that are not trained to produce proofs generalize better on problems built from longer proofs, suggesting they hold efficient but less interpretable internal reasoning strategies.
significance: The results characterize where systematic generalization breaks down in neural proof generation and provide evidence that proof supervision is not required for reasoning, and may even hinder generalization. This matters for the interpretability and reliability of Transformer-based theorem proving and motivates deeper inspection of the reasoning strategies these models actually employ.

aiRole.description: Transformer language models trained by the authors generated natural-language first-order proofs on a logical reasoning task, yielding findings on length generalization, backward- versus forward-chaining proofs, and generalization without proof-generation training.

humanContribution: Humans designed the logical reasoning task and proof representations, trained the Transformer models, and checked the generated proofs for logical consistency and inference accuracy.

zh.title: 用 Transformer 衡量神经证明生成中的系统泛化能力
zh.summary: 本文研究 Transformer 语言模型（TLMs）如何处理以一阶逻辑（first-order logic）证明为基础的自然语言逻辑推理任务，即借助 TLMs 生成自然语言证明的软式定理证明（soft theorem-proving），并对生成证明的逻辑一致性以及最终推理的准确性进行检验。模型在长于训练长度的序列上出现长度泛化问题，但在接触更长、穷尽式证明后泛化性能有所提升。研究发现，模型使用反向链接证明（backward-chaining proofs）时的泛化优于正向链接证明（forward-chaining proofs），尽管生成正向链接证明更容易。未被训练生成证明的模型在涉及更长证明的问题上泛化更好，这表明 Transformer 拥有高效但更难解释的内部推理策略。
zh.significance: 这些结果刻画了神经证明生成中系统泛化（systematic generalization）失效的位置，并提供了证据表明证明监督并非推理的必要条件，甚至可能妨碍泛化。这对基于 Transformer 的定理证明的可解释性与可靠性具有意义，并促使研究者更深入地考察这些模型实际采用的推理策略。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者训练的 Transformer 语言模型在逻辑推理任务上生成自然语言的一阶证明，由此得到关于长度泛化、后向链与前向链证明对比，以及未训练生成证明时的泛化表现等发现。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了逻辑推理任务与证明表示，训练了 Transformer 模型，并检查所生成证明的逻辑一致性与最终推理准确率。

title: AI Feynman 2.0: Pareto-optimal symbolic regression exploiting graph modularity
summary: AI Feynman 2.0 is an improved symbolic regression method that seeks Pareto-optimal formulas, meaning the best accuracy for a given complexity. It typically becomes orders of magnitude more robust to noise and bad data than the previous state of the art and recovers many formulas that earlier methods could not. The approach infers generalized symmetries, or arbitrary modularity in a formula's computational graph, from gradient properties of a fitted neural network. It extends to data available only as samples by using normalizing flows, and it accelerates robust brute-force search with statistical hypothesis testing.
significance: The method advances automated mathematical and scientific discovery by recovering compact formulas from noisy, defective, or sample-only data. Its robustness and ability to exploit modular structure make symbolic regression more practical for discovering interpretable laws in realistic settings where measurements are imperfect.

aiRole.description: The authors present AI Feynman 2.0, an improved symbolic regression method that fits data to Pareto-optimal formulas, is typically orders of magnitude more robust to noise and bad data, and discovers many formulas that stumped previous methods.

humanContribution: Humans designed and built the method, including the neural network fit, generalized symmetry discovery, normalizing flows, and statistical hypothesis testing used to accelerate the search.

zh.title: AI Feynman 2.0：利用图模块化的帕累托最优符号回归
zh.summary: AI Feynman 2.0 是一种改进的符号回归（symbolic regression）方法，旨在寻找帕累托最优（Pareto-optimal）公式，即在给定复杂度下取得最佳精度。与此前最先进方法相比，该方法在噪声和不良数据面前的鲁棒性通常提升数个数量级，并能重新发现许多先前方法无法求解的公式。该方法从拟合神经网络（neural network）的梯度性质中推断广义对称性（generalized symmetries），即公式计算图（computational graph）中的任意模块化结构。借助归一化流（normalizing flows），该方法可推广到仅有样本的概率分布（probability distributions），并运用统计假设检验（statistical hypothesis testing）加速鲁棒的暴力搜索。
zh.significance: 该方法推动了自动化数学发现与科学发现，能够从含噪声、存在缺陷或仅有样本的数据中恢复简洁公式。其鲁棒性以及利用模块化结构的能力，使符号回归更适用于在测量并不完美的现实场景中发现可解释的规律。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者提出 AI Feynman 2.0，这是一种改进的符号回归方法，可将数据拟合为 Pareto 最优公式，通常对噪声和坏数据的鲁棒性高出数个数量级，并能发现许多曾难住此前方法的公式。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计并构建了该方法，包括用于加速搜索的神经网络拟合、广义对称性发现、normalizing flows 与统计假设检验。

title: Graph-to-Tree Neural Networks for Learning Structured Input-Output Translation with Applications to Semantic Parsing and Math Word Problem
summary: The paper introduces Graph2Tree, a Graph2Tree Neural Networks model combining a graph encoder with a hierarchical tree decoder, so that augmented graph-structured inputs are encoded and tree-structured outputs are decoded. Seq2Seq approaches typically either ignore input structure during encoding or flatten outputs into sequences during decoding. Experiments on neural semantic parsing and math word problem solving show the model outperforms or matches state-of-the-art results on both tasks.
significance: Handling structure on both the input and output side is a persistent limitation in Seq2Seq systems for structured translation. A graph-to-tree design that is competitive with state-of-the-art models on semantic parsing and math word problems offers a useful alternative architecture for tasks where mathematical and linguistic objects are inherently non-sequential.

aiRole.description: The paper presents Graph2Tree, a graph-encoder to tree-decoder neural network that encodes structured input and decodes tree-structured output. Experiments show it matches or outperforms state-of-the-art models on neural semantic parsing and math word problem solving.

humanContribution: Humans designed, built and trained the Graph2Tree architecture, curated the task data, and ran extensive experiments evaluating the model on the semantic parsing and math word problem benchmarks.

zh.title: 面向结构化输入输出翻译学习的图到树神经网络及其在语义解析和数学应用题中的应用
zh.summary: 本文提出 Graph2Tree，即一种由图编码器和分层树解码器组成的图到树神经网络（Graph-to-Tree Neural Networks）模型，用于编码增强的图结构（graph）输入并解码树结构（tree）输出。Seq2Seq 方法通常在编码时忽略输入结构，或将输出简单处理为序列。在神经语义解析（semantic parsing）和数学应用题（math word problem）求解上的实验表明，该模型性能超过或持平于现有最优模型。
zh.significance: 在结构化翻译任务中，Seq2Seq 系统难以同时处理输入与输出的结构信息。Graph2Tree 这种在输入和输出两端都保留结构的设计，在语义解析和数学应用题上取得与现有最优模型相当或更优的表现，为处理本质上非序列化的数学和语言对象提供了一种有效的架构选择。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文提出了 Graph2Tree，一种由图编码器和分层树解码器组成的神经网络，可编码图结构输入并解码树结构输出。实验表明，该模型在神经语义解析和数学应用题求解任务上达到或超过了现有最佳模型的性能。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计、构建并训练了 Graph2Tree 架构，整理了任务数据，并进行了大量实验，在语义解析和数学应用题基准上评估该模型。

title: Deriving Theorems in Implicational Linear Logic, Declaratively
summary: The paper addresses generating all theorems of a given size in the implicational fragment of propositional intuitionistic linear logic. It begins by filtering for linearity the proof terms produced by a Prolog-based theorem prover for Implicational Intuitionistic Logic, but the PSPACE-complete check per formula limits this approach to very small formulas. Using the Curry-Howard isomorphism as a bridge between proof terms and theorems, the authors derive step by step an efficient algorithm requiring low polynomial effort per generated theorem. The resulting Prolog program runs in O(N) space for terms of size N and generated in a few hours 7,566,084,686 theorems together with their normal-form proof terms. The work is organized as a literate Prolog program and is fully replicable.
significance: The work replaces a PSPACE-complete per-formula linearity check with a low-polynomial generation method that scales to billions of theorems, enabling the production of large datasets for correctness and scalability testing of linear logic theorem provers and of training data for neural networks tackling theorem proving challenges.

zh.title: 声明式地推导蕴涵线性逻辑中的定理
zh.summary: 本文研究如何生成命题直觉主义线性逻辑（propositional intuitionistic linear logic）蕴涵片段中给定规模的全部定理。研究者先对 Prolog 实现的蕴涵直觉主义逻辑（Implicational Intuitionistic Logic）定理证明器所输出的证明项进行线性过滤，但每个公式所需的判定属于 PSPACE完全（PSPACE-complete），因而该方法仅适用于很小的公式。借助证明项与定理之间由 Curry-Howard 同构（Curry-Howard isomorphism）提供的桥梁，作者逐步导出一种高效算法，每个生成定理仅需低多项式开销。由此得到的 Prolog 程序对规模为 N 的项使用 O(N) 空间，并在数小时内生成了 7,566,084,686 个定理及其范式证明项。该工作以文学化 Prolog（literate Prolog）程序形式组织，结果完全可复现。
zh.significance: 该工作以每个定理低多项式开销的生成方法取代了每个公式一次的 PSPACE完全线性判定，将规模扩展至数十亿定理，从而能够构建用于线性逻辑定理证明器正确性与可扩展性测试的大型数据集，并为应对定理证明挑战的神经网络提供训练数据。

title: INT: An Inequality Benchmark for Evaluating Generalization in Theorem Proving
summary: INT is a benchmark for inequality theorem proving designed to test how well learning-assisted provers generalize beyond their training distribution. Built on a theorem and proof generation procedure whose adjustable parameters define six distinct types of generalization, INT also provides a lightweight, user-friendly proving environment with fast simulations. The paper reports learning-based baselines evaluated along all six generalization dimensions and shows that augmenting the same agents with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) at test time helps them prove new theorems.
significance: Generalizing to theorems unlike those seen during training is a central obstacle in learning-assisted theorem proving. INT offers a controlled way to measure six characteristic generalization challenges in automated theorem proving, while its fast, accessible environment lowers the barrier to both learning-based and search-based experimentation. Demonstrating that MCTS yields additional proved theorems at test time points to a practical route for strengthening prover agents.

title: Premise Selection in Natural Language Mathematical Texts
summary: The paper addresses premise selection in natural language mathematical texts, where conjectures written in natural language and mathematical formulae are used to recommend premises likely useful for proving a statement. It formulates the task as link prediction and applies Deep Convolutional Graph Neural Networks, comparing performance against baselines and showing that a graph structure can yield higher F1-score, especially for multi-hop premise selection.
significance: Selecting relevant premises is a semantically difficult bottleneck for automated mathematical reasoning from informal text, and the work shows that graph-based neural models improve evidence recommendation, particularly when useful premises are reached through multiple hops. This offers a data-driven route toward assisting proof search over natural language mathematical corpora.

aiRole.description: The paper proposes an approach treating natural language premise selection as link prediction using Deep Convolutional Graph Neural Networks, and reports that a graph structure yields higher F1-score, especially for multi-hop premise selection.

zh.title: 自然语言数学文本中的前提选择

title: IsarStep: a Benchmark for High-level Mathematical Reasoning
summary: IsarStep is a benchmark for high-level mathematical reasoning built from a non-synthetic dataset drawn from the largest repository of human expert proofs written in a theorem prover. The task requires a model to fill in a missing intermediate proposition given surrounding proofs, covering undergraduate and research-level mathematics and computer science. Experiments show the task is challenging yet supports non-trivial mathematical reasoning by neural sequence-to-sequence models, and a hierarchical transformer outperforms the transformer baseline.
significance: It gives the field a well-defined, human-derived measure of progress toward the long-term goal of machines generating human-readable proofs automatically, and it shows neural models capture non-trivial reasoning while leaving clear headroom for better architectures.

aiRole.description: The paper introduces the IsarStep benchmark and reports that its neural sequence-to-sequence models capture non-trivial mathematical reasoning, with a designed hierarchical transformer outperforming the transformer baseline on filling in missing intermediate propositions.

humanContribution: Humans built the non-synthetic dataset from a repository of proofs written by human experts in a theorem prover, defined the missing-proposition task, and designed and trained the hierarchical transformer architecture.

zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文提出了 IsarStep 基准，并报告神经序列到序列模型能够捕捉非平凡的数学推理，其中设计的分层 transformer 在填补缺失中间命题的任务上优于 transformer 基线。
zh.humanContribution: 人类从定理证明器中由专家撰写的证明库构建了非合成数据集，定义了填补缺失命题的任务，并设计和训练了分层 transformer 架构。

title: Mathematical Reasoning via Self-supervised Skip-tree Training
summary: The paper asks whether self-supervised language modeling over mathematical formulas can support logical reasoning. It proposes several evaluation tasks for models trained on formal mathematical statements, including type inference, suggesting missing assumptions, and completing equalities, and introduces a novel skip-tree training task. Models trained with skip-tree exhibit strong mathematical reasoning ability and outperform models trained with standard skip-sequence tasks. The study also evaluates conjecture generation by measuring how often predictions are provable and useful within other proofs.
significance: The work supplies concrete reasoning benchmarks and a new training objective for language models over formal mathematics, showing that the choice of self-supervised objective substantially affects downstream reasoning. Its analysis of provability and proof usefulness offers a more meaningful way to judge machine-generated conjectures than surface-level accuracy.

title: Towards Concise, Machine-discovered Proofs of Gödel's Two Incompleteness Theorems
summary: The paper presents MATR, a new framework for automated theorem proving designed to be formalism-agnostic, highly modular, and easy to extend to unusual logics or new reasoning processes. The authors describe MATR's high-level design and implementation details, then define a formalized metalogic suited to proofs of Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems. They report on progress toward semi-autonomously generating proofs of both the First and Second Incompleteness Theorems within MATR, using the framework's adaptability to handle metareasoning.
significance: Machine-discovered proofs of foundational results such as Gödel's two Incompleteness Theorems test whether AI reasoning systems can handle metatheoretic arguments rather than only object-level formalisms. A framework that readily accommodates unusual logics and custom reasoning processes could broaden the range of mathematical domains amenable to automated discovery, while shorter machine-generated proofs may yield new human insights into classical results.

title: Prolog Technology Reinforcement Learning Prover
summary: This work presents a reinforcement learning toolkit for guiding automated theorem proving in the connection calculus. Its core is plCoP, a compact and extensible Prolog-based prover built on the leanCoP implementation, augmented with learning-guided Monte-Carlo Tree Search following the rlCoP system. The toolkit also includes a Python interface linking plCoP to machine learners and an external proof checker that validates plCoP proofs. Evaluated on two benchmarks, the toolkit demonstrates extensibility through two additions: guidance extended to reduction steps, and an extension of the standard leanCoP calculus with rewrite steps and learned guidance for them. The authors argue that the Prolog setting is well suited to combining statistical and symbolic learning methods, and the full toolkit is publicly released.
significance: The toolkit gives researchers an open, compact, and readily extendable platform for combining learned guidance with symbolic connection-calculus proof search. By adding learned guidance for reduction steps and rewrite steps to the leanCoP calculus, the work shows how new inference rules and search heuristics can be incorporated with machine learning, while the external proof checker ensures that learned search still produces verifiable proofs.

aiRole.description: The authors' plCoP toolkit, a Prolog-based automated theorem prover extended with learning-guided Monte-Carlo Tree Search, was evaluated on two benchmarks and demonstrated with learned guidance for reduction steps and for rewrite steps added to the leanCoP calculus.

humanContribution: Humans built the Prolog prover, the Python interface and machine learners, and the external proof checker, and designed the calculus extensions and guidance schemes.

zh.title: Prolog 技术强化学习证明器
zh.summary: 本研究提出了一套用于引导连接演算（connection calculus）中自动定理证明（automated theorem proving）的强化学习（reinforcement learning）工具包。其核心是 plCoP，一个紧凑且易于扩展的基于 Prolog 的自动定理证明器，构建于 leanCoP 的 Prolog 实现之上，并加入了 rlCoP 系统所采用的学习引导蒙特卡洛树搜索（Monte-Carlo Tree Search）。工具包还包括连接 plCoP 与机器学习器的 Python 接口，以及验证 plCoP 证明有效性的外部证明检查器（proof checker）。该工具包在两个基准上进行了评估，并通过两项扩展展示其可扩展性：一是将引导扩展至归约步骤（reduction steps），二是在标准 leanCoP 演算中加入重写步骤（rewrite steps）及其学习引导。研究者认为 Prolog 环境适合结合统计学习与符号学习方法，完整工具包已公开发布。
zh.significance: 该工具包为研究者提供了一个开放、紧凑且易于扩展的平台，用于将学习引导与符号连接演算证明搜索相结合。通过为归约步骤添加学习引导，并在 leanCoP 演算中加入重写步骤，本研究表明新推理规则与搜索启发式可以借助机器学习融入证明搜索；同时，外部证明检查器保证了学习式搜索所产生的证明仍然可验证。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者的 plCoP 工具包是一个基于 Prolog 的自动定理证明器，加入了学习引导的 Monte-Carlo Tree Search，并在两个基准上进行了评估，还展示了为归约步骤以及为 leanCoP 演算新增的重写步骤加入学习引导。

title: Tactic Learning and Proving for the Coq Proof Assistant
summary: The paper presents a machine-learning system for tactic proof search in the Coq Proof Assistant, following a similar approach to the TacticToe project for HOL4. The system learns from earlier tactic scripts and their application to proof states, predicts appropriate tactics, and finds proofs written as tactic scripts. Evaluated on the Coq Standard Library, the predictor identifies the correct tactic for a proof state 23.4% of the time, the proof searcher proves 39.3% of the lemmas fully automatically, and combined with CoqHammer the two systems together prove 56.7% of the library's lemmas.
significance: The results show that learned tactic prediction can drive substantial fully automatic lemma proving in a widely used interactive proof assistant, and that pairing a learned proof search system with a tool such as CoqHammer yields complementary coverage that exceeds either system alone.

title: Towards a Geometry Automated Provers Competition
summary: The paper proposes organizing a competition for geometry automated theorem provers (GATPs) to compare the field's many specific methods and implementations, spanning synthetic, algebraic, and semi-synthetic approaches. Beyond efficiency measures such as CPU time, provers should also be judged on outputs such as visual and/or readable proofs. A competition would give developers a test bench for improving existing systems and proposing new ones, and would produce rankings that users, such as developers of educational e-learning systems, could consult when choosing an implementation for a given intended use.
significance: Geometry automated theorem proving involves many heterogeneous methods and goals, from artificial intelligence research to educational applications, making direct comparison difficult. A standardized competition and ranking would drive improvements and new approaches while giving downstream users an evidence-based way to select the best prover for their application.

zh.title: 迈向几何自动定理证明器竞赛
zh.summary: 本文提出为几何自动定理证明器（geometry automated theorem prover, GATP）组织竞赛，以比较该领域众多的具体方法与实现，涵盖合成式、代数式、半合成式等不同路径。除CPU时间等效率指标外，证明器还应以可视化证明和/或可读证明等输出加以衡量。举办此类竞赛可为开发者提供测试平台，以改进现有证明器并提出新证明器，同时形成排名，供教育电子学习系统开发者等使用者按预期用途选择最佳实现。

title: An Experimental Study of Formula Embeddings for Automated Theorem Proving in First-Order Logic
summary: This paper experimentally compares formula encodings for machine-learning-supported automated theorem proving in first-order logic, contrasting pattern-based embeddings used in current systems with graph-based encodings, most previously untested in this setting. Graph-based embeddings slow encoding but support more efficient search and produce simpler proofs. The study evaluates several performance dimensions beyond proof completion rate.
significance: The results give empirical guidance for choosing representations in neural-guided theorem proving, showing that more complex graph encodings can buy search quality and proof simplicity at a runtime cost, while the broader evaluation framework helps direct future research.

title: Beyond Notations: Hygienic Macro Expansion for Theorem Proving Languages
summary: This paper proposes a hygienic macro system for interactive theorem provers, drawing on ideas from the Scheme family of programming languages. It addresses two problems at once: the inadequacy of ad hoc syntax-sugar substitutions for building reusable library abstractions, and accidental name capture in tactic languages. The approach is extended to type-directed macro expansion, yielding a uniform system spanning simple syntax sugar through elaboration of previously built-in syntax. The system is implemented and integrated into Lean 4, and is designed to be simple enough for adoption in other systems.
significance: Extensible syntax and predictable macro behavior are foundational to library engineering and tactic development in interactive theorem provers. By unifying hygienic and type-directed macro expansion and integrating it into Lean 4, this work offers a practical route to reducing library redundancy, eliminating subtle name-capture bugs, and supporting richer abstraction mechanisms across theorem proving languages.

zh.title: 超越记号：定理证明语言的卫生宏展开
zh.summary: 本文受 Scheme 编程语言家族的启发，为交互式定理证明器（interactive theorem provers, ITPs）提出了一套卫生宏系统（hygienic macro system）。该系统同时解决两个问题：以临时的语法糖（syntax sugar）替换来构建可复用库抽象的机制过于简陋，以及策略语言（tactic languages）中出现的意外名字捕获（accidental name capture）。作者将该方法扩展至类型导向的宏展开（type-directed macro expansion），形成一套统一系统，覆盖从最简单的语法糖到对以往内置语法的精化（elaboration）。该宏系统已实现并集成到定理证明器 Lean 4 的新版本中，且足够简洁，易于集成到其他系统。
zh.significance: 可扩展语法与行为可预期的宏机制，是交互式定理证明器中库工程与策略开发的基础。通过统一卫生宏展开与类型导向的宏展开并将其集成到 Lean 4，这项工作提供了一条切实可行的路径，可减少库中的冗余，消除隐蔽的名字捕获错误，并在定理证明语言中支持更丰富的抽象机制。

title: Subsumption Demodulation in First-Order Theorem Proving
summary: The paper introduces subsumption demodulation, a new simplification inference rule that improves reasoning with conditional equalities in superposition-based first-order theorem proving without radical changes to the calculus. The rule is implemented in the prover Vampire via a new clause index and an adapted multi-literal matching component. Experiments on the TPTP and SMT-LIB repositories show that the extension solves many problems beyond the reach of state-of-the-art reasoners.
significance: Stronger handling of conditional equalities directly benefits applications of automated reasoning to software analysis. The successful integration into Vampire, together with broad benchmark gains, shows the rule is practically usable rather than merely theoretical.

aiRole.description: The Vampire theorem prover, extended with the new subsumption demodulation inference rule, solves many previously unsolved problems from the TPTP and SMT-LIB repositories. The paper also shows that subsumption demodulation is a simplification rule requiring no radical changes to the superposition calculus.

humanContribution: Humans introduced the subsumption demodulation inference rule and established its simplification properties, then built and implemented the technique in Vampire via a new clause index and an adapted multi-literal matching component, and ran the experiments.

zh.title: 一阶定理证明中的子句包含去调制
zh.summary: 本文提出一种新的简化推理规则，称为子句包含去调制（subsumption demodulation），用于改进基于叠加（superposition）的一阶定理证明（first-order theorem proving）中对条件等式的推理，且无需对底层超演算做根本性改动。该规则通过新增子句索引并改造多文字匹配组件，在定理证明器 Vampire 中实现。在 TPTP 和 SMT-LIB 上的实验表明，该扩展能解决许多现有先进推理器无法解决的问题。
zh.significance: 对条件等式更强的处理能力可直接惠及自动推理在软件分析中的应用。该规则成功集成到 Vampire 并在广泛基准测试中取得进展，说明其具有实际可用性，而不仅是理论成果。

title: A Formal Proof of PAC Learnability for Decision Stumps
summary: The authors present a formal proof in Lean of probably approximately correct (PAC) learnability for decision stumps, a classic result in machine learning theory bounding the error probability of a simple classifier. Despite its apparent simplicity on paper, the proof requires careful analytic and measure-theoretic reasoning. The construction separates deterministic properties of the learning function from measurability proofs and probabilistic analysis.
significance: The work demonstrates that a standard machine learning theory guarantee can be carried through in full formal detail, exposing the analysis and measure theory hidden by informal arguments. Its decomposition of deterministic, measurability, and probability components may inform future formalizations of learning-theoretic results.

zh.title: 决策树桩 PAC 可学习性的形式化证明
zh.summary: 研究者给出了决策树桩（decision stump）这一概念类满足 PAC 可学习性（PAC learnability）的 Lean 形式化证明。这是机器学习理论（machine learning theory）中的经典结果，用于界定一种简单分类器的错误概率。尽管论文上的证明看似简单，完整形式化时会出现分析学与测度论（measure theory）层面的微妙问题。证明的结构将关于学习函数确定性性质的推理与可测性证明及概率分析分离开来。
zh.significance: 该工作表明，机器学习理论中的一条标准保证可以被完整地形式化，从而显露出非形式论证所掩盖的分析学与测度论细节。其将确定性性质、可测性与概率三部分分离开的构造方式，可为今后学习理论结果的形式化提供参考。

title: Predicting Algorithm Classes for Programming Word Problems
summary: This paper introduces algorithm class prediction for programming word problems, defining classes by the algorithms needed to solve each natural-language problem. It releases four new datasets, two multiclass sets with 550 and 1159 problems and two multilabel sets with 3737 and 3960 problems, and casts the task as text classification using neural and non-neural models. The best classifier reaches 62.7 percent accuracy on the five-class dataset Codeforces Multiclass-5 (CFMC5), trailing human performance by only 9 percent. Code and datasets are made publicly available.
significance: The work reports what appear to be the first results on this task, connecting natural-language problem statements to algorithm design categories. The released datasets and code provide benchmarks for measuring how well models infer the algorithmic approach a problem requires, while the human comparison situates current model capability against people.

aiRole.description: The authors define the task of algorithm class prediction for programming word problems, release four datasets, and train neural and non-neural classifiers whose best model reaches 62.7 percent accuracy on the Codeforces Multiclass-5 dataset, about 9 percent below human performance.

title: A Henkin-style completeness proof for the modal logic S5
summary: This paper formalizes in Lean a Henkin-style completeness proof for the propositional modal logic S5, closely following Hughes and Cresswell but using a system best described as a Mendelson system augmented with axiom schemes for K, T, S4, and B and with necessitation as a rule of inference. The language has false and implication as its only primitive connectives and necessity as its only primitive modal operator. The full source code is available at https://github.com/bbentzen/mpl/ and has been typechecked with Lean 3.4.2.
significance: A machine-checked Henkin-style completeness proof for S5 makes a standard textbook argument available in verified form, reducing the risk of overlooked gaps in the meta-argument. The modified axiomatization shows that the formalization adapts the classical proof to a Mendelson-style presentation, and the published Lean 3 code offers a reusable artifact for further work on modal logic formalization.

zh.title: 模态逻辑S5的一种亨金风格完备性证明
zh.summary: 本文使用 Lean 定理证明器形式化了命题模态逻辑（propositional modal logic）S5 的亨金风格（Henkin-style）完备性证明（completeness proof）。所形式化的证明接近 Hughes 和 Cresswell 的论证，但该系统采用不同的公理选择，更恰当地描述为在 Mendelson 系统上补充 K、T、S4 和 B 的公理模式，并将必然化规则作为推理规则。语言仅以假和蕴涵作为基本逻辑联结词，以必然作为唯一的基本模态算子。完整源代码发布于 https://github.com/bbentzen/mpl/，并已用 Lean 3.4.2 通过类型检查。
zh.significance: 以机器检查的方式形式化 S5 的亨金风格完备性证明，使经典教科书中的论证以已验证的形式呈现，降低了元论证中遗漏漏洞的风险。这套经过调整的公理化表明，形式化工作能够将经典证明改写为 Mendelson 风格的表述，而公开的 Lean 3 代码也为模态逻辑形式化的后续工作提供了可复用的材料。

title: Mathematical Reasoning in Latent Space
summary: This work presents a simple experiment testing whether neural networks can carry out several steps of approximate reasoning in a fixed-dimensional latent space. Formal statements are embedded as vectors designed to capture their semantic features, specifically whether they can be rewritten by other theorems, and graph neural networks are trained to predict rewrite success and to propagate predicted embeddings across multiple rewrite steps. Deduction sequences performed in the latent space are checked against the corresponding sequences carried out with real formulas. The experiments show that graph neural networks make non-trivial predictions even after several steps of propagation, with the corpus covering a wide range of mathematical disciplines.
significance: The results indicate that deduction in latent space is feasible in general, suggesting that symbolic mathematical reasoning could be performed on compressed vector representations rather than only through explicit manipulation of formulas. This points toward scalable neural theorem reasoning methods that combine semantic embeddings with multi-step inference.

zh.title: 潜空间中的数学推理
zh.summary: 本研究设计并开展了一项简单实验，测试神经网络能否在固定维度的潜空间（latent space）中完成多步近似推理。形式化语句被嵌入为向量，用于刻画其语义特征，即该语句能否被其他定理重写，研究者使用图神经网络（graph neural networks）预测重写是否成功，并在多个重写步骤之间传播预测得到的嵌入表示。潜空间中执行的演绎序列会与使用真实公式执行的对应重写序列进行核对。实验表明，即使在传播多步之后，图神经网络仍能做出非平凡的预测，且语料涵盖广泛的数学学科领域。
zh.significance: 实验结果表明潜空间中的演绎总体上是可行的，这意味着符号化的数学推理有可能在压缩后的向量表示上完成，而不必只依赖对公式的显式操作。这为结合语义嵌入与多步推理的可扩展神经定理推理方法提供了方向。

title: Reconstructing veriT Proofs in Isabelle/HOL
summary: The paper presents a procedure in the proof assistant Isabelle/HOL that reconstructs proofs produced by the veriT satisfiability modulo theories solver, which is part of the smt tactic. It details the architecture of an improved reconstruction method and the design challenges involved. Experiments show that the veriT-powered smt tactic is regularly suggested by Sledgehammer as the fastest way to automatically solve proof goals.
significance: Automatically found proofs must be checked inside the proof assistant to preserve the trustworthiness of the overall proof, and veriT is one of the main external solvers used by interactive theorem provers. A more effective reconstruction pipeline lowers this verification overhead and strengthens the practical reliability of Sledgehammer and the smt tactic in everyday formal development.

aiRole.description: The paper presents a reconstruction procedure in Isabelle/HOL for proofs generated by the SMT solver veriT, and its experiments show the veriT-powered smt tactic is regularly suggested by Sledgehammer as the fastest method to automatically solve proof goals.

title: EKSTRAKTO A tool to reconstruct Dedukti proofs from TSTP files (extended abstract)
summary: EKSTRAKTO extracts TPTP subproblems from TSTP proof traces and reconstructs complete Dedukti proofs by calling automated provers that can emit Dedukti proofs, such as ZenonModulo or ArchSAT. The tool is agnostic to the proof calculus of the prover producing the trace and can be paired with different provers. Applied to traces from automated theorem provers on the CNF problems of the TPTP library, it reconstructed proofs for a large proportion of them, substantially increasing the number of Dedukti proofs available for those problems.
significance: Automated prover traces are typically incomplete and hard to check or reuse in proof assistants. Reconstructing them in Dedukti yields proofs that can be translated to Coq, HOL, Lean, Matita, and PVS, while the tool's prover-agnostic design makes it applicable across trace formats. The reported results significantly expand machine-checkable proof coverage of the TPTP CNF problem set.

title: Generating theorem proving procedures from axioms of Truncated Predicate Calculus
summary: The paper presents a new approach to automated theorem proving in which polynomial-cost procedures that recognize sentences belonging to a given theory are generated directly from a set of axioms of Truncated Predicate Calculus, a subset of standard predicate calculus. The approach notes that a sentence is true if and only if its negation cannot be proved, and several example problems are included to demonstrate performance.
significance: Deriving theorem proving procedures automatically from axioms could reduce the manual engineering effort behind prover tools and yield recognizers with polynomial cost for theories over this fragment of predicate calculus, offering a tractable route to automated reasoning with worked examples.

zh.title: 从截断谓词演算的公理生成定理证明程序
zh.summary: 本文提出一种自动定理证明（automated theorem proving）的新方法：以所谓截断谓词演算（Truncated Predicate Calculus，标准谓词演算（predicate calculus）的一个子集）的一组公理为基础，生成判定语句是否属于某一理论的多项式代价程序。文中指出，一个语句为真当且仅当其否定不可被证明，并给出若干示例问题以展示该方法的效果。
zh.significance: 从公理自动生成定理证明程序，有望减少证明器工具背后的手工构造工作，并为该谓词演算片段上的理论提供多项式代价的判定程序，为自动推理提供一条可计算的路径，且附有具体算例。

title: Modeling Intra-Relation in Math Word Problems with Different Functional Multi-Head Attentions
summary: This paper proposes a group attention mechanism built from different functional multi-head attentions to capture global features, quantity-related features, quantity-pair features, and question-related features in math word problems, where generic deep learning feature extraction is not tailored to the task. The method significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches, raising accuracy from 66.9% to 69.5% on Math23K with a training-test split, from 65.8% to 66.9% on Math23K with 5-fold cross-validation, and from 69.2% to 76.1% on MAWPS.
significance: Designing attention heads around the structural features of math word problems, rather than relying on generic feature extraction, delivers consistent gains on standard benchmarks. The improvement on MAWPS is especially large, indicating that modeling intra-relation structure such as quantity pairs and question relevance is a productive direction for automated math word problem solving.

aiRole.description: The authors' deep learning model with a group attention mechanism for math word problems achieved improved benchmark accuracy on Math23K and MAWPS over previous state-of-the-art methods.

humanContribution: The humans designed the group attention mechanism and model architecture, trained the system, and evaluated it on the Math23K and MAWPS benchmarks.

zh.title: 用不同功能的多头注意力对数学应用题中的内部关系进行建模
zh.summary: 本文提出一种群注意力机制，由具有不同功能的多头注意力组成，分别提取数学应用题（math word problems, MWPs）中的全局特征、与数量相关的特征、数量对特征以及与问题相关的特征，以弥补通用深度学习模型在特征提取上未针对数学应用题专门设计的不足。实验结果表明，该方法显著优于此前的最优方法：在 Math23K 训练-测试集划分下准确率由 66.9% 提升至 69.5%，在 Math23K 5 折交叉验证下由 65.8% 提升至 66.9%，在 MAWPS 上由 69.2% 提升至 76.1%。
zh.significance: 围绕数学应用题的结构特征设计注意力头，而非依赖通用特征提取，可在标准基准上取得一致提升。MAWPS 上的提升尤为显著，这说明对数量对和问题相关性等内部关系结构进行建模，是自动求解数学应用题的一条有效方向。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者提出的深度学习模型采用群组注意力机制解决数学应用题，在 Math23K 和 MAWPS 基准测试上的准确率超过此前的最优方法。
zh.humanContribution: 研究人员设计了群组注意力机制与模型架构，训练该系统，并在 Math23K 与 MAWPS 基准上对其进行了评估。

title: Semantically-Aligned Equation Generation for Solving and Reasoning Math Word Problems
summary: This paper proposes a neural math solver for math word problems that treats equation generation as a bridge between the semantic and symbolic worlds. Built on an encoder-decoder framework, the encoder models the semantics of the problem text while the decoder tracks the semantic meanings of symbols generated so far and selects the next symbol accordingly. Preliminary experiments on the Math23K dataset show the model outperforming both the state-of-the-art single model and the best non-retrieval-based model by about 10% in accuracy.
significance: Tying symbol generation to semantic meaning offers a principled way to connect natural language understanding with equation construction in math word problem solving, and the reported gains on Math23K suggest this semantic-symbolic alignment is a promising direction for improving neural reasoning over quantitative text.

aiRole.description: The paper's neural encoder-decoder math solver generates equations for math word problems and achieved about 10% higher accuracy than the state-of-the-art single model and the best non-retrieval-based model on Math23K.

humanContribution: The researchers designed, built and trained the semantically-aligned encoder-decoder model and evaluated it through preliminary experiments on the Math23K dataset.

zh.title: 面向数学应用题求解与推理的语义对齐方程生成
zh.summary: 本文提出了一种求解数学应用题的神经网络求解器，将方程生成视为连接语义世界与符号世界的桥梁。该模型基于 encoder-decoder 框架，其中编码器负责理解题目的语义，解码器则跟踪已生成符号的语义含义，并据此决定下一个生成的符号。在 Math23K 数据集上的初步实验表明，该模型的准确率比当前最好的单一模型和最好的非检索式模型高出约 10%。
zh.significance: 将符号生成与语义含义相结合，为数学应用题求解中连接自然语言理解与方程构建提供了一条有原则的途径。Math23K 上报告的性能提升表明，这种语义与符号的对齐是提升神经网络对量化文本推理能力的一个有前景的方向。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 该论文提出的神经编码器-解码器数学求解器为数学应用题生成方程，在Math23K上比最先进的单一模型和最佳非检索模型准确率高出约10%。
zh.humanContribution: 研究人员设计、构建并训练了该语义对齐的编码器-解码器模型，并在Math23K数据集上进行了初步实验评估。

title: Graph Representations for Higher-Order Logic and Theorem Proving
summary: This paper introduces the first use of graph neural networks (GNNs) for higher-order proof search and reports improvements over state-of-the-art results on the HOList benchmark. Motivated by the absence of a well-established method for converting higher-order logic formulas into graph-based form, the authors consider several graphical representations of higher-order logic and evaluate them for higher-order theorem proving.
significance: Turning formulas into graph representations is a key bottleneck for applying graph learning to formal reasoning. Results showing that GNNs can beat existing systems on HOList indicate that graph-based encodings are viable in the highly expressive higher-order setting, and could help build stronger automated theorem provers.

aiRole.description: The paper's graph neural network system is reported to improve upon state-of-the-art results on the HOList benchmark for higher-order proof search, the first use of GNNs for this task.

humanContribution: Humans designed several graphical representations of higher-order logic, built and trained the GNN models, and evaluated the representations against the HOList benchmark.

zh.title: 高阶逻辑（higher-order logic）与定理证明（theorem proving）的图表示
zh.summary: 本文首次将图神经网络（GNN）用于高阶证明搜索（proof search），并在 HOList 基准上取得了超越当前最佳水平的结果。由于目前仍缺乏将高阶逻辑公式转化为图表示的公认方法，研究者考察了高阶逻辑的多种图形化表示，并针对高阶定理证明（theorem proving）任务对它们进行了评测。
zh.significance: 将公式转化为图表示，是把图学习应用于形式化推理的关键瓶颈。GNN 在 HOList 上超越现有系统的实验结果表明，在表达能力极强的高阶设定中，基于图的编码方案是可行的，并有望帮助构建更强的自动定理证明器。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文报告其图神经网络系统在 HOList 高阶定理证明基准上超越了当前最优结果，这是 GNN 首次用于高阶证明搜索。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了高阶逻辑的多种图表示，构建并训练了 GNN 模型，并在 HOList 基准上对这些表示进行评估。

title: Isabelle technology for the Archive of Formal Proofs with application to MMT
summary: This overview reports on the Isabelle technology underlying the Archive of Formal Proofs as of Isabelle2019. Interactive development and quasi-interactive builds place heavy scalability demands on Isabelle/HOL, Isabelle/ML, and Isabelle/Scala, integrated within Isabelle/PIDE, the Prover IDE. Notable add-ons include prover session exports and headless PIDE for automated updates driven by semantic information. Isabelle/MMT exemplifies the technology by converting all of Isabelle plus the AFP into OMDoc and RDF triples, while the same technology is readily reusable for other applications.
significance: Continuous AFP growth drives ongoing Isabelle performance improvements needed for large-scale interactive and quasi-interactive builds. The reported tooling supports semantically informed automation and enables formal mathematical knowledge to be exported and exchanged through Isabelle/MMT, OMDoc, and RDF, with straightforward reuse in other applications.

zh.title: 用于形式化证明档案库（Archive of Formal Proofs, AFP）的 Isabelle 技术及其在 MMT 中的应用
zh.summary: 本综述报告 Isabelle2019 时期支撑形式化证明档案库（Archive of Formal Proofs, AFP）的 Isabelle 技术。交互式开发与准交互式构建任务对 Isabelle/HOL、Isabelle/ML 与 Isabelle/Scala 提出显著的可扩展性要求，这些组件集成于 Isabelle/PIDE（Prover IDE，即定理证明器集成开发环境）。该版本的重要补充包括证明器会话导出与无头 PIDE，后者支持基于语义信息的自动更新。Isabelle/MMT 是一个示例应用，可将整个 Isabelle 及 AFP 转换为 OMDoc 与 RDF 三元组；将这套 Isabelle 技术复用于其他应用也较为直接。
zh.significance: 形式化证明档案库（Archive of Formal Proofs, AFP）的持续增长推动了 Isabelle 的性能改进，而这是支撑大规模交互式与准交互式构建的必要条件。文中所述工具支持基于语义信息的自动化，并通过 Isabelle/MMT、OMDoc 与 RDF 实现形式化数学知识的导出与交换，且可直接复用于其他应用。

title: A formalization of forcing and the unprovability of the continuum hypothesis
summary: The paper presents a formalization of forcing via Boolean-valued models in the Lean 3 theorem prover. It includes the fundamental theorem of forcing and a deep embedding of first-order logic together with a Boolean-valued soundness theorem. As an application, the construction is specialized to the Boolean algebra of regular opens of the Cantor space 2^{ω_2 × ω}, and the failure of the continuum hypothesis in the resulting model is formally verified, supporting the title's unprovability claim for CH.
significance: Forcing is central to modern set theory and independence results, yet it has been among the harder techniques to formalize in proof assistants. A machine-checked treatment of Boolean-valued forcing, including the fundamental theorem and a deep embedding of first-order logic with soundness, provides reusable infrastructure for verifying set-theoretic independence. The formal verification of the failure of the continuum hypothesis in a concrete model demonstrates that this framework scales to significant mathematical arguments in Lean 3.

zh.title: 强迫法形式化与连续统假设的不可证性
zh.summary: 本文展示了在 Lean 3 定理证明器中利用布尔值模型（Boolean-valued models）对强迫法（forcing）进行形式化。工作包含强迫法基本定理（fundamental theorem of forcing），以及一阶逻辑（first-order logic）的深层嵌入（deep embedding）与布尔值可靠性定理（Boolean-valued soundness theorem）。作为应用，作者将构造特化到康托尔空间（Cantor space）2^{ω_2 × ω} 的正则开集（regular opens）构成的布尔代数上，并形式化验证了所得模型中连续统假设（continuum hypothesis）的失效，从而支撑标题所述的连续统假设不可证性结论。
zh.significance: 强迫法是现代集合论与独立性结果的核心工具，却一直是定理证明器中较难形式化的方法之一。对布尔值强迫法的机器检查处理，包括强迫法基本定理与一阶逻辑深层嵌入的可靠性，为验证集合论独立性结果提供了可复用的基础设施。在 Lean 3 中形式化验证具体模型中连续统假设的失效，表明该框架能够处理重要的实质性数学论证。

title: Hammering Mizar by Learning Clause Guidance
summary: The paper reports a large improvement in hammer-style proof automation over large interactive theorem proving (ITP) libraries by combining machine learning with automated theorem proving. The authors integrate state-of-the-art machine learners into the E automated theorem prover and develop methods that enable learning and efficient internal clause guidance across the whole Mizar library. The trained system improves the real-time performance of E on the Mizar library by 70% in a single-strategy setting.
significance: Hammer-style automation is the workhorse for finding proofs over large formal libraries, and its usefulness is limited by premise and clause selection. Making learned guidance run efficiently inside E across an entire library such as Mizar shows that data-driven guidance can be scaled to very large formal corpora, and the 70% real-time speedup translates into substantially more goals being discharged within practical time limits, strengthening automation for formal mathematics.

zh.title: 通过学习型子句引导锤击Mizar
zh.summary: 本文通过将机器学习与自动定理证明（automated theorem proving）相结合，在大型交互式定理证明（interactive theorem proving, ITP）库上实现了锤（hammer）式证明自动化性能的大幅提升。作者将最先进的机器学习器集成到E自动定理证明器中，并开发出可在整个Mizar库上进行学习与高效内部子句引导的方法。经训练的系统在单一策略设定下将E在Mizar库上的实时性能提升了70%。

title: Formal Proofs of Tarjan's Algorithm in Why3, Coq, and Isabelle
summary: The paper presents a formal proof of correctness for Tarjan's algorithm, a non-trivial algorithm from graph theory, developed independently in three proof assistants: Why3, Coq, and Isabelle. The work serves as a comparison of how these systems support formalizing and verifying the same algorithm.
significance: Comparing provers on a single non-trivial formalization exposes the practical strengths and differences of each proof assistant, guiding tool choice for formal verification work and informing the development of proof assistant infrastructure and automation.

zh.title: Why3、Coq和Isabelle中Tarjan算法的形式化证明
zh.summary: 本文给出了Tarjan算法（Tarjan's algorithm）正确性的形式化证明（formal proof），该算法是图论（graph theory）中一个非平凡的算法，研究者分别在三种证明助手（proof assistants）Why3、Coq和Isabelle中完成了这一工作。该研究也构成了对这三种系统在形式化和验证同一算法方面的比较。
zh.significance: 针对同一个非平凡的形式化任务比较不同的证明器，能够揭示各证明助手在实践中的优势与差异，为形式化验证工作中的工具选择提供依据，同时推动证明助手基础设施和自动化能力的发展。

title: Formalizing computability theory via partial recursive functions
summary: This work extends the mathlib library of Lean with foundations of computability theory, using primitive recursive functions and partial recursive functions as the main objects. A constructive encoding of partial functions makes them executable when the relevant programs provably halt. Main theorems include the construction of a universal partial recursive function and a proof of the undecidability of the halting problem, while type class inference supplies Gödel numberings on demand and hides the encoding details.
significance: A formalized computability core in a widely used library lets users of Lean verify claims about programs, their executions, and undecidability, with executable partial functions supporting both proof and computation. The type class-based treatment of Gödel numberings separates abstract theory from concrete encodings, making the development reusable across models.

zh.title: 基于部分递归函数的可计算性理论形式化
zh.summary: 本工作为 Lean 定理证明器的 mathlib 库扩充了可计算性理论（computability theory）的基础，以原始递归函数（primitive recursive functions）和部分递归函数（partial recursive functions）为主要研究对象。作者采用偏函数的构造式编码，使得当相关程序可证明停机时这些函数仍可执行。主要定理包括通用部分递归函数（universal partial recursive function）的构造以及停机问题（halting problem）不可判定性的证明；类型类推断按需提供 Gödel 编号，并将编码细节封装起来。
zh.significance: 在广泛使用的库中形式化可计算性核心，使 Lean 用户能够验证关于程序、程序执行与不可判定性的结论，而可执行的偏函数同时支撑证明与计算。基于类型类的 Gödel 编号处理将抽象理论与具体编码分离，提高了开发成果在不同模型间的可复用性。

title: Comparison of Two Theorem Provers: Isabelle/HOL and Coq
summary: This paper compares two widely used automated theorem proving tools, Isabelle/HOL and Coq, with respect to expressiveness, limitations, and usability. It first introduces the foundations of formal systems and automated deduction theory along with their main problems and challenges, then details the most notable features of each prover, supported by illustrative proof examples. The motivation is the risk of error accumulation in large, complex mathematics and the practical use of mechanical verification for engineering tasks such as software or algorithm security properties.
significance: A side-by-side evaluation of Isabelle/HOL and Coq on expressiveness, limitations, and usability gives researchers and engineers a basis for choosing a proof assistant and highlights the trade-offs between the two ecosystems. The illustrative proof examples make the comparison concrete for readers learning formal methods or applying them to verify software and algorithms.

zh.title: 两种定理证明器的比较：Isabelle/HOL 与 Coq
zh.summary: 本文对两种广泛使用的自动定理证明（automated theorem proving）工具 Isabelle/HOL 与 Coq 进行比较，考察表达能力、局限性与易用性。文章首先介绍形式系统（formal system）与自动演绎理论的基础及其主要问题与挑战，随后在示例证明的支撑下详细比较所选定理证明器（theorem prover）最值得注意的特性。研究动机在于数学规模与复杂度上升所带来的错误累积风险，以及对软件系统或算法安全性质进行机械验证等工程实践需求。
zh.significance: 从表达能力、局限性与易用性方面对 Isabelle/HOL 与 Coq 进行并列评估，可为研究者与工程师选择证明助手提供依据，并凸显两大生态之间的取舍。文中给出的示例证明使这一比较具体可见，有助于学习形式方法或将其用于软件与算法验证的读者。

title: Proof Simplification and Automated Theorem Proving
summary: This paper describes a technique for simplifying proofs that automated theorem provers first generate, which are typically far from optimal by any measure of simplicity. The author presents the method as an invitation to a broader and still open question: what constitutes a reasonable measure of proof simplicity.
significance: Automatically generated proofs are often needlessly complex, limiting their readability and reuse in formal mathematics. Making them simpler is useful in itself, and defining sensible measures of proof simplicity remains an open problem that could shape how prover output is evaluated and improved.

zh.title: 证明简化与自动定理证明
zh.summary: 本文描述了一种简化证明（proof simplification）的技术，这些证明由自动定理证明器（automated theorem prover）初步生成，按任何简洁性标准衡量都远非最优。作者将这一方法作为引子，指向一个更广泛且仍未解决的问题：何为合理的证明简洁性度量。
zh.significance: 自动生成的证明往往过于复杂，妨碍其在形式数学（formal mathematics）中的可读性与复用。简化这些证明本身就有价值，而如何定义合理的证明简洁性度量仍是开放问题，可能影响对证明器输出的评估与改进方式。

title: Neural Math Word Problem Solver with Reinforcement Learning
summary: The paper addresses two failure modes of sequence-to-sequence models for math word problems, namely generating spurious numbers and placing numbers incorrectly, by extending the model with a copy and alignment mechanism called CASS. Training uses reinforcement learning to directly optimize solution accuracy, avoiding the train-test discrepancy of maximum likelihood estimation, which maximizes equation likelihood while evaluation is based on non-differentiable solution accuracy. Experiments show that copy and alignment fix both failure modes, that reinforcement learning outperforms maximum likelihood on this task, and that feeding the neural model's output as a feature into a feature-based model yields a combination that significantly surpasses state-of-the-art results.
significance: The work offers concrete fixes for well-documented error patterns in neural solvers for math word problems and demonstrates a principled training objective that matches the evaluation metric rather than a surrogate. The complementarity between neural and feature-based approaches suggests that hybrid pipelines can materially raise accuracy on this benchmark class of mathematical reasoning tasks.

aiRole.description: The authors' CASS sequence-to-sequence model with copy and alignment mechanisms, trained by reinforcement learning, generates equations for math word problems and, combined with a feature-based model, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solution accuracy.

humanContribution: Humans built and trained the CASS model, designed its copy and alignment mechanisms and reinforcement learning objective, ran the experimental analysis, and incorporated the model output into a feature-based model.

zh.title: 基于强化学习的神经数学应用题求解器
zh.summary: 本文针对序列到序列模型（sequence-to-sequence model）求解数学应用题时的两类失败模式展开研究，即生成虚假数字和数字位置错误，并通过在模型中引入复制与对齐机制（copy and alignment mechanism）提出 CASS 模型加以改进。训练采用强化学习（reinforcement learning）直接优化求解正确率，从而避免了极大似然估计（maximum likelihood estimation）的训练-测试不一致问题：极大似然估计在训练时以最大化方程似然为目标，而评测指标是测试时不可微的求解正确率。实验结果表明，复制与对齐机制能有效解决上述两类问题；在该任务上强化学习优于极大似然训练；将神经模型的输出作为特征融入基于特征的模型，二者结合后的效果显著超过当时最佳结果。
zh.significance: 该研究为神经网络求解数学应用题中常见的错误模式提供了具体改进方案，并展示了与评测指标一致的训练目标，而非依赖替代目标函数。神经模型与基于特征的模型之间的互补性表明，混合流水线能够在这一类数学推理任务上实质性地提升准确率。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 作者提出的 CASS 序列到序列模型结合复制与对齐机制，并以强化学习训练，可为数学文字题生成方程；与基于特征的模型结合后，解题准确率显著超过当前最好结果。
zh.humanContribution: 人类构建并训练了 CASS 模型，设计了其复制与对齐机制及强化学习目标，进行了实验分析，并将模型输出融入基于特征的模型。

title: Towards Neural Theorem Proving at Scale
summary: This work addresses the computational bottleneck of the Neural Theorem Prover (NTP) model proposed by Rocktäschel and Riedel (2017), a continuous relaxation of the Prolog backward chaining algorithm in which unification between terms is replaced by similarity between their embedding representations. Answering a query requires enumerating all possible proof paths and aggregating the results, which becomes infeasible even on small knowledge bases. The authors observe that restricting attention to proof paths with the highest proof scores accurately approximates the model's inference process, enabling inference and learning on previously impracticable knowledge bases.
significance: The intractability of aggregating over all proof paths has kept neural models that jointly learn representations and reason from scaling to real-world datasets. Pruning to top-scoring proof paths removes this obstacle while preserving accuracy, making the NTP approach usable on knowledge bases far larger than before and bringing end-to-end neural theorem proving closer to practical application.

aiRole.description: The paper reports that the Neural Theorem Prover (NTP) system, restricted to proof paths with the highest proof scores, accurately approximates full inference and can now answer queries and learn on previously impracticable knowledge bases.

humanContribution: Humans designed the proof-path approximation, built and trained the NTP model, and evaluated it on knowledge bases.

zh.title: 迈向大规模神经定理证明（theorem proving）
zh.summary: 本工作针对 Rocktäschel 与 Riedel（2017）提出的神经定理证明器（Neural Theorem Prover, NTP）模型所面临的计算瓶颈。该模型是对 Prolog 反向链（backward chaining）算法的连续松弛，其中项之间的合一（unification）被其嵌入表示之间的相似度所取代。回答一个给定查询时，模型需要考虑所有可能的证明路径并对结果进行聚合，这即使在小型知识库（Knowledge Base, KB）上也很快变得不可行。作者观察到，仅考虑证明分数最高的那些证明路径即可准确近似该模型的推理过程，从而在先前不可行的 KB 上实现推理与学习。
zh.significance: 对所有证明路径进行聚合的不可行性，一直阻碍着联合学习表示与推理的神经模型扩展到真实世界数据集。只保留高分证明路径的剪枝方法在保持准确性的同时消除了这一障碍，使 NTP 方法能够在远大于以往的知识库上使用，也让端到端的神经定理证明更接近实际应用。
zh.aiRoleDescription: 论文报告称，只考虑具有最高证明分数的证明路径的 Neural Theorem Prover (NTP) 系统能够准确近似完整推理过程，并可在此前难以处理的知识库上回答查询和进行学习。
zh.humanContribution: 人类设计了证明路径近似方法，构建并训练了 NTP 模型，并在知识库上进行了评估。

title: Natural Deduction and the Isabelle Proof Assistant
summary: The paper describes the Natural Deduction Assistant (NaDeA) and its interfaces with the Isabelle proof assistant. NaDeA uses a generated prover that has been verified in Isabelle to give feedback to the student, and for each formula the student proves it generates a theorem that can be verified in Isabelle.
significance: The work links natural deduction pedagogy to formal verification, giving students feedback backed by a verified prover and turning every proved formula into a theorem that Isabelle can check, strengthening both trust and reusability of student proofs.

zh.title: 自然演绎与 Isabelle 证明助手
zh.summary: 本文描述了自然演绎助手（Natural Deduction Assistant, NaDeA）及其与 Isabelle 证明助手之间的接口。NaDeA 借助一个已在 Isabelle 中验证的生成式证明器为学生提供反馈，并针对学生证明的每个公式生成一个可在 Isabelle 中验证的定理。
zh.significance: 该工作把自然演绎教学与形式化验证联系起来：学生获得的反馈由经过验证的证明器支撑，而每个已证公式都能生成可在 Isabelle 中检验的定理，从而增强了学生证明的可信度与可复用性。

title: A Lean formalization of Matiyasevič's Theorem
summary: This work formalizes Matiyasevič's theorem in the Lean theorem prover, showing that the power function is Diophantine. This supplies the final and most difficult component of the MRDP theorem establishing the unsolvability of Hilbert's 10th problem. The development required building a small number theory library, notably covering solutions of Pell's equation and properties of the Pell x,y sequences.
significance: Formalizing the last hard step of the MRDP theorem in Lean significantly raises confidence in a classical result at the boundary of logic and number theory, while the accompanying Pell equation library is a reusable artifact that can support further formal developments.

zh.title: Matiyasevič 定理（Matiyasevič's Theorem）的 Lean 形式化
zh.summary: 本工作在 Lean 定理证明器中形式化了 Matiyasevič 定理（Matiyasevič's Theorem），证明幂函数是丢番图（Diophantine）的。这补全了 MRDP 定理中最后且最困难的一环，该定理确立了希尔伯特第十问题（Hilbert's 10th problem）的不可解性。这一形式化工作需要构建一个小的数论库，尤其是佩尔方程（Pell's equation）的解以及佩尔 x,y 序列的性质。
zh.significance: 在 Lean 中形式化 MRDP 定理的最后一步，显著提升了这一处于逻辑与数论交界处的经典结果的可信度，同时所构建的佩尔方程库可作为可复用成果，支撑后续的形式化工作。
